I bet you like the cute, bubbly types, don't you?
We have lots to do today, so no slacking off!
Hey! I have a good feeling about today.
Today's the best day of the year! Happy birthday, Sensei!

Today's my birthday! So for a birthday gift...
...I want you to spend the day with me!
Happy New Year! I hope you have a really good one.
Christmas is a time for everyone to be happy! Every Trinity girl likes to celebrate Christmas.
Halloween has only just begun. Let's go! The festival should start soon!

Normal.Transcription: Nice to meet you, Sensei. I'll show you what a Millennium girl can do.
If only there were a way to have the vending machine stocked with only energy drinks.
Hmm... Why don't we continue after taking a nap?
Need...more...sugar...
If I fix this part this way, and that part thataway... Good. Time for some modifications.
Hmm. Huh? What was I doing just now? I was playing a new game.
It's an old weapon... This weapon contains memories that cannot be quantified.
Hm... These are surprising results.
I need even more data.
The energy this fills me with is priceless.
Researching and uncovering obscure knowledge is always fun.
Once this research is done... I'd like to study you next, Sensei.
It would be fascinating to examine the human mind under a microscope.
I wonder if there's a mechanical contraption that could measure my affection for you, Sensei.
If only I could use my ability to turn back time... I want to enjoy this moment forever.

Battle.Transcription: A chance to prove my skills.

Lobby.Transcription: Hello, Sensei. Would you like a cup of coffee?
Welcome, Sensei. You're here approximately 43 seconds earlier than I expected.

Believe it or not, I'm pretty good at games.
You wanna test my skills, Sensei?

Cheat...?
I may be a hacker, sure, but that would take all the fun out.
Do people think hackers are just a bunch of cheaters or something?

I hack because knowledge should be free.
That's what I believe.
The sweetest soda is the drink of intellectuals.

Happy birthday, Sensei.
Today, I bestow unto you Hare's Protection. It's code which will protect you from every bug regardless of what coding language you use.

Um, this isn't what I meant by Raspberry Pi...
Still, thank you for remembering my birthday.
Hello, new world.

Did you know, Sensei?
Christmas is the time of year where people do a certain something together.
Heh heh. You know what I mean... Hacking, of course.

Why am I not outside enjoying the festival?
Because the Halloween Festival can be enjoyed the same from behind a screen.

Normal.Transcription: Makeup doesn't make a girl beautiful—passion does.
If I made a Sensei Bot, I could make a fortune...
Now that I think about it, the helicopter could use a tune-up.
Hmm... How about a battle-ready bidet?
I'm surprised no one wants camouflage underwear. I was so confident that it would be popular...
Hmm... Is there anything that needs to be repaired?
A miracle happening at my fingertips. Design and production... Sensei, look forward to my genius.
Sensei, your consideration fills me with warmth.
Upgrades improve quality of life. And it happened to me of all people!
The more you work with machines, the more you understand the kindness of their creators.
Making something for someone else brings a meister joy.
I'm usually making things at the workshop, so I'm not used to conversation. But...you're different, Sensei.
The human mind is fascinating. I'm not sure what the mechanism is, but my heart is pounding.
It's still more likely to happen in my dreams, but...I want to go to space one day. It'll be hard work, but when I do, I'll take you with me, Sensei.
I'll always be here in this workshop. If you need help, come by anytime, Sensei...

Battle.Transcription: Get ready to see technique that's been honed for ages.
Our superior skills will ensure our victory.
修理ならなんでも任せてくれ。

Lobby.Transcription: Welcome, Sensei. Let's do our best today!

Calling upon my expertise was the right decision.
I'm going to prove that to you.
(Hmm. Sensei can be...very hard to read.)
I thought it might come to this. I'm looking forward to the opportunity to finally work together.
Millennium battles are decided by the abilities of the technicians around you.
With you by our side, our potential is greater than ever.
The true beauty of a machine can be found in its logic, precision, and simplicity.

Happy birthday, Sensei.
So, how old are you turning this year?

Today is my birthday?
I see. It completely slipped my mind. It's never been that important to me...
But...it makes me happy that you remembered my birthday, Sensei.

Happy New Year, Sensei.
I'm going to be a nicer person this year...
...because I'm with you.

I hope Santa brings me the latest gadget.
What? You think I should make it myself?
Hmm. Well...
Making my own Santa could be difficult...

I was asked to make a moving pumpkin doll.
But...mine was rejected because of its self-destruct capabilities.
I don't get it. What's the point of even building a robot that can't self-destruct?

Normal.Transcription: I'm Okusora Ayane. You can count on my support.
Ahaha!
It looks expensive...
Should I hide some snacks here...?
How does it work?
Is this okay...?
Hahaha... I don't know if I can handle something like this very well, but...I'm sure it'll work out somehow if I look at manuals and stuff, right? Thank you!
Hahaha... Thank you for your concern, Sensei.
This will make it easier for me to support everyone else!
Uh... Is it okay if I grow even more than this?
Yes, I'll be sure to meet your expectations, Sensei.
Mm... I'm so happy we're close, Sensei. B-But what do we do if people think it's strange...?
It seems I'm always in your care, Sensei. I wonder... How I can return the favor?
I still have so much to learn from you, Sensei... So, I want to stay with you longer.
Sometimes I think I don't deserve to stay like this... Hahaha! Forget it—it's nothing.

Battle.Transcription: Whenever you need support, I won't let you down!
It seems I made it on time.
I'll be in charge of support.
ご指示をお願いします。

Lobby.Transcription: Welcome, Sensei. Allow me to go over your schedule.
I-I've been waiting, Sensei.
What kind of tasks are on your itinerary today?
I'll check the schedule too.
Huh? We have to work all night? J-Just the two of us?
N-Not that I mind, but...what will the others think?

Oh, I see. You were just joking.
Yeah.

Happy birthday, Sensei.
Shall I add a birthday party to today's schedule?
What? With me?

You knew it was my birthday?
Oh, wow... Thank you.
To be honest, I wasn't expecting that...

I look forward to working with you this year, Sensei.
I'm glad I get to spend another year with you.

Christmas, huh? I suppose a festive holiday like this is okay from time to time...
Huh? Go out together? M-Me and you?
Happy Halloween! It's been so loud around here, Sensei.

Normal.Transcription: Blue. Archive.
I will fight by your side when you want to overcome adversity and hardship.
We're running low on medical supplies.
Hmm. Well, it's not bad.
Looks cozy.
I'm impressed by how...clean everything is.
Body temperature good, pulse is stable... Hmm. You're perfectly healthy.
The fact that I need more power to heal more people feels like a bad joke. But I will always do my best.
I've grown!
I'll keep giving my all to improve.
Now, I can be even more useful to you, Sensei.
I've become even stronger.
Whenever I'm with you, Sensei, my heart starts racing. For medical personnel, that's quite troubling.
Heehee! You're quite strange, Sensei.
My face feels like I have a fever coming on, but I'm sure I don't have a cold... How strange.
Sensei, it seems you require a lot of care. I...don't dislike that about you.

Battle.Transcription: You're hurt? Oh no! Take this.
If you need help... Leave it to me.
It's not medicine. It's the future.
Your determination will decide things from here.

Lobby.Transcription: Welcome, Sensei. These documents need your attention.
The Prefect Team desires order. Isn't that what Schale wants too?

I'll tell you a secret...
I'm not a fan of needles either.
I hope you know there's no cure for stupidity.

Pardon? You want me to laugh?
...Perhaps if we were alone together.

(If I knock Sensei out and perform CPR...)
(...would that count?)
What? I look lost in thought? No. It's nothing.

Happy birthday, Sensei. You're due for a booster shot.
I'll have to ask you to undo your pants.
Wait! You only have to pull them down slightly!

Today is my birthday. That gives me the right to have you to myself.
Would you...hold my hand?

Happy New Year, Sensei. Last year was very chaotic...
...but I enjoyed it because I was with you.

I like Christmas because its primary color is red. Do you appreciate shades of red like I do, Sensei?
I'll say it now, but it has nothing to do with the color of blood...
Happy Halloween, Sensei. Would you like some candy? These are sugar-free, so they're healthier.

Normal.Transcription: Otose Kotama from Millennium Science School. I find you very intriguing.
There's a wiretapping device in this cafe... Hmm, I see...
The signal is unstable.
How odd. Sensei's GPS signal was detected nearby...
Look at the cafe's new dessert. Uploading to my blog now...
New Momo Friends merchandise. The time of reckoning...has arrived.
Adjusting the hertz... Can you hear me?
This harmonious power... It's like a well-composed orchestral piece.
This has made me even stronger. You can test me if you'd like.
I must hear more of this sweet melody.
I can hear so much more now—including your heartbeat, Sensei!
My heart rate is up, my blood is pumping fast, and my temperature is up. But...I do not know the reason for it.
I've recorded every conversation I've ever had with you, Sensei. Do you...want to listen to them?
Sensei, your voice is like music to my ears. It lifts my spirits.
...I am certain. Sensei, you are special to me.

Battle.Transcription: I am already completely aware of all your goals.
I believe that's an appropriate decision.

Lobby.Transcription: There you are. I could hear you approaching by the sound of your footsteps.
That was a surprise. I nearly screamed, with you showing up out of nowhere like that.

I see your call history is exclusively female students.
I would like an explanation.
...Crime? What do you mean? Wiretapping is not a crime.
Would you care to explain the post that just went up on your private account?

Sensei, could I ask you to sing a song for me?
Please sing into this voice recorder.

I can hear the voice of other girls looking for you, Sensei.
...Let's ignore them.

Happy birthday, Sensei. Though you've probably heard that many times today already...
Then again, it is a sentiment that never loses value or meaning, even over time.

Thank you...for wishing me a happy birthday.
Hearing it from you means more to me than all the other well wishes today.
I look forward to hearing your voice in the coming year more than anything else.

Christmas is an excellent time to listen to wiretaps. You hear all kinds of interesting stories and talks.
Same as...lovers whispering sweet nothings.

I wonder what a rapping Halloween ghost is supposed to sound like.
I could always bug it if I get the chance... I mean, record it. With consent.

Normal.Transcription: I'm Juri from Gehenna's School Lunch Club. Let me know if you're hungry.
Mmm... What a sweet scent.
Do you think this is edible?
Maybe I should try frying it to see what happens.
Oh, wow. This place is nice.
I think I can cook something really tasty here.
Heehee, if you use this gun for cooking, the meat becomes significantly more tender!
Do you think this will help me cook tastier meals?
Good stamina is a must for cooking!
Heehee! I have a sudden urge to cook!
I will try super hard to create an even more delicious dish!
Sensei, spending time with you is as fun as cooking!
The best spice...is love!
What ingredients I should use to express how happy I am...
Anything that includes Sensei is bound to be delicious.

Battle.Transcription: If I flip just like this... Huh...?

Lobby.Transcription: Welcome, Sensei. Aren't you feeling hungry?

Welcome, Sensei. Would you like to eat before we begin?
What about...just a snack?

Ugh...
Why does everything I cook end in failure?
If the ingredients are still moving, that means it's fresh, right?
Do you smell something burning...?
Oh, silly me! I forgot about the pie in the oven!
Which do you think will add more flavor? Sulfuric or hydrochloric acid?

Happy birthday, Sensei!
I baked a cake for you...
...but it, uh, ran away. Yeah...

You want to get me something for my birthday?
Heehee. Hearing you say that is all I could ever want.

I made osechi to celebrate New Year's.
Would you mind giving it a taste?

Um, so I roasted a turkey for Christmas...
It shouldn't still be moving...right?

I'm surprised at how popular my usual snacks are for Halloween.
Apparently, they make for good for pranks.

Normal.Transcription: Is anyone in need of first aid? I would be happy to help.
Does anyone need first aid?
It warms my heart just looking at this place.
A patient would be able to make a speedy recovery in a place like this.
I don't think it's a bad thing to relax like this every now and then.
Oh... What a beautiful shade of pink.
Don't run away just because the shot hurts!
I've become even healthier!
If only I could share this power with those who are sick...
I'll work even harder if it means helping patients!
Have I grown a little? Heeheehee...
Being with you, Sensei, heals my mind, body, and soul...
Heehee! I feel so happy.
Too many people need me for me to be your personal doctor, Sensei... But I'm always thinking of you.
Let's create a peaceful world together!

Battle.Transcription: Phew... I've prepared this for all of you!
Sick and injured get my attention first!
具合の悪い方はいませんか？

Lobby.Transcription: Welcome, Sensei. How are you feeling today?
I've been waiting for you, Sensei. As always, let's work toward creating a peaceful world together!
Oh, a new patient?
You look tired. Would you like me to massage your shoulders?
Fatigue is the root of many illnesses, so don't push yourself too hard.
It always breaks my heart to think about the patients who are suffering.
I can't forgive those who would trample on the peace we have!
Happy birthday, Sensei! I hope your day is filled with warmth and joy!

Thank you for remembering my birthday. Oh? A birthday gift?
Your smiling face is enough for me!
Happy New Year! Be sure to bundle up so you don't ring in the new year with a cold!
Merry Christmas, Sensei. Even if just for one day, I hope people can stop fighting and enjoy a wonderful peace.

I got some Halloween candy!
I love sweets, but if I eat too many, I'll earn myself a trip to the dentist...

Normal.Transcription: We've turned the first page of our story!
I don't see enough books here. You need to stuff that bookshelf.
Oooh. This room is perfect for reading.
Oh, I've never seen this book before!
Heh heh heh! Everything's coming together!
Heehee! I have an idea!
Heeheehee. Those who have overdue books are in big trouble now.
Thank you, Sensei.
The more books you read, the stronger you can become!
Wisdom from all corners of the world can be found in books.
Another mote of knowledge!
I know what love is, you know. I've read all about it in books.
Heehee! I feel just like I do when I finish a good book...happy.
There are some things I can't learn from books. For example, they can't tell me a thing about you.
Learning new things always makes me happy too. What would you like to know about me, Sensei?

Battle.Transcription: Knowledge is food for the soul.
Another testimony to the power of books!
Heehee. If you say so. Here I go!
素晴らしい物語に出会うと、とても幸せになるんです。

Lobby.Transcription: Welcome, Sensei! Did you read the book I gave you?
What kind of book shall I recommend to you today?
Whenever I have spending money, I buy a book first. Clothes or food are secondary.
What kinds of books do I like? Hmm... I'm not choosy when it comes to reading.

Sensei, I wouldn't recommend that book. Four pages from where you are, the main character dies in vain.
...Whoops Was that a spoiler?
It'd be nice if there were more books here. Can I recommend a few?
I wish people would read a little more...
Happy birthday, Sensei! Please let me know if there are any books you're interested in!

Heehee, I love books, but...they're all I get on my birthday, it feels like sort of a letdown.
Today, I'd like to get a special gift from you!
Happy New Year! I'll be counting on you in the months to come.

Merry Christmas! Today's a special day, Sensei!
I'm so glad we can spend time together on a day like this... Teehee.
Halloween is almost here! I'll have to pick out a special mystery or horror novel.

Normal.Transcription: Don't underestimate me because I'm small! I have big potential, you know!
I'm not even done growing yet... How do I know? Just trust me!
Heehee. Maybe I should take a nap before I go.
*sigh* How can you be so oblivious?
I wanna eat some yummy desserts! Oh! Sensei!
Ugh! Regular milk leaves such a gross taste in my mouth. O-Oh. It's strawberry milk?
If I accept something like this... All right! I'll do my best with it!
Th-Th-thank you!
Heehee! Sensei, you can rely on me more if you want!
All right! I'm even stronger now! And I'm taller too, right?! I'm sure of it!
...Thank you, Sensei. I'll be sure to repay the favor.
I guess, you know... N-No. I-It's too embarrassing!
I had...fun today. Really! I-I'm not lying!
D-Don't get me wrong! I really enjoyed my time with you, Sensei—Agh! I feel like I said something I shouldn't have!
Th-Th-thanks! I-I don't know what else to say. But next time... I'll...!

Battle.Transcription: Hmph! I'm going to take you all down!
You should thank me for joining!

Lobby.Transcription: D-Don't pat my head like that! Hmph. I'm not a little kid, okay?!
Do you think, in a few years, I'll look more like a lover than a sibling?
I've been chugging a liter of milk. Every! Single! Day!
I-If I'm on duty…that means I get to have snack time with you too, right, Sensei?
Do your best today! I'll help you however I can!

Sensei? You're not looking too good...
Sh-Should we try some dessert therapy?
As long as I'm here, don't even think about slacking off. That's what I thought! Now, back to work!
Happy birthday, Sensei! There's a decent dessert place nearby. Let's go!

Th-Thank you for remembering.
(I wonder how many years it'll take for people to start thinking we look good side-by-side...)
Why are you looking at me like that? I-I wasn't thinking anything weird! I swear!
Happy New Year! My New Year's resolution? To have a nice body, of course!
Merry Christmas! I love the holidays! The streets and windows are all decked out with my favorite colors!

Trick-or-treat! It's a super special Halloween for the After-School Sweets Club! Let's go!
I don't really care about the ghosts, but the candy aspect is very important to me!

Normal.Transcription: I'm Mashiro, first-year from the Justice Task Force. I may be inexperienced, but I'm here to help however I can.
I doubt Tsurugi would like these kinds of decorations...
This furniture is fluffy like Hasumi's wings...
Tranquil like water...
Is Tsurugi's neck okay...?
I don't mind coming here every once in a while.
How pretty... Heehee.
This is what you call true justice.
Thanks for the support.
I can feel something powerful.
Phew! My battle spirit is burning hot!
I'll do my best in the name of justice.
The justice that lies within you, Sensei... It must be very impressive.
The day you do something unjust, Sensei... No, that day will never come. I'm sure of it. You are justice personified.
The time I get with you always feels so short...
I love—justice! Yes, that's it. I love justice!

Battle.Transcription: Target locked... Target is in range.

Lobby.Transcription: Welcome, Sensei. Let's strive for justice again today.
I've been awaiting your orders.
Oh, are we mobilizing?
You called for me, Sensei?

The goal of the Justice Task Force...
...is to vanquish evil and establish justice.
Justice—in this academy.

I gave my word.
I would endure brutal training and mind-numbing trials...
...so that I could protect justice.
But the time I spent with my upperclassmen was so enjoyable...
Forgive me in advance. Everyone strays from justice from time to time.

But I'm only saying this just in case...
What you're touching right now is not the operational console.

Happy birthday, Sensei.
I hope you feel righteous justice on your birthday.

I see. So today is my birthday.
It must have slipped my mind.
Thank you for telling me.

It's a new year. This year...
I will see injustice stopped once and for all.

This is a holy day for Trinity.
I wonder what sordid activities those Gehenna scum are up to on a day like this...

The festive day to celebrate all of Trinity's saints has come.
Pumpkin ghost...? Did you have a nightmare?

Normal.Transcription: Sensei—er, my lord! Izuna heard your call and came right over! Nin nin!
O-Oh, my lord!
A ninja lives in the shadows, forever lurking in the dark... It's not good for your eyesight.
Should we hide somewhere nearby to gather information?
This place is big enough for Izuna to use her Secret Izuna-Style Ninjutsu 108 Shadow Clone technique...
I am awaiting my lord's orders... I'm so bored!
Th-This is a cutting-edge ninja weapon...! Can Izuna become an elite ninja with this?!
Izuna thinks she could use this to learn even more advanced ninjutsu!
Ah, yet another instance of my lord proving their grace...
Izuna will become a ninja that meets your expectations no matter what, my lord!
Higher! Faster! Izuna might just be the strongest ninja ever, my lord!
My lord, do you think this flutter in my heart that I feel around you is...my sense of duty?
Whenever Izuna is by your side, Izuna is happy. Is this...the joy a ninja feels when serving an honorable lord?
Give me any command. Izuna will be here to obey her lord's orders!
Izuna has always sought someone like you, my lord. At last... Izuna found you, and it makes her very happy.

Battle.Transcription: Ninja-run to the next target area!
Izuna is on her way! Shuriken! Ack!
Allow Izuna to show you ninjutsu!
Izuna will try to avoid them!
If that is your command, my lord!
Feel free to give Izuna any orders!
Nin nin! My lord! How can Izuna help?
Allow Izuna to show you Izuna-Style Ninjutsu!
Mission success! This ninja completed the mission perfectly!
Izuna dedicates this victory to her lord!

Lobby.Transcription: Oh, my lord! I've been waiting for you! I'm looking forward to today! Nin nin!
Welcome, my lord! I want to show you the ninjitsu I studied yesterday!

Izuna's dream is to become the best ninja in Kivotos.
You'll work with me again today, won't you...?

What will today's mission be, my lord? Scouting the enemy camp? Rear infiltration?!
Huh? Studying for tomorrow's test?

Are you going out on a patrol today, my lord?
I'll stick by you as though I were your shadow! Nin nin!

I may be a ninja, but I can also play the role of the femme fatale!
Especially with you, my lord!

What? I'm not supposed to use my skills on you?
Then...I'll have no one else to use it on...

Happy birthday, my lord!
Izuna vows to stay by your side and make this the best birthday ever!

Wh-What? You want to wish ME a happy birthday?
Th-Thank you, m-my lord...

I'm spending New Year's Day with my lord! This is great!
Happy New Year, my lord!

Merry Christmas, my lord!
I prepared Christmas ninjutsu specially for today!

Halloween. Today is the day when ghosts and goblins walk among us...
But don't worry, my lord.
Izuna will keep you safe from their trick and treating ways!

Event.Transcription: My lord! It's the festival! Where should we go first?

My lord! Izuna is really excited for the festival!
Izuna shall follow you!

The festival is already at this stage.
My lord! Were should we look next?

Aw. The festival is ending soon, right?
Whatever it takes! Please stick with Izuna till the very end, my lord!

The Hyakkiyako Cherry Blossom Festival is already over...
There's still plenty of festivals to come.
Please hang out with Izuna again, my lord!
Hmm hmm hmmm. Izuna, on the lookout! ♪

Izuna senses a presence... It's my lord!
Were you looking for Izuna? Heehee.

Dango, senbei, okonomiyaki...!
There's so much food Izuna wants to eat with you!
Izuna is ready! My lord, Izuna will protect you by being your festival guide! Nin nin!

Normal.Transcription: I'm Shizuko of the Festival Operations Department! I look forward to working with you, Sensei... Huh? I'm trying to be professional here!
Moe moe...kyun! D-Did I do it right?
I need to get back to preparing for the festival.
How should we spruce up Momoyodou's menu?
Maybe we should try something bold... Like kimono-style bunny girl outfits.
Do you think we could use this place as a temporary shop for Momoyodou?
This is something that's not for sale at any festival, right? Heeheehee, I'll cherish it, Sensei!
Heehee. I feel like you cherish me, Sensei! Nyan! Probably because I'm so cute, right?
Woohoo! I grew! Victory!
Yes, well... I'll do my best to live up to your expectations...
Sensei, you're so nice to me... I'll do my best as the owner of Momoyodou and as a pop idol!
S-Sensei, you're s-so close...! The distance between us is so...! I-Is this okay?
This sweet sensation is like a mouthful of anmitsu from Momoyodou...
When I'm with you, Sensei...my day feels like one big festival. Isn't that SO mysterious?
Even the best festivals have to end eventually. But until then, will you stay by my side?

Battle.Transcription: Momoyodou will open wherever we're needed! Ah...! The tea cup...!
Wah! What if I don't recoup my costs?!
I-I won't let this get me d-down!
Ugh! It's merchandise from the shop...!
As expected of Sensei! You have a good eye!
Let's go! A chance to earn festival money ...No, I mean...I'll do my best!

Lobby.Transcription:
Heehee, you're back, Sensei!
Heehee. That was perfect.

Ugh. I'm getting exhausted...
Oh, Sensei, you're here! Sit down, sit down! Please, make yourself comfortable!
Yes, Sensei? Which task can I help you with today? You can count on me!

I don't know why I always let my guard down when I'm with you.
Is it...just because of who you are, Sensei?

Ah... When I go back to Momoyodou, there will be a lot of work waiting for me.
Do I not wanna go back?
Heehee. That's not it. It's what I'm supposed to do.

What? You think I'm cute?
D-Don't tease me like that! You know how I really am. I'm so...
That's what's cute about me? U-Ugh...

You're careful with your wallet, right, Sensei? You need to be careful with it, okay?
The festival and Momoyodou's anmitsu are waiting for us.

Happy birthday, Sensei.
Now, let's go to Momoyodou. The Festival Operations Department president declares that it's time for a birthday party!

What?! You want to celebrate my birthday?
A-Ah! D-Don't look at me! I know my face looks really weird right now!
Heh. Heh heh. Heh heh heh...

Happy New Year! I'm going to spend New Year's Day dozing on the kotatsu!
Five more minutes...
Today is Christmas! Let's go Sensei! The Festival Department can't just sit around do nothing.

Trick or treat! If the students try to trick us, they'll have to order our anmitsu!
What? We can't force them to? Why not?

Event.Transcription: Welcome to the Momoyodou shop! Now, Master, what do you need today?

Oh, Sensei. Welcome.
Now, choose to your liking!

The festival is over, but we're still open.
I'll personally bless the remaining items. Look around, Sensei!

Momoyodou won't be stopped, even if there is a festival!
Well, we are the Festival Operations Department after all. Heehee.

Great. Here it's... Moe moe...kyun!
Huh? This looks old? How so?!
Oh, that! No, no. It's not like I was thinking about taking the leftovers!
Your choice... I knew you had good taste, Sensei!
As always, thank you, Master!
That's a good item, right? Heehee.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive
Go with the light at your back, hero.
I must prepare for round two.
I would also like a cup of coffee.
It is important to take a few breaks. They restore your HP.
I want to go on another raid. Expect a DM later, Sensei.
I like to be petted. It warms my artificial proteinic skin.
This is the...legendary holy sword...! Oh, it is a gun.
Level up! I pulled a lot of EXP!
Everyone has taught me the benefits of games and friendship. What are you here to teach me, Sensei?
Look, Sensei. I finally got the hang of smiling!
Sensei! Objectively speaking, this is the strongest I have ever been!
I want to improve Sensei's favorability too!
What I feel when I encounter a new game, raise my level, or succeed at equipment enhancement is nothing to the fascinating and inexplicable sensations I experience when I see you, Sensei.
Contact with Sensei has programmed something within me. A big something...that does not have a value. The name of this feeling...
I am happy...to have met Sensei.

Battle.Transcription: I am here, and I will help!
As long as I have my party, I will not be afraid.
Courage! That is the best magic.
MP charge is at 100%. Here I go!
Target confirmed. Breaking through the output threshold!
The hand of justice crushes evil...
I will pour my full willpower into this light and break through! Balance destroyed!!
Confirmed elimination of enemies. Mission complete.

Lobby.Transcription: Welcome, Sensei. I have been waiting for you.

What kind of adventure will you embark upon today?
I am ready to accompany you at any time.
A new game is coming out soon! You will play it with me, correct?

Mmm. I am hungry. Huh...?
No! I do not eat batteries!

It has been many a millennium since humans last set foot here...
I have always wanted to say that.

I do not know why, but I can shed tears.
They must be to wash my ocular lenses.

Sensei, our next destination is an arcade...
L-Lying? I would never!

Today marks the anniversary of the first day you logged in to your life. To me, that moment is the best gift I have ever received.
Congratulations, Sensei.

Today is my birthday. The day I got to meet everyone.
It is also the day I met you for the first time.

Happy New Year...
Abort! Now is not the time for that!
Sensei! The New Year's event is underway!

Santa Claus allegedly leaves presents for good boys and girls.
I hope you will be my gift, Sensei.
Ghosts are not scary. Dark-type monsters are weak to light-type spells.

Event.Transcription: What do I need to do today?
Ah, I was supposed to organize...

Even without armor...
In fact, even if I lose the Sword of Light...
No matter what, I am still Aris.
As long as I am with everyone!
And as long as I am with Sensei!
Sensei! A mission! It is a mission!
Yes! I really like Sensei, because you never change!

Bum bum bum!
Sensei has earned a reward!

You are very cool, Sensei!
We shall do it one by one!

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive.
I'm the best player around! I'll help you out.
Hmm... This game is actually kinda fun.
I hear this game's getting a sequel. That's it, I'm getting a part-time job.
When I'm all grown up...I might grow out my hair.
C'mon... C'mon... The claw picked it up!
All right, now I just need to... Clear!
I don't know if this is the right way to describe a weapon, but it's beautiful. I'm happy.
I want to get better at drawing. I also want to be of more help to you, Sensei.
It's a great feeling when your efforts pay off.
I want to be an adult. Then I can be a reliable pillar for everyone...or for you...
Thank you, Sensei. I'll keep on doing my best.
You're always so kind, Sensei.
Please keep making good memories with the Game Development Department. And...with me... Ah! Never mind!
When I make a game, I want you to be the first one to play it, Sensei.
Sometimes...I wanna spend time alone with you, without Momoi. Uh... C-Can I hold your hand?

Battle.Transcription: The very basic element of playing in a party is teamwork.
I want to hurry back and play games...
Clear. Let's move on to the next stage.
*sigh* ...I lost. Guess it is what it is!
I'm...slightly frustrated. Now, let's try this out.
I don't hold a grudge, but you better watch out.
Consecutive sniping shots! Here I go!
Ah, yes. I'll do my best.
I'll do it properly, since it's my responsibility now.

Lobby.Transcription: Welcome, Sensei. Let's be sure to work hard today as well.
I'm going to work hard so today is special for both of us.

I'm worried about the Game Development Department.
I know I'll be okay as long as I'm with you...
You played our game too, right? Which part was your favorite?

I want to draw even more beautiful things... But I need to practice.
Can you help me?
I don't want my art to just be about moe, I want it to convey "love" too.

Hmm... It's a tight budget again this month.
Do we get paid if we're on the roster?

I want to wish you a happy birthday, Sensei!
I don't know what you like, so...
Do you wanna come pick something out with me?

I think birthdays should always be spent with family.
So I've got to hang out with Momoi today. Wanna come with, Sensei?
Happy New Year! I'll be counting on you this year as well.

Merry Christmas! Today's a day made for couples.
...I-Is something I heard once!

I'm not usually a big Halloween fan, but maybe with you, and everyone else, this year...
I think it'll be fun. I'm excited!

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive!
Wanna hear a fun story? Let me tell you!
Games! Games! I just want to play games!
Huh? I used to watch this series when I was young.
Hmm... We don't have enough for everyone's snacks. Should I get a part-time job?
Oh! I just thought of a wonderful story idea!
Great! All clear!
Th-This is exclusive equipment! I am now a proud, OP schoolgirl!
I need more EXP!
Level Up! This is always an exciting moment!
I want to become stronger! So that I can become the big sister who protects everyone!
Now my firepower's going to get serious!
If you want to raise my bond rank, buy me more new releases!
Ugh... What am I setting up for? I don't even know what to expect yet.
Huh? Did I just set myself up for a... N-No! I didn't!
One needs life experience to make the best game. Including love experience... Right?

Battle.Transcription: Umm... I'm more confident if I'm using a controller...
Always keep a close eye on the HP gauge!
Okay... Just like this... Ehhh! Ugh... I won't forgive you!
Heh. This is f... Huh? I died?! I can't believe it!
I wo— Huh?! I lost?! Seriouslyyy?!
I have to go buy ice cream now! It's all because of you!
Kyah! Hold o— I can't play games like this!
Let's finish up quickly and head back!

Lobby.Transcription: Welcome, Sensei! Let's start a mission!
I'm all ready. Let's go! We've got quests to clear!

There's a difference between pro gamers and game lovers.
Which one are you?
Oh! That new game is coming out today.

I was supposed to go on a raid today! But I'm on the roster instead!
...I guess this isn't so bad, either.
The mission can wait, Sensei. Let's play a game first!
You're so lucky, Sensei... You can buy any game, whenever you want.
Happy birthday, Sensei! Let's go chow down with everyone from the club!

Sensei! Today's me and Midori's birthday!
Buy us a two-player game that we can play together!
Happy New Year! Let's play fun games this year!

Christmas... *sigh*
If you dress up in red and gift me a console, this'd be the best Christmas ever!
Wow! It's Halloween! I'm so excited, Sensei! C'mon, get me some candy!

Normal.Transcription: The Great Leader of Red Winter Academy is here! Feel honored, Comrade!
Hmm... I like it. The Great Leader is quite pleased.
Hmm... I see everything is in order.
Ahem. Her honorable-ness has arrived.
What a peaceful day. And it's all thanks to me! Hahaha!
(Is my mustache on right...?)
I absolutely love it. My authority! My power! My mustache! It's almost enough to intimidate even myself... But don't worry, Comrade. I'll always be with you.
This power is...overwhelming! Do you see this, comrade?!
Not bad, not bad at all... There are no limits to my growth!
This right here is the power of Red Winter!
That's pretty good! Right, comrade?
St-Stop embarassing me, or...or you'll be purged!
Ah... Thanks, comrade.
Aw, gee!
Heh, heeheehee...

Battle.Transcription: There shall be no time to rest!
Let's use this momentum to take everything down!
How's this? Does it properly convey the full might of the Great Leader's pow—Oh! My mustache...!
That's all you got? Puhahahaha! ...Huh? Oh, wow!
State Guard, emerge! Over there! Fire!
Go, my State Guard! That's the purge target!
Do I need to assert my authority?
Huh, oh! L-let go of me!
Comrades! It is time to do your duty!
This is the power of Red Winter!
You were just admiring my greatness, right, comrade?

Lobby.Transcription: There you are, Comrade! We have much to do and so little time!
You're here, Comrade! We've got a big day ahead! You'd best be ready!
Did you call me, Comrade?
You're with me today. It's time to partake in revolution, Comrade!

Can't you feel my authority?
Worry not, Comrade. You have nothing to fear. I am quite merciful.

Huh? My mustache fell off?
Huh...? Nooooo! My authority...
What the heck? It's right where it's supposed to be! Is this a joke to you?!
Heehee... I'm glad we're together again, Comrade.

It's your birthday? Really?
Very well. I shall create a new annual celebration to mark this day!

Um... I admit, I'm a little embarrassed...
My grand superiority feels somewhat lessened when you tell me happy birthday...
But thank you anyway, Comrade!

Happy New Year, Comrade! Are your resolutions for the new year in order?
If not, then I'd be happy to advise you!

Today's date is... Right, Christmas! That day when a fat, old man gives gifts to kids.
That's amazing! I want a gift too!

Halloween... The masses always get so loud and annoying.
Oh, my mustache...? It's not a Halloween costume!
Ask again, and you'll be purged, Comrade!

Event.Transcription: The purge begins now!
Heehee. It's time for revolution!
Excited for Ivan Kupala's festival!
Hmm? Need my help, Comrade?
I can't believe there are students who still defy the authority of the mustache!
Purge them all!

For this year's Ivan Kupala, I've prepared a huge... uh... um...
Pudding! A huge pudding!
Once the purge is done we can share among us.

Normal.Transcription: Are you the one that I've been watching through my telescope? Ooh, I'm so excited!
Heehee. I found some cool furniture!
I wonder what's beyond...
If I don't escape from the Spec Ops...
The view here is spectacular!
I wonder where Sensei is...?
Thank you, Sensei! I'll treat it as preciously as this telescope!
I feel like my eyes got a lot better.
Thanks to this, I know so many details of Sensei's daily life.
Thank you, Sensei. I'll do my absolute best observation work!
I'll earn my way out of Spec Ops if I keep doing my best, right?
Heeheehee... I feel so self-conscious when I'm talking to you face-to-face like this...
As long as I'm with you, I'm not afraid...even in the most bitter cold weather!
More... I want to know more about you, Sensei!
The moon looks beautiful tonight, Sensei.

Battle.Transcription: Heehee! I see everything, you know.
A-Are you putting your faith in me?
If you're okay with a student like me...

Lobby.Transcription:
I knew you'd be back soon!
I was... I was watching you!

Huh? But Sensei was here just now...
Ah! You scared me! When did you get here? I wasn't watching you!
*pant* *pant* ...I have the most fun when I'm watching you, Sensei.
I never get sick of your face no matter how many times I look at it!
Ugh... You're not supposed to be like that with other people.

When you're looking out at this big wide world...
...you realize that we're all so insignificant.
I hope you and I can go stargazing one of these days.

Happy birthday, Sensei!
I'll be watching to make sure nothing bad happens to you today!

Did you know, Sensei? If you look up at the stars on my birthday...
...you can see a pair of stars flying across the southern skies. That day is...
...today!
This year,I'm gonna get out of this place and go back to the main institute.

If you look up at the night sky from far below on Christmas...
...all the stars shine so beautifully.
I wonder if I'll get any candy this Halloween...

Event.Transcription: Oh, Sensei? Did you bring something to eat?

Thank you so much for the supplies!
We'll find some way to repay you!

The festival is already halfway over.
Well, we don't have anything to do with it anyways...

Looks like Ivan Kupala will be over soon too.
If you find anything else that might be delicious or useful...
Please bring it to us!
It's the last day of the festival, Sensei. Anything you're forgetting?
The festival is over, but we still need all the supplies we can get!
Spec Ops No. 227 is always low on sweets...
When do you think we can return to the main institute...?
Wow! That looks so tasty!
Can we really eat it?

Normal.Transcription: I'm Yuzu, president of the Game Development Department. You're really going to accept me?
I guess...you like the mature types?
I want to study games more seriously.
This area looks nice. I want to take a nap right here.
Um... I wonder if there's anywhere to hide.
Ack! What are you doing here?!
I feel like power is filling my body. Is this...courage?
I'm feeling a little relieved... Thanks to you, Sensei...
I...I want to be more confident.
When am I scared? Hm... Maybe when you're not by my side...
I-I'm not strong. But I'll try my best...because I really like everyone.
I-I wasn't a burden? In that case... Heehee, I'm glad.
I'm not sure... I really am not used to this... But I'm happy.
When Sensei is teaching or leading... Sensei is really...cool...
S-Sensei, I also...um, well... It's e-embarrasing!

Battle.Transcription: I took cover here and drew their attention. Like this!
I-I'll need to emulate the qualities of a president first...
I managed it somehow... I-I'll keep going!
Phew. I'm happy I could be of help...
S-Sensei, if you need to...then I...
I-I'll do my best to get closer...I think...
W-With other people...?! I-I'll try my best!
Success... I'm happy. So this is what it feels like.

Lobby.Transcription: Sensei... You're here. I was waiting for you.
Sensei... Welcome.
A favor for you? Anytime.

Yes, you can ask me anything.
I'll... I'll do my best!

Oh... I really want a pet cat.
Games and cats... That's all I need to be happy in life.

Yes, Sensei. I'm going to become stronger.
Just like how you and everyone else protected me... I want to help everyone too.
(I want to be someone worthy of standing by their side.)

Happy birthday, Sensei.
I mean that...from the bottom of my heart!

Today is...my birthday.
It's Kivotos' Culture Day... Don't forget!

Happy New Year.
I'm gonna show you just how much I can grow.

Merry Christmas, Sensei.
There's something Santa and video games have in common. Both of them make you feel so excited.

The streets are filled with flickering jack-o-lanterns and candy.
I want to go too. With you, Sensei...

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive.
I'm Shirasu Azusa, a transfer to Trinity. I work solo and can take cover easily due to my size. Any other questions?
Hmm. Not bad, I suppose.
(So many interesting things...)
What's that?
Heehee. That's funny.
So cute!
Sensei, I want you to decide how I should use this power. Because I am here for you.
Tactical execution capabilities improved.
I've become stronger.
Yes, I'll make sure to meet your expectations.
I've grown. Thank you.
This emotion... I did not expect this...
Ah, um... Th-Thank you.
U-Uh, thanks for your consideration.
My heart is beating... I don't know what to do.

Battle.Transcription: Everything's mostly taken care of here. Let's go.
Vanitas vanitatum. All is in vain...!
It's still all right. If there's something else, leave it to me.

Lobby.Transcription: I've been waiting, Sensei. What's today's mission? Anything I can help with?
You're back, Sensei. Let me know if there's anything you need done.

If life has no intrinsic meaning, then why do we live at all?
Huh? Oh, it's nothing.

Missions. Objectives. Achievements.
I've never really thought about much else...
...until now, anyway.

I wonder if I'm being helpful...
I am?
I-I see...
It's okay. I know I'm no fun. Sorry to disappoint you.

One of these days...
...I might fall short of your expectations.

Even if none of this matters, it's okay if I'm with you.
Happy birthday.

Are you really...celebrating my birthday?
Is it really okay to celebrate a birthday like mine?
I was happy to hear it... Thank you.

Here's to surviving another year. I hope next year we'll...
N-Nothing!

Christmas... A holy day, and one of the most important of the year.
Is it really okay for someone like me to be with you like this today?

It's loud and crazy. I just don't care for it.
But if you like it, then I'll do my best to care.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive.
I'm Urawa Hanako. I look forward to working with you, in all kinds of ways.
What a cute, cozy place!
Did you do the interior design, Sensei? It's adorable!
Maybe I should casually just leave something behind...
Or, hm... Maybe I should play a prank...
Heehee. This is so much fun!
You are so silly, Sensei. Do you really want to see everything from me? Heehee! I'm talking about my skill. What were you thinking?
Heehee! Seems like I've grown more, doesn't it?
Thank you, Sensei.
I'll be sure to return the favor. Did you have anything special in mind, Sensei?
If you're this considerate all the time... I won't be able to hold back.
Can I...trust you, Sensei?
You can go further, right, Sensei?
I want you to see me as I really am, Sensei.
Sensei... Would you rather have pain and suffering?

Battle.Transcription: I'd like to be of some help...
Oh my, is it my turn?
Oh my, you're bold, aren't you...?

Lobby.Transcription: You're here, Sensei! I look forward to working with you today.
Heehee. I've been waiting, Sensei.
Heehee, I guess it's kind of fun to be on duty like this.

I think it's just the two of us here...
Maybe I'm kind of excited?

Huh? What do I mean?
I'm not sure... What DO I mean?
Do you need me to do anything, Sensei?
Heehee. I just wanted to see that expression of yours, Sensei.

Happy birthday, Sensei.
Is there a particular gift you've been wanting? If not...
...I could always be your gift.

Um... A birthday gift...
Oh, you're the gift, Sensei? Heehee. Just what I wanted!
When can I unwrap it?

I look forward to working with you this year, Sensei.
I'm sure I'll make lots of mistakes, but please don't leave me, okay?

A holy night. I'm so excited...
Huh? I was just talking to myself. Please pay it no mind.

It's Halloween. It's the day everyone shows a little more skin...
Huh? That's not what it is?

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive.
Shimoe Koharu... Mark my words. I won't be here for long!
Ugh. Normies...
Ugh...
I have no plans of getting to know you better.
If I come across anything unseemly, I'll get rid of every bit of it.
Everyone looks so excited.
I made it this far. Sensei, you saw it, right? This is just the beginning. Please continue to watch over me.
Y-You don't have to go to such lengths to take care of me...
You're watching me grow...? Sounds kind of weird...
Heehee. See? I can also grow like this!
Heehee, not a bad result, right?
There's a lot I can't do yet, but I'll keep working hard!
Seriously, all you do is tease me... But I appreciate the support anyway.
Lewdness is strictly forbidden, but... No! No, that's not allowed either!
I-I'm close with Sensei because, well, they're my sensei! That's all there is to it! Really!

Battle.Transcription: Look! This is all thanks to my excellent performance!
This is nothing... It's really not all great...
It's not mine! Don't get the wrong idea!
Wh-Why are you asking about this...? S-Stop talking!
That doesn't leave me with much choice.
Wh-What are you trying to do?
You see that? That's how good I am.

Lobby.Transcription: Oh, Sensei. Welcome.
I've been waiting, Sensei.
I-I won't forgive anyone being naughty where I can see!
Quiet about my grades...! I'm trying my best.
I'm gonna do my best to quickly graduate from the Make-Up Work Club.

N-Naughty things...?
No such thing allowed! I'm gonna confiscate everything and burn it into ashes!

Teacher-student relationships are completely inappropriate!
That can't happen in Kivotos!

It's your birthday, Sensei. You can relax today.
No, wait! You can't slack off just because it's your birthday!

Y-You knew today is my birthday?
Th-Thank you. I didn't think you'd remember.
That makes me weirdly happy...

Are you sure you want to spend your New Year's with me?
N-Not that I'd care, mind you.
Nothing illicit will taint this holy night! You got that, Sensei?!

Candy? I'm too grown up for candy! I-I want something more adult-ish...
N-Never mind.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive.
Shirasu Azusa. Arrived at the objective. Let's go straight to the next, not that I'm particularly excited.
This place isn't so uncomfortable. Not bad.
I feel like I'm being watched.
Heehee.
I have to admit this is cute...
Might be just a bit tired...
This is exactly what I needed. Thank you. I'll make sure you won't regret it.
Thanks for your unwavering support. Someday, I'll repay you.
I've definitely grown..
The constant support is helpful.
Yes, it's not a bad feeling.
I'm quite satisfied. How about you, Sensei?
No hesitation. I prefer things this way...
Just a bit more... I wish this moment would last longer.
I understand now. The beach is...fun.

Battle.Transcription: As expected, there is no correlation between my clothing and my results.
Mission complete. Let's head to the next location.
Just look at that endless sea and sky... Ah! Oof...!
The breeze feels good... Oh.... Wh-What the—
Well, then. I'll leap into action.
I knew from the start this would happen.
This makes me...all kinds of happy.

Lobby.Transcription: I've been waiting. Hurry, Sensei. What's the next mission?

I hope...this can continue...
Hmm? When did you arrive?

Wh-Why are you staring at me?
I knew it. Is my outfit too flashy?

To be honest, I don't have the ability to judge for myself.
I'm not sure how I look...
If this is what you want Sensei, then I'll follow your decision.

Hmm? What am I doing?
Nothing in particular, really.
And that's how I like it.

I get to experience a lot of new things when I'm with you.
I never could have imagined this in the past.

These clothes offer no particular defense to my midsection.
Hmm? You think it makes it more powerful? What is that supposed to mean?

Happy birthday, Sensei.
The days we can relax and talk together...
I'm really glad to have them.

Hmm? Happy...birthday?
Oh, yes... Thank you, Sensei.

Another year safely gone by. Hopefully this summer as well...
N-No. It's not that I'm looking forward to...

I don't think the outfit is suitable at all...
But that makes it better?
I don't understand.

Well, people often wear flashy clothing today.
So I think this will be fine.

Event.Transcription: Ocean... Summer...
Hmm? What the...? What are you looking at?
Welcome, Sensei. There's a lot to do.
This swimsuit is so cute! Heehee.
S-Sensei? Were you staring at me?
S-Stop looking... I'm really not used to this.
I-I'm fine... Don't mind me.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive.
Trinity Justice Task Force first-year, Mashiro. Wherever it may be, under any circumstance, I will support you, Sensei—with all my might.
Something feels suspicious, but...
Surely there won't be students causing a commotion at a place like this, right?
(It would've been great to come here with the upperclassmen.)
(This location offers a great vantage point.)
(Tranquil and still, like water...)
Is this also...true justice?
Whether it's for duty or for fun, I'll do it the proper way.
Your lessons are always easy to understand.
Another fruitful bout of training.
So this is the power of justice...
When I'm with you, even the blazing heat feels oddly pleasant.
What a beautiful beach... Thank you for bringing me here, Sensei. It's just as I thought... You truly understand justice.
Sensei, why don't we play on the beach over there? E-Even justice needs time to recuperate!
Sensei, um... W-Would you like to have some ice cream...with me?

Battle.Transcription: Now for some heat stroke preventatives.
Not a single moment of rest to be had.
And here I was looking forward to some time off...
I'm glad I thought ahead and brought plenty of drinks.
One shouldn't drink too much sparkling water.
What would you think of showering in sparkling water?
I will wash away all evil.
Never let your guard down, not even on vacation.
Would you like a drink as well, Sensei?

Lobby.Transcription: Welcome, Sensei! How shall we train today?

I've been waiting, Sensei. Let's go and have fun in the water...
I mean, let's go begin training!
Alas, let's sortie!
Justice is never out of season!

Cute swimsuits are justice...?
I'll keep that in mind.
You mean this? It's a normal popsicle.
Are you okay with eating something that I've been eating?

Happy birthday, Sensei.
I'll stay by your side and protect you so that your day can be perfect, Sensei.

A birthday present? I see...
...but this popsicle is more than enough for me, as long as I'm with you, Sensei.
Happy New Year. I'm already looking forward to this year's summer training.

Summer is over and now it's already Christmas.
Good times fly by so quickly.
I'm starting to enjoy the warm pumpkin soup served in the dining hall.

Event.Transcription: It's pretty hot today too. Watch out for heat strokes!
Now, let's begin the special summer training!
I'm nervous. It's my first time at the beach with other Trinity students...
The wise ones like the water...
(Maybe I could have gotten a color other than black for a swimsuit...)
Just now, I think I heard Tsurugi's despair.
Whether it's for duty or for fun, I'll do it the proper way.
Surely students wouldn't cause a commotion at a place like this...
Never let your guard down, not even on vacation.

Normal.Transcription: Bluuue Archive!
Keheehee! Oh... S-Sensei?
I-Is it really okay for me to be here?
H-Huh?! Sensei?!
Y-You see...um... Ugh... Ahhh!
I'm more at ease on the battlefield...
A place like this... I-I...!
Heeheeheehee... No doubt... Heeheeheeheeheeheehee!!!
Kyahahahahaha!!!
Ehehehehehe...!!
Good...! Very good!!
This... This is it!!
Ah... Ugh?! S-Sensei...?!
Th-Thank you...Sensei...
I don't think I'll ever get used to this, but...thank you.
With everything you've given me, how could I...?

Battle.Transcription: Who needs a pool when there's a sea of blood?!
I won't let you get away!
Let's take this to another level...!

Lobby.Transcription:
Y-You're here, Sensei!
L-Looking forward to today...
I-I've been waiting. Sensei!
Kehee....heeheehee... Keheehee!!

Ke-hahaha
Hahahaha!!! Kekekeke!!!

Yes? S-Sensei...?
How long have you been standing there...?
Hmm? The whole time?! Then...?!

S-So...about that...
I don't know how I should explain it.
B-Birthday... Just say whatever you want, Sensei!

B-Birthday? Y-You remembered my birthday?!
Th-Thank you...Sensei.
I'm looking forward to the coming year, Sensei.

Th-This doesn't feel like an appropriate look for a day like this.
What? You think it's fine as is?

The streets are glowing strangely, and so busy.
So this is, Halloween...

Event.Transcription: S-Sensei, um... It's n-nice to meet you!
(I wonder what Sensei thinks about how I look...)
Wh-Whoa!
Oh... Um... Uh...
I...I'm ready, Sensei.
(What to do, what to do...? What am I going to do?!)

Ts-Tsurugi!
Let's go!

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive!
I-I know this look is still very modest. But if you're okay with it, I'm happy to help!
It's a little embarrassing to wear this in a cafe.
The furniture has a summer vibe too...
(No wonder. I had a feeling I was attracting attention.)
(The warmth of the summer sun feels great...)
(Is there any summer-exclusive Peroro merch?)
This firearm is waterproof, right...?
Heehee... I wonder if I'm any fancier with this...
I'll try even harder!
I practiced swimming just in case.
Anything for Peroro!
As long as I get to spend time with you, Sensei, this summer will be the best one yet!
When I'm with you, Sensei, even the darkest depths of the ocean don't scare me!
My heart... It's all aflutter.
Sensei, please spend time with me next summer too!

Battle.Transcription: This is the highly-exclusive, limited-edition Peroro bomb!
It's a perfect day for a vacation!
Everyone, please step away from the tank!

Lobby.Transcription: Sensei, it's the ocean! The ocean is waiting for us!
The weather's nice today, Sensei. Are you up for a walk on the beach?
I heard we were going to the beach, so I put this on.
How does it look? Is it too plain?
We can't leave out Peroro, even during a vacation on the beach!
I thoroughly prepared waterproofing measures to prevent Peroro's soft feathers from getting wet!
Hmm? Sensei, have you seen Crusadie that was parked at the front of the Schale building?

Happy birthday, Sensei!
I want you to have my cherished Peroro tube as a gift!
What do I want for my birthday?

Thanks, but I'm okay.
Having a vacation with Sensei is the best birthday gift for me!

Happy New Year, Sensei!
I can't wait for summer this year as well!
I saw Peroro buried in the snow in front of the Schale building earlier.
It was only wearing a Santa hat. Won't it get cold in this weather?
H-Halloween costume? This is just a typical swimsuit. Ahaha... I can understand the confusion, though.

Event.Transcription: Mmm... Refreshing ocean smell!
I hope it's a fun vacation!
I'm ready! I even brought a Peroro tube for swimming!
Oh? I swear I put the keys to the locker rooms here...
S-Stop looking at me! It's embarrassing!
We're finally here! Look, the ocean!

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive.
Gehenna Head Prefect Hina reporting. I assure you this outfit is merely for summer training.
I hope this swimsuit will not cause any issues.
I'm getting a little tired. Perhaps due to the training.
Cute swimsuits aren't my style.
It's nice and cool here. Perfect for summer training.
Shall I start planning the next training session?
This, for me...? Thank you. I won't let you down, no matter what.
The camp was definitely effective.
I know I don't look very approachable, but let me know any time if you need my help.
I can get even stronger... I want to get even stronger...for you, Sensei.
I'm always thankful. I know I seem tough, but it would make me happy if you relied on me more.
It looks like I get to spend this summer with you too, Sensei.
It's finally summer, but... I hope you don't mind spending it with a boring kid like me... Anyway, the important thing is that you're with me. O-Okay...?
D-Don't stand so c-close to me... It's me, I know, but... This outfit makes me feel so self-conscious.
Sensei, your hands are so cold. But considering how hot it is today, I'm glad. Can we stay a bit longer?

Battle.Transcription: Leave no one behind. Let's go.
This heat is such a bother...
The mission was a success. Now quit staring at me so much.
That was simple enough. What? Don't look at me like that.
I must ensure order everywhere, including here on this beach.
I have no choice. I will have to use force.
Training or not, I'll still be ruthless.
It's for the mission, right? Okay.
...If you're talking about getting ready, I'm already prepped.
...What's up? What do I need to do?
It's annoying, but it's an important part of training.
Sensei, I'll leave the commands to you.
Since the orders came from you, Sensei, victory is a given.
The mission was a success! But it was too easy. Maybe this training regimen isn't challenging enough...?

Lobby.Transcription: Ah, you're here, Sensei. Preparations for the training session are complete.

I'm looking forward to the summer.
...Um, if you keep staring at me like that, well...
This swimsuit? I thought it'd be perfect for my summer training.

No, I didn't hold particularly high hopes for this summer.
...Maybe a tiny bit.

Resting is just as important as training?
I suppose, but I can't just neglect training.

You want me to ask for help when I need it?
Thank you, Sensei. Just hearing that makes me happy.

Until the very last moment of this summer...
I'll be helping you right by your side, Sensei.

It's your birthday today, Sensei?
Let's see... Is there anything I can do for you?
A walk on the beach? Heehee. Sure if that's what you want.

My birthday? Oh, I forgot about that.
Do I want anything? I haven't given it any thought.

You want us to go in the water, together?
W-Wait, Sensei! My heart's not ready yet...!

Happy New Year, Sensei.
I'll look forward to this summer. And maybe the next one...

Merry Christmas, Sensei.
I'll never understand the commotion about this day.
But it is nice spending it with you.

Halloween... I'm not very familiar with it...
But everyone seems so lively. Like a summertime beach.

Event.Transcription: Welcome, Sensei. We're ready for summer camp. Let me know if you need anything.

Oh, you're here, Sensei. Did you get to check the summer camp schedule?
So hot today... Stay hydrated.

It's summer. The heat and humidity are leaving me lethargic...
...but it all comes with the territory of training.

Dangers are always lurking at the beach.
You never know when and where accidents will occur. Be careful.
Um... You can call me if you need me.

I never expected to spend summer camp training with you.
That's...somewhat new and refreshing.
This outfit is suitable for summer training.

There's no sense in throwing out things that are still good.
I just thought that this would be effective. That's all.
The summer training camp will begin now.
It's annoying, but it's part of training.
It's hot and annoying...
I'm seeing real effects from the boot camp.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive.
I'm not joking! This is all part of the recon mission.
Surely there won't be students, drunk off the resort atmosphere, causing mischief here, right?
Looks like there isn't anyone...out of line.
(Would this be enough to protect from UV rays?)
(Is there an ideal place to open up the sun bed...?)
(Aaah! No wonder I felt like someone was staring.)
This is...a proper weapon? Really?
These must be the results of the Summer Boot Camp.
Let's see... I can confidently say I'm well versed in the technique.
Just because I'm enjoying the beach, that's no excuse to be lazy about my training.
Hm, I've definitely grown. ...Hey! What are you staring at?!
Sensei, you... I'm depending on you.
Can I ask... Would you like to spend the summer with me? For training, of course!
Have you been following me? Ugh...
It's so peculiar. I know you're a hopeless, pitiful adult, Sensei. But somehow you're still on my mind.

Battle.Transcription: I'll smash you to bits like a sand castle!
Good, let's move to the next site.
The most effective medicine for fools is bullets.
Everyone's excited about the beach... It's so silly...
Seriously? Just when I was about to take a break...
I wanted to rest a bit...
This was my first day off in ages. Why?
A specialist can handle any situation!
This is a gift for rule-breakers!
Well, then... Shall I at least warm up?
Hmph! Small fries are so annoying.

Lobby.Transcription: Welcome, Sensei. It's sunny today and great for sunbathing.
You're late! I thought I was going to get sunburn waiting for you!
No eating while walking! No exceptions just because it's a resort.
What's that smile on your face? Surely you're not excited about the ocean, right?
What? You can't stop smiling after seeing my swimsuit?
Die, you pervert!
Heehee. Lemonade tastes so much better at the beach.
N-No, I'm not excited because of the ocean!
Happy birthday, Sensei. Is there any gift you want?
This is already enough? What do you mean?
A birthday at the beach seems a little romantic, but I guess I don't hate it.
There are only fools in the water and trouble on the beach, but...
It's still the best birthday I've ever had. Thanks.
Is it already New Year's Day? It felt like summer was just yesterday. Time sure flies.
A Santa bikini outfit? No one would ever wear anything so stupid! Pervert! Die!
I feel uneasy for some reason...
Y-You say something just went by behind me?
It's not even summer. Stop it with the sudden scary story!

Event.Transcription: You're here, Sensei. We've prepared whatever you might need for summer camp.
My schedule is always a lot lighter compared to the president.
Hmm. That's not bad.
Not bad, Sensei.
You can trade in Gehenna supply boxes right here.

Why are you staring like that?
Nothing's free, period.
We're already halfway through camp. You should hurry if there's anything you need.
Not many days left for summer camp. If you need something, be sure to let me know soon.

Is today the last day? It was an eventful break.
What a summer camp.
Summer training is all over. Check if there's anything left behind.
Huh, there was something like that lying around? You're lucky, Sensei.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive!
Summer! It's summer, Sensei! Come eat delicious food with me this summer!
Traditional summer foods. Shaved ice... Somen... Grilled sweetfish... Yum!
Next time we go to the beach, Sensei... We're eating 100 pieces of takoyaki!
They're a must for summer! Yakisoba, zarusoba, and nagashisomen!
It's so nice and cool here...
Swimsuit? Check. Stocked ice cooler? Check. I officially have everything ready for summer!
An equipment just for summer?! You got it for me?! Yay! I'm so happy!! Thank you!!
How was it? Oh, it was tasty! Just as good as chocolate-flavored eel!
Phew, I'm full! Thank you, Sensei!
Thank you for the food, Sensei! Let's go get cold noodles together next time!
Whoa! This thing that Sensei gave me, it tastes really good! Huh? It's not edible? Well, it was tasty, so I guess it works out!
It's always fun being with Sensei!
Let's eat this together, Sensei! It's a little hot for us to be this close together, but I DO want to eat this with you!
Sensei, I feel weird... My heart won't stop pounding... Is this heatstroke...?
With Sensei, maybe this summer's the one where I get to try everything I wanted to eat. Let's go, Sensei!

Battle.Transcription: It's hot, and I'm hungry...but it's important to exercise before eating!
Let's hurry up, finish this, and then go eat!
Let's get it done and go buy something cold!
Max Motivation! But I'm starting to get hungry...
The summer food tour is not over yet!
Great. Let's hurry to the Beach Shack!
What should I go with? ...Okay, I'll go with this!
Mmm, I can't choose! ...Okay! I'll go with this!
It's tasty. Thank you for the food!
Ah, would you like a bite, Sensei?
Let's go on the summer specialty food tour together!
I'm sure we're almost at the Beach Shack...!
Mmm, it's over! Let's go get some spicy shaved ice, Sensei!
Great! This settles it, right? Let's hurry up and go eat lemon yakisoba, then!

Lobby.Transcription:
Oh, Sensei! Let's go to the beach! The beach, Sensei!
You have work to do? Then I'll wait until you finish!

La la la... Welcome, Sensei!
I'm all set. Waiting on you to get ready, Sensei.
Hmm? What do I mean? Of course it's about preparing to go to the beach!
Summer calls for the Beach Shack! We have to go, Sensei!

Red, yellow, green...and blue.
Which is your favorite, Sensei?
Hmm? What am I talking about? Shaved ice syrup flavors, obviously!

Sensei, you know how swimming in the ocean makes you hungry?
I tried to think of a solution.

And I got it! I just need an edible tube! It'll help me float AND feed me!
What do you think? Amazing right?! Heehee!
Hmm? There isn't a tube like that? Why not?

Happy birthday! Sensei!
Let's turn Schale into a waterpark to celebrate!

Ta-da! Today's my birthday, Sensei! Let's go for a swim!
Summer is still a ways away, but how could I wait when you're here with me?

Happy New Year! Sensei!
Rice cake soup would be great to ring in the new year, but I can't waitto eat summer delicacies with you too, Sensei! Heehee!

Merry Christmas! "Isn't it too cold to be wearing a swimsuit?"
I just had a warm udon, so I'll be fine!

Halloween is a day dedicated to wearing weird clothes and getting candy, right?
Hmm. Then maybe this look is okay after all?

Event.Transcription: Oh, it's Sensei! Well, welcome to the Beach Shack!
Welcome, Sensei! I've been waiting for you!
Yes! Take a gander! Lots of tasty things!

Hey, Sensei! This one... Huh?
Come on, don't look at me! Look around the shop!
Um! N-Nothing for free, even if you keep poking me!
We're almost halfway to the end of the day! Enjoy while you can!
The end is close! Keep at it!
Sensei! Today's the store's last day. Did you get everything you want?

We're closed! Thank you everyone!
Thought that was it? Heehee. Don't worry. There's still some time left!
Remember to check one last time if you forgot anything!
Wow! I knew it, Sensei!
You chose that? Hmm... Good choice!

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive
I was just cycling. Want to join me, Sensei? It'll just be a light 200 kilometers.
Today's average pace is... Hmm. Just a little faster than my average.
I need to cool off.
Where should we go next?
We need to fill up on calories so that we don't get tired.
Group-cycling would be fun too...
This is a lightweight personal weapon developed for riding and more agile tactics. It's great for enduring long-distance rides as well.
I haven't forgotten my training. In fact, I'm going to get even stronger.
I might still be having growth spurts.
Sensei, thank you for always helping me.
I can reach higher speeds with this...
I'm glad we're together, Sensei.
I'll be counting on you next time.
I appreciate your concern.
Hmm... I owe you again.

Battle.Transcription: Thank you, I got it for sure.
It's time to take this out.
I had no intentions of taking it out.
Hmm... Well, I have no choice.
This grenade is perfect for cycling.
This is an essential item for cycling.
It's a perfect plan. Let's start.
It's D-Day! It's okay. Just follow my lead.
It's all thanks to your guidance, Sensei.

Lobby.Transcription: Welcome, Sensei. Would you like to go cycling with me?
I was waiting for you. Where should we go today?

I've been working on improving my cadence when cycling.
I heard pedaling faster while at a lower gear makes for good practice.

I haven't had as much time to cycle lately due to task force work.
That's why I'd like to go the distance today.

Would you like to learn how to cycle, Sensei?
I can be in front and block the wind while you follow behind.
That will make it much easier for you.

There's lots of parts I want to buy, but I need to hold off.
Bicycle parts are expensive.

Actually, I made several of these jerseys hoping to go cycling as a group.
But the others refused, so it's just me.

It's Sensei's birthday today?
Would you like to go cycling to celebrate?
My birthday?....Oh. I suppose it is. Th-Thank you.

I know a mountain course where you can see the sunrise from.
We can ride through the night and watch the sunrise from the peak.
Would you like to go with me? It's only 2,000 meters above sea level.

Why am I cycling on a day like this? Well...I didn't have any other plans...
So I'm fine with making plans with you right now.
Cycling is off limits? Hmm...

Today is Halloween?
Hmm. How about Trick-or-Cycling...?

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive!
Don't treat me like a child! I'm still everyone's favorite older sister at heart!
(Seeing the cafe from this perspective is interesting...)
Hmm. It would be uncomfortable for anyone at this height.
(Just a little more... If I stretch just a little more!)
*yawn* So sleepy...
Since I'm just a kid, it's okay if I take a nap, right?
It seems a little big for me now, but still, I'm most familiar with this weapon!
Oh? It seems I grew a bit taller...
Heehee! Thank you, Sensei.
I learned something new again!
Growth like this is always welcome!
With a body like this... It won't seem weird no matter how much I act like a baby, right? Ehehe...
Despite how I look...I look forward to working with you!
Heehee. Let's play again next time, Sensei!
Are you leaving already? But... W-won't you stay and have fun a bit longer?

Battle.Transcription: Heehee! It's so convenient being this small!
Oh, is this the right way?
Looks like there are only good kids here!
Let's play together next time too!
I-I think I'm going to drop it...!
I'm used to looking after people.
Wow, amazing! This is so high!
Come out, come out, wherever you are!
After handling a gun, don't forget to wash your hands!

Lobby.Transcription: Welcome, Sensei. Looking forward to today's class!

*yawn*...
A strawberry chocolate with rum raisin...

O-Oh! Sensei?
I-I wasn't dozing off!
I'll be a good kid and wait patiently!
Yes, it's yours truly! Shun!

Sensei, Sensei! Someone gifted us Roy's rum raisin chocolate!
Can I try one right now?

I can't have a snack because it'll spoil my appetite?
But they look so good...
Can't I have just one?
Happy birthday to you! Happy birthday to you! ♬

Happy birthday dear...
Ah! I bit my tongue...

Today's my birthday?
Oh, my. I completely forgot about it.
Wait. Then how old am I technically?
Happy New Year, Sensei! Let's hurry over to the temple and drink gamju!
I knew it. I'm still too old for Santa to leave me gifts...
But that's okay. I'm spending this Christmas with you, Sensei!
That means the current me is okay with receiving candy!

Event.Transcription: What a nice day for a picnic!
I'll be guiding you through Shanhaijing today!
Wh-Where do you think Shun went?
(No one noticed...right?)
Sensei, over there! Look at those snacks!
(Haha. I guess this look isn't so bad...)
Welcome, Sensei. Looking forward to today's class!
Heehee. This size is convenient sometimes!
Mmm... I got sleepy...
Thank you!
Heehee. Thank you, Sensei.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive!
Valkyrie Police School's Kirino, reporting for duty! Put your hands up and do as you're told!
Surely there aren't any culprits hiding around here...right?
I hope I'm not breaking any laws by being here...
That person looks familiar somehow. Could they be a wanted criminal?
Nothing to report!
Another peaceful day in Kivotos!
I'll devote myself to learning how to shoot this gun skillfully! I'll become worthy of it!
If I keep working hard... Would I be able to get assigned to the security division?
I'll put my all into the safety of Kivotos!
Heehee, making good progress today!
Thank you for all the hard work you've done for me.
As expected of Sensei!
One day, I want to become a great adult, just like Sensei!
Seriously... This is just work. And here I almost thought...
It's not a crime for teacher and student to be in a relationship in Kivotos! Th-That's all I wanted to say...

Battle.Transcription: This place is a safe zone now!
Let's move on to the next area!
Right, left... Phew...This place is safe now!
You have the right to remain silent and... Wh-Wha?
Crimes are not forgiven in Kivotos... Whoooa!
I'm warning you! If you don't surrender... Ahh!
What do I do, what do I do? ...Hiyah!
Let's get going. Citizens' safety first!
Dear citizens, Kivotos is safe as usual today!
Thank you for helping with today's patrol!

Lobby.Transcription: Welcome back, Sensei. Are you up for going on a patrol with me?
Welcome, Sensei. Run into persons of interest on the way?
Was there an issue you wanted to bring up with me?
All I want is to help Kivotos' students.
I love doing the rounds in this neighborhood because there are so many delicious places to eat.
B-But that doesn't mean that I'm slacking on my patrols!
You have the right to remain silent. You have the right to... Wait, what was the other thing you have a right to?
Happy Birthday, Sensei! But even if it's your birthday I won't look past any broken laws!
You remembered my birthday... How touching, Sensei.
Happy New Year, Sensei. Let's work together for Kivotos' safety this year as well!

Ensuring the safety of citizens 24/7!
We can't let our guard down even on Christmas!
Ah, more students walking around with provocative attire!

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive!
I was taking a long break, but oh well. Can't do much about it if Sensei is calling for me.
Could there be a cheese-flavored drink?
This is a great place to spend the day off.
Can this thing be used in an experiment?
It's okay. Don't be afraid, Nezusuke.
Oh, my. This is quite...
I am a jack-of-all-trades who is not only skilled at researching, but at shooting as well!
You delivered such power... You're really impressive, Sensei.
Wow! I feel really strong!
Heeheehee! I grow more every day!
Is this a new experiment? Not bad at all!
It's just what I expect of Sensei!
Hehehe... Hey! I don't make stupid faces like that! Muahahaha!
What is this tangle of feelings I get every time I see Sensei? It's a truly difficult question.
If I had to choose between you and cheese... Are you sure I can't have both?

Battle.Transcription: Just try and withstand this, if you can!
You should look forward to my performance!
なに、ぼく様に何か問題でも？

Lobby.Transcription:
*sigh* Oh? You're here?
Want to grab a bite to eat?

There you are! Don't you know it's rude to keep a lady waiting?
As punishment, you'll be helping me with an experiment. Heh heh.

Hmm. The chewiness of the knife-cut noodles...
Astounding. Truly amazing.
What? Is me eating normal food weird? I'm not Nezusuke, you know!

This cool outfit suits me?
Hahaha! Of course. Everything I wear suits me!

I can get a ton of inspiration outside of the lab too.
Either making fun of Kin, or bothering Mei...
Hmm? Is something leaking?

Happy birthday, Sensei.
I don't have a gift for you...but would you like to have an elixir I've been testing?

Ugh. Another year of the immortality elixir being incomplete and another year older.
Hmm? Am I worried about getting old? Haha. Surely not. I'm not like Shun.

So I get to start the year with you.
That must be a sign of good things to come!

Sensei, is there a gift you want?
I don't have gold, but I can brew up something that can turn your hands and feet gold. Haha!

Trick or treat! I'm going to cause mischief if you don't give me something.
Well, I'll be doing that even if you do. Mwahahaha!

Event.Transcription: Sensei, welcome to Shanhaijing!
Heehee. You didn't forget about today's plans, right, Sensei?
Where did Shun wander off to this time?
Heehee. Won't be long until the elixir of immortality can be made!
That's strange. There shouldn't have been any other ingredients in the rejuvenation elixir...

Wait, while I was working...
Did this get mixed in with Nezusuke's fur?
Welcome, Sensei, to my new remote lab!
I'll purchase any good alchemy materials!
Anything can be made with the power of superior alchemy!
Hmm. This blue stone you mentioned. I'm not familiar with it either...

The remote lab won't be open for long.
Remember to exchange any good materials you find!

The vibe around the promenade feels kinda off.
We need to close the remote lab and fast.

The remote lab is open until today.
Get what you need while you can!

The remote lab is closed.
But if there's anything left, please show it to me.
Not a bad choice.
Heehee. Thanks for collecting all the good stuff.
Oh, an excellent choice!

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive!
Why pick this of all outfits? Well, it's surprisingly easy to move around in. Hahaha!
I can feel people staring... Is it because of the outfit?
It's even easier to get around in than my maid uniform. Not bad.
Hey! What'cha looking at?! Better watch it!
It's not a bad place. I think I'll be coming here often.
Sensei's...not here? On a business trip? I-I mean, it doesn't matter, anyway...
Hah, you have to go all-out sometimes. Hope you can keep up.
Hah, not bad. I'll get you back. Look forward to it!
Haha! Good. I was waiting for this!
Pretty good, Sensei! You won't regret it.
Ahaha! Not bad! I like it! Leave the rest to me!
Hey, you gotta take responsibility... After all of this, you better not say it was just a joke.
I'm feeling pretty good, for some reason... Huh? F-Forget it!
*sigh* That's not good... Huh? Hey! Don't look over here!
It's weird... The way I feel when I'm with you... Weird.

Battle.Transcription: Don't rush— I'll take you on!
I've been waiting for this moment!
