Battle.Transcription: Ninjutsu! Thank you technique! Summer version!
Swift like a ninja! Starting the mission!
Let's go to the next one, my lord!
We won! My lord! It's Izuna's victory!
Ehehe! What do you say, my lord? Izuna! Worked! Hard!
Yes, my lord! Izuna, on her way!
Feel free to give any order to Izuna this summer, as always! My lord! Nin nin!
Please look forward to Izuna's performance, my lord!
Check out the improved Izuna-style summer ninjutsu!
Mission complete! Let's go have fun at the beach, my lord!
There's no enemy Izuna can't defeat with Izuna-style ninjutsu! Probably!

Lobby.Transcription:
Heeheehee! Welcome, my lord!
This summer, I'll protect you as I always do, my lord! Nin nin!
My lord! I've been waiting for you! What should we do today?

You're working so hard, even on such a hot day, my lord...!
Though I'm unworthy, I'll support you!

Umm, is there anything I can do for you, my lord...?
Oh, how about I use Izuna-style ninjutsu to defeat this heat?!
Ninjutsu Breeze technique! *blowing*

Crushing watermelons, building sand castles, and most importantly, eating shaved ice!
I have so many things I want to do with you this summer!
I saw in the ninjutsu codex that it's good to learn the CPR technique just in case there's an accident at sea!

So, my lord, can you help me learn CPR?
...Oh, are you not available right now?
Okay! Then I'll wait for you right here!
When we have a chance next time, I'd love to play at the beach with the president, Tsukuyo, and you, my lord!

Happy birthday! My lord!
Today is a special day! Let me take care of everything!
I'll make your day even more spectacular than the greatest summer memory!

...Huh? Yes, I got it!
Then, first I'll do my absolute best to sit next to you! Nin nin!

Right! Today is my birthday!
Heeheehee, thank you for remembering!

It warms my heart to hear you wish me happy birthday!
...I'm so lucky! Thank you so much!

Happy New Year!
I can't believe I get to welcome the new year with you. I'm so moved!
This summer, and the next one! Let's have lots of fun together!

It's Christmas, my lord! I can't believe I get to spend time with you today.
It's gonna be such a special day for me!
Um... What do you think, my lord?
...Really? Heehee, I'm so happy.

It's Halloween, my lord! Does it look like I'm wearing a Halloween costume?
If it does... My lord! Trick or treat!

Event.Transcription: My lord, here! Over here! Izuna got a spot!
Oh, Izuna has been waiting, my lord! Izuna is yours to command!

The Beach Shack is our base for this mission.
The word "base" makes Izuna feel like a real ninja!

Hm hm hm. ♪ The Beach Shack has all kinds of food!
What would you like, my lord? Shaved ice? Takoyaki?
Everything is delicious as long as Izuna is with you, my lord!

She always faces danger and challenges head-on...
Is it possible that Shizuko is...a ninja?

Let me know if you need anything!
Izuna will get it done in a flash, like a ninja!

We've got many people on our side this time, my lord!
It's boisterous and fun, my lord!

*gulp* But we've already come so far in our mission...!
Izuna is gonna work hard to prove herself to everyone! Nin nin!

So much happened this summer! It makes Izuna's head spin...
...But every day was so fun! Heeheehee! Thank you, my lord!

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive?
A moment ago...I found Mister Crab walking on the beach. Sensei, do you wanna go see him together?
So cool!
Wow, this is...ice cream?
Let's make a house for Mister Crab around here!
Handkerchief, check. Trowel, check... We can make a sand castle with these.
I wanna play in the sand with everyone at the Yin-Yang Club.
Is this for me? Wow, thank you! Next time I'll give you something. I hope you're excited!
It's like the summer sunshine...
Yep, I'm stronger now! Did you get stronger too, Sensei?
Light and fluffy! Feels like a cloud!
A tank next...and after that, I want to be a rocket!
I can get warm and cozy with Sensei... Is this what they call happiness?
Sensei, listen, listen! My heart is pounding.
When I'm with Sensei, I start coming up with lots of haiku. It's fun.
The summer is full of sparkling things. But what sparkles the most, has got to be...

Battle.Transcription: I'll destroy anything in my way!
Should I try going this way?
Look, look, Sensei. My victory pose!
Victory pose, summer version! How is it?
I'm sure I had it around here somewhere... Found it. Bang!
Where'd I put that grenade...? Ah, here it is. Fire in the hole!
Um. So... Okay. I guess I'll try shooting them first?
The sun is nice and warm!
A walk, a walk! ...Huh? It's not?
In search of the sparkles! Advance!
Is this it? Let's head back then, Sensei.
Did we win? Can I go swimming now then?

Lobby.Transcription: Welcome, Sensei. What brings you here today?

Sensei, long time no see.
Huh? You don't think it's been that long? What's a long time then?
This summer, I want to write better haiku...

I wrote a new haiku. Wanna hear it?
Okay.
Ice in midsummer The cold feels so delicious Underneath the sun

Waiting for summer Exploring for something more The sparkling of...
Huh? What am I looking for?
...What do you think?

I hear that people shine when they work hard.
I wonder where that shine comes from?
...The forehead?

Is today your birthday, Sensei?
Then happy birthday! Sensei, because of today I was able to meet you and get to know you...
Yeah, it's like a miracle!

My birthday...? Thanks, Sensei.
Oh, by the way, President Niya asked me to bring you. They're gonna party to celebrate.
...Oh, my birthday party? Really?
Happy New Year! I'll be counting on you this year too, Sensei.

Sensei. Merry Christmas.
Was I a good kid? If I was, Krampus wouldn't exist!
Huh? It's a little different?

Trick or treat!
Which one do you want? "Trick"? Then, I'll take "or."
...So who's gonna take "treat"?

Event.Transcription:
Oh, I've been waiting for you, Sensei.
...Huh? Why was I waiting?

Welcome to the Beach Shack!
...How was that?
Everyone else seems busy... Why don't we play?

Come to think of it, Kaho told me that when I'm in danger...
I should just throw a grenade.

I've brought you something for heatstroke prevention...
Here. Matcha Ramune.
Why don't you try it?

Sensei, did you call? I was just about to call you, too.
What a coincidence!
Everyone seems happy. There's nothing more important than being happy and healthy.
Everyone is working hard. I should work harder, too.
Huh? Is it already over? Then, Sensei, let's play in the water together.
There's so much to do. It's overwhelming, right?
Oh, Sensei. I received something called...a task list. Do you want it?
Wow, amazing...
Sensei, great job. You did well.
Is poking people on the task list? Then I'll poke you too, Sensei.
President Niya says I shouldn't slack off.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive
Saori of the Arius Squad. I owe you a lot. I'll do what I can to repay my debt. Looking forward to working with you.
Hmm...
I still haven't adjusted to places like this...
What's this...?
I don't quite understand though...
I see. I think I get it...
How...can you trust me? After all that's happened... Aren't you worried I might betray you? I don't understand what you're thinking...but I'll do my best to not let you down.
...My abilities have improved.
I've gotten stronger.
Unless I get stronger... If I don't get stronger, I can't protect anything.
Not enough. I need to get even stronger...
Do you still have faith in me?
Well, I do feel thankful. But I... No, never mind. Forget what I said.
You think I'm going to thank you...?
...No intention of abandoning me, right?

Battle.Transcription: I see, so this is the place.
That was simple... What's the next mission?
Vanitas vanitatum. All is in vain...!
No one can escape from it!
What are you trying to do?
Got it. I'll deal with it.

Lobby.Transcription: I'm ready to assist wherever needed, Sensei.

I've been waiting, Sensei.
What's with that reaction?

Is this helping?
...Okay. That's all I needed.

What is the point of life when it has no inherent meaning?
I can't seem to figure it out.
So... I'll continue to struggle.
Your orders, Sensei. That's my purpose.
Is it okay that I'm still alive...?

...I heard it's your birthday.
I'm sorry... What do you say in this situation?
If it weren't for you, I wouldn't be here.
So... I'm glad you were born.

I've never really had "happy" birthdays before...
So... I don't really know how to react to a birthday greeting...
I don't know if I've earned the right to a happy birthday yet.
I wonder if I'll ever feel like I deserve it...

A year has already passed. This world is as cold and painful as ever...
But regardless, the days continue on...

A holy night... Though it doesn't feel different from any other night.
After all, labeling one day as "holy" doesn't alleviate any of the suffering in this world.
Everything is in vain.

It seems like a festival, but I'm not particularly interested.
After all, it's all in vain.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive.
SRT Academy, RABBIT Squad's Kazekura Moe. Heeheehee... I'll be your support.
Should we designate this as our new base?
It's...weirdly safe here.
Need...more candy...
Something important, like a launch button, might have fallen off...
Heehee...
RABBIT Type 224 pistol received... Um, it's kinda small though. I need a little more ka-boom!
Heehee... Thanks, Sensei.
A bit more... Yes, I should be able to do a bit more...
With all the extra treats you're giving me, Sensei, my stomach's about to burst...
How exciting... This is great. Things are finally getting fun!
You're always helping me out when I need it, aren't you, Sensei? Heehee...
I feel like this is nearly crossing a line or something.
...You're looking for sweets? Sorry, I already ate everything I had on me.
A fiery end wouldn't be so bad if it was with you, Sensei. Heehee...

Battle.Transcription: Time to go out with a bang!
Heehee... This is why I can't give it up.
What is it, what is it? I smell something dangerous here!
Heehee... Would you like to blow up more with me, Sensei?

Lobby.Transcription: Welcome, Sensei. You look busy as usual. Heeheehee.
Oh, it's you, Sensei! You seem busy these days.
I've got to replenish supplies for the RABBIT Squad....
Nom nom... Sugar is important. I can't give it up!
Ah... I wanna eat the inarizushi she makes...

Seriously... Why are candies not included in the basic supplies?
Sugar is like the fuel that keeps the operator going.

Aren't you a busy bee. Need help?
You can count on me! Mostly... Heeheehee.

Happy birthday, Sensei. On that note...
How about we have some extravagant fireworks to celebrate?

Birthday cake? No, no. Birthday fireworks is more like it.
Yeah! Something flashy! Something that goes ka-boom! Heeheehee.

I heard that Shanhaijing Academy has a custom where they set off fireworks to drive away demons...
I've never heard of a more beautiful custom. Heeheehee.

This Christmas I'm gonna eat turkey with RABBIT Squad members.
Huh? At the park where we always stay, of course.
Hm? The Fire Safety Act...? What's that?

This jack-o'-lantern... Wouldn't it burn more nicely if I put in some white phosphorous powder...
*pant* *pant*

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive.
Trinity General School, After-School Sweets Club's Kyoyama Kazusa. Um, thanks for having me.
It's a cute place... Not bad.
Can we...sit here?
It looks kind of delicious...
It's relaxing. I like it.
You designed this, Sensei?
Oh... I didn't know why you were giving this to me... But I guess I'll be able to help you more from here on out.
Huh...? Ah. Thank you, Sensei.
There are other kids...so why me?
It means...keep doing your best? Well, thank you.
I can't get used to something like this... Well, not that I hate it or anything.
Something like this... How should I describe it...?
Sensei, uh... No, sorry. It's nothing.
I wonder why it's so difficult to say "thank you".
Well, it's, uh... Thank you always.

Battle.Transcription: If we're doing this, let's do it properly.
Yeah, something like this is good every now and again.
Not even a moment to relax and eat...
Don't feel so bad about it.
Um... Well, I'll give it a try.
It's been a while since I've done something like this...
Getting serious, aren't we? Let's do this, then.
Piece of cake. Good work, Sensei.

Lobby.Transcription: There you are, Sensei. What's on the schedule?
I've been waiting. Okay, let me know if there's anything I can help with, Sensei.

Let me know anytime you have something going on.
Oh, but I'm not good at reading complex sentences...so I'll pass on that.
It's comfortable here... It makes me kinda sleepy.
Sensei. Let's eat something, okay? Should we go out and get something?
...Huh? Don't mind me. I'm watching you work.
A story from my middle school days? ...I'd rather not.

Happy birthday, Sensei. I didn't get anything, but...
Um, how about we take a walk together?
Oh yeah, my birthday... Thanks, Sensei. I'm glad you remembered.

Happy New Year, Sensei. I'll be counting on you this year, too.
I don't feel like things will change much, even when the new year comes.
...But I don't think that's a bad thing.

So, it's Christmas...
Do you have plans later? Actually, I prepared something...
Ugh... Halloween... I hate how loud it gets.

Event.Transcription: Hey, Sensei. Let's get it done.
All right, let's hurry. There's a lot to do.
Is it going well? ...I should hope so.
This should be the last spurt. Are you still okay?
Cleanup is also important. Is there something you haven't finished yet?
Huh? What's going on?
Don't worry. I'm not going anywhere.
...That tickles.
Ugh! Knock it off! Go do your job!
Let's see. What's gonna come out?
Okay, let's spin!
Hm? Are you sure it's okay for me to spin instead?
Sensei. Look at this! Not me!
Oh... That's pretty awesome! Congratulations.
Yeah. It looks like a good one.
Something that looks special...
Take a look and see if there's anything else you want to exchange.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive!
I'm Kokona of the Disciplinary Support Department's Plum Blossom Garden! N-No! I'm a full-fledged instructor!
What...is this?
There sure are a lot of weird items.
I want to put this in the Plum Blossom Garden, too.
Where did Shun go...?
It'll be good for educating kids.
Sometimes strict, sometimes kind. Things a good teacher keeps in mind. You do your best, and when you do, I think to myself, "I can too!"
I'm a full grown-up, but I'm still growing up.
Perhaps I've become a little more like Shun...?
Well, uh... Thank you. Sensei.
Life is continuous learning, or so I've heard.
I-I'm not a kid! I've told you many times...
One day, I want to be like Sensei and... N-No! It's nothing!
It's odd. When I'm with Sensei...my heart feels warm for some reason...
I'm an instructor... But even an instructor needs a Sensei.

Battle.Transcription: Is that all you've got? How clumsy!
Let's go to the next area!
This feels nice. I'm looking forward to next time as well!
Ahem, of course! Despite how I look, I'm a full-fledged instructor!
I have plenty of candy, you know.
I'll show you the essence of an instructor!
Hm, hmm. This much is nothing.

Lobby.Transcription:
Welcome, Sensei! N-No, I wasn't really waiting...
Well, I guess a little...
How can you make a lady wait? You've lost points!
Yes, I'm looking forward to working with you today.
I know how to teach a class. Do you wanna take my class?
P-Please don't call me Kokona without my title! I'm not just some little kid, you know?!

What's going on?
You called me just because? What the...
Ack! D-Don't poke me! Hmph! I'm not a little kid.

Happy birthday, Sensei! Aren't you proud? I remembered!
...Do you know my birthday, Sensei?

My birthday... You remembered.
Heeheehee. Thank you.

Happy New Year, Sensei!
I'll be working hard as an instructor this year, too. I could really use your support.
I'll be counting on you this year again!

Christmas... Will Santa Claus come again this year?
N-No! I'm an instructor. So it's not like I'm looking forward to it or anything...!

Halloween sweets?
I-I'm the one who'll be giving them out because I'm an instructor!
But it's not like I don't like sweets...

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive.
Millennium's Cheer Captain, Shiraishi Utaha. With ice-cold reason or fiery hot passion, I'll never stop cheering for those I care for.
A space brimming with passion.
Cheers up high! Don't be shy! If we try, we'll reach the sky!
I want to play a big game with everyone here...
(Heehee, I suddenly have a fun idea for a cheer.)
We need more...spirit.
Being filled with passion is a meister's inspiration!
Thank you. Sensei's cheering, it reached me.
Passion and growth... Perfect words for a Meister.
I won't stop moving onwards. Would you follow me, Sensei?
It's all thanks to Sensei. You have my gratitude.
In any cheering...you always have to factor in love. Remember that, Sensei.
Right now, I'm the Cheer Squad leader. ...So I'll cheer for Sensei to best of my abilities.
One's feelings are...strange. Sensei gives me strength just by being there.
It feels like Sensei has a knack for bringing out students' hidden passions. That's how I feel, at least.

Battle.Transcription: Put all your cards on the table, then burn it all!
Shall we move to the next stage?
Looks like our cheering reached them this time too!
The value of passion outweighs reason.
No matter what gets in our way!
I can smell the scent of passion somewhere.
Burning passion is also one of Meister's basics.
This is the strength and passion of Millennium.

Lobby.Transcription: Welcome, Sensei. If you need support in the form of a cheer burning with unmitigated passion... I'm always ready.
Sensei, the first step to cheering for others is cheering for yourself!

Whether you're healthy or sick, energy is the best medicine.
Especially if you need to kick-start your creativity.
Feeling down? I see that frown. Your mood'll rebound, just hear my cheer resound! ...I'll try again later.

As long as you're here, Sensei...
I feel like I can do anything.
Being a meister sometimes means cheering on for your machines. Don't get us wrong, we think on them long, but whatever we make might have a mistake! ...Maybe our new club motto?

I'm glad I get to see this side of you, Sensei.
What do you think? Do you like it?
Oh, Sensei, today's your birthday, right?
Today's importance certainly warrants a special cheer only you can hear!
My birthday? Time really flies.
Thank you, but today doesn't feel particularly special.

Thanks to you, Sensei,
every day feels like a celebration.
Thank you, Sensei.
Today's a new year. Let's start with a cheer. Some energy we'll ignite by chanting with might! ...Wait, should I have created some sort of cheer-amplifying device?
Santa is so dedicated. I wonder if he has someone who cheers him on.
...Perhaps the dreams and wishes of children are the cheers he hears.
The explosion of certain pumpkin lanterns...of all the pumpkin lanterns in the lounge... Let's just say it wasn't an intentional design choice.
I just thought that the pumpkin lanterns would sparkle extra bright at 60 frames a second. I was technically correct.

Event.Transcription: Let's do our best to make this Kivotos Halo Festival as great as possible!
The energy is palpable...

Millennium's honor is at stake.
Of course the Engineering Department will help.
Good to see that preparations for the Kivotos Halo Festival are going well.

It's almost time for the Kivotos Halo Festival.
I'm already getting excited. I'll try to contain myself.
Well done, Sensei. I'll be waiting by the cheering event stage.

My cheers still need fine-tuning...
There's no helping it. I'll do my best.

A request received will become a design achieved!
That is the eternal motto of the Engineering Department!

Come to think of it, I haven't seen Seminar's resident perfectionist anywhere...
I hope she isn't sick.
(In fact, I hope everyone can enjoy the festival to the fullest...)

I get that we're not an athletics club...
...but I didn't think Kotori and Hibiki would be this out of shape...

There's only one way to get fit. The Engineering Department's next undertaking will be...
...designing an exercise robot.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive!
I am Ushio Noa, Seminar's secretary. I look forward to your support, Sensei.
(This cafe feels like a fantasy...)
(It makes me want to let my worries fade away as I lose myself in the dream.)
I would love to have furniture like this in the Seminar lounge. Heehee.
The way this space is structured and put together is very impressive.
Heehee. Yuuka would love it here.
This conversion kit is so interesting. It makes me want tinker around... Whoops.
It's always fun to learn something new.
Heehee, this might be a little fun...
It's very easy to understand Sensei's teachings.
It's hard to give an exact answer...but I might've grown a bit. Heehee.
Heehee, Sensei's words are just like the light of a warm sunset.
Thank you for always helping me, Sensei.
It's a bit difficult to record... Saying it's "good" might not be enough.
This feeling right now... I don't want to record it.

Battle.Transcription: Thank you for the perfect advice.
Heehee, you've got the wrong place.
It's good to get up and move once in a while.
Let's call it here for organizing things.
What kind of variables would be waiting for us?
Concluding the meeting with this. Thank you for the hard work.
I see... So that's your weak spot?
Heehee... Shall we deploy our strategies over here this time?
I'm glad to hear that my records helped.
Even if you try to hide, you can't escape from my records!
I look forward to working with you again.
Heehee. If you have a better idea, then please go ahead.
Enemy arrival acknowledged. Please issue your orders.
Heehee, leave the groundwork to me.
I could record many new sides of Sensei, I'm gla... Ahem. Pardon me, I mean I learned a lot.
Those were great orders. What do you say to a cup of coffee or something later?

Lobby.Transcription:
Welcome, Sensei.
Would you like to check today's schedule?
Heehee, aren't you a bit late, Sensei?

Look at me that way all you want, it won't make you any less tardy.
You can, however, be less late in the future. I would appreciate it.
(staaare)
Oh, don't mind me. I'm just...observing.

Anything interesting on your mind?
Please let me know so I can record it immediately.

The poetry I wrote...?
I submitted it to The Millennium Prize.

Everyone read it,
but no one gave me their feedback.
Strange, isn't it?
Yuuka is so expressive. It's never boring when she's around.
But it means I can't help but tease her, heehee.
Curiosity is the driving force behind scientific development, but it can also be the driving force behind distress.
It's a bizarre sensation. Fear being dragged forward by desire...
Happy birthday, Sensei.
On a calendar, it looks like just another day...
But for you, at least, I hope it feels even a little more special.
I don't see much meaning into keeping track of the day of one's birth, but...

It's nice to be congratulated by others.
Thank you for thinking of me.

Happy New Year.
I look forward to working with you this year, Sensei.

Christmas...
It's not a special holiday at Millennium School,
but it certainly feels special today.

If you have some time after work,
why don't we add dinner to tonight's schedule? Heehee.
A special day to remember the oft forgotten dead...
I will need to work more diligently, so no one else is left unrecorded and forgotten.

Event.Transcription: Hmm. According to my schedule, we should be preparing for the Kivotos Halo Festival now.
We'd better hurry. We don't want to miss the opening ceremony!
(Hmm... Next on the agenda is...)

It’s not long until the Halo Festival begins.
Let's do our best until the very end.

Thank you for your hard work, Sensei. Everyone has really given it their all...
I'm sure this year's Kivotos Halo Festival will be amazing.

All eyes will be on us during the festival...
...so we need to do our best to showcase the true value of Millennium!

I'm not that athletic...
But at the end of the day, this is another one of Seminar's duties.
(...I suppose not everyone is that excited for the festival...)
I am absolutely, 100% certain that, without fail, Yuuka is going to nag my ears off.
Heh heh... I'm already picturing Yuuka's flustered face.
Here, this is a list of tasks that must be completed in preparation for the Kivotos Halo Festival.
Just in time, Sensei, for me to ask you for help.
Oh? Why can't I do it?
Haha. Oh, Sensei. I'm busy already, of course. I could do it later, but...
I learned a lot. Well, you are a teacher.
You're very reliable. I'm surprised.

Normal.Transcription: B-Blue Archive...!
Sensei... Um, uh, wh-what do you think? This is my first time making a cheerleader outfit... It's not too bad, right?
Anyone here need, um...cheering?
This rowdy atmosphere... It's not all that bad.
Who knew cheering was so tiring...? I'm a little thirsty.
Hmm... Maybe I should tinker with this just a bit?
Is up to here good? Or...here?
Thank you, Sensei. I'll keep showing you things you've never even imagined.
What a strange feeling... It's not bad though... More, please.
What do you think, Sensei? I-I...hope you like it.
You think I have good style? Well... I did make this myself...
I aim to be the best, no matter my look. ...Yes, as a Meister.
It wasn't my intention, but... If YOU like it, Sensei, I'll keep it on.
If ever you need me, just say the word! I couldn't possibly wear this every day, but...
Something feels a little...out of the ordinary, I guess? I mean, I AM in this...outfit...
I feel like I should be cheering you on, but our roles are reversed. It actually makes me feel quite happy. I look forward to your support, Sensei.

Battle.Transcription: Wearing this outfit in front of other people feels so...awkward.
I'm not really the type to do this but... I don't have a choice.
Ah, thank you. I needed that.
Did I get my feelings across...?
Go, team, go! Whoa... How embarrassing.
Fight! Win! ...Am I doing it right?
Yep, I'll see what I can do.
Phew... That's over. What did you think?
It's easier to try things when I'm cosplaying. Unless... Maybe it's because I'm with you, Sensei.

Lobby.Transcription: Welcome back, Sensei. Do you want a cheer? Something modded? Or...
Sensei, let's stay motivated! If you need more energy...just let me know.
Sensei... You look worn out. Do you need a cheer? You definitely need a cheer!
I want you to rely on me, Sensei. Not just with engineering, but with other things too.
This isn't a sports field, so this outfit... It's a bit...

It's so strange.
I usually don't mind revealing outfits...
(...Maybe Sensei makes me self-conscious?)
Let's go, Sensei, let's go! I'm always grateful for you! Sensei! Thank you!
Today is a special day, so I tried to put in some effort.
Sensei! Happy birthday!

Sensei, today's my birthday.
And so, for today... I want to be cheered on by you!
Happy New Year, Sensei. I'll cheer you on this year again.
Christmas already... Maybe I should make seasonal cheer outfits...
Oh, it's Halloween. No wonder it's so festive outside.
Huh..? Me? Th-This outfit wasn't made for that...

Event.Transcription:
Dressing like this is a bit...
I just need to keep in mind that this outfit is for the sake of the Kivotos Halo Festival...
Heehee. I'm looking forward to a fun festival.
(I can't seem to get comfortable with cheerleading no matter how much I practice...)
Preparations for the Kivotos Halo Festival are almost set. Just one last push...

Thank you for all your help, Sensei.
Whatever happens, our cheers won't let you down.

I'll show you today's work!
Let's tackle it step-by-step!
This list... Is this right? Wh-Which one...?

There's so much...
I wish I could perform surgery on this.
Amazing! I knew I could count on you!
Great work, Sensei! I'm so happy!

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive.
Heh heh, Happy New Year. I'm prepared with a floral furisode and an open mind. Let's find some intriguing new food to try!
True epicurianism involves all aspects of life.
Location and appropriate dress are essential elements of fine dining.
This is the time of year for special dishes. Heehee, I'm quite excited.
I've worn furisodes quite frequently, actually.
I hope we find food that's truly worthy of savoring.

Special foods that you only eat once a year make a holiday seem magical. With this experience, I'm getting closer to true epicurianism, and...closer to you, too, Sensei. I truly always appreciate you.
Oh, my. Heehee... Thank you. Sensei.
Is it okay...to do all this for me?
I'm always indebted to you, Sensei. Please watch me grow, okay?
May our days be full of happiness, Sensei.
Someday... Someday. I've been hoping to find someone who would study and walk the path of the gourmet with me. If you'd like... could you be that person, Sensei?
What kind of food do you like, Sensei? Let's go find it together, if you'd like.
Could you stay by my side...a little bit longer? Yes... Just a bit longer.
You know? For me, the moments I spend with Sensei are always special. Even when those moments have nothing to do with dining.

Battle.Transcription: Everyone, I look forward to working with you all.
Since you've gotten in the way of fine dining, it means you're ready to get punished accordingly, right?
What fine dining experiences will be waiting for us this year?
Heehee... Now then, let's go enjoy the osechi.
Mmm! I was looking forward to this taste.
Heehee. I'm looking forward to it.
That's what you get for interrupting fine dining.
To eat, or to live. That is the question.

Lobby.Transcription: Heh heh heh, welcome, Sensei. Have you enjoyed any epicurean experiences today?
How are you, Sensei? Why don't we look for a fine dining experience for the New Year?
Sensei, do you like furisodes? ...Huh? You think I look good in one? Heh... O-Of course I do!
Hm... Suddenly, I'm craving something warm and soft to eat. Could it be because I'm talking to you?

Osechi are typically all boiled foods.
However, it seems these days that's not always the case.
My opinion? I think either way is delicious.

What's more appetizing than seasonal food? For the New Year, we could have osechi, ozoni, oshiruko...
Oh... Now I'm hungry!

The value of gourmet food is universal.
...You agree, right Sensei?

Sensei! It's your birthday today. What would you like to eat?
I'll make us reservations at a restaurant that I'm sure you'll enjoy.

Oh! You're celebrating my birthday...? I'm so happy.
Heh heh heh, please go out to eat with me today.
As long as I'm with you...every meal will be gourmet.

Happy New Year, Sensei!
It's New Year's Day! I've changed into my furisode to celebrate.
It's very important to wear the proper outfit to enjoy a celebratory meal.

Sensei, how's your Christmas going? Everything I eat today tastes especially sweet and warm.
Heehee. I think...that's all thanks to you, Sensei.

Happy Halloween! I brought a delicious pumpkin pie with me today.
Would you like a bite, Sensei?

Event.Transcription:
Welcome, Sensei. Oh my... You're working on New Year's Day? Don't forget to take a break sometimes.
Now then, let's enjoy a cup of tea together.

Heehee. It's nice to see you this New Year's Day.
Don't you know? I'm always prepared.
Heeheehee. Did you call me, Sensei?

Please refrain from tickling me like that.
I didn't know you enjoyed goofing off like that, Sensei.

Furisodes can be a bit inconvenient, to be sure.
But one must have proper dress when fine dining.

To craft the ultimate flavor, one must have an unflinching resolve.
...No one will be able to stop us. Heeheehee.

The circumstances are a little complicated, but...
...My passion for fine dining won't be impeded by something like this.

I hope we all do our best.
I taste food using every ounce of my passion and sincerity.

Time marches on...and memories fade.
But as long as you and I remember... It'll all be okay.
Yes, I'm certain.

Sensei, are you here to pick an omikuji too? This way.
Heeheehee. You don't have to be so tense.

Heeheehee... It's my first time doing something like this.
It's kind of fun.

Did you find what you were looking for?
Heeheehee... Maybe it's closer than you think.

It's important to take it easy sometimes.
It's like having a little granita with your full course meal.

Oh, you drew the great blessing! You're quite lucky, Sensei! As to be expected.
I prepared a special gift for drawing a great blessing, Sensei.

You drew a blessing. That means some good luck is coming your way.
I hope you have a happy New Year.
...You got a modest blessing. Here's your prize.

A small blessing... That's not too bad.
To bring great luck, they say you need to work on the small things first.

A future blessing means you're likely to be lucky down the road...
That's a good sign. All right then, this way.

It's okay. The result of the omikuji only shows your current luck.
It could turn into good fortune later...
Huh? You feel happy and sad at the same time, because I comforted you? I-I don't understand...
Sensei, they're still serving omikuji. Please don't forget to pick one out.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive.
Did you have any New Year's Eve noodles? I hope everything goes well for us this year!
Precise measurements are important when cooking.
This kimono...is pretty.
What was my first dream of the New Year?
I hope we have a peaceful year...
Maybe I can take a little break here...
It's so strange. When I'm with you, I feel like I can do anything. I'll try my best again this year. Please watch over me.
I'm always grateful for you, Sensei.
This is for me...? Are you sure I can accept something like this?
I don't know what to do! I don't have anything for you! ...What do you mean you've already gotten enough?
I never imagined I could improve this much... And it's all thanks to you, Sensei.
Promise you'll tell me if something happens. No matter when, okay...?
Every day I spend with you is precious. I wouldn't trade them for anything.
S-Sensei? Heehee... I just wanted to call you.
There's something I want to tell you, Sensei... I promise I'll call. Will you wait for me?

Battle.Transcription: I put my all into this!
This is the School Lunch Club's specialty osechi!
It's filled with my honest feelings!
I'll prepare the New Year's cuisine.

Lobby.Transcription:
Oh, Sensei! Welcome.
Are you hungry? Can I make you something?

Please come in! I'll warm up some food.
I made it with love.

Wh-What do you think of my kimono?
I hope you like it...

I was nervous about wearing a kimono in front of you, but...
Now I'm glad I did.

Did you know your hard work is very inspiring to the students?
To me as well, of course. Heeheehee.

Osechi is a lot of work to make.
But that's what makes it worth it in the end.

I feel so relaxed with I'm with you.
I should get going, but...
Huh? You want to stay with me a little longer?

Today's your birthday, Sensei! Happy birthday!
I'm glad I got to celebrate with you!
What dish would you like today?

Wow... My birthday... You remembered.
Thank you...!
Just hearing that from you makes me so excited!

Happy New Year, Sensei.
It's New Year's Day, so I put on my kimono.
I made osechi. Will you join me?

It's Christmas... The year is almost over already.
I was thinking of hosting a small party... What do you think?

The Halloween season is so fun and energetic.
I wish we could eat the jack-o-lantern later...

Event.Transcription:
Hello, Sensei! Did you decide on your New Year's wish?
Here, I'll pray next to you!
Are you cold? Do you need a warm meal?
Yes, Sensei? What's going on?

This scooter is so helpful.
If I lose this too, whatever will I do...?

I want to try making other New Year's foods as well. Not just osechi.
Oh, but... If I eat all of that, I'll definitely gain weight.

I don't know if I'd call it a New Year's wish, but...
I hope the cafeteria stays safe this year...

Yes... Now is the time to show off my cooking skills!
I'm gonna try my best. Come watch me!

Even though it's become such a big deal, it doesn't change what I need to do.
All I can do is try my best.
Besides... I feel reassured with you at my side!

I'm glad it ended well.
So...Sensei? Was my food to your liking?
Sensei, welcome. The market owners prepared all manner of products.
It's my first time running the shop. Heeheehee.

It's fine. Don't worry.
I feel confident I can manage our inventory.

Huh? A special School Lunch Club dish, you say?
If you want...I can make something for you.
All right, please give me a minute.
That's my top recommendation!
Oh... Yes. You mean this one, right?
Did you enjoy it? Please come again!

Both the festival and the cooking contests have ended.
I have to prepare for tomorrow...but you should take your time and look around.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive!
Happy New Year, Sensei! Let's go find something delicious!
It's...pretty cool...or maybe fun would be a better description.
I smell something mouth-watering...
I should be careful not to get it dirty.
I always get interrupted just when I'm about to eat something good...
It's okay, I'm sure I'll grow! There's potential, right...?
I've become stronger... I'm only gonna say this once, so listen! Um... Thank you for everything, Sensei. I appreciate it.

I wonder if I got any bigger...
How can you think I'm fine the way I am? You're kidding me, right?
Be serious. This is super important to me!
Dishes taste so good on special days... Why do you think that is, Sensei?

Maybe I could eat more if I get stronger...
It doesn't make a difference? W-Well, of course it doesn't. I knew that!
Hehehe! What do you think? Are you starting to see me in a new light now?
Do you think...I look okay? I'm not used to wearing outfits like this... Wh-What are you smiling at?!
Something about you is weird, Sensei. When I'm with you—A-Actually, never mind! Forget it!
Flattery won't get you anywhere! I mean, I guess, sometimes...it might...
Do you want to enjoy some delicious food with me next time? Um...just the two of us...

Battle.Transcription: Thanks! I'll be sure to pay it forward!
Are you watching, Sensei? I'll be right back!
This should be an easy win!
This should be fine... Huh?! How can it be empty!
This place should be safe, right? Wait—why?!
Slowly...! Carefully...! Whoa! What are you doing?!
♪ Hm, hm, hmmm! ♪ Aaaah! I-I'll never forgive you for this!
Heave-ho, heave-ho... Whoa! Why am I doing this alone?!
I guess you really need me, huh?
Leave it to me! I'll end everything in a flash!
Let's finish up and chow down!
Hm... What should I ask for today...?
I win! Not that I expected any different!

Lobby.Transcription:
Welcome, Sensei! Let's finish work quickly and go eat something yummy!
I'll help you!

Seriously, Sensei, where have you been? Oh, why I was waiting? Because you...
Wh-What am I supposed to say?!

Did you fall in love with me because of my kimono?
O-Of course. Do you think I'm just a glutton?
My favorite osechi dish? Hmm... It's hard to pick just one, because they're all so good!

Hey~ How long are you going to be working?
Hurry! Hurry! Let's go somewhere!
*sigh* I wish I knew how to cook. Then we could make something at home.

What's wrong? Are you feeling lonely?
I-I'm not saying I am!
Heeheehee. Today's your birthday, Sensei. Let's go out and celebrate!

You didn't forget my birthday, did you? Let's get ready and go out!
Heehee... What are you gonna buy me today?

Happy New Year, Sensei! What? Th-This outfit...?
B-Because it's New Year's Day. Wh-What do you think?
You think I look good in it? It's cute...?
S-Stop! Th-That's enough!

There's a lot of delicious Christmas food! This time...
I hope I don't get interrupted.

Halloween is kind of weak compared to other festivals... Maybe because it's so focused on pumpkins?
Well I don't mind, because they're still delicious!

Event.Transcription: Oh, you're here, Sensei! It's loud outside. Should we go check it out?

There are lots of extra-delicious foods on New Year's Day...
I always end up spending too much money...
Oh, what's up, Sensei? Oh... Did you wanna talk to me...by any chance?

Seriously, don't poke me like that! You're messing up my kimono.
Cleaning it is not the problem!
Hakamas are better... They're way easier to move in.

I have to braid up my hair too?!
I can't pull that off! There's no way...

I feel like it'll be really annoying...
When it comes to bad luck...my intuition is dead on...

I had a feeling it would turn out this way...
But since you're with me, Sensei, I'm sure it'll work out somehow.

Ugh, I'm so tired. I'm glad everything worked out.
That osechi was good! I ate so much!

Is all this here for you, Sensei? You've got a lot of work ahead...
Well, let me know if you need help.
Now's not the time to relax! Good luck, Sensei.

Huh? Did you call? Are you gonna buy me something?
Heehee. Just kidding.
It's not that I don't like loud environments. If I didn't, then I wouldn't be able to get along with the Gourmet Research Society.

See? You can do it, too.
Heehee. I've always wanted to say that.

Honestly, I don't think I could've done it myself... Such is the power of an adult...
Not bad.

Are we done for today?
Then let's go grab something delicious!

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive!
I'm Aomori Mine, Remedial Knights captain. Does anyone need medical assistance?
I'm keeping an eye out for people who are ill or injured.
This place is so calming.
It's a lovely spot for a tea party. Shall we?
Taking breaks is important for your health. The Remedial Knights aren't exempt from that.
Drinking black tea after a meal is a boon for health and beauty.
Thank you so much for your kindness. I'll do everything I can to be helpful to you.
Why would you...do all this for me...?
Thank you. Sensei.
Heehee, it seems I'm the one who received aid.
How about a cup of tea later, if you don't mind? I want to return the favor.
It's an unfamiliar feeling... It feels fluffy...and my warms my heart... It's a tingling sensation.
Have you noticed? ...Sensei has changed me...bit by bit.
If I...could be of strength...
Sensei, you always give me things I cannot pay back... You're a troublesome person, seriously... Heehee.

Battle.Transcription: I'll take the lead, so please watch my back.
Thank you. This is a relief.
This is our victory. But never let your guard down.
A touch of aid to the battlefield!
Go forth with faith and honor in your heart!
It's the Remedial Knights' time to shine.
Leave it to me. I'll take the lead.
May there be blessings to everyone.
I will give my aid to anyone who needs it, without fail. Naturally.

Lobby.Transcription: Welcome, Sensei. Let's work together towards peace in Kivotos, as always.

Sensei, what's wrong? Did something happen?
Please don't worry about me. I'm used to waiting!
Does anything hurt? Please call on me any time you need help.
You certainly seem busy. I can help with anything you need.

If you're tired, just say so.
I'll take care of anything you need, like black tea or snacks. If you want, you can even use my lap for taking a nap...

The ideal situation is one in which the Remedial Knights aren't needed at all.
I hope we'll continue to see such peaceful days.

The Remedial Knights' building is decent, but this place...
Hm, maybe it's time to relocate...
Oh? No, no, just talking to myself. Don't worry about it!

Happy birthday, Sensei.
I've put together a first aid kit that can take care of a plethora of injuries. So? What do you think?
It's the thought that counts? I...see...

You remembered! Thank you...
I'm so happy.
If it's okay... Can I ask you to spoil me today? Heehee.

Happy New Year.
Okay, Sensei. Shall we?
I'll still help everyone who needs medical attention this year.

I've heard it said that Christmas is a day for giving gifts to show your appreciation.
Um... Sensei. In that case, what kind of a gift would you like?

Every Halloween, people always come up to me to tell me how nice my "knight costume" is.
But...this is just what I always wear! I don't appreciate hearing it year after year.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive! ☆
Don't worry, I, Misono Mika, have finally arrived! Oh, we're already well acquainted, so let's skip the formalities, okay? I'm looking forward to working with you, Sensei.
Hmm, it's a bit tight...but I think it'll be okay anyway!
Hahaha! What's this? So silly!
You know, I used to have something like this before...
Well, I don't think I'll be bored around here.
Hm, I guess Sensei isn't around...
I'd never say no to such kindness from you, but this might cross a line. Not that it matters to me, but...Sensei, are you gonna be okay? ☆
Whoa... Are you sure about me getting this strong? You sure you can take good care of me?
Ahaha! ☆ So you're not satisfied yet? Maybe I'll try harder to live up to your expectations, then.
I've become stronger. This too...is for Sensei.
I've never considered myself weak...but if it's for Sensei, I don't mind becoming even stronger.
Thank you, Sensei. But...I wonder if I really deserve it...
For me...? Uh... I wonder if this is okay...
I'm happy...and I'll never forget it.
I...will work hard so I can stand proudly next to Sensei.

Battle.Transcription: That wasn't a big deal, you know?
You can't go beyond this point.
Hmm. So it's your turn now?
Something like this is a piece of cake.

Lobby.Transcription: Sensei! You're back! You kept me waiting, you know!
Welcome! Don't worry, I was perfectly well-behaved while you were gone.

It's a beautiful day, isn't it?
It seems like a shame to spend it cooped up inside.
...If it's all right with you, let's go for a walk after work?

Is this how student duty is supposed to be?
I mean, I didn't really know what to expect, but...
Well... I'm not really bored or anything!
If you need help, I'm at your service! You can count on me to do my very best.
Oh... I see. That's how you look when you're working.

Happy birthday, Sensei!
Should I sing Happy Birthday to you?
Huh? Are you embarrassed?

Oh... How did you know it was my birthday?
Yeah, um... Thanks...
Hahaha, it looks like you got me.

Happy New Year, Sensei!
I might not deserve it, but I'm still looking forward to the New Year with you. ☆

Tonight is a holy night, Sensei.
Do you have any plans today?
Then, if you don't mind... Let's spend it together.

Happy Halloween! ☆ Did you hear? Some of the stores have limited-edition accessories that are only available today!
We could go shopping, or something like that?

Normal.Transcription: Bluuue! Archiiive! ♪
Yay! What do you want me to work on? Where should I dig? I can excavate whatever you want!
Wow! So this is your...?
Not...these hot springs, right?
Well, since this place is yours, I'll make it an exception.
Huh? Is that...? *gasp*
There sure are a lot of people! It's bustling. I like it!
What? You're giving me this? Why? Um, I don't understand... But I guess I'll just keep working hard! Hahaha!
Ooh!! What is this? I feel the strength!
Thank you for the support! I should work harder too!
This is totally welcome! I'm so happy! Thank you, Sensei!
I'll work hard! Look forward to it!
Uh, um... What is it? I don't really get it. What is this feeling?
It's fun when I'm with Sensei! Why? Well, I never thought about that.
Is there anything...I could help with? Well... I just feel like helping.
Weird... It's not like I'm sensitive to heat or anything... But it feels a bit hot when I'm with Sensei, for some reason.

Battle.Transcription: Huh? Did you just do something?
It's time for hot spring development!
Let's go, let's go, let's go, let's go!!

Lobby.Transcription: Hi Sensei! Welcome! What should we do today? Do you want to build a hot spring?
I've been waiting for this moment! Say the word and I'll get started!

Hmm... What should I do here?
Do you need to be warmed up? Or...

What do I do in my free time? Uh... I dunno...
Oh! You were looking for work!

I hate when things get complicated. You can't just ignore the problem, either...
That's why I like to get rid of things and start all over!

Are you hungry? Do you want me to make you some ramen?
Huh? Tools?
I'll use this! ♪

Adjusting the output? Hm... I dunno...
It'll work. Probably...I think! I've never tried!
Happy birthday, Sensei! It's so hot out today!

Oh yeah! Today's my birthday! Hm... What do I want as a present...?
How about an excavator?

Happy New Year!
My wish for the year...is more hot springs to build and more land to dig!

Isn't today the day nice kids get gifts?
Oh! That's so exciting! I wonder what I'll get.

There's a bunch of people outside...and they look like weirdos.
Maybe it'll make it easy to escape from the Prefect Team today!

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive.
I'm Ogata Kanna of the Valkyrie Police School Public Peace Bureau. Leave criminal interrogations to me.
The coffee here...smells pretty nice.
I'm tired...
The new Cottontail Detective series is at a place like this...?
Ugh, I got a message from the Defense Office.
I'm hoping for a peaceful day in Kivotos!
Come to think of it, there was a time I couldn't handle this gun very well. Now that I'm used to it, it's a shame there's not much of a chance to use it these days...
I see. That could be another solution. Good lesson.
That should do for today's training.
The work I do every day is for the citizens.
A director who doesn't train diligently won't set a good example for her subordinates.
If all adults were like you, we'd be out of our jobs... Eh-hem! Ignore me. I was just talking to myself. No need to worry.
Not even I will be able to interrogate you for information, Sensei. Heehee...
A romantic relationship between teacher and student...? Wh-What are you implying?!?!
I will occasionally rely upon Schale.

Battle.Transcription: I have eyes on the suspect.
It's no use trying to trick me.
I'm sure you've heard of the Feral Hound.
Freeze! This is the Valkyrie Public Peace Bureau!
Freeze! If you so much as twitch, I'll haul you in for criminal charges!
It looks like I made it just in time.
Is it the Public Peace Bureau's turn?
Hm? Is there anything that requires me to sign?

Lobby.Transcription:
I've been waiting, Sensei.
Let me know if you ever need the power of the Public Peace Bureau.

...Was there an incident?
Please wait a moment. I'll request a warrant.

A lot of documentation is needed for a Public Peace Bureau dispatch.
I sometimes envy Schale's ability to execute quick responses.
I don't have the ability or authority to take care of this, but...
I'm going to make some coffee. Would you like a cup?

The students at the Public Safety Bureau make for good police, but...
They're too inexperienced to deal with the heavier crimes...
I don't like donuts very much. They make my hands too messy.

About the Feral Hound nickname...
Umm... I'd prefer it if you didn't call me that in front of others... It's embarrassing.
Today's your birthday. Happy birthday.

As a public official of Valkyrie Police School,
I'm not in a position to give you gifts. However...
If it's okay with you, I'd like to take you to lunch at my favorite restaurant.
Oh... Today's my birthday.

The staff's been talking about it since this morning.
I thought they were discussing the criminal we arrested yesterday.

I hope you have a happy New Year.
I hope we get to meet for occasions other than investigations this year.
...Are you working overtime again?
As it happens, I'm on duty today as well.

...It's Christmas, so...
How about a sweet latte, instead of just black coffee?
I'll bring it right away.

Halloween...
It's a troublesome time that can hamper our investigations.

If a criminal hides in a group of people wearing costumes,
it becomes difficult to locate them. Masks ruin facial sketches.
It is troublesome.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive.
I'm Utazumi Sakurako of the Sisterhood of Trinity General School. May you have a blessed day today.
So, Sensei, this is the place you worked to create?
It seems to have welcomed many different sorts of people.
It's quite different from the cathedral.
Although...I certainly wouldn't mind visiting once in a while.
It may be different, yet I feel at peace here.
You're so generous. Thank you. I hope I can repay your kindness one day.
Oh, thank you. I'm not used to someone thinking of me so much.
I know not how to respond to the grace you've shown me...
May your actions be blessed.
I would be remiss to decline your kindness... Thank you.
Sensei... Um... Nevermind. I-It's nothing...
Each time I try to say something to you, Sensei... I question whether my words are appropriate.
There are precious few who understand me as you do, Sensei.
Presently... I am a Sister to everyone, but... Um...

Battle.Transcription: This is simply another trial laid before us.
I wish to thank you all.
I'm happy to see that everything has ended well.
It was bound to come down to this.
A blessing to these holy rounds.
I thank you for your blessing.
All of this, I do for you!
I beg of you, take this!
May luck follow you wherever you go.
I look forward to working with you all.
May you all be blessed with grace.

Lobby.Transcription: I've been waiting for you, Sensei. May you be blessed, today and all days.
Oh, Sensei... I was praying for you just now.

I'm supposed to assist you at Schale...
It's different from my usual work, so I'm a bit nervous.

Work at the cathedral?
It's okay. I've been organizing my schedule.
Yes, Sensei. If there's anything I might be able to do...
Anything regarding the cathedral, or any other work...please let me know.
You seem tired. Is there anything I can do for you?

Today is a special day. I am full of gratitude.
That's how I feel too.

Thank you, Sensei.
It's nice that someone's celebrating my birthday.

A year has already passed. It's time to welcome the New Year.
I wish great happiness for you in the New Year, Sensei.

Yes. Today is special, without question.
I hope you can feel it, too.

The day before a festival... Those are the busiest days.
No, I'm not saying I don't like it. The more the merrier.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive
Millennium Science School, C&C call sign Zero-Four. Asuma Toki. I promise perfect assistance.
What's this space for?
A cafe... I've heard of it.
Beverages containing sugar can be very effective for recovering from fatigue.
At the very least, I can make tea. I'm familiar with that.
I'll make note of the interior here.
Thanks for caring... I've decided to provide complete personal protection for you from now on. Please leave everything to me.
I can't say I'm complete, but... I'm one step closer.
I can assist you even better with this.
Thank you, Sensei. I will do my best to meet your expectations.
I appreciate the faith you've placed in me. I will keep doing my best to not bring shame to C&C's name.
My connection with you has gotten deeper, Sensei. That said, I hope you'll start keeping a closer eye on me.
A relationship is supposed to be a special connection between two people. And, well, you've become quite special to me.
...Despite my appearance, I'm a swirl of emotions inside. So Sensei... I hope you share those feelings with me.
Is this what it feels like to open your heart to someone...? Say something... I'm too shy.

Battle.Transcription: Sensei, are you watching? Peace, peace!
Let's move onto the next one. Cheese!
This is the full extent of my power!
I'll give them everything I have.
I will eliminate everything in my path. After all, that is my role.
I see... So this is what all the fuss is about.
I just did what I can.
Victory. Woohoo! What do you think?
Mission complete. Heehee. Are you satisfied?

Lobby.Transcription:
You're here, Sensei.
I've been waiting. I'll be assisting you today.

Thank you for coming, Sensei.
What can I do for you?

Report for duty? At your command.
...Please give me a reward when I'm done.

You rarely give orders, Sensei.
Does that mean I can do as I please?

Do I need a break?
I've been taking enough breaks, thanks to you.

I have a little bunny rabbit impression I can do.
Boing.
...Please hurry and compliment me.

Give me an order.
I'll do my best to honor the name of C&C.

Happy birthday, Sensei. A round of applause for you.
It's my job as your assistant to celebrate your birthday.

Huh? My birthday...?
Oh... Thank you for celebrating that.
You know actions speak louder than words, right?
Let's go out. I'll assist you.

It's the New Year.
I'm turning over a new leaf. I've upgraded to an updated maid version.
I'll be able to assist you even more efficiently now.
Please don't keep quiet. Hurry, respond.

I know what I'm supposed to say in this situation.
It's "Merry Christmas."
Then I shall shoot down the formidable flying enemy...
...known as Santa Claus that is threatening your safety.

To celebrate Halloween, I've activated my most powerful maid mode.
This is where you say, "You don't look any different than usual!"

Normal.Transcription: Blue, Archive.
How are you? I'm Kirifuji Nagisa, host of the Tea Party at Trinity General School. I'll do my best to assist you.
Heehee. How are you?
The aroma of coffee...is nice from time to time.
(This place is full of students. I shouldn't let my guard down...)
Oh, those treats look so pretty.
(The chairs here look quite comfortable.)

I've been carrying this pistol because it's small and doesn't interfere when I'm making tea, but I'm not sure how good it is for self-protection. If something happens...I'll be counting on you, Sensei.
I will engrave your teaching upon my heart, Sensei.
Heehee! This much power is more than enough for Trinity's host.
I see. I didn't consider that method...
I receive things from you often, Sensei... Thank you.
Tea time with Sensei is always so flavorful. My cup runneth over, so to speak.
If ever you find yourself craving delectable black tea, please do visit the Tea Party. I'll be waiting.
Heehee! I am eternally grateful for your kindness.
As representative of the Trinity students, I would like to express my sincere appreciation for your thoughtfulness, Sensei.

Battle.Transcription: I hope this suits your taste.
One must have music at teatime.
The cannon salute maybe informal. Nevertheless, one should always emulate respect.
A change of scenery from time to time is most welcome.
Each customer's send off must always be prim and proper.
Trinity's artillery is second to none.
Heehee, maybe we can walk a little further today?

Lobby.Transcription:
How have you been, Sensei?
I was preparing tea while waiting for you.

Welcome, Sensei.
If you'd like, how about a cup of black tea before work?

Heehee. The weather is nice today as well.
How about we take a stroll after work?
Huh? Where did the cup warmer go...?

I'm so focused on the task that I keep forgetting this is the Schale office...
Excuse me.
There aren't eyes everywhere in the Schale office like there are in the Tea Party office. I feel more comfortable here.
So as to be a role model to Trinity students, I have to be aware of my surroundings.
(For some reason...I feel calm...and my eyelids keep closing...)
Tea Party tasks are usually desk jobs, so a quality chair is very important.
Why don't you get a new chair for your Schale office?
Happy birthday, Sensei.

I've prepared special tea leaves.
Please come to the Trinity terrace when you're done.

A birthday...gift?
Hmm, I don't really want anything specific, but...
If I could spend a day with you, that would be the best gift I could think of.

I wish you all the best for the New Year.
I'll be counting on you for your guidance again this year.

...This year is almost over.
Did you eat any Christmas cake, Sensei?
If you haven't yet, I prepared some Christmas pudding. Why don't you join me?

This is the limited edition Halloween pumpkin tea I got from Mika, but...
it tastes a bit strange...
...Huh? It's not pumpkin tea, but pumpkin soup paste...?
Mi—ka!

Normal.Transcription: Blue! Archive!
Is there anything fun going on? I, Kurosaki Koyuki, am here! Yahahaha!
Wow, there are a lot of interesting things here!
Th-This is a safe zone, right?! No one can get me here, can they?!
Oh, this place is the infamous...
By any chance...are loud people not allowed here?
*gasp* ...! I'm hungry.
No, um... Huh? Eh? Is this okay? Is it really okay? Sensei...do you...really trust me...?
What? For me? ...Really? You sure you got the right person?
Yahahaha...! So much power...! What? Great responsibility? What's that?
No one can stop me! ...Except Sensei! And my seniors!

Ah, this is... Well, I mean... Wait, maybe it's actually good?
Yaha... You sure you want to do this much for me?
What is it?! A gift?! For me?! From Sensei?!
Thank you so much for the gift! I should be polite to adults, right?
Did I do something wrong today...?
Thank you... I'll treasure it... Really.

Battle.Transcription: This is the joy of...well, you know.
Ehh?! A-Aren't there too many of them?!
Um... Are we doing all of this?
It was worth calling me, wasn't it?
Please call me next time too, okay?

Lobby.Transcription:
You came, Sensei!
I've been waiting for you for so long!

Yahahaha, Sensei!
...Huh? No, I didn't touch anything.
Maybe...?

Can I help you with anything?
Or should I just help you by not doing anything?

Calculations?
They're easy! Not that I like doing them, though.

Did you call me to find a password, by any chance?
I'm not your notepad!

Oh, did you tell my upperclassmen that I'm here?
If I don't let them know, they'll scold me later...

Huh? I'm not bored.
...Huh? I don't know. Why?

Happy birthday, Sensei!
I'll do anything for you today, Sensei.

Yup! Today's my birthday!
Yahahaha! I hope I'm lucky today. Otherwise, I'll be in trouble!

Happy New Year!
Argh! It's already the New Year!
Hmm? When the sun rises in the New Year, is it a new sun? Or is it just the same old sun from last year?

Merry Christmas! We can play all we want today!
Right?
A lot of people are wearing strange outfits today.

...Me? I-I've never...
I don't know if I have, or...have I...? Yahahaha...?

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive.
It's New Year's. I just thought I should wear the right outfit to celebrate... Please keep looking after me this year too, Sensei.
I hope next year will be a good one...in a lot of different ways.
Hah. There's a lot to think about...
But I guess what I really want is peace and good health. Really, that's all...
I hope that everything that happens is stuff we can handle.
I actually...kinda like this outfit. It's not bad, right?
Sensei, am I really gonna be able to... No, wait. Nevermind. I'll make sure I live up to your expectations.
Um... Thank you. Please take care of me this year too, would you?
I don't know if I can meet your expectations...but I'll try.
I wonder what face I should be making right now. ...Sorry. I'm not used to...these kind of situations.
I'm always in your debt, Sensei... I don't know if I can repay you for it, but I'll do my best.
Relationships...are interesting. The more they grow, the more you think about each other.
Um, I don't say this sort of thing often...but I think...I'm glad to have you in my life, Sensei.
I always wondered...how it would feel to ring in the new year with you, Sensei. And now, I think I'm starting to understand that feeling.
Thank you for saying it looks good on me. Although you were probably just being polite. Wait, you meant it? W-Wait, Sensei, that's not fair...

Battle.Transcription: There's no end to the requests this year either.
I think that was a good start to a new year.
Let's get the job done quickly.
Good work, Sensei. And your clothes didn't get dirty. I'm glad.
I shouldn't start the year off by making bad memories.

Lobby.Transcription: Hey, Sensei. Happy New Year.

Wow, you sure have it rough. Trouble right from the start of the year?
Um...it just doesn't seem like anyone else's business.

You think I'm...even cuter in a kimono?
Hmph. Don't say stuff you don't mean.

Hah. That's more than enough teasing out of you, Sensei.
Wait, you...you mean it? E-Even so, that's enough!

About Problem Solver... Don't worry. It's nothing big.
I hope there aren't any...incidents...this year.
What's wrong, Sensei? I can help you with whatever.

Even if it's not official business, if it's something you need, I'd try...
Um, never mind. Forget about it. I didn't say anything.

Happy birthday, Sensei. What do you want as a gift?
Do you want any music? I've got a whole bunch.

My...birthday?
So you remembered. Hearing you wish me a happy birthday doesn't feel half bad.
It makes me happy. Thank you.

It's a new year. Happy New Year, Sensei. I hope you have another great one.
...Pocket money? Really?

It's Christmas. New Year's is coming up soon, isn't it?
All in all...how was the year for you?

Halloween always gets a little rowdy.
Not that I dislike that kind of vibe.

Event.Transcription: Good job, Sensei. Nice to see you.
Did you make a wish?

Things don't always turn out like you want...
But that doesn't mean you should stop dreaming. That's what I think, anyway.
I hope you have a happy, peaceful year.
...Do I feel bad spending all the money I saved for a new album on an offering?

I guess I did go a little overboard, huh...?
Eh. It's worth it to see the boss smile.

Haruka's seemed really overworked lately...
You think she's okay?
(...The Kurokame Gang. I have a bad feeling about this.)
This seems like trouble, right from the start...

An offering thief...
Ugh...this seems like a pain. I don't really wanna...
But it's the boss' orders, so there's nothing I can do...

Hah. Well, that was a disaster.
And I even had to face off against that weird robot...
Oh well. At least it wasn't boring.
Good thing you're here, Sensei. There was something I wanted to ask for your help on.
Sorry, I know it's annoying to be asking this right after New Year's, but...do you think you could make a little time?

Haha, it's weird for Problem Solver to ask Sensei to do a job, and not the other way around, right?
But this the whole thing is a bit weird.

Sorry. I'm not like Mutsuki... I'm really not used to this kind of place.
Um... I'm just not sure what kind of expression I should be making right now.
Thanks for your help. Here's your payment from Problem Solver 68.
Thanks, Sensei. You really saved us...

Normal.Transcription: B-Blue... Archive...
Um, sorry... It's me again already... E-Even though the year's just started...
Ah, I-I'm sorry. Someone like me...shouldn't be wearing something so pretty...
S-Sensei...? Are they not here?
This is Sensei's, so... Why is s-someone like me here?
I-I think I stand out too much...
I wanna hide...
This year and next year, and the year after that...and even in the next life...! I'll get rid of everything that you don't like!
Th-Thank you... Sensei...
Wh-Why are you giving someone like me s-something so meaningful...?
I will repay you for this k-kindness... No matter the c-cost!
Wh-What do I do?! What sh-should I do...?! I'll do anything! P-Please, just tell me!
I-It's too much... You're way k-kinder than someone like me d-deserves...
I-I know I can't do anything r-right. But I'll s-still do whatever you t-tell me to!
I-I'm sor—N-No, I mean. Um... Thank you...
Please look after me...this year t-too... Wait—No. I'm not t-trying to f-force you! I just m-mean...

Battle.Transcription: In the new year, I... Huh?!
Did someone say you could be there?!
Don't run, don't run, don't run, don't run!
C-Can someone like me really be here? Ah, heehee, Sensei.

Lobby.Transcription:
H-Happy New Year, Sensei!
A-And you actually called me, on purpose... I'm sorry!
...Ah! T-Thank you!
Welcome, Sensei! Um, I-I've been waiting! N-Not that you need to rush for someone like me...
To celebrate New Year's... Wh-What should I do? What sh-should I explode...?
What can someone like me do here...

Um...p-plans? For the year?
Oh no. S-Should I have thought about it?!

I-I just want... This year...
I want to l-listen to what you tell me... And learn f-from it... That's my goal...
I-I'm sorry. It's always like this...

H-Happy birthday...
I wanted to say it quietly...so you wouldn't have to listen...

M-My birthday?! W-Why?
Why would you remember something so insignificant?

Happy New Year...! I-If it turns out...that it's a bad year for you...
I'll get rid of the year for you...

I-It's already Christmas...
I was wondering...does Santa get your permission before coming to Schale?
If not, I'll...
Ah... Halloween... I, that is... Th-This time, I didn't shoot...

Event.Transcription: S-S-S-Sensei? Oh! I-I'm sorry! Welcome!

...Heehee. This is an unexpected surprise, Sensei.
Um, n-no! I didn't mean anything in particular by that!
H-Huh?! Wh-Wh-What is it, Sensei?

You called me...for no reason? At all? J-Just because?!
I-I see. Heeheehee...

I-I get to bring in the new year with all the Problem Solver members...and even S-Sensei...
Heehee... It feels...a bit special.

I know it's probably c-completely terrible...to have to spend time with someone...like me...
Oh, that's...not the case? I-I see...
...Th-Thank...thank you, Sensei.

I'm not totally sure...but it seems like something big happened...
...Should I destroy everything?

I think...Aru is having fun...
I'm relieved...heehee.

I guess things have finally calmed down...
But...I wonder...what was that robot?

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive
My name is Kuwakami Kaho, the vice president of Allied Hyakkiyako Academy's Yin-Yang Club. I'm pleased to make your acquaintance.
Hm... This seems like an ideal location to establish Hyakkiyako's Embassy...
So, what space have you reserved for the Hyakkiyako merchandise?
Oh! Did I sense...just now...the presence of my idol...?
Heehee, it's quite raucous in here. It's not a bad atmosphere, though.
To see students from so many different academies... Truth be told, I'm quite impressed with Schale.
Oh! Such a lovely gift, and from you, Sensei? It's too much, but it would be rude to decline. I'll treasure it.
Thank you, Sensei. You've helped me grow.
It's a pleasant experience to feel yourself growing.
You've made me stronger again, Sensei. I want to use that strength to help everybody.
It seems like I've grown a bit more. If even someone like me could be of help to you, that's wonderful.
My heart is pounding... It's... This is my first time feeling something like this.
The more time we spend together, the smaller the distance between our hearts... Yes, I see it.
My whole body feels warm... Could this be—But, no... Perhaps... Urgh.
I've never had someone looking after me before... I also never knew it would make me this happy.

Battle.Transcription: I hope you can keep moving safely.
Now, shall we move on to the next one?
Heehee, this is the strength of the Yin-Yang Club.
Heehee, I hope this can promote Hyakkiyako, even just a little bit.
Ah?! From up in the sky, it's...?
As vice president of the Yin-Yang Club, I will see it done.
Did you find that to be helpful?
Whew... I'm just grateful everyone is all right.

Lobby.Transcription: I've been waiting, Sensei. What's on your schedule today?

Yes, all the preparations have been completed satisfactorily.
Hyakkiyako and Schale... I hope we can work together like a team in a three-legged race.
You called for me, yes?

As the vice president of the Yin-Yang Club, it is my honor to be assigned a shift at Schale.
However, I admit, I do worry that I may not always be able to acquit myself well.

...Oh? You say I've always been a help to you?
Heehee. Thank you. That is a relief.

When things are tough, I draw strength from my collection of Chise merchandise.
...Shall I give you a piece, Sensei?

Schale is certainly admirable.
To think that you'd be able to host advantageous exchanges with so many students...
Heehee, I'll need to study hard myself in order to keep up.

Please visit Hyakkiyako's Yin-Yang Club one day.
I promise that you will find our skills as hosts without flaw.
And, in addition... Niya and Chise will be very happy.

Heehee, please receive my sincere birthday wishes, Sensei.
In fact, I am planning to host a one-night-only celebratory concert in your honor at Hyakkiyako.

Huh? What do you mean, too much? A mere greeting is enough...?
Oh, I really thought it was a good idea. Is it not? I see...

M-My... birthday?
...No, I'm just a bit surprised.

I'm unused to receiving birthday greetings from anyone outside of the Yin-Yang Club...
But I'm very happy to receive them from you. Thank you, Sensei.
Heehee. Happy New Year, Sensei! Thank you for all you've done for us this past year.

Merry Christmas.
It seems that Santa Claus looks quite similar to Namahage. So this year, we're planning on holding an exclusive event at Hyakkiyako with that as a theme.

Huh? You're saying it's totally different? A story unique to Hyakkiyako...?
I see. It seems the cultural differences were larger than I imagined.

Happy Halloween, Sensei!
It is important that we do not lose our culture to the appeal of Halloween. So this fall, Hyakkiyako shall throw beans and shout "Happy Setsubun!"

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive!
Although I look like a maid now, in truth I am still Aris. Please continue to support me, Sensei.
Where shall I begin to clean?
This looks like a location that will trigger a side quest!
I have heard tell that this world holds places called "maid cafes."
A maid needs a master. My master must be you, Sensei!
My maid level has gone up! Wearing this maid uniform has improved my stats!
This...this is a legendary holy sword, imbued with both my strength and Sensei's! Thank you! I will raise my level even higher to become a maid hero worthy of this!
Maid level up! My stats have increased!
I do not have a level cap as a maid or a hero!
I have given a lot of thought to what I must do to become a hero maid. I simply need to level up as both a maid and a hero! Please help me, Sensei!
As long as I am with you, I can become a great hero maid. Please stay with me!
Sensei! Do I look good in a maid uniform?
Heeheehee! I am glad I am with Sensei. Please pat my head some more!
I am a maid today! And as a maid, it is my duty to provide you with shoulder massages, Sensei. What do you say? Tap, tap!
My affinity has improved! But... Can I keep acting like a kid for a little bit longer...?

Battle.Transcription: I will use my mad power to clean up!
Even if I change jobs, I will always be the same Aris.
I will begin the clean up!
The mission was a success! Amazing, Sensei!
Mission complete! That is my favorite catchphrase!
Clean up! Clean up! Oh! I'm ready and waiting!
Time to clean up! Hm? I can go!
Heave-ho. Heave-ho. Oh! I will keep doing my best!
You will not escape my sight!
I am Aris, the maid. I look forward to working with you!
My role today is...light element single-target DPS!
Um... I am still not used to this skin.
I will become a great hero maid!
I did it, Sensei! Please praise me!

Lobby.Transcription:
Welcome, Master!
Aris the maid is here to take care of everything!

Tell me anything.
For now, I am your maid, Sensei!

I am both a hero and a maid today.
So that makes me a hero maid!
A hero maid has to have all the skills of both a hero and a maid.
So that means it is an advanced class!

When I wear a maid uniform, I feel as if my cleaning skill level has increased!
Sensei, do you need me to clean somewhere?

I have heard that a maid has many duties!
Cooking, cleaning, laundry, destruction, ambushes, security and even world peace! ♪

I have heard that a calm mind is very important for a sniper.
Um, S-Sensei? When you pat my head like that...
Augh... I have lost my calm mind...

Sensei, what is on your task list for the day?
Oh, you are going to spend all day vegging out? And you want me to join you?
Yes! I will veg out as well!

Happy birthday, Sensei!
What would you like as a gift item?

The day I met you and my friends in the Game Development Department...
I will not ever forget that day.
Sensei, I look forward to many more days together!

Happy New Year, Sensei!
What is my first task as a maid?
Is it truly all right for me to just spend time with you?

I know.
In games or in reality... Christmas is a time for events!

Happy Halloween!
Today is a day people when disguise themselves as video game characters!
Or...is it that video games are becoming reality today...?

Event.Transcription: Please hurry, Sensei! It is a very special event!
My loadout is equipped! I am ready to go! What about you, Sensei?
I have worked very hard to clean and keep watch. Did I do a satisfactory job?

Uh... This is much more complicated than I expected...
But I am okay! Because I am a hero maid!

That was an incredible adventure!
As long as we are in a party together, I am not afraid of anything, Sensei!

My maid level still is not very high...
But I will continue to grind for more EXP!

Sensei, please tell me if you see Neru anywhere.
Promise me, okay?

Cooking, cleaning, laundry... A maid must level up many skills.
Will you join me on this quest, Sensei?

Um, you can hit me, but I will not drop any loot...
I am not a mob!

Welcome, Sensei!
A hero maid can even work as a shopkeeper!

We have many powerful items in stock!
But since it is you, Sensei... I think you can have whatever you want!

The event is over, but the shop is still open!
However, only for a little bit longer! So you cannot dilly-dally! Promise!

Welcome to Aris' Adventure Supplies!
We have many powerful potions and materials to aid in your quest!

Oh! A smile, Sensei?
Right away! Momoi told me that smiles are free!

Bum bum bum! Item acquired!
I shall grant you an upgrade! One premium smile, coming up!

Hohoho... You have quite an eye for quality, dear guest.
How did I do? I memorized dialogue for these kinds of situations!

O' weary traveler, is this your choice?
Did you like it, Sensei? I have been wanting to try that one!

Inventory management is also part of a maid's duty!
I will work hard again today!

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive.
Hello, Sensei. It's me, Toki. Prepare to see the true power of an undercover agent.
A peaceful tea time... It certainly is relaxing.
This place truly improves one's quality of life.
If I had time and a budget... I too would like to create a place like this.
As an agent, it is forbidden to let one's guard down. But here...it is difficult to avoid.
I find I am reminded of many things when I visit. I don't necessarily mind it, though.
I have been told that sometimes it is not a weakness to tell someone your honest feelings. In that case...thank you, Sensei. From the bottom of my heart.
I will continue on this path until I am the best bunny agent of us all.
My role is to protect you, Sensei. That's the one thing I can't leave to anyone else.
I'll do my best to not bring shame to these rabbit ears. What? That's not it...?
Infiltrator, action, escort, entry, maid, or bunny girl—I will follow your orders.
You need to visit me more often, Sensei—at least as often as I think of you.
Being with you puts my heart at ease. Sometimes I even fall asleep.
You can always lean on me. If you need help, no matter what, I'll be there. I've always wanted to say that.
I need you as much as you need me, Sensei. I know I shouldn't say such embarrassing things, but it needed to be said. Heehee!

Battle.Transcription: Call sign Bunny Zero-Four, on the move.
Hop, hop! I am the greatest agent.
What are your orders for the invincible bunny girl, Sensei?
No need to worry. I'm a bunny, after all.
Anyone could have seen that coming. Yahoo!

Lobby.Transcription:
Hello, Sensei.
Today, I am on the shift as a bunny.
I look forward to working with you. Boing, boing.

Welcome back, Sensei. I've been waiting.
Let me repeat that, so you understand that it's important.
I've been waiting. Boing, boing.

I am a rabbit, and not a puppy...
But if you make me to wait like this...
I might make a mess.

What was it you called me for?
Is there an operation? Is it security? Combat? Destruction? Justice?
Huh? There wasn't a reason you called?

Schale duty is certainly interesting.
You seem busy, and yet you're not working...

It's not that I'm always eager for work.
I, too, enjoy killing time.
However... I'd like to be someone you can rely on, Sensei.

Sensei, please help. There's been an incident.
