I've come down with a terrible case of boredom. It's extremely serious.

Happy birthday, Sensei.
Huh? Of course I remembered.
An excellent memory is a basic prerequisite for becoming an extraordinary agent.
Well, are you ready? We must celebrate.

It is my birthday. Thank you for remembering.
However, I am acting as an undercover agent right now.
I'd also like to ask you to celebrate in an inconspicuous space, with just the two of us.

It's already New Year's. Time certainly has flown...
Have you made any resolutions?
Tell me. I will ensure that you don't break them.

It's Christmas.
Oh, you don't need to worry about me.
I'm not cold. ...Achoo!
You... You saw nothing. *sniff*

Today is Halloween.
I have seen many people disguised like me today.
Is it possible that they're all aspiring agents?

Event.Transcription:
Welcome, Sensei.
Preparations for the stealth mission are complete.
Everything is ready. Awaiting your orders.
This place appears to hold a secret.

I understand that you have been through a great deal, and may be experiencing some confusion. But please trust me.
You can always rely on me, Sensei.

Good. It all wrapped up satisfactorily.
I will simply consider this a learning experience on my path to becoming the perfect agent.
Yes, Sensei. What is it?

Ha... In these clothes, it feels rather...
But the fabric is so thin, I suppose that's inevitable...

You mean the bunny suit?
It has different advantages from the maid uniform. It's fitting for certain situations.

You think I look good in it?
Hm... Thank you. I wasn't expecting such a response.
Hello, Sensei. Today's tasks are ready for you.

It is important to consider every detail of a mission.
Let's work step by step today.

I understand that it can be overwhelming to be assigned a full schedule.
However, I am here to assist you, Sensei.

An agent and a mission go hand-in-hand.
...In other words, you are an agent now, too.
We have completed today's tasks. Good work, Sensei.

Even by my standards, this has been demanding.
You are certainly impressive, Sensei.
Hello, Sensei. Today's tasks are ready for you.

It is important to consider every detail of a mission.
Let's work step by step today.

I understand that it can be overwhelming to be assigned a full schedule.
However, I am here to assist you, Sensei.

An agent and a mission go hand-in-hand.
...In other words, you are an agent now, too.
We have completed today's tasks. Good work, Sensei.

Even by my standards, this has been demanding.
You are certainly impressive, Sensei.

Normal.Transcription: Blue...Archive...
It's me, Hanaoka Yuzu... Um, I look a little different right now because of...a few reasons. Thanks for your help...
I'm a maid right now... So maybe I should...clean something?
Is a maid that develops games...something people would like?
Ugh...I wanna hide somewhere...
For an infiltration mission...cardboard boxes are a necessity.
Welcome, Master. Um...like I thought, it's too embarrassing...
This... You must've gone to such lengths for this... I'm so happy! I promise to work even harder from now on, Sensei... You'll see!
S-Sensei?! Oh, u-um...! Aaah!
I'm always so...grateful. I'm very glad that... you're here...
I was able to...take a big step like this...so I want to keep on changing.
Right now I'm...a maid...so I want to be able to help you, Sensei.
Um, Sensei... N-No! It's nothing...
I've been able to do my best because you were with me the whole way, Sensei. I can't possibly deliver what I feel with words, but...um...thank you.
Um, Sensei? What do you think of maids? And... What do you think of my look?
Um... If I were more optimistic, then...there's something I need to tell you, Sensei. Wait—Now?! Uh, w-well I...!

Battle.Transcription: When it comes to hiding...I'm pretty confident!
If Sensei stays with me... I will!
P-Please put me back inside the box...

Lobby.Transcription:
Eeek! W-Who?!
Oh, it's just you, Sensei. That's a relief. I mean, welcome.

I've been waiting, Sensei...
I'm happy that you're here.

I'm not very good at cleaning, but...
If you ask me to, Sensei...

What? You're saying I...look good?
Um, I'd rather you didn't make fun of me...
Y-You're not? You mean it? Then...that's just...
Why do people wear cat ears with maid uniforms, I wonder?
Cats don't seem like they'd make good maids... If anything, they're more the master type...
This...may be a good reference for the game.
This frilly outfit...it's a bit embarrassing.

H-Happy birthday, Master.
I just thought I should try it once, since I'm a maid...

Oh, you remembered my birthday? Thank you.
It's all right. There's no need to do anything special.
Just being with you, Sensei... I mean, being with you, Master is enough to make me happy.
Um, I-I mean... As a maid, that's my official stance!

Happy New Year, Master.
...U-um, maybe it's better if I just call you Sensei.
I heard Santa comes in through the chimney.

It's too bad we don't have a chimney in the Game Development Department...
I'd like to go inside one, if I have the chance.
A chimney looks pretty cozy...

Halloween...
The streets are full of people in costumes, but...
It's not a holiday I care much about.
I'm familiar with it from game events, though.

Event.Transcription:
Sensei! Um...
Welcome, Master.

There's so many people here... I'm not used to crowds...
But I can think of it like a special event, right?

Cleaning, hosting...
Ugh... I just wish there were fewer guests...

Th-There's big trouble!
Sensei...please help me!

I still can't believe all of that happened...
But...it all turned out okay. Thanks to you.

Th-The box... Where is the box...? Without it, I...
Oh! You found it!
Thank you, Sensei.

Um... Even though it was scary...
...all of this might be good inspiration for the game I'm working on...
Sensei, will...will I do okay?

Ugh... I really want to go home and play games...
But I can't just sit here being scared... That helps no one.
After all, if I don't try to do everything I can...

Normal.Transcription: Blue! Archive!
Hi, hello! Everyone's superstar savior, Uzawa Reisa, is here!
Oh, this is...a lot of people...
Should I just go...?
No, I have to push forward as normally as possible in times like this!
I-I gotta stop... Everyone's gonna think I'm strange.
This seems like a really safe place!
I can't...really believe it. I'm really helping you, Sensei? I always hope I am, but...
Th-This is for...me?
Thank you, Sensei! I'll make sure to do even better!
There's no end to how much I, Uzawa Reisa, can grow!
Responsibility and personal growth go hand in hand! I will do my best!
If it's okay with you, um, I'd like to escort you more often...
I'm afraid I've shown you too much, but... I guess it's fine. It is YOU, after all!
I've made it as far as I have thanks to you, Sensei.
Just as you do, I look forward to working more with you!

Battle.Transcription: Leave it to me, Uzawa Reisa!
I'll go wherever you need my strength!
Here comes Uzawa Reisa with the whole gang!
Whew! That was an easy win!

Lobby.Transcription:
There you are, Sensei!
Uzawa Reisa, reporting for duty!

Oh! It's Sensei's grand entrance!
So, what's the plan for today?
You called me, Sensei? What did you wanna talk about?

Ah, was my voice...too loud?
Your head was ringing? Oh no! Sorry!

Hmm. Interesting!
I've noticed that when I come here, some of my tension just goes away!

Um, do you have an errand for me to run, maybe?
It feels a bit weird to just stand here...

Have no fear! No matter what happens...
I, Uzawa Reisa, will be by your side, Sensei!

Happy birthday, Sensei!
Since it's a special day, we should do something special! Ooh, I know! Let's go on a patrol together!

You remembered my birthday? Thanks!
A whole lot of people have wished me a happy birthday this year!

It makes me happy to have lived this long!
Even though... Well, it's true I'm only 15...

Happy New Year, Sensei!
I'll be counting on you for backup this year!

Merry Christmas!
Huh? A gift exchange?

Aaah! I forgot! I forgot!
I'm really not used to this kind of thing...
If there's no candy, I won't stand for being teased!
...Huh? Did I interpret something wrong?

Event.Transcription: Oh, Sensei! Over here!

Here comes the superhero of the Vigilante Crew!
It is I, Uzawa Reisa! Hi!
Ooooh... Things are heating up!
The final sprint!
Let's keep trying our best until the very end!
That's right! Uzawa Reisa's here on standby!
What is it? Whatever it is, feel free to let me know!
There was an incident? Where?! Who's the culprit?!
Um... Being still is...really difficult for me...
I found some stuff on my patrol today! Lemme show you!

In this line of work...I see a lot of lost stuff.
I sure hope they find their owners!
Is there anything you need more of? Lemme check and see what we've got!

Hm? What are you looking for?
Is it not here?

Okay! Just let me know if you need anything!
I'll go get it for you right away!
Oooh, I see, I see.
Hm! Yep, that's good too!
So, that's what you needed?
Okay! Here it is!

Oh! Hey there, Sensei!
There's a whole mountain of things to do!
So...I made a list! Let's check everything off together.
Huh? Sensei? What's wrong?
Concentrate! We gotta focus, okay?
Wow! I knew it, Sensei!
Nice! It's all going so well!

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive
My name is Akeshiro Rumi. I am president of Shanhaijing Academy's Black Tortoise Promenade. You can call me Rumi.
The decor here... I wonder how it would look at the Promenade?
The snacks here too... We could learn from this.
It's been too long since I've relaxed like this...
Let's hope our Genryumon friends don't try to pick a fight with me.
So peaceful... Yes, this is nice.
It's important to use weapons that fit well in your hands, whether on the battlefield or in the kitchen.
Huh, did I get stronger?
This feeling... It's not bad at all. And it's thanks to you, Sensei.
Thanks, Sensei. Why don't you visit the Black Tortoise Promenade some time? I'll treat you.
Now that I'm stronger, maybe I can make more food... Are you hungry, Sensei?
I'm everyone's cook, head chef, and head of the Promenade, but... Sometimes... I just want to be something special for just one person.
Hm... I'm sorry, Sensei. I'm not quite...used to these kinds of emotions. This is really the first time—you know...
I'm inviting you to spend time here today, Sensei—not as the head of the Promenade, but as Rumi, the student. What do you say?
Responsibility is a heavy burden to bear, and at times... I wish I could let it go... Thank you for listening, Sensei.

Battle.Transcription: You have nothing to worry about.
Why not try a little harder?
Yeah, yeah. You called? So, what're you craving?
No one can fight on an empty stomach. I'm not joking.
Maybe I should go over there.
I guess that should do it. Good work, everybody.
In that case... Hah! How's that?
Feeling hungry? Have as much as you'd like!
Would you like me to make you something?
Do you need my help? You can count on me.
Whoa...! That's dangerous. You need to be more precise.
Shall we get started? Try to keep up.
An enemy... I would have preferred negotiating with them.

Lobby.Transcription:
Oh, Sensei. There you are.
I thought you forgot about us. Haha.

Hello, Sensei.
Making the president of the Black Tortoise Promenade wait... How bold of you.

This is Schale... Ah, sorry.
I rarely spent so much time away from the kitchen. It's not what I expected.

To a chef, the kitchen is a battlefield...
Does that mean this is Sensei's battlefield?

Sure you have something I can use to cook here...
I was thinking about making something.

Food is important, isn't it, Sensei?
Don't skip meals, and don't eat just anything. Got it?

The reason I like cooking? Well... Cooking is always honest.
The more effort you put in, the better it tastes. The more you study, the more opportunities open up.
In a way... It's like you, Sensei.

I remembered, Sensei. It's your birthday, right?
That's why I made some long noodles for you. I also have some peaches for dessert. Make sure you eat everything!

My birthday...? Thanks, Sensei.
It's been a while since I celebrated it with anyone...
When you're the merchant guild president, it's easy to lose track of the days.

Happy New Year. I'll be counting on you this year too.
New Year means it's time for jiaozi dumplings! And kagami mochi! And steamed fish and rice cake soup and...
Huh? You think that your stomach will burst if you eat all that...?

Christmas... It's not a holiday that's very familiar to me, but I enjoy the atmosphere.
Today, I plan to make some tanghulu. What do you think?

Halloween... I'm not quite used to it, but I do know what it is.
Let's see... Should I try making some pumpkin mooncakes?

Event.Transcription: Oh, there you are, Sensei. How are you enjoying Shanhaijing?

I'm glad you didn't get lost.
The streets of Shanhaijing are complicated.
Those Genryumon guys never change. For better or worse.
Don't worry. The Black Tortoise Promenade—and myself—are on your side.

After all that, we're finished.
It's all thanks to you, Sensei. You haven't lost anything, have you? If so, I'll go find it.

My shoulders have been so stiff lately... I need a massage.
Maybe from Sensei...? *gulp*

Haha! You can't tickle the truth out of me, you know!
I can offer you one of the dishes I'm still studying, but...

I always provide the highest quality food to my guests!
And, well... If I'm still studying a dish, it might not be at that level yet.

Sensei, you are very important to me.
You're a customer and a colleague and...um...
Sorry, I've said too much...

We're known for our food...
But the main work of the Black Tortoise Promenade is commerce.
You can leave product management to us.

Of course, product sourcing and distribution are important...
But so are presentation and the layout of your goods. Take your time and look carefully.

Things have been taken care of, but I plan on continuing the store for a while.
It's important to always finish your work.
Hm. What's wrong? Are you concerned about something?

Just let me know if you need anything.
...I'll buy the right one next time.
Thank you as always! It's been a while since I saw the store. Haha.
Do you want that one? A good pick. Quality guaranteed!
Make your purchase before it's sold out. There's nothing worse than waiting for the next shipment.

As you probably know, Sensei, there's no such thing as a free lunch.
If a product you use or consume is free...
All that means is you've become the product yourself without even knowing!
Now, Sensei. It's time to test your luck.
Make a choice. I wonder what will come out.
Spend it all here or you'll regret it later.
This is just one of the many enterprises the Promenade is involved in.
As with anything, luck is important.
Amazing! What a surprise! Congratulations, Sensei.

This card is really rare. It's quite valuable.
I'm really happy for you.
Let's see here... The result is....? Well, it's still good...
Yikes... Well, well... Don't be too disappointed, Sensei. There's always next time.

Normal.Transcription: Blue, Archive.
I am Konoe Mina, executive officer of Shanhaijing Academy's Genryumon. I'll take care of anything or anyone that gets in our way!
They say every lost ship needs a lighthouse to lean on. Ah... F-Forget I said that!
The scent of tea hangs in the air... I'm not good at making it, but it came out pretty good.
A place where nothing moves, not even a muscle... That's what this place is.
The cafes in Shanhaijing are more like tea houses...
It smells good... Maybe I should relax a bit.
Amazing... It fits perfectly. Like it was mine all along. Heh heh. I'm all ready now. Shall we go?
I feel stronger! Is this...thanks to you, Sensei?
The me of today is stronger than the me of yesterday... That's just how things worked out.
Here's looking at you, kid! Get it...? Do you really not know? Oh well... Sorry, I was just going with the vibes.
When we have something to protect, we will stand strong. Don't ask me what that's from. I can't remember every little thing, okay?
They say you should be cautious when hunting for birds—not too fast, not to slow... Hang on—How did I get on the subject of birds...? I-I don't know.
One day, we will all meet our end. Until that day comes, I hope we continue working well together... Wow! Wasn't that a cool line?!
We can close the gap one step at a time. Then one day... Wait, then what?
...I was told to avoid what is unfamiliar to me. But I've also heard that I can't grow if I don't challenge myself... Ugh, forget I said anything.

Battle.Transcription: Those who stand still cannot achieve victory.
Respect to friends and bullets to traitors... Heh.
I was just savoring the moment... Heehee.
Now...is the time to stand up.
It's going to rain soon. Huh.
I wonder if there is meaning to this life.
We have a future together, don't we?
I guess there's no dream you won't wake up from.
One has to hold their fate with their own hands.
It's always like this. I don't want to get controlled by the environment.

Lobby.Transcription:
Oh, it's you, Sensei. To meet you in a place like this... This is a small world indeed.
Oh? You think I'd obviously meet you since we're at Schale...?
Y-Yeah...

I've been waiting for you, Sensei.
What does the world have in store for us today? I'm excited.

No person can live alone...
It's a cliché, but I don't hate it.

Humans should be wary of other humans... But humans must also trust their fellow humans.
Should I trust you, Sensei? Or...
Don't worry so much, Sensei. Everything will be okay by tomorrow.

Movies are a great thing. Especially those that have passed the test of time.
They don't survive because they are classics. They are called classics because they survived.

Sometimes I wish I could really be someone.
I don't care who it would be. Just anyone greater than me.
Perhaps, that is why... I enjoy movies.

Congratulations, Sensei. For what? Why! Your birthday of course!
My gift is...top 10 noir movies selected by me!
Let's watch them together!

Heh... Being wished happy birthday by Sensei. Not bad.
I can't stand sitting around all day like some kind of desk jockey.
Hang out with me today!

It's a new year... Happy New Year, Sensei.
Sensei, do you have a new year resolution?
Mine, of course, is to live an even more hard-boiled life.

Is there a Christmas...festival?
The word festival seems to mean many different things.
...What's with the look? I didn't mean anything by it.

Is it Halloween...? That's a favorite for kids everywhere.
Maybe I should stop by the Plum Blossom Garden and pass out some candy...
Sensei, if it's okay with you, why don't you join me?

Event.Transcription:
Sensei? Hurry over to Shanhaijing.
Oh, and I suggest you steer clear of the Black Tortoise Promenade.

This is Shanhaijing.
Heh. Don't let your eyes wander too much. I'd hate for you to get lost.

This must the be doing of the Black Tortoise Promenade.
I can tell that much at a glance.

How did this happen...?
Ugh... I hate it when things get complicated...!

What an ending...I never imagined...
Well... I think things ended well. Good.

Oh? You got something to say? Go ahead.
There are some days when I just want to tell people what I really think.

Why?
We've still got business to finish.
And even if it's dirty business...somebody's got to do it.
Wasn't that a cool line?

Shanhaijing is noisier than usual.
Is it because you're here...?

If there's action to be had, we'll be the first ones to act.
So let's go.

Purpose. Duty. Operation. Mission. They all mean the same.
Don't worry. We'll take this one at a time.
When there are multiple missions, I take care of the simple ones first. That makes things go more smoothly.

If you ever feel overwhelmed by your tasks, let me know right away.
I will always be on your side, Sensei.
This would have been difficult for even a Genryumon member... I'm surprised, Sensei.
You really did it, Sensei! I knew I wasn't wrong about you.

You've been taking on difficult missions like a pro.
B-But...! Any Genryumon member can do that!

Normal.Transcription: Blue, Archive.
Civil engineering, construction, demolition... Contact us if you need workers. We'll even agitate for you!
The most important thing in the field is safety, above all else.
The architecture here... I'll just say it's not bad.
Leave it to our workers. This is nothing...
A 3-day work week... What a lovely phrase...
The pudding here seems...different from the pudding supplied by the secretariat.
Strong, trustworthy equipment is your best partner on a work site. In that sense... This rascal has never disappointed me.
With hard work and dedication, growth is guaranteed.
Your lessons are always easy to understand. Thanks.
Class enlightenment is the mainstaple of a successful revolution.
The next job should be safe too.
Thanks to you, our workers are more robust.
I know I can always count on you to watch my back.
I'd describe this feeling as...revolutionary!
Monopolies are such a bourgeois thing to do... But if I were monopolizing you, Sensei... Well, I might be tempted.

Battle.Transcription: I refuse to accept sub-par pudding!
We call for the Red Winter Federal Academy Secretariat to hear our demands!
Guarantee rights and protections for all workers!
When our wills coalesce into one we have nothing to fear!
I'll do my best to prove the value of labor.

Lobby.Transcription:
Stay safe today!
Let's aim for a new "No Accident" record in Schale!
You're late. This isn't sabotage, is it?

Sensei, I don't know what you're trying to prove
with this sabotage, but...
Safety, check! Confirmation, check! Accident-free, check!

When it comes to pudding, I love all flavors.
Custard cream, chocolate, even fruit...
...just not water pudding.
(What would be a good justification for our next coup d'etat...?)

Sensei, I think you've been working too late for too long...
You are getting overtime pay, right?

I wonder what our upperclassman is doing right now...
I hope our upperclassman is doing well.

Congratulations, Sensei.
Let us celebrate the birth of a new comrade today.
Heehee... Sensei, do you know what today is?

Yes! It's a day that we should celebrate with our all!
On this day, the people rose up and demanded freedom!

Huh...? It's my birthday...?
...I totally forgot.

This is the year we claim the Red Winter Academy Secretariat for the party.
We'll create a paradise for workers...!

Only distributing gifts to good kids...
This Santa Claus sounds like a dirty capitalist to me.
I once tasted a limited time Halloween pumpkin pudding...

It had a subtle sweetness that was oh, so luxurious...
I'd even work weekends for another taste of such a snack...
Eek! Wh-What am I saying...?

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive.
RABBIT 1, outfit change completed. Undercover operation commencing.
(I want to take a shower...)
There's a delicious smell coming from somewhere...
(I should have chosen a cuter swimsuit...)
This is Sensei's... What am I doing...?
Sensei... Where could you be...?
RABBIT Type 31 Submachine Gun , acquired. The internal workings have been modified to operate underwater, but maybe we could also modify the exterior to be...cuter?
Thank you for the support. I'll make sure to meet your expectations.
It feels like I'm receiving different things than usual. ...Huh? It's because I'm on an undercover mission?
You've given me a lot, Sensei. I'll make sure to put it all up to good use.
Delivery confirmed. Thank you.
Y-You sure it's okay? To do all this for me? I-I'm not saying I hate it, of course.
Thank you, Sensei. I'll cherish it.
Is there anything I can do for you? Anything you need...
Well...given the occasion, if Sensei is okay with it...

Battle.Transcription: It's all thanks to you, Sensei.
UV protection...is also part of the mission.
It's time to test out the new drone.
Even if I'm wearing a swimsuit, it won't impact my ability to carry out the operation.

Lobby.Transcription:
Welcome, Sensei.
Preparations are complete. Whatever your command, I will complete it perfectly.
Welcome, Sensei. I've been waiting for you.
...Hm? Wasn't I cold, waiting for you in my swimsuit?
That wasn't a problem. Regardless of the situation, waiting for you is never difficult, Sensei.
So...this swimsuit... Does it look good on me?

I've only ever worn SRT Academy's standard-issue swimsuits before, so...
...this cute design feels a bit unnatural to me.
I'm pretty good at swimming, although Saki can still beat me...
Since I'm off-duty right now... I can help you with non-mission related things.

Could it be because rabbits don't like water...?
I don't think I've ever seen a rabbit-pattern swimsuit.

Maybe that means cows are good swimmers, since cow print suits are pretty popular.
A rabbit pattern would be really nice though...

Please don't hesitate to call on me for help.
I'll always be there for you, Sensei.

Happy birthday, Sensei.
I've...been pretty busy recently, so I wasn't able to prepare a gift, but...
Instead, I'll do anything you ask today. Anything at all.
Is it my...birthday?

Heehee...
I think I've already received my gift... So it's okay.

I'm looking forward to the new year, Sensei.
This year, even if we don't have a mission, let's go to the ocean...
...I'm sorry. Don't mind me.

Today is not the day for this outfit.
...Next time, I'll wear something more appropriate...

It's noisy outside...
I wanted to treasure the memories we made today.

Event.Transcription: Today's mission is to infiltrate and investigate... I hope we don't run into any trouble.
RABBIT 1, preparations completed. Sensei, your orders, please.

I'm afraid I've upset the town residents...
What should I do?
Heehee... We really did this summer in full SRT-style, didn't we? It was more fun than a simple beach vacation, in a lot of ways.
Great job, Sensei.

I know we're here on a mission, but we are at the beach after all...
...Do you have some time for us?
When was the last time I had a shrimp sandwich...?
(I shouldn't look too excited...)

I've made arrangements for our absence.
The students at the Valkyrie Public Safety Bureau will be watching Bun Bun while we're gone.

I have to admit, I get a little jealous sometimes...
It's just that... Bun Bun seems to like the Public Safety Bureau students more than us sometimes.
Welcome, Sensei. I've organized a list of things we'll need for the investigation.
...This is the target for today's undercover operation.
Yes. H-How can I help you?
Um... The fabric of this swimsuit is somewhat thin...
I-If you look at me like that... I don't know what to say...
As I'd expect, Sensei. I had faith in you.
Thank you for your assistance. You were a huge help.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive.
RABBIT 2, mission preparation completed. Remember your training, even at sea!
(This outfit really is uncomfortable to move around in, especially indoors...)
(Is...that edible...?)
Dressing like this for the next mission might not be a bad idea.
Could that be...the weapon I saw in the manual...?
Nothing to report! Continue patrol!
RABBIT Type 26 Machine Gun, acquired. Fully waterproofed, this baby won't malfunction even on the high seas. Of course, I still need to clean and oil it after every battle...
No matter the environment, we can never neglect our training.
Today's sweat leads to tomorrow's victory.
I'm not trying to brag, but...I think I've grown a little bit stronger...
(I wonder...if I've gotten closer to my seniors with this.)
Well, if it's coming from Sensei...whatever orders you have, I'll take them.
I don't want to be seen failing. Especially not in front of Sensei.
This is... It's, uh...a way to show my thanks for always helping me...
If something's troubling you, call me whenever. Even if it's not SRT-related.

Battle.Transcription: Ooh... I can feel the energy rising...!
"Know thyself and thy enemy, conquer a hundred battles!"
For an SRT special forces member, this is a piece of cake!
(This is why I can't quit diving...!)
This one's going to hurt, you know!
An underwater mission. I wonder how I'll do...
In the mountains or out at sea, there's no limit to SRT!
Wait... Don't stand so close during an operation. It's dangerous!
Commencing search. Advance, and watch out for ambushes.
Heehee, a victory by the numbers!
As expected... The manual doesn't lie.

Lobby.Transcription: Hello, Sensei. I was just cleaning my gun.
Wh-Whoa! When did you get here?
I wasn't slacking off!

It's really hot again today.
Are you making sure everyone is taking preventative measures against heat stroke?

We need to be careful about dehydration. Drinking water is very important.
It's also important to get enough sodium.

I really don't like the ocean much.
Firearms malfunction more easily in that environment.
But an SRT student should be prepared for any situation.
I'm using a waterproof tactical map, meant to be used at sea.
Moe said to just use some waterproofed GPS equipment, but...
I don't want to do that. A paper map has a value of it's own.
(It would have been nice to come to the sea with everyone for a reason other than a mission...)
What did I do with my helmet?

This boonie hat is serving as my helmet.
This actually happens to be made of bulletproof fiber!

Happy birthday, Sensei.
I'll handle the busywork for today. Go home early and get some rest.
If you end up working late even on your birthday... That's just kind of sad.
...A birthday gift? I...don't really need anything...

If it's okay with you, let's have dinner together.
I don't care what we eat. Even just convenience store food is fine.

Happy New Year, Sensei! What's your resolution?
As for me... I want to eat fresh fish at least once a week...
I-I mean... I'll work hard to resurrect SRT Academy!
Oh, Sensei. If you have some time in the evening, please stop by Kousagi Park.

Moe got a large turkey to celebrate Christmas, but...
It was way too big for RABBIT Squad to finish on our own.
Having a BBQ at Schale might be difficult so...let's have a party at the park.
Recently, I've noticed more pumpkin in the convenience store lunches other students throw away...
Does that mean...that the Halloween season I've heard so much about is upon us?

Event.Transcription: RABBIT Squad's first away mission... I'm getting excited.
This is a chance for SRT to show our stuff!
There's something...suspicious about this town. They're hiding something...

I really don't wanna help those jerks! Ugh.
But providing assistance to civilians is part of SRT's duties.
I'm glad the misunderstanding has been resolved. Now, there's no need to worry about a lack of shrimp.
RABBIT 2, preparations completed! We can enter at any time!
Well, I tried to dress like a normal tourist...
I don't look suspicious... Do I?
Hey... Sensei, is there something on my stomach?
I don't personally like seafood much. It's too difficult to preserve.
I do like dried seafood though, like dried squid!

Normal.Transcription: Blue... A-Archive...
R-RABBIT 4, reporting for duty. Should I...really be dressed like this...?
Everyone's wearing these amazing outfits...
U-Ugh...
Even though I'm wearing a s-swimsuit...no one is noticing me.
(I wonder what they're talking about...)
Wh-Where did everyone g-go?
RABBIT Type 39 Rifle, a-acquired. Sniping on the ocean has m-many difficulties due to the w-wind and waves. But if it's within 1 km... I-I can do it...

Oh, but I don't have anything to give you in return...!

If you're sure... This is all so new to me...

Happy New Year, Sensei!
I-If...it's okay with you, why don't you spend New Years with the Knowledge Liberation Front?

Merry Christmas, Sensei!
If I could ask Santa for a Christmas gift...
It'd be for a first edition book that I've been searching for...

I've read about Halloween in a lot of manga.
I guess that makes sense, since it's a day when all the monsters get together.

Event.Transcription:
Welcome, Sensei!
Heehee. I've been waiting!

Hi, Sensei!
If there's anything I can do, just let me know.

Seems like things are getting bigger and bigger...
But I'm sure it'll be okay, right, Sensei...?

It's too late to turn back now.
The Knowledge Liberation Front will push on!
Somehow, it's finally over... I'm just glad everyone's safe.
Yes? Did you call me, Sensei?

I wonder what Meru is doing right now...
I just hope she's not going crazy somewhere...

I like reading text just as much as looking at pictures.
Comics can teach us so many things.
S-Sensei? I feel embarrassed...when you look at me like that...
Are you looking for something, Sensei? Take your time.
I'm used to arranging and displaying things. Just leave it to me!

Look around as much as you'd like.
I'd hate for you to get the wrong things.

Managing the shop...?
This is nothing compared to managing the library.

What if there's an out-of-print first edition book mixed in here somewhere...? What should I do...?
Oh! I-I'm not saying I'd snatch it up for myself...!
Oh, so you picked that one.
Wait just a moment... Yes, here!

And...what's the line...?
"Oh! You have great taste!"

Thank you so much!
I was so professional just now! Heehee...
Welcome, Sensei. What would you like?

Are you getting your fortune?
Can I watch from the side? Heehee.
Is there something wrong?
Yes, Sensei? What's going on?

A little luck, just for you...
I've always wanted to say something like that!
Wow, you won! That's amazing, Sensei!
Sensei, you have really great luck! This is so great!

Can I see?
Hmm... This is pretty good!

Aah...
D-Don't be too sad. At least you have me, Sensei!

Normal.Transcription: Blue! Archive!
Whether you need keen scientific insight or a spirited cheer, just leave it to me!
Oh! There are so many people here!
I could even hold a lecture here!
Sensei, your decorating style is...fascinating!
Oh, what's that...?
While I'm at it, I might as well find a stage to cheer on!
Allow me to explain how this gun works... Just kidding! Sensei, you already know... When you collect enough of this knowledge, one day...
This is all for cheering, meaning it's for everyone, right?!
Thank you, Sensei! I'll work hard to earn all the attention you've given me!
I'm the one who's cheering, but...for some reason, it's embarrassing!
It feels like I'm the one who's always getting cheered on. I want you to be that someday, Sensei!
Sensei... Um, do you need cheering? Maybe, if you're okay with someone like me...!
I'm always ready! Just let me know if you need me!
I'd be happy...if this could repay you for all you do for me...
Do you like...my cheerleader outfit? If so, I'll wear it every day!

Battle.Transcription: This is...! Thank you for your consideration!
Huh? I'm at the very front? I'm in the cheer squad, though...
I'll take the lead! ...Was that not it?
Right, on to the next one!
We've still got a ways to go!
Look at me! Here I go!
Ehhh, what is all this?! I'm sorry!
Yes! Leave it all to me!
If you're in need of cheering, it's my time to shine!
Play! Play Ah, not yet? Haha.
Mmm! This is going to be a long fight!
I see, this is going to need some cheering!
Phew... That was a great match! Good work!

Lobby.Transcription: Sensei, Sensei! You can do it! Stay strong!

I've been waiting for you, Sensei! Shall I cheer you on?
...You do need a cheer, don't you?

Oh, this outfit?
What do you think? Isn't it pretty?

Uh, umm... I'm not sure why, but...
I feel little embarrassed...
D-Don't just look at me like that. Please say something!
Schale needs cheerleaders too, so this cheer is just for you!

Do you know the history of cheerleading?
Oh... I see.

Happy birthday, Sensei!
Since today's your special day, I'll cheer you on in a special way!

M-My birthday...?! I-I never imagined that you'd remember...
I'm so happy! Hahaha!

Have a happy New Year!
I'll come cheer you on whenever you need it, Sensei!
Merry Christmas! Oh, did you know that Christmas started as...

Wow, it's so noisy outside!
Hmm... Do people know the real origin of Halloween?

Event.Transcription: Leave the cheering—and explaining—to me!

Play, play, run and play! You can do it, go Sensei!
How was that? Did it give you a burst of energy?
Things are heating up! You can do this!
Almost there! I'll cheer you on until the very end!

Ugh! I'm exhausted.
But I also feel...refreshed!
Oh? What is it?

Do you have a question for me?
Then, I...!

I-If you keep poking me like that...
This is a bit embarrassing...
Eek! W-Was that you, Sensei...?

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive
The season of exercise...and appetite! There's a culinary feast to be enjoyed...and I have no choice but to take advantage of this opportunity.
Let us now depart on a gastronomic adventure.
So where should we head first...?
Eating is a noble pursuit.
No amount of exercising will do you any good if you don't eat well.
After we're done resting, shall we explore the street stalls?
I'll do my best. Especially for you, Sensei, since I know how much you care.
It's fun to get up and move your body sometimes.
Thank you for always watching over me, Sensei.
From one to ten, thank you for considering us. Leave the stall guide to me.
Heehee. The memory of today will live in my heart forever...because it was amazing.
Um... Sensei, when I'm with you, my feelings start to overwhelm me... Did you know that?
Your presence is what helped me to shine, Sensei.
Gourmet food is the best post-workout snack! And if I'm sharing it with you, Sensei, it's even better...
Does the tracksuit...look okay on me? Heehee. I-I know it's an obvious yes, but thank you for the compliment anyway.

Battle.Transcription: What's next? Heehee! This is fun.
Next up...the true path of exploration.
Savor a moment you will never forget... Let's go.
Healthy mind is contained in healthy taste.
Would you like to explore the world of fine dining with me?

Lobby.Transcription:
Welcome, Sensei.
Can I ask you about today's schedule?

I can't believe you made me wait...
But for you, Sensei, I'll wait as long as you need. Heehee...
I'm already in my gym clothes, and part of me does want to compete, but...

Going to the games, cheering for my friends, and eating something delicious...
What a perfect order of events.

I feel somehow lighter dressed like this...
Gym clothes really are something special.

I feel more at peace than usual.
Could it be because of this outfit? Or perhaps because of Sensei...?
Heehee...

Sensei, after this, can you spare some time for me?
I'll take you to the best street stall.

Yes, of course I remember.
Today is your birthday, Sensei.
This outfit is so comfy and easy to move in. Why don't we go out?

I can't believe you're wishing me a happy birthday...
Thank you. I know I've already received my gift, but...

Well, it's only once a year, so maybe it's okay if I'm a little greedy...
Sensei, would you join me on a stroll through the street stalls?

Happy New Year, Sensei.
A day to celebrate the start of a new year...
And a great excuse to check out all the delicious offerings at the local food stalls.
Shall we go take a look?

Spending Christmas together... Heehee, what a wonderful thought.
I brought a dish that's just perfect for sharing.
Let's dig in!

I guess...some people think this is my Halloween costume...
I found out there's a food stall nearby that sells pumpkin snacks.
Shall we go check it out?

Event.Transcription: The Kivotos Halo Festival... It's the dawn of a new culinary era.

Thank you for coming, Sensei.
So, will you join me...
...in my conquest of the food stalls?

Sensei, are you enjoying yourself?
I myself couldn't be having more fun.

And so the Kivotos Halo Festival is coming to an end...
They say that good times are fleeting, but...
...memories are forever.
How are you holding up, Sensei? I've finished my conquest of the food stalls...

I don't gain weight easily, but I also can't eat much, so...
I'm always filled with regret about the food I couldn't try.

I need to move my body for a bit.
Would it be okay if I join the race? The bread-eating race, that is.

The Kivotos Halo Festival street stalls are like a culinary exhibition!
I'm convinced I'll find the ultimate flavor here somewhere...!

Sensei... Will you take a walk with me?
...It's nice to have a different outfit for a change.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive.
Oh, have you come to pick me up? I would have gone myself if you'd asked. Once again, I am Ichika of the Trinity General School Justice Task Force. Please look after me!
Ah, so this is it? Sensei's Cafe!
I see. So this is how you like it...
I like how peaceful it is here!
I'm relaxing...
Should I at least help clean...?
What should I say...? I'm thankful that you're treating me so kindly, but I don't know if I deserve it... Still... I'm happy. Really.
For me? Yay! Thank you, Sensei!
Even if you do all that, nothing's going to come out, you know?
Ahaha, if you give me this much, I HAVE to earn it!
Um... It's an honor, but, uh... Haha.
Oh my... I'm not sure how to repay you for this...
I should just be honest and be happy in a situation like this, right?
I'll repay you for this favor one day! As for how I'll repay it, that's going to stay a surprise until then!
It feels weird, like something's tingling... Am I imagining things?

Battle.Transcription: I'm a bit busy right now...
I'll leave it to you, then!
Can we do this later? I'm a bit busy right now!
Let's just keep going like this!
Huh...? Did I get the order wrong?
Phew! That takes care of things. I'm going back.

Lobby.Transcription: Welcome, Sensei! I'll do my best today too!

Ta-da! Ichika is here!
Or rather, it's Sensei that's here!

My, working here is quite comfortable!
Ah. I'm not saying that it's easy, of course. It's just very pleasant.

My most difficult work... I'd say it's breaking up fights.
Oh, you too, Sensei? We're the same.
I wish that everyone would simply relax and not get so worked up...
If I'm given a great responsibility, like Sensei has been... Will I be able to immerse myself in it completely?

Do you have a task for me? I'll do whatever you need!
I'm confident that I can complete any job you give me!

Happy birthday, Sensei!
Has anything good happened to you today? If not, let's make sure something good happens right now!

Hm... You want to know why I came all the way here on my birthday?
Right... Maybe I came...BECAUSE it's my birthday. Heehee!

Happy New Year, Sensei!
I pray that this year, I might enjoy some leisure!

I'm sorry it's been so hectic since this morning!
The Justice Task Force has been called on to take care of all kinds of things.
My head is spinning!

Somehow, I've got a bad feeling...
Well, I'm sure it'll turn out all right, no? Haha!

Event.Transcription: Welcome! I'm ready as I'll ever be!
Let's get started!
Wouldn't you say there's about half left?
We're almost there. If there's anything I can do to help, please let me know!
Very good. I'll take a look around!
Yes. I'm right here.
Hm...? What's wrong?
I don't care for this kind of joke... Heehee.
Oh, Sensei. You don't have to call me like that multiple times. I'm always on standby right here.
Oh! Sensei! Perfect timing!
You're going to check the list, aren't you? I've prepared it for you!
Ah! What's this, Sensei? Are you going to do the same thing?
...Next time, come prepared!
Yes! Confirmation complete!
Is that it? Let's clean up!
That's it for today! Haha! What are you going to do now, Sensei?

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive!! Wahahaha!
Wahaha! Wherever there's a hot spring, so are we! And wherever there's no hot spring, we're there too! The explosives are primed for detonation!
Oh? This is...?
Right here. If we make a hot spring...
...Mm, too dangerous. Too many troublemakers here.
Even here...do I need to hide...?
Mm... I'm bored... I guess I could study.
Sensei... Are you sure you're okay with this? Sticking with me won't be easy. You've been warned. Whatever happens next is on you, okay? Wahaha!
Wow. So things like this really happen sometimes!
Sometimes, Sensei...I wonder if you're sure about this. If something happens, you're an accomplice, you know?
Oh! I was just looking for that! Thank you!
Wahaha! Don't worry, I'll keep it a secret that you helped me.
You're doing this much for someone like me? Very kind of you!
You're such an interesting person, Sensei. And yes that's a compliment.
Well, feel free to let me know whenever if you need anything. Yeah, "anything". No matter what it is, I'll get it ready. Behind the scenes, silently.
Wahahaha!! Thank you, Sensei!

Battle.Transcription: Here, a gift from me! Wahahaha!
Let's go, let's go! Woosh! Wahahaha!
I didn't need it...but thank you!
Trying to get in our way... There's no telling what's going to happen next, is there?
Ahh! Work! Leave it to me!
This kind of place makes you happy just digging!
Let's go with this place for the next work site!
That was great! Let's just keep it going!
Wonderful! That was some amazing hot springs development!

Lobby.Transcription: Wow, Sensei! This place is pretty colorful!
You're finally here! I've been waiting, Sensei!

It's not like I'm just digging wherever I want, you know?
I have a little more sense than that.

Hm? There's more to developing a hot spring than digging around in the dirt?
I like building things too, of course!

We just never get to that stage, is all!
Wahaha! It's just one of the things I love about my job!

When I'm with you, Sensei, I'm just as happy as when I'm digging up hot springs.
Hahaha! Don't be so guarded!

If I'm arrested, please come visit me!
I'll be waiting! Hahaha!

Oh! Sensei, today's your birthday, isn't it?
It's a special day, so I'll make you a gift!

*sigh* The Prefect Team tried to nab me on the way to Schale. Again.
Really! Can't they give me a break on my birthday, of all days?

I wish you good fortune, Sensei! We survived another year!
Now, let's have another year full of digging!
I love Christmas! Security gets lax during the holidays, making it the perfect time to develop some hot springs!

It sure is rowdy here! Even the sound of the excavator will get drowned out in this noise...
Don't give me that look.

Event.Transcription: Wahaha! We meet again, Sensei!
Sensei! Over here! I've been waiting for you, you know?

You're...busy right about now, right?
Well then, why don't I help you out?

Now! The end of the work day is almost here!
There's no time to kick back and relax! Let's go!
Good work, Sensei. Let's go over it one more time!
Hm? Do you have something to say?
You think you can do whatever you want and I won't retaliate...? Just you wait!

Are you egging me on?
...Are you sure you can handle the consequences of this later on?
Wahaha! Don't tickle me! I'm too ticklish!
Now, what do you need?
Now! We've got everything here! Everything except for what we don't! Wahaha!
The store's gonna close soon! Grab as much as you can!
Huh? What's wrong?
Don't get distracted or they'll sell out!
Hm, I see. You have a good eye, Sensei.
Excellent!
As expected! That's not bad at all!
You wanted that, did you?

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive!
Hello Sensei! Welcome to Hot Spring Resort No. 227. Please make yourself at home.
(I feel a strange chill...)
(It's been a while since it was this rowdy, but...I don't hate it.)
Mmm! Smells good.
Oh? Did this go...bad?
And here's to...winters past.
Well, I'm sure we won't need our weapons, but...if it comes down to it, we'll use them.
Ohh... That's some impressive fermentation—I mean, growth.
Think I can use this to make drinks? Heehee! I'm just joking.
It's important to work hard no matter where you are.
Thank you for always helping me, Sensei.
Sensei, do you want to talk...just the two of us?
...I'll leave the door open. Feel free to stop by if you're bored.
...You have a kind expression, Sensei. I understand why everyone falls for you.
Once I can start drinking... I want to share my first glass with you, Sensei.

Battle.Transcription: Would you like some Hot Springs manju?
Now, Sensei. Let's have a toast.
The Hot Springs Resort No. 227 specialty drink bar is officially open!
I can take a bottle of mors with me, right?

Lobby.Transcription: Hot Springs Resort No. 227 is officially open.
Welcome, Sensei. Can I get you started with something to drink?
Mm... Maybe it's because I just got out of the bath, but I feel a bit hot...
I only just heard about this, but did you know you can ferment milk to make alcohol?

So, if I take some fruit milk and...
Don't look at me like that. I won't actually do it.
Nodoka is amazing. I just don't have that kind of passion.
Don't pay it any mind if you run into a bear in the hot spring. They work here.
...I'm kidding, of course.
Don't overdo it, Sensei. There are a lot of students who would be sad if you got sick.
Happy birthday, Sensei. I've prepared a special bath for you today. Let's go in together later.

Aww... You don't want me to join you?
But whyyyyy?

You want to buy me something tasty? For my birthday?
Heehee. What should I ask for...

Well, if you're the one buying, I'm happy with anything.
...Except for curry.
(May this year, like the last, be a year of no change.)
Ah, Sensei. I mixed some drinks that compliment grilled turkey. Grab one on your way out.
They shouldn't be fermented...yet. Heehee...
Pumpkins have a good fragrance and plenty of sugar, so it should work...
Pumpkin juice! I'm talking about pumpkin juice. Don't worry about it.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive!
I'm Tokiwadai Middle School second-year Misaka Mikoto. Let me know if you need my help.
So this is Schale's Cafe...
Wh-What...is this...?!
There's so much to take in.
Th-This is...kind of cute...
Oh? Do you need something?
To be honest, I guess it's a bit interesting... People don't usually carry something like this around. Thank you for preparing it... I'll make sure to live up to your expectations.
Ooh, what's this?! Not half bad!
It feels like my head is clearing up. Thank you!
You sure you can give me all this? I-It's a good deal for me, but...
I'll pay you back for all the help!
All this giving feels one-sided. Are you sure it's okay?
This feels kind of embarrassing, but I'll accept.
Maybe this sort of thing isn't half bad once in a while. Yeah.
I want to do something for you too. Um, is there anything I can help with?

Battle.Transcription: If that's how you're going to play it...!
If you really want to see it that much...!
This looks like a good spot.
All these need to be done? ...Got it, for now.
How was it? Not bad, right?
Mm, what is it? You need me to join in?
Help you? Well, when you put it that way...
There were lots of them, weren't there?

Lobby.Transcription: Sensei, over here. You're pretty late! I've been waiting.
Great work, Sensei. Oh, me? I've been here all along.
Going outside by myself is still a tall order...

You want me to help out during power outages...? You're kidding, right?
...I guess I could help if you really need me to.
Sometimes I think this place is just like my Academy City.
Sensei, do you want to get some fresh air?

So, um... What's with all the talking cats?
N-No! It's nothing!
Oh! Sensei, isn't it your birthday today? Happy Birthday! Is there anything special you want?

Th-Thank you. I didn't think I'd spend my birthday here...
Ahaha... It's a weird feeling.

Happy New Year, Sensei!
Say, what do people do for New Year's around here, anyway?
So, you've got Christmas here too... Do you have any plans today, Sensei?
It's pretty lively outside. So holidays like this are the same wherever you go...

Event.Transcription: Let's get started.
I'm ready. Are you?
That's quite a bit of progress.
Almost done, right?
Well, let's just check it out this once.
Oh? Need something?
Are you kidding me?
Don't you have anything better to do?
...Hah. Okay, okay. What can I do for you?
We meet again, Sensei. Let's give it a spin, shall we?
I've got a feeling something good will come up.

Come on. Since you're still here, why not spin it all while you still can?
It'd be a waste otherwise.
Not me! Press over there!
Ahahahaha! H-Hey! That tickles!
Wow! Congratulations!
Oh, that's a pretty rare one, isn't it?
That's pretty good, right?
I guess that wraps it up for now. Good job, Sensei!

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive.
Oh my, I've already introduced myself... Don't you remember? Heehee.
Oh, the interior is darling!
Very sensible.
And there are so many interesting friends here.
Maybe...this isn't so dreadful.
There's no need to overthink things while I'm here. No, this isn't so bad.
You really are something else. Oh, I don't mean that in a bad way. I usually don't trust people whose thoughts I haven't read, but...let's just say that I don't find you suspicious.
Not bad, huh? I wonder...what I can do for you in return.
I'm not the type of person to be indebted to others but...I'll keep it in mind.
...Like my head feels clearer now.
Feels like it's become easier to use my powers. ...Are you curious? Would you like to test them out?
Are you like this to other people too? Heehee...you must be very popular.
Hmm... Is this also because you're "Sensei"?
Sometimes I wonder if I should read your mind. Don't worry. I haven't done it yet.
Wait... Isn't this too much for a foreigner?

Battle.Transcription: I'm not the type to make moves myself.
Hmm. I wonder if it's really okay?
I didn't want to go this far...
Seriously, it is what it is.
It was bound to come down to this, you know?
I can try moving, just a little.
Quite an easy fight, wasn't it?
I am going to square this up later, you understand?
I'm not the type to take the lead.
I can do it, if needed.
Oh my, so you do this sort of thing too?
Good thing we're all in a good mood today, isn't it?
I worked pretty hard... Is there a reward or anything?
I didn't say I can't do it. ☆

Lobby.Transcription: Welcome, Sensei. I've been waiting for quite a while. ☆
Oh? I was simply...here. There's no one to chauffeur me, and even if there were, I have no desire to explore.
A teacher's job in this city is both similar and different to what I know.
Your work looks terribly difficult... Can I help you in some way? Within reason, of course.
To be perfectly honest, my head still hurts a bit.
My remote control? It's important, but... It's not special in and of itself.
Now that I think of it, do you have any restaurants you can recommend? Please take me there.

It's your birthday, isn't it? How shall we celebrate?
For example... Is there someone you want to be with, maybe?
Happy New Year, Sensei. You do say that here, don't you?
Christmas... How many times have you played the role of Santa, Sensei?
It's so noisy outside. Well... We should be fine here.

Event.Transcription: Hello, Sensei. Shall we get started?

What can I do for you?
This is our story, so we may as well cooperate. ☆
How do you do?
Is the end in sight?
Just to be thorough, why don't we check again? ☆
Eeeh? So that's how you're playing it.
I'm sure you have something else you should be worrying about, no?
...Even my patience has its limits. ☆
Uh-oh... Is this all right?
Shall we take a look at your progress?
You're here to check in, I see. How may I help?
You're not the type of person who knows when to quit, hm?
Ehhh...?
I can tell that you've put the work in. Well done. ☆
Wouldn't this be a little useful?

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive!
Hello, Sensei! I'm Saten Ruiko, a first-year student at Sakugawa Middle School! Pleased to meet you!
Oh, that's...
Whoa! This here! That's actually really amazing!
At first glance, it looks normal, but if you look closely, it's strange... How fun!
So this is what a cafe is like in another world...
I'm relieved. Heehee.
Is this...for me? It's a strange, strange feeling... Thank you. I-I'll do my best! ...I'm sorry, this is all I can say... Hahaha...
I-Is this for me?! Thank you! I'll do my best!
I can't really explain it except to say... I feel stronger!
Whoa! I can feel power surging through my body! Is it always like this?!
Sensei! I feel like I can do anything right now!
I don't know what to say. A simple thanks feels so inadequate...
R-Really? For Me? Are you sure...?
I rely on you more and more, Sensei. Haha...
All the good and wonderful things that have happened since I got here... They're all thanks to you, Sensei.

Battle.Transcription: Whoa, can I go too?! Yay!

Lobby.Transcription: Ah! Sensei, I've been waiting for you! What are you up to today?
Hello, Sensei! Is there anything I can do for you?
This world is so similar to my world, but it's also so different... It's interesting.
Oh, you're going for a walk? ...I want to go too! Please take me along, Sensei!
From top to bottom, it sure is a funny world you've got here!
It may have been random chance, but I'm glad I'm here!
How about you, Sensei? Since we got here...are your days a little more fun?

Happy Birthday! I hope it's a great one, Sensei!
Is there anything you're wishing for?

Happy New Year, Sensei! Time sure does fly...
Thank you again this year, Sensei!

Do you have Christmas too?
In that case, will we get to see Santa fly across the sky?!
Halloween...! Sensei! We've got to—! C'mon, let's grab some costumes and get out there!

Event.Transcription: There you are, Sensei! Let's get going!
I've been waiting for you, Sensei!
We're already halfway there! Let's finish this!
Almost there. Here we go...!
That does it! Should we take another look?
Hm? Sensei? What's wrong?
Um, something I can help you with?
Um, Sensei, it isn't time to play games.
Sensei! Focus! Focus!
Ta-da! I prepared a bunch of stuff!
Here you go, Sensei! Pick your favorite!
Is there anything left to do? Check, check, check!
What? What are you looking for?
Whatever you're looking for is over there, not here...
Oh, that? That's great!
Hmmm! You're very perceptive! ...Just like that!
You found it! I'm sold!
Oh, yeah! I thought that was good too!

Normal.Transcription: Bluuuue Archive!
I'm Kadenokouji Yukari! As a proud member of the Hyakkaryouran, I'll do my utmost to live up to my duty, Sensei!
Ahem. So, this is Schale? It's very charming!
I had to wake up really early to catch the train this morning. So sleepy... *yawn*
(There's an ominous presence here... Could Schale be a sanctuary for evil demons?!)
Hup! As a member of Hyakkaryouran, I want to set a good example for the other students.
Hm, hmm. Here I come! ♪
Huh? Is this for me...? A symbol of trust?! I have to work hard to be legendary enough to meet your expectations!
This throbbing feeling from getting Sensei's trust... Yes, I'll repay you with all my strength and sincerity!
To give me something this precious... I'll do my best to meet your expectations!
I'll study and practice to make sure I remember everything Sensei taught me!
I, Yukari...have taken another step forward for the Hyakkaryouran!
When I'm with Sensei, I naturally loosen up. And I feel...very happy.
So this is what people mean when they say you get energetic just by having them beside you. Heehee... How interesting.
Yes, thanks to you, Sensei, I could stay as Yukari. Thank you, truly.
H-Huh...? Since the moment I've met Sensei, my heart's been pounding... Wh-What should I do if my heart explodes or something?!

Battle.Transcription: I, Yukari, an elite of the Hyakkaryouran, will go!
Hm, hmm! Perfect! V for victory!
I'll show you what I'm capable of!
Whatever I have to do, I will.
With my own hands, and no one else's...
I will show you my full strength!
Heehee, so you need my strength?
I'm here to represent the Hyakkaryouran!
Heehee, here begins the legend of Yukari!
Heehee! A flawless victory, all thanks to everyone's combined effort!

Lobby.Transcription:
Heehee. Welcome, Sensei! Time to work!
Here, this way! Please sit down!

Yes! I've been waiting for this moment!
Welcome, Sensei. Let's do our best today!
Hm, hmm. I see. This is a typical work day at Schale. I'm learning so much!
It's not easy to work at the Hyakkaryouran. I mean, it's hard here too, but...
It's all going to work out perfectly! Yes! Because I'm an elite member of the Hyakkaryouran!
Hm, hmm. The invincible Hyakkaryouran! This is only the beginning of the legend of Yukari! ♪
Yes, Sensei! Please don't hesitate to ask me for anything you need!

So, what should we do after work today?
Should we go get some junk food? Or break someone's high score at the arcade?
Hm, so many options... How do we choose?

Happy birthday! You must be so excited, Sensei
I'm so excited to celebrate your special day together! I, Kadenokouji Yukari, will make sure you have the best birthday ever!
All right! Let's start with working on your wish list!

...Huh? You just want to...make memories...with me...?
Ugh... That's a much more difficult request...
I-I do like the idea of that though...

Oh! Um... Y-You remembered my birthday? Wow... Hearing your birthday wishes...
Oh, geez... Um. I can't stop smiling.
Happiness isn't always a far-off dream, I guess...

Happy New Year! I wish you all the best in the new year, Sensei!
I'm sure I'm not the only one who's super excited about the new year!
Um, to make sure nothing bad happens... Let's go on a patrol again tonight!

Merry Christmas, Sensei!
I've already invited Renge, Kikyou, and Nagusa!

I hope you'll come and enjoy some red bean jelly at the Hyakkaryouran!
Heehee! It'll be lots of fun! I promise!

Ack! I went outside, and it was shocking!
The streets are filled with goblins! What in the world is happening?!

...Huh? It's Halloween? People just dress up as monsters today?
You're joking! It's not Setsubun yet! You tried to trick me. How cute!

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive!
Fuwa Renge of Hyakkiyako, Hyakkaryouran's Assault Squad Captain, reporting for duty! Together with Sensei, also known as Mentor, I'll pursue my youth! I look forward to working with you!
Wow, wow! So this is Schale! Look at everyone, basking in their youth.
Hm, how should I pursue my youth?
I hope Yukari's taking care of herself...
Awesome! I wish our rooms were like this...
If there's a troublemaker... I'll discipline them for good.
Is...this...? A legend of legends! It's the epitome of youth! *pant* I need to calm down... Thank you, Mentor! I'll treasure it!
I was able to grow thanks to you, Sensei. Ah, it's all thanks to Mentor. Thank you.
So this is another way of teaching... It hadn't even crossed my mind. Sen... No. Mentor, you're incredible.
Amazing! I can feel the energy flowing through me. Yeah! It's amazing! So amazing!
Meaning you're expecting my best, right, Sensei? Haha! Just trust me! I'll repay you with everything I've got!
I mean, I did ask you to join in my youth activities. But even something like this... Is that okay?!
(Uh, is this okay? Is it okay?! I'm REALLY close to Sensei here... Whoa, what should I do?)
Mmmm! Something feels funny from being with Sensei...! Ahh! Sorry! I'll just go for a quick lap in the field!
Ah... It's... No, I'm doing fine. It's just that...I was thinking about how my Mentor cared about me... Th-That's all I was thinking!

Battle.Transcription: I'll take the lead! Now, follow me!
Hah! I'll show you what the Hyakkaryouran is made of!
They don't call me Captain for nothing, you know!
I walk the path of victory!
I am the Assault Squad Captain of the Hyakkaryouran!
Now then, I'll go in full force as well!
No way! It's not over yet!
Ha! Try to live through this!
W-Wait! Mentor! I'm still...not mentally prepared yet...!
Take a good look at the power of the Hyakkaryouran!
Haha! We won, thanks to Sensei's direction.

Lobby.Transcription:
Sensei! Do you have work for Schale today?
I'll lend you a hand!

Hold it right there! You of all people can't be playing hooky!
Don't even think about slacking off. They don't call me Hyakkaryouran's Disciplinarian for nothing.

It seems we have similar struggles, Sensei.
Work is just an endless chore wheel, isn't it?
That's an experience I can relate to!
I oversee all training for Hyakkaryouran members. There's not enough hours in the day sometimes!

What if I wake up one day and find my youth's slipped right through my fingers?!
No! Nooo! I don't want to attend the funeral of my own youth!

It's not like... I love the Hyakkaryouran. I really do.
I'm the Assault Squad Captain for a reason! I love fighting and teaching my underclassmen new techniques.

But is that all there is to life?
I'm afraid of growing old and looking at the vast landscape of my life and only finding drills and mock battles.
You're an adult, so you understand, right, Sensei?!

Our relationship is that of youth teacher and student! Mentor!
It's time to enjoy my youth! And in that spirit...

I present the latest book from the author of "Koi About Love!"
It's mind-blowing! A masterpiece! You need to read it, Sensei.
I really can't get over it. I'm looking forward to hearing what you think about the plot twist.

I'm always indebted to you, Sensei... No, Mentor.
Please tell me everything and anything, Mentor!
I'll do whatever is within my power.

Isn't it your birthday today, Sensei? I've been counting down the days!
Let's go out and celebrate your birthday!

When it's you and me, you can forget the small stuff.
We'll have the time of our life creating unforgettable memories.

Um... My...birthday?
Oh. I guess it is. Thank you.
Ah! I'm sorry. I didn't mean to seem ungrateful.

It took me a little off guard, more than anything.
Hah! You're making me blush a little, Sensei. Wait right there! I need to recollect myself.

Happy New Year. Sensei.
...The sun is rising already? How depressing.

Time truly passes too quickly! Even at this moment of new beginnings!
This will be the year we find my youth! Promise me, Mentor!

Merry Christmas, Sensei... I mean, Mentor.
You don't have to explain. Days like today are the very acme of youth!

There's no time to laze around, Sensei! We absolutely must go see Hyakkiyako's light show!
Let our youth mentorship begin!

That explains all the weird outfits I saw on the streets. It's Halloween!
I think it's a favorite holiday for a lot of students.

...If that's how it is, I can't fall behind! Let's wear costumes today, Mentor!
I'll be an ogre demon! You need to pick something too!
There's no point in doing something if you're not going to put your all into it!

Normal.Transcription: Blue, Archive.
I am Kiryuu Kikyou, operations officer of the Hyakkaryouran. It appears a constructive business relationship is beneficial for both parties. I suppose I'll be in your care, Sensei.
Set up for the next operation.
How vexing. I'll retreat to center myself.
Hyakkaryouran members do not conduct themselves foolishly.
Have you completed your work, Sensei?
Even at Schale boredom tugs at my strings.
Do you truly have such trust in me? Hah. Fascinating. Whether it's trust or pure delusion, you know my character well enough to know I will return the favor, with interest.
To give me something like this... Just what do you want in return? That's how this works, isn't it?
I don't know what you're plotting, but...if you want to give me this, I won't say no.
You're still at it, even after all those harsh words. You're a very...strange person.
You helped me grow. I won't deny it. It's the objective truth. So... I'll say you have my thanks at the very least. Hmph.
We're awfully close together, Sensei...though I can't complain about that.
Ah, Sensei. Where did you go? Stay where I can see you, please.
Sensei's favor. I'll accept it with gratitude. Next time, I'll get you something. Be ready for it.
It's true that I rely on you. So promise me you'll rely on me too.

Battle.Transcription: Your support will make a difference in ths operation.
Since I came up with this strategy, I'll take the lead.
Take a good look at the power of the Hyakkaryouran.
For a Hyakkaryouran officer, victory is all but assured.
This ought to turn the tides.
There's only one thing to do.
There's no need to hold back. I'll go at it full strength.
Have a full taste of the Hyakkaryouran.
...Why don't you just do as you please?
I'll show you all the strategic genius of the Hyakkaryouran.
Sensei, your command. I'll back you up with my tactics.
With your tactics and my strategy, no one can stop us.
If I had to rate my operation... I'd give it about a million points out of 10?

Lobby.Transcription: Welcome, Sensei. Come and sit by me. You have work to do, right?

Are you busy again today?
Don't concern yourself with me.
I will behave and work quietly in my corner.

...You're thanking me? For...helping with Schale's work?
Hah. You are misguided if you believe my motives are to assist you, Sensei.

I am the Hyakkaryouran's operations officer.
This was merely an opportunity to view and analyze Schale as an organization.
Should I will it, Schale's defenses would crumble like a straw house.
...It was merely a joke, Sensei. Please ease your look of alarm.

Conducting Schale duty is disappointingly simple.
I'd expected somewhat of a challenge.

My current directive is to follow your orders. You may speak what you wish.
...Is that not my purpose here?

You toil for Kivotos' sake, no?
So, naturally, the Hyakkaryouran falls under your protection.
...Yes. I am glad we were able to meet. Truly.

I'd be...displeased if you left my sight without warning.
So I request you stay by my side...where I can feel your presence by your warmth.
...That is all that I wish for.

Naturally, I remembered your birthday.
My anticipation for this day likely outweighed even yours.
Birthday wishes. Sensei.

I've thoroughly planned today's operations.
We shall begin now, Sensei.

Yes. It is my birthday. Have you prepared a proper celebration?
I expect your undivided attention on this day.
I lay claim to your time from this moment forward.

Happy New Year, Sensei.
...That is all.
I see no need for further pleasantries. It is us, after all.

Merry Christmas. Sensei.
...Would you like to go buy turkey or something?
I am capable of indulging in holiday cheer, Sensei.

Choose, Sensei. Trick or treat?
...Treat?
...Disappointing.

Then, it's my turn. I will select trick.
Now, what trick do you have for me, Sensei? Fufu.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive
It's much cooler than usual. Is that why my body feels so light?
With Himari gone...
It would be perfect if we had some shaved iced here.
The AC power button...
The increase of occupants here is making it warmer.
I would like to spend the rest of my life here.
Regardless of the environment, with this, I can relax.
Investing in me will give you the best value.
It seems all of the special training is bearing fruit. Good.
This is not enough. I must get even stronger.
I've been able to make it this far thanks to you, Sensei.
Thank you, Sensei.
...I receive quite a lot of help.
Weird. It's hot, but I feel good.
If I'm with you, Sensei, then I might not mind hot places so much.

Battle.Transcription: Everyone looks like they're having fun.
I'd like to try ice diving, too.
Okay, leave it to me. I'm feeling better than usual right now.

Lobby.Transcription: Welcome, Sensei. I've cooled the room for you.
Great job, Sensei. Why do you appear surprised?

...Why am I still wearing this?
...Because I like it.
It's...hot... Please... Please lower the thermostat.
I will remove my jacket.

Underwear is not appropriate. But swimsuits are?
How are the two different? Does the material make one more acceptable?

I found this magazine to be a great reference. I found it under the desk.
...What's wrong, Sensei?

Happy birthday, Sensei. On this special day, I will try to wear an outfit you approve of.
Do you have any requests?

You told me we would spend some time together.
I've created a schedule to maximize our efficiency.
I will not waste even one second of this day.
Happy New Year, Sensei. I hope that my skills will improve to the point that I'll feel satisfied with myself this year.

It's Christmas. I brought an appropriate outfit, so I'll change into it and...
...Or am I already in the holiday spirit?
I like Halloween. No one will blink an eye at whatever you wear.

Normal.Transcription: Blue, Archive.
I found you. Whether it's in the mountains or the seas... I'll capture your voice, Sensei. Wherever you are.
This is... It's been trending on social media recently.
I know this song... Ugh. What was it called?
I swear I left it somewhere around here...
I finished the recording.
(What was that sound? I don't think I've heard that before.)
I've been considering modifying my gun to play your voice every time I pull the trigger. That would be nice.
With this, I can record sounds even more clearly.
It's always exciting to unlock more power.
I can hear Sensei's voice clearly now.
Sensei, it would make me happy if you could continue to speak to me directly.
I plan on recording the sound of nature today. Of course, that includes Sensei's voice. Because Sensei is also part of nature.
Sensei, say something sweet, please. Because I'm recording right now.
(I wouldn't need to install a wiretapping device if you were always by my side, though...)
Listening to Sensei's voice calms me down more than any ASMR.

Battle.Transcription: I think I heard something over that way...
I've recorded all the sounds from this place.
Sensei, tell us how you feel about the victory.
Sensei, if you could share a few words, please.
There was a bear bell around here...
If it's efficient for me to go, then yes.
If it's what you want, Sensei.
Mmm... I can't hear clearly from here.
...I thought I was in charge of rear support.
I still have a long way to go...

Lobby.Transcription:
Ah. You changed shoes, Sensei.
I was trying to figure out why the sounds of your footsteps were slightly different.

Sensei! W-Welcome.
Don't make that face. I didn't do anything nefarious. Not really.
All I did was... Well, I was warming up your chair for you. Something like that...

I recommend you dress for the weather when you go out this weekend.
Temperatures are calculated to drop off quite a bit.

...Why did I say "when"? How do I know your schedule?
Um...
I just...thought there might be a possibility? Haha.

Winter is my favorite season to visit the mountains.
The quiet of winter is perfect for recording all kinds of sounds.

Which means you should be careful talking about secrets on a snowy mountain.
Sounds carry further than you would think in that environment.
Why do communications towers have to be at the very top of mountains?

Not that I don't understand the science behind it...
But they're so difficult to get to! How am I supposed to install my wire tap?
...Red Winter Academy's propaganda broadcasts are even reaching all the way out here.

There's less radio wave interference around this time of year.
That school has some terrifying propaganda.

Keep an eye out for wildlife if you're in the mountains.
Most especially snakes.
I've heard stories of people having to abandon a hike after encountering a snake with only a hammer and pot to protect themselves.

Happy birthday, Sensei.
Your gift is this ASMR track. It will help you get better sleep.
Listen to it before you go to bed tonight.

M-My birthday?
Oh. Thank... Thank you.
Let me just... Okay, ready. Please repeat exactly what you just said.

Happy New Year, Sensei.
I'm strangely happy I get to be the first person to greet you in the new year.

Days like today are special. Lovers exchange sweet words and wishes for the future...
It makes me feel something on the inside.

...Huh? That's eavesdropping?
Oh. Really? It is? Are you sure?

The sound of a knife carving through the thick skin of a pumpkin... Now that's music to my ears.
I got so carried away with the sound of my slices, I made too many jack-o-lanterns.
You should have one! S-Since I have extra and all that...

Event.Transcription:
Ugh. I can still feel the cold under all these layers.
I didn't even realize I was shivering.
People who come outdoors like this to celebrate the new year are the poster children of inefficiency.

(Not even the vice president will suspect that I brought wiretaps with me.)
(Heehee...)

A BEAR?! Right now??
The universe is working against me.
I need to hurry back and edit the audio files with Sensei's voice...
I-I mean, I can't wait to go home and rest!
If there's one thing I can't stand, it's absolute silence.

But then again, when it's quiet...
Well, the quieter it is, the better I can hear Sensei's voice.
The wind... It's like it's crying.

I'm monitoring all frequency communications within a three kilometer radius...
Huh. Nothing.

S-Sensei! Are you busy?
Would you help me with setting up the camp, please?
Hello, Sensei. The vice president gave me very specific orders on how to set up the camping equipment. I really am doing my best...

I was told that this camping equipment was easy to use...
But setting it up isn't easy at all.
Were you trying to say something...?
Wait right there. I'm going to bring my recording devices.
I see. I'll remember that.
Can you show me how you did that again?
I would like a verbal, step-by-step explanation, please.
Sleeping will be a lot more comfortable tonight with this.

Normal.Transcription: Blue, Archive.
There's...no internet access here. But a true Veritas member wouldn't be stymied by this harsh environment!
I like how cozy it is here.
(That outfit looks freezing.)
Frenzy MAX in a glass... No shaking... Or stirring it.
(I might stay here forever. It's so comfy.)
(All these wifi names are so weird...)
Hiking has made me realize how ridiculously heavy my gun is. I'm gonna try to modify it a little to shave some weight.
This information... The other hackers on the forum would be shocked!
I could use this tip outdoors.
Thank you, Sensei. Next time, I'll show you some improvement.
Mmm, that's an interesting thought. I learned something from it.
The road of truth is endless. And so is the emotional journey.
Sensei, would you like to play games or something, at the club room, on your next day off?
When I'm looking at a big mountain, I'm reminded of Sensei. Just like the unchanging view...Sensei's going to be there for me, right?
I don't like hiking...but if it's just me and Sensei, it might be okay.

Battle.Transcription: Now then, time to get a move on.
I-Is it over? Is it okay to go back now?
G-Good work... Now, if you'll excuse me...
Would you like a sweet potato?
Ugh... Do I really have to go outside...?
Where is this? Who am I...?
It would be okay...to go back now...right?

Lobby.Transcription:
Ugh... You're leaving already?
I'm gonna chill here for a little longer.

You're here, Sensei.
I'll make you a cup of coffee to warm up.
They make some pretty high-quality camping beds these days.
Maybe I'll get one for the club room. Heehee.

Most of this camping equipment is meant to be easy to install.
I think it'd be good for homebodies who're trying to get outdoors more.
I wish they'd make a tent that can fold itself back up though...
Instant food tastes a lot better next to a campfire, for some reason.
The next time we're camping, I'll bring a bunch of different Frenzy MAX flavors and do a taste test.

Coding with a bunch of distractions around me...
...it almost makes me miss the quiet of the campgrounds.
What did people do before the internet was invented?

It's your birthday today, right?
I, uh, didn't get you a gift. But you can just tell me what you want.
I'll give you whatever.
Even if...it's me and my time.
A birthday gift? Nothing I want, really.
I could really go for a latte though. Can I have one with an extra shot of espresso...and lots of condensed milk.

Happy New Year, Sensei.
They were handing out gamju in front of Millennium Tower.

I really liked how sweet it was.
Which gave me the idea... Gamju-flavored Frenzy MAX!
So people still leave the house when it's this cold, huh?
I think Christmas Eve is best enjoyed indoors. Underneath a blanket.
...Hey. Don't make it weird.

Huh? My Halloween plans?
The same as usual. The other members and I are gonna buy a bunch of snacks and play video games.
My favorite horror game series releases a new edition during Halloween every year.

Event.Transcription: We've gotta get back indoors. It's freezing.

Camping, at a time like this...
I can't with the vice president sometimes.
There's...nothing to do...here...

Th-There was a bear nearby...?
Is it okay for us to stay here?
It was a little rough, but I guess these kinds of experiences can be nice sometimes...
