O-Only...if it's from time to time...!
The closest convenience store...is beyond that mountain...
(The Wi-Fi signal...is gone?)

This energy drink...is warm.
I wouldn't normally say yes, but I'm doing a lot of things I wouldn't normally do.
The hard work never ends, huh, Sensei? Even after such a tough year, you're still letting us drag you around...
...Huh? What do you mean you're enjoying yourself?
...I guess Sensei is popular for a reason.

Did the vice president force you to come along too, Sensei?
If you don't mind, could you lend me a hand?

A-ACK! O-Oh... It's just you, Sensei.
I'm sorry. I thought you were a bear.

We've got to make sure we clean up everything.
I don't even wanna imagine the vice president's reaction if we're not thorough...
You know, if this was a game, we could've collected all of this with just one click.
Huh? What? Did I get something on my clothes?
Yeah, I think we'll manage with this.

This...is for me?
Thanks. I'll give you everything I gathered in return.

You gathered all this yourself?
Wow... You're made for the outdoors, Sensei.
Hey, Sensei. Look, I'm making curry.

I like watching it boil in the pot.
It makes me feel all warm and fuzzy.

So, the curry is technically ready...
But if you want to add more ingredients, let me know.

Uh, is this thing working?
Can you taste test it please, Sensei?

I read once that chocolate is a good secret ingredient for curry.
...So, maybe an energy drink could also work?

...! Whoa. It's actually good.
I didn't know curry could be this good.
Seriously! It's delicious.
It's definitely better than instant curry.
Wh-What a...taste...!
Ugh. I really tried. I'm sorry.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive
Heehee. Oh, Sensei. How's my dress? Do give your honest opinion. I only need it as a reference.
Right now, I'm a spy. Heehee.
I wonder where President Hina is?
This outfit is quite comfortable and easy to move in. ...It does feel a bit cold.
Phew. I hope there's no trouble, at least for today.
(Heehee. I should take my time with this...)
Thank you for your continued support. As you know, Sensei... I, Amau Ako, have never let you down. Not now, and not ever. I look forward to continue working with you.
Reliable support as always. Thank you. Heehee.
I was able to take another step forward. All I want is to be reliable.
...Thank you. Sensei. I'm always thankful, and I hope you know that.
I've taken another step forward. The more I grow, the more perfect my assistance can be.
This again. It doesn't surprise me anymore. Just you wait...
Ah... N-No, I don't feel awkward. Not at all. Even when we're VERY close to each other, I feel nooothing at all! Nothing!
You're already so close, before I even realize it. You're just...not fair. Seriously, not fair.
As I've said before... I don't dislike Sensei. ...That's how I truly feel, no lies or anything, you know?

Battle.Transcription: Heehee, keep your eyes out for my performance.
Heehee, it was performance befitting a Senior Administrator!
How was it? I worked hard!
I won't let them get away!
There's no weak point in this siege!
Everyone, let's deal with this situation!
Don't you dare think you can outrun the Prefect Team!
If there's anything you need just let me know.
Yes, commencing operation. Sensei, your orders, please.
I'm heading to the site myself. Sensei, I'd like to ask for your assistance.
Wow, surprising. I didn't think your orders would be THIS good, Sensei.
Yes, that was perfect teamwork. Heehee, I'm glad I came here myself.

Lobby.Transcription:
Welcome, Sensei.
Just for today, you have I, Amau Ako's help. It's Just. For. You! ♪

Oh my, Sensei. Aren't you running a little late?
Well, it doesn't matter.
I shall be assisting you today. I look forward to working with you.

A great senior administrator is one who puts themselves out in the field.
Yes... That's me.

You see, this dress reflects my resolve.
In it, I'm the perfect secret agent.

To be more specific... I'm like the heroine in a spy film.
I have that kind of determination.

Even if I'm in this fancy dress, I'm still me.
To support Sensei, one must be flawless.
...So with that said, make sure you stay focused too.

Huh? I sound more excited than usual?
...Are you sure you're not mistaken? Even with a change of clothes, I'm still me.
Speaking candidly, I consider this a chance to show extra support to Head Prefect Hina. Really.

Huh? I'm a lifesaver?
I see... I'm happy to hear you're pleased with my assistance.
...Although, I do wish you'd show appreciation for my talents more often.
Heehee...

Sensei, happy birthday.
It's been a while, so... Why don't you spend the day with me?

"What are we going to do," you say?
Well...uh... H-How about an all-night crossword puzzle marathon, or...
D-Don't laugh! I didn't think you'd actually ask for my input!

Oh my, are you congratulating me on my birthday?
Thank you. Hmm? Since it's my birthday...

I can ask for anything? Is that so?
Heehee... Are you sure about that, Sensei? You have no idea what I'll ask for...

Happy New Year, Sensei!
Here we are, ringing in the new year again.
...When we first met, I never thought that we'd be able to spend time together like this.
Hm, it's a bit overwhelming.

Merry Christmas, Sensei.
Just the name Christmas makes me feel like something magical is in the air.
If you don't mind, shall we walk through the illuminated streets together?
...You're supposed to say "Yes, of course!"

Yes, I know. Today is Halloween.
Trick or treat? This is the choice that people are faced with on this day.
Which would you prefer, Sensei?
...There's no way you'd choose...a trick...would you?

Event.Transcription:
Welcome, Sensei.
Are you ready?
Be prepared. Stay strong.

All the proper preparations are in place.
As the Senior Administrator of Gehenna's Prefect Team...
Now is the time to take a stand.

You think this won't be resolved easily?
Well, I can't simply give up.

Seriously! You are persistent!
Phew, yeah, all right!
With that, I should be ready to fight until the end!
Now, please, Sensei! Let's go!

It's finally over...
Wow. There really was a lot going on today...
It feels like all the tension has been completely drained out of me.
...Would you like to head back and grab a cup of coffee, Sensei?

As for the party...
How is this all going to turn out?

Well, it doesn't matter...
Whatever happens, the Prefect Team...
No, I will be there to solve it!

Right now, I'm just a spy backing Head Prefect Hina.
I've been holding back. Maybe it's time that I showed off my true skills.
Heehee. Look forward to it.

And here I thought it would be quiet this year...
But I guess that'd be too much to ask for in Gehenna. Phew.

Welcome, Sensei.
I had something I was hoping that you could solve for me.
Could you help me?

Heehee. No running away, now! Especially after coming this far.
Yup, your to-do list is filled to the brim. ♪

That's right. If you're thinking of playing hooky, you better think again.
I'll be right next to you. Carefully monitoring... I mean assisting you.

I can understand the desire to do anything but the task right before you.
However, that extra stuff can wait until after your work is done.
You follow?

Hmm... Not bad.
A fine reward for fine work. It's only natural.

Oh my... You solved it in a single try?
Wow... I'm impressed. Truly. As expected of you, Sensei.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive! Heehee!
Ibuki is here! Sensei, did Ibuki make you wait?
Seven times one is...seven. Seven times two is...fourteen...
What is this place? Can Ibuki explore it?
What game should Ibuki play with Sensei today?
Adults like this? Hm, Ibuki is not too sure.
It's no fun all alone...
W-Wah?! You're giving this to Ibuki? Really? Um, just because it's Ibuki? Wow! Sensei! Ibuki is so happy! Ibuki will cherish it always!
Sensei, Sensei! Ibuki thinks she got taller!
Thanks, Sensei! Ibuki will always help you a bunch!
Ibuki wants to grow as tall as the older students!
Here, Sensei! Ibuki will give you some of her pudding as thanks!
Ibuki wants to share a secret. Promise not to tell? The secret is... She has so much fun when she's with you, Sensei!
Heeheehee... Ibuki is so happy! She will be an even better kid!
Ibuki wants to be a cool adult just like you, Sensei!
Ibuki is thinking of you, Sensei! Were you thinking of her too? Heehee! We are truly connected!

Battle.Transcription: Ibuki will hang out with Sensei as soon as she's done!
Wow! This is so much fun!
We won! Didn't Ibuki do great?
Ibuki is going to add a bunch of her favorites!
A little of this, and this... Ta-da!
Ibuki drew this herself, you know!
Ibuki is going to use this color!
Yep! Ibuki will help out too!
Wow! You want to play with Ibuki?
Ibuki will keep doing her best, exactly how you taught her!
Does Ibuki finally get to play with Sensei?

Lobby.Transcription: Ah! Sensei! Welcome back!
Ibuki waited for you so patiently! So praise Ibuki!
Ibuki is here to help! What do you need?
A snack break? Yes! Ibuki loves that idea!
Business Expense Settlement Statement... What's that supposed to mean?
Kihehe. Is there something you want to say?
Yes! Please take care of Ibuki too!

Sensei, Ibuki heard you were having a hard time with your work! Let Ibuki help!
Ibuki can do it! Just say the word!

Happy Birthday, Sensei! Did you get a lot of gifts?
Here's one more! It's a big hug, Sensei!

Wow, you remembered Ibuki's birthday? Thank you, Sensei!
Ibuki is so happy that Ibuki could take off and fly!

Happy New Year, Sensei! Huh? What's this?
Pocket money? Its an allowance to buy what Ibuki wants?
All right then! Ibuki chooses you, Sensei! Here, take Ibuki's money!
Ibuki's been a good girl... Ibuki wants a gift from Santa Claus!

Growl! If you don't play a trick, Ibuki will eat all the treats!
...Wait, that's not how it works?

Event.Transcription: Welcome, Sensei! Heehee!
Are you looking for something? Let Ibuki help!

Ibuki had so much fun dancing with you at the party, Sensei!
Promise Ibuki we'll get to do it again!
Huh? Ibuki is not for sale, though...
Mm! That one looks great!

Thanks for shopping with us!
Come again, Sensei!
A gift? For Ibuki?
That! Ibuki likes that one too!
Wow! Ibuki has never seen one of those before!

Normal.Transcription: Kihehe. Blue... Archive!
I have arrived! Kihehe. I, the Great Hanuma Makoto of the Pandemonium Society, am here in the flesh. Now bow! Shower me with your praise and hospitality!
Schale... Kihehe. It's as cramped as ever.
Ibuki's playground project must be planned and constructed meticulously...
If we wish to ensure Iroha's capture...
Satsuki. Chiaki. I will be GREATLY displeased if I hear you're ditching class again.
These vibes aren't too bad.
Ki...Kihe...Kihehehehe! You're quite formidable, Sensei. To have prepared such a gift... I'll take it as proof of your faith. I look forward to having your support in the future as well.
I see... Even I, the epitome of what it means to be a leader, still have room to grow. Kihehe!
I never expected to have your full support, Sensei... I won't refuse. Kihehe...
Oh...? Sensei, you expect a lot of me... Fine. I won't let you down. Kihehe!
An elite leader deserves and elite reward...naturally. Kihehehe!
It's been so much fun talking to you lately, Sensei. Kihehehe! Don't you agree?
Ah, there you are, Sensei. I was just enjoying a break. Would you like to chat?
It's nice to spend a little time away from the hustle and bustle to relax... Kihehe, I like it.
Kihehe. You can lean on me a bit more, Sensei. After all, I am the leader of Pandemonium Society, the almighty Hanuma Makoto.

Battle.Transcription: Listen to my speech, and listen well!
Go! Go! Go! Kiheheheh! ...Eh? Th-This isn't the place?!
Are you asking for my help? Kekeke.
Keke. Let's see what Sensei's capable of.
You want to see me up close? Kehehe, feel free.

Lobby.Transcription:
You're finally here, Sensei. You shouldn't keep the leader of the Pandemonium Society waiting too long.
Kihehe. Well, all right. Let us speak of my great deeds.

You're late, Sensei. I just came up with a brilliant scheme to conquer Kivotos.
I'll share it with you. Come. Hurry up and take a seat.

Kihehe. To think the day would come where I, of all people, would be the Student Rep.
Well, perhaps this chore could grow into a plan to conquer Kivotos... Yes indeed. Kihehe.

The day that I, a capable leader, gain Sensei's full cooperation...
It'll be like giving wings to a tiger! Or throwing gasoline onto a raging fire! Kekeke!

Hmmm? There's an emergency right now, and you can't help me?
Kihehe, don't worry. I understand that you're quite busy.

Sometimes finding the whereabouts of Ibuki's pudding is a feat worthy of the great sagas from mythology.
Ah... Some days do truly feel like that. Yes indeed.

Kihehe. I've never met anyone like you before.
You neither agree nor disagree with me. And you don't butt in with your opinion either...
...fascinating. Kihehe.
Great deeds do not happen overnight. I, the Great Makoto, vow to never give up.

Someday, surely, you shall stand by my side.
Prepare yourself for that day. Kihehe!

Heehee... Kekeke! I heard the news. Today is your birthday, eh, Sensei?
The Pandemonium Society shall host a celebration in your honor. There's no time to waste. Let's go, Sensei! Kihehe!

You wish me a happy birthday?
Kihehe. So you're not completely clueless, Sensei! It's only natural to celebrate the birth of a great leader.

If Sensei assents, we shall press on!
Let us begin my great birthday festival!

Happy New Year. It is the dawn of a new era, Sensei.
Shall we discuss the latest plan to conquer Kivotos?
It'll be the monumental first meeting of the year! Don't be late!

Kihehe, Merry Christmas, Sensei.
Apparently, today is a holiday when a freak in a sled flies across the sky at Mach speed, leaving gifts for good children.

I will not be outdone. Let us purchase gifts for Ibuki!
Care to join me, Sensei?

Ah, Halloween. My favorite holiday after April Fool's Day.
Pranks are permitted all across the board.
Kihehe. Well then, Sensei? Trick or treat?

Event.Transcription:
It's a shop that was specially opened in honor of the Gehenna Party.
Feel free to take a look around. Kihehe.
...I was wondering who that was. Have you decided on your purchase, Sensei?

Kehe. It's a shame, but this is the end for this temporary store.
Oh, don't look so down and out.
We'll make the next one even larger and more luxurious! Kihehe!

All the goods here are items that the Pandemonium Society has prepared.
Ahh, it was possible thanks to our vast financial power.
We've just begun! Don't be surprised just yet. Kihehe.

Hm? What did I do with the goods?
Kihehe. Are you plotting to take your place at my side?
You don't have any particular aim? Is that so...?
Oho, to think you'd choose that path. I applaud your skilled evaluation.

I was going to recommend you take that one.
Kihehe. Excellent choice.

Kihehe. I am in a good mood today.
I'll throw in a little bonus! Here's a cooperation proposal from the Pandemonium Society!
...Huh? You don't need it?
So that's what you wanted, Sensei? Kihehehe. You're a strange one.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive.
Sorasaki Hina. Gehenna's Head Prefect. I-I tried on the dress you picked out, Sensei. How do I look?
I can't get myself to calm down while I'm in a dress.
I want to sit down and practice.
Look how they shine.
Phew, I'm a bit tired...
As the head prefect, I must remain sharp.
For me? Thank you, Sensei. You always talk to me about trust. I want to return that feeling. So please, listen until the very end.
I was able to make it through another verse thanks to you, Sensei. ...Thank you.
I can be here like this thanks to you, Sensei. I'm truly happy.
I want to keep getting stronger so I can repay you. Would you watch me do that?
I want to grow and get stronger so Sensei can rely on me. That's all I can think about right now.
You're the one who taught me that even someone like me can be of help. Thanks to you, Sensei... I can... Thank you, truly.
Um... Wearing this, I think I'm more self-conscious than usual. It's okay if it's Sensei with me, though...
Is there really a place here for someone like me? ...Heehee, you really don't change, do you. Thank you.
Sensei, would you grab onto my hand? That way... It might calm my nerves down a little bit.

Battle.Transcription: Let's go. There's only one thing to do.
I'll clean this up before practice.
I should raise the tempo a little bit.
Mission complete. ...I'm glad it went well.
I need to check before I practice.
The melody I prepared for you...
I want to show you...what I've practiced.
This might sound clumsy, but...to you, from the bottom of my heart...!
I'll play with all I've got!
I was waiting for your orders, Sensei.
Even if I'm in a dress, it doesn't change what I must do.
As expected, Sensei's command is flawless.
It was a flawless victory. I've been taking the time to practice.

Lobby.Transcription: Hello, Sensei. Is there anything I can help you with?
Ah, Sensei. This way. Over here.

Ah? Huh? I-It's cute?
Th-Thank you... Th-That's...

This is the dress that you recommended.
It's really pretty, but it probably doesn't suit—

...Huh? It looks great on me?
Wh-What are you saying, Sensei?!

I've been practicing piano a lot lately.
It's been a while since I focused on anything besides my Prefect Team duties. It feels...refreshing.

Something about this dress makes me want to sit up straight.
My heart's pounding more than usual. I wonder if that's why?

Even in a dress, it's still me. I will continue to serve at your side, Sensei.
So... Don't run away.

"Hina's strict, but she's still cute," you say?
Ugh. Really. Wh-Wh-What are you even saying?
...I mean, I'm happy. But s-still... Really.

Happy birthday, Sensei.
I... There is a song I've been practicing today. If it's all right...could you take a listen?

You actually were going to ask me to play it yourself, you say?
It-It's not that special or any—No.
I prepared this song for you. So I shall perform it to the best of my abilities.

Ah, today is my birthday. That's right.
Thank you for remembering, Sensei.
Something that I want? Well...
It's enough to have you here, Sensei...
I'm truly grateful, Sensei.

The sun rises once again. Happy New Year, Sensei.
I guess this is the start of yet another year with you.
Heehee. It's quite a pleasant thought for me.

Merry Christmas, Sensei.
On a day like this, I'm sure I wouldn't look out of place even in a dress like this, right?

Huh? Let's go somewhere that matches my dress?
W-Wait, Sensei... H-Hold on!

It's Halloween. Trick or treat.
Just for today, I have permission to play tricks on you, right?

Event.Transcription:
Welcome, Sensei.
I'm sure the Pandemonium Society is giving you a hard time...
But I'd like to ask for your help.

You're here, Sensei.
Sorry to ask you for another favor.
...Don't worry about it? Fufu. How like you.

I see. So it's still happening...
Well, it wouldn't be the Pandemonium Society if things ended neatly.

Even after all this, it's still not over.
I'm not sure whether to call them gluttonous or greedy.
Well, we're not going to simply roll over and accept it.

It's finally over.
After days of commotion, this is how it ends.
Still... A lot happened.
I hope that you had a little fun at least, Sensei. Really.

Whenever there's trouble with the Pandemonium Society, it's always a hassle, but...
I'm glad that this time, you were here, Sensei.

Throwing a party at the last minute...
What are they thinking? Really?
It's not like we can know, but still...

Whatever happens, the Prefect Team's mission doesn't change.
This sort of thing happens all the time, after all.
It wouldn't be Gehenna without the chaos.

Hm? Gehenna's...scary?
N-Now, now. I think you might be being a little hyperbolic...

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive.
Hey. These kinds of clothes aren't my usual style. Sorry if I'm weird about it. I'm putting my trust in you, Sensei.
Not bad. You've got a pretty strong fashion sense.
I feel like I'm being watched...
Hmm... So this is your idea of fashion, Sensei?
...Hmm, I feel pretty comfy.
I really could use a place to sit down.
Sometimes I wonder... I've been given so much... I don't know if I could ever pay it back. Maybe I never will... In that case, thank you, Sensei. I'll keep doing the best I can.
Thank you, Sensei. I owe you for what you've given me.
Why would you go this far for me...? No, never mind. Thank you.
Well, I don't know who's the one receiving help at this point.
Received. I won't make you regret this.
Thank you, Sensei. This is really good.
I'll treasure it.
When I'm with Sensei like this, the dress doesn't feel half bad. Odd.
It just...feels a bit different than usual. Maybe because of the outfit.

Battle.Transcription: If we're doing this, let's get it done for sure.
Great work, everyone. You too, Sensei.
Well, I guess that's about it.
So it's my turn. I'll get ready.
Got it. I'll get it done properly.
What do you think? Do you like it?

Lobby.Transcription: Oh, Sensei. You're here. What shall we do today?

Hey, Sensei. Got any plans?
If there's nothing in particular...then maybe...
No, never mind.

This dress suits me?
...Thank you... Happy to hear it.

If you like it, maybe I should wear it more often.
Oh... I mean, once in a while.

Something feels different today for some reason.
I don't feel like my usual self... I wonder why...
Then again, I don't really mind. Heehee.
...Oh, but keep what I said a secret, okay?

Happy birthday, Sensei. Anything you want?
...Ah. I did say anything but I'm not helping you work.

My birthday?
Oh, right.
Thanks. I wasn't even thinking about it.

Happy New Year, Sensei.
Since I'm already dressed up...
Wanna throw a party?

It's Christmas...
Hm? Walking together in this outfit might cause some misunderstandings. Are you all right with that?

A Halloween costume?
I'm already set.

Event.Transcription: I've been waiting for you, Sensei. What should I do?
...Ah, I was just looking for you, Sensei.
It's surprisingly busy, isn't it? Shall we get to work?
Time is short. But don't worry, I'll help.
I'll start cleaning up.
...Huh? Did you call me?
Sensei... Now's not a time to goof off.
*sigh*...Playtime can wait until after work.

I'm not bothered by your ribbing, but...
I'd appreciate it if you knocked it off.
Do you need supplies? They're here.
If there's anything else you want, just let me know. I'll grab it.
Work's over, but...did you forget something?
If you did, just let me know. I'll find it.
Hey, that tickles.
That's what you needed.
So that's where it was. It'll definitely be helpful.
I'm glad we got this just in time.
Good choice.
I've organized our in-progress tasks. Let's review them together, Sensei.
Here to check on our progress?
Sensei, please!
...It feels nice working with you, Sensei.
Yeah. It all worked out.
Not bad at all.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive.
So, what kind of commission do you have for me? Or is it a new business deal? Well, whatever it is... I'm glad you came, Sensei.
Th-That person is...?! But it should be fine here, right...?
This place isn't too bad.
I think it's time to take on a new project. Something big...and ambitious!
I wonder if I'll ever find a worthy business partner?
Hmm... How am I going to cover this month's operating expenses?
Despite spending so much time together, hearing you say "I trust you" still feels...strange. Even so... I'm looking forward to working with you, Sensei. That's all that needs to be said.
You've got good foresight. I promise, I'll never, ever let you down.
I can't believe you've got such expectations of me... Me too, I suppose. I've got to work on myself more.
Don't worry. No matter how strong I become, I won't leave you behind, Sensei.
Heehee... You can always counting on me.
I wonder...how much I should confide in Sensei. Tough question...
Words might not be enough, but...I'm thankful to you, Sensei.
What should I say in these situations? ...There are things that even I don't know.
Sensei, um... No, nothing.

Battle.Transcription: You want to take me down?
There's still some left. Let's keep moving.
Over already? That was surprisingly easy.
Heehee, better than you were expecting, yeah?
It's an offer from the boss.
You've heard of the name at least, right?
Problem Solver 68. Make sure you remember the name.
How is it? Not a bad proposal, right?
You've got something to... Eek! Phew...
This job is perfect for me.
Don't worry. Leave it to me.
Since I'm in charge, this is only natural.
How was it? Would you say satisfactory?

Lobby.Transcription:
Welcome, Sensei.
Shall we get down to business?

I've been waiting for you! What's the job for today?
You'll be by my side, won't you?

Whatever you need, just let me know.
Today's pretty special...

Because we're all dressed up!
Hey, Sensei, wanna go paint the town?

You think my dress is very fashionable?!
O-Of course it is! To be the boss, you have to dress like one!
...Heehee.

Ugh... Cleaning this dress is gonna be expensive... I know it.
H-Huh?! I didn't say anything!
You know, it's okay to talk about things besides work too.

Heehee, today's an exceptionally special day...
Of course, I remembered!
Happy birthday, Sensei.

Oh?! Um...it is my birthday... You remembered?
Th-Thank you...

Happy New Year, Sensei.
It's a given our partnership will continue. Here's to another successful business year.

Just another day for Problem Solver 68...
Yeah. With you, maybe it'll be a meaningful one.

The streets are buzzing...
Hey, Sensei. Would you like to throw a party?

Event.Transcription: Time to go to work, Sensei.
Great timing. I have something to show you.
Would you look at the time...
That was quick... Is it already over?
Hang on until the very end.
Huh? Sensei? What's the matter?

Sh-Shhh! Quiet!
They'll find out about the infiltration!

Eek?!
Oh...it's just you, Sensei.
It's too dangerous here... Let's talk outside.
Now then, shall we gather some clues?

Sensei, let's organize the documents.
Would you mind helping me?
I need to learn more about the target.
F-Focus, Sensei. No, not on me! On the documents!
H-Huh? You got something to say?
Oh. So that's what it was.
I understand completely.
As expected of the business partner I've been scouting.
We have the needed intel...but let's dig a bit deeper. Just in case.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive. Heehee.
The end of one year...and the start of another. Just thinking about that makes my heart skip a beat. And if there are delicious dishes? Ah, it's perfect! ★
I wonder what's on the menu today?
Good times, good food... Isn't it amazing? ★
Viral food videos are incredible! They do make me hungry though...
The number of reviews is more important than the rating!
Hey, I don't JUST think about food, you know?
Wow! Thank you so much! With this, I can blow everything away! Heehee... Just kidding, Sensei. I'll behave. ★
Watch how much I can eat—no.... Watch how much I can grow! ★
Full or not, I can still eat! There are so many tasty dishes on New Year! It would be a shame not to taste them all! ★
Heehee... What will the special menu be this year? What should I expect, Sensei?
I have so many new experiences when I'm with you, Sensei. But, I'm ready for something even more novel...
Wanna go somewhere, Sensei? Leave the driving to me.
I'm not exaggerating when I say food is life. But I wonder if there's something even more important... Do you think something like that exists? Heehee.
I have a new outfit that I may or may not want you to see, Sensei. Heehee!
As a sensei, I know it's typical for you to cherish all of your students. But... I don't really like "typical". ★

Battle.Transcription: Hm. Let's get this show on the road.
I look forward to it. Heehee.
There are lots of things I want to eat in this world, you know?

Lobby.Transcription:
Oh my! Sensei's here! ★
All right, here's what I'm thinking for lunch!

Welcome, Sensei! ★
I've been waiting so patiently, Sensei.
For how long, you ask?
That's a secret. ★

How do I look in my new kimono?
Aren't you going to say I'm cute? Or dazzling? Something like that?

It's a special offer! Lunch with me! For the low, low price of zero yen! What a steal!
Whaaat? You think I'm just trying to play hooky?
Just who do you think I am? ...That's the right answer! ★
Heehee, when I'm with you, I feel light as a cloud. Why is that?

Can I count on you, Sensei?
...Oh dear. There's two different responses.
Maybe I'm expecting something totally absurd, though? Heehee. ★

Huh? What am I up to?
As you can see, I'm using you as a pillar of support!
No. I'm not moving from this spot. I like where I am right now. ★

It's your birthday, Sensei! I'm so happy, it might as well be mine!
Oh dear! It's not because I'm excited for birthday cake... Not all!
...Okay... That's exactly it! ★

Thanks for the birthday wishes, Sensei.
While we're on the subject... May I have three whole cakes, please?

Have a Happy New Year! ★
Now, let's go eat some osechi!
I'll drive! Hurry up now, Sensei!

Christmas to New Year's...
Heehee, it's truly my favorite season!
Because it's filled with delicious things!

Am I not allowed to pull a trick even after I get a treat?
...There aren't any rules about that?
Be careful, I might just take your word for it...
Heeheehee... ★

Event.Transcription:
Wow, Sensei! Did you already make your New Year's resolution?
If you haven't yet... Would you like to make one with me?

They say hot food in cold weather is the best way to warm up your body.
Huh? There's a bunch of osechi waiting for us?

I want...something fresh...
No. Something yummy... No, it's not that either...
Yes! It looks like something exciting is happening.

In many ways, it's been a lively day. ★
I don't mind it.
It might be challenging for other people though.

Seems the New Year's atmosphere is coming to a close.
The osechi was absolutely delicious. ★
What's going on, Sensei?

Oh my, are you teasing me, Sensei?
Are you sure you want to play that game?
My revenge is a very...special dish...

You bored, Sensei?
If I had my way, I'd make sure you never had a dull moment.
What do you say?

Only for you, Sensei? That's not fair.
Yes! Gotcha. There's no escape! ★

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive
Greetings, Sensei. I'm Satohama Umika from the Allied Hyakkiyako Academy Festival Operations Department. Do you enjoy festivals?
Hmm, what if I suggested something like a Cafe Festival...?
There are so many people out and about... Hm...hmm...
While it's already a great place, how about we add a little something extra...
How would the boss feel about it?
A bunny girl in a kimono is a bit much...
Um...thank you, Sensei! Wow, I never thought I'd get something like this... Please continue to watch over me! I won't let you down.
Ehehe. Thank you, Sensei. Now that I've grown like this, I can prepare an even better festival, right?
I can grow even more! For festivals... And for Sensei!
It feels like I've taken a step forward! It feels...nice.
What do you think, Sensei? Have I...grown? If so, I'll be so happy...
Do you know that feeling of excitement on the day before the festival? That's exactly how I feel right now. Ehehe.
Um, Sensei? If I'm with you, I...um... I-I'll be ready for any festival coming my way! *sigh* That's not what I wanted to say...
Sometimes I think, if I'm with Sensei...maybe every day would feel like a festival.
Um, Sensei? There are many things I want to say... But above all, thank you. I mean it.

Battle.Transcription: Now then, everyone! We've got a lot to prepare for!
Let's do this, step by step!
Palanquins, parades, food, fireworks... Festivals are always the best!
Another incredible festival! What did you think, Sensei?
Let's see, let's see... How is it?
This looks like a good spot!
Is there a festival going on somewhere?!
I'll prepare the best festival for you!
Whoa! Seriously, Sensei. You surprised me.
Nothing gets me as excited as the start of a festival!
It's great to see everyone working hard and having fun!
What a great festival! Don't you agree?
While there's something sad about the end...there's always another festival!

Lobby.Transcription: Oh! Welcome, Sensei! How may I assist you?

You're here, Sensei! Where shall we start?
I'll give it my all!

Schale is quite intriguing... There's just something so...exhilarating about it.
It feels like a festival!

I like seeing new and exciting things. That kind of atmosphere makes me come alive.
Hanging out with Sensei... Yes, I think I like it.

Since coming to Hyakkiyako, I've learned a lot. And so many things have changed.
But even so, I've never stopped loving festivals.

I'm eager to learn more and excel.
So please, Sensei. Teach me all you can!

After my work at Momoyodou's done, I need to start preparing for the festival. And somewhere in there I need to fit in lectures and studying too.
There's too much to do!
Oh? It's the same over at Schale?

Sensei! I heard it's your birthday today!
How about I show you around a local festival to celebrate!
There's another festival in Kivotos today!

Huh? Oh, that's right... Today is my birthday.
Heeheehee. Getting birthday wishes from you... I don't know why, but it makes me really happy.

It's the New Year! Let's go to the New Year's festival!
Does something like that exist? Of course it does! If not, we'll just make one!

I'm only telling you this...
...but if we don't do it this way, our club won't function properly...

It's said that diverse experiences drive creativity, but...
This is a bit...

Environment, clothing, elements... All conditions are in order.
Well then, Master. Today, I will be by your side as well.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive!
I WILL make this the "best vacation"! No compromises!
Hm... It looks like everyone's busy.
I have the sudden urge to have a water gun fight...
Is it barbecue time?
...I guess I should clean up a bit.
Phew... That feels better.
Is it okay to just play around like this...? Y-You're the one who approved it! So you better take responsibility, okay?!
Um...I like fun as much as the next person, but are you sure this is okay...?
All right, all right! I won't hold back this time!
You want to have some fun too, right? I can tell!
Are you going to hold a water gun contest? All right! I'm going to blow everyone away!
...Yeah. I'm having a lot of fun, Sensei.
I'll enjoy myself the best I can! If something happens, you can stop me!
Now that I think about it...I've never felt this way before.
S-Sensei. Um... Well... D-Do you want to...swim together...?

Battle.Transcription:
るんるん～
わ、わぁっ！？

Lobby.Transcription: Welcome, Sensei! It's cool here!
You're late, Sensei! Do you know how long I waited?!
The ocean is refreshing, after all!
I'm really happy... I get to come and play with everyone.
If I go all out on having fun, I won't have any more regrets!

*sigh*... I'm tired...
N-No! Even time spent resting is a waste!
Sensei... Um... What do you think of this swimsuit?
Happy birthday! Let's play together!

My birthday...?
Right... For the entire day, we should...!
...What should we play with?

I think there was a New Year outfit too...
Well, I guess it doesn't matter. Happy New Year, Sensei.

I wonder if I was a good kid this year...
What do you think? S-Sensei?

Halloween?! A swimsuit isn't a costume, though?!
I guess it could be, depending on how you look at it!

Event.Transcription: Come on, Sensei! We don't have time. Let's hurry!
Ah, Sensei! This way, over here!
Huh? Why? Do we need to do something?
Sensei... What are you doing?
Are you enjoying that? Hmm?
Quit doing weird stuff! We have to stay focused on our tasks! Hurry up!

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive.
Public Peace Bureau Director Ogata Kanna from Valkyrie Police School. Forgive my rudeness in greeting you like this, but it's the nature of my duties.
Anyone in danger...? Nope.
I'll take a short break.
I never slack off on warm-ups, so I'm ready to move out at a moment's notice.
Mmm... There are a few items of concern.
I'll need to get started on patrol as soon as break's over.
Sensei's symbol of trust... I see. A lifeguard shoulders heavy responsibilities. I'll do my best to live up to your expectations.
I still have lots to improve on... But I'll continue to work hard.
Thank...you. It's almost too much for someone like me.
To pay me this much attention... Thank you, Sensei.
I'll do my best to repay your trust in me.
So that everyone can be at ease and enjoy the summer.
Don't forget to warm up. I'll show you. Do what I do.
Sensei, please stay within my sight. I'm saying that as a lifeguard.
A lifeguard should always keep her cool, but that's hard when I'm next to you, Sensei. I wonder why...

Battle.Transcription: Confirmed. An individual is in need of rescue. On the way.
That's a relief. But never let your guard down.
If everyone can stay safe, even for a little bit...
You there, stop where you are!
Is there anyone in need of rescuing?
Yes, I'll be on my way.

Lobby.Transcription: I've been waiting, Sensei. If you need my help, let me know anytime.

Welcome, Sensei.
From here on out, consider me responsible for Schale's surface water safety.
Huh? There's no...swimming pool here?
I'm not used to wearing swimsuits... Apologies if it's any sort of bother.

Incidents happen when you're unprepared.
I'm always on alert, so I can respond right away.
Coffee? It gets in my way, so I only had one cup.
Sure I can rescue people, but I don't know about welcoming or helping guests.

When you're feeling tired, you should move your body.
Then, let's get up. I'll show you a lifeguard's warm-up.

Happy birthday, Sensei.
I hope your day is a safe one.
I'll secure Sensei's safety.

Ah, it's my birthday again.
It's no different from any other day...
Another new year. Let's hope there aren't any safety accidents this year.
On exciting days like these, lifeguards have to be even more alert than usual.
...But, well, I guess a cup of coffee with you would be okay, Sensei.
I'm not a huge fan of candy...

Huh? The trick then? That's okay, as long as it's not dangerous...
But the only target...can be m-me.

Event.Transcription: Sensei, I've been waiting for you. Have you done your warm-up exercises?
Enjoy yourself at the water park.

Are you enjoying playing in the water?
As I always say, nothing is more important than safety.

...I've made it this far thanks to you, Sensei.
Let's make sure to finish strong.

It's a bittersweet feeling.
How do you feel, Sensei?
I know I have to wear a swimsuit, but...it's awkward.
A water park... I didn't expect to feel any connection to it.

No matter the situation, overconfidence is never a good thing.
If you encounter anyone in need of rescue, please inform us immediately.
P-Please come in! Welcome!
Ahem. As I expected, I still can't get used to this.
This is a specialty shop. If you need anything, feel free to make a purchase.
A recommendation...? I'm not sure, but I'll rely on your judgement, Sensei.

The shops are closed, but it looks like the park will be open for a little longer.
Make sure to enjoy it until the very end.
Yes? Is there something you're looking for?
...Sensei, please view the products, not me.
Ah, that's a product I was curious about as well.
Thank you for your purchase. I hope you'll find it useful, Sensei.
Choosing that one shows you have great taste. Very impressive.
Th-There's no need to get me a gift. I'm still at work anyway...

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive...
Ugh, you're going to make me do something bothersome again...? Well, since it's a request from you, I'll at least play along...
Is there anywhere I can hide and eat donuts?
Surely I don't have to work here too...? Surely? SURELY?
(If I sit and sleep with sunglasses on...would it look like I'm working...?)
This swimsuit is rather plain, so it doesn't stand out.
Well, nothing's going to make me get into the pool today, so I suppose it'll be fine.
Um. To do this much for me... If something happens to Sensei, I'll do my best to rescue you. ...Can I take a break until then, though?
Ugh... I don't want to try even harder...but this will be fine for now.
Huh? Are you sure? I'm not really that motivated, you know...
Um... you don't need to do all this. I'll still keep an eye out for you when you go into the water.
I really don't feel like it, but I guess I should keep my end of the bargain. I would really appreciate some donuts, by the way...
I'm not loafing off. I'm working. My eyes are working, to be precise.
Are you happy to be at the swimming pool too? Come sit down next to me and take a break.
If I'm going to play hooky...I'd rather play hooky with you, Sensei. Heehee.
The tube is the perfect size, the pool water is just right... This is paradise. Why don't you join me, Sensei?

Battle.Transcription: I'll share it with you. It's delicious!
Ugh, what a drag... Wait, this could work!
I want to take a break... Oh, right!
I wonder what I could do here... Got it! Mission complete!
Maybe I should have some donuts after this.
It's not my fault if you get hit!
I think there might be someone better suited than me...

Lobby.Transcription: Ah, Sensei! You're not going to the pool today?
Good work, Sensei. Sorry to ask, but could you grab that remote over there?
Huh? My job? Isn't it a good thing if the lifeguard has nothing to do?
How odd. I don't hate swimming, but it's suddenly such a bother when it becomes work.
Would eating donuts also become a pain if it was for work? ...Well, I don't plan on testing that one out, though.
Since I'm here, Schale is safe today as well.
Heehee, no need for repayment. A box of donuts will be enough.
I heard that donuts and mugs are the same... But I don't quite understand what it means...
Hm? Paperwork? I might've done that in the past, but I'm a lifeguard right now.
I'll help you if something dangerous happens during work.
Happy birthday, Sensei. Do you want...a Water Park Wristband as a present?
Birthday present... I want a vacation...

Huh? I can take a break at Schale?
As expected of Sensei! I knew I could trust you!
Happy New Year, Sensei. I hope there'll be less work this year.

Don't tell me that there are people who go out to play in water in this season...
Let's have Christmas cake already, Sensei.
Halloween, it's a day full of trouble...

But if I go out in this outfit, I won't be of any help, you know?
So I'll just stay still here!

Event.Transcription: Hey, Sensei, I see you've been working hard.
The water park... I'd love it...if I wasn't working here!
Everyone's so full of energy. Is it because they're here to play?
Oh, yay! It's almost time to leave work!
We've had our ups and downs, but we made it through the day. You worked hard as well, Sensei.

The water slide?
No, it's not that it's scary... It's more like...b-bothersome, I'd say...
It's so hot... Working on a day like this is the worst!

On a hot day like this, it's essential to keep your sugar levels up.
Therefore, donuts are a must.
Ack! E-Everything's under control at the scene! ...Huh, Sensei? You startled me.
Are you here for an exchange? We have a variety of options, so feel free to have a look around.
Ahh... It's so nice and cool. You should relax a little while longer.
The shop is now closed. How about we go out for a little after-work get-together?
Even for you, Sensei, I can't give it away for free.
Check out the products, not me!
Wow?! There's such a thing?
S-Sensei, you're luckier than I thought!
Congrats! You got first place!
Is this it? Wow, we both worked really hard.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive!
Lifeguard Kirino of Valkyrie's Public Safety Bureau at your service! I'll handle any dangerous situation!
Yes! This looks like a safe spot!
I'm a little worried about that person. I should keep an eye on them.
(Service, sensitivity, sincerity, and smiles! Don't forget!)
This... I wish we had this at the water park!
The AED is located at...
I'm not the best shot, but I'll put my all into ensuring your safety, Sensei!
I'll keep working even harder!
I'm actually getting better at swimming! Unless... Y-You don't think it's just in my head, do you?
Safety first and second! And that includes guaranteeing yours, Sensei!
I'm still a little awkward... but I'll become a lifeguard if it means living up to your expectations.
Can you swim, Sensei? If not, I could teach you...if you like.
You know, it'll be break time soon. W-Would you like to accompany me... to the water slide?
Would you like to go into the water with me?
Um... I'm always looking after you, Sensei. So, I hope... I hope you do the same for me too.

Battle.Transcription: Hm, who's going to be a problem...? Hey, you!
I will take care of this!
Don't horse around near the pool! It's not safe!
な、なんですか！？逮捕しますよ！？

Lobby.Transcription: I've been waiting for you, Sensei! Shall we start the warm-up exercises?
Hello, Sensei! Are you having a safe day today?
When entering the water, start by getting the parts furthest from your heart wet!
Hm? Do you need my assistance?
Check for reactions, call emergency services, check breathing...then...
D-Don't say anything! I think it's coming back to me!
Don't worry if you fall into the water! I'll come save you!

Water accidents can happen at any time!
Even Schale's office isn't an exception!

Happy birthday, Sensei!
If you visit the water park, I'll let you ride the slide two times in a row, as a birthday treat!

Thank you for the birthday wishes!
I hope you have a safe and enjoyable day, Sensei!
Let's keep everyone safe this year!

It's a very Merry Christmas!
Sensei, how about a meal at my favorite spot in the main building?

During a lively festival, dangers are bound to arise!
It's not a swimming pool, but you still need to be cautious for safety risks!

Event.Transcription: Welcome! Sensei, which do you prefer, the slide or the wave pool?
Nakatsukasa Kirino, reporting as a lifeguard this time!
A monster at the water park? How is this possible...?!

This time, it's finally my turn to step up!
I'll ensure the safety of Sensei and the guests!
I was really concerned, but it all turned out well in the end! Great job!
I've even held back on food adventures, so I could wear my swimsuit...
When I came to my senses, I found myself on a food court pilgrimage...

How about a water slide?
I can recommend the most exhilarating one!
The kids playing are so cute!
Yes? Is there something you need? Just let me know if there's anything at all!
This is today's task list! It's a lot, but let's give it our all!
One at a time! I'll do my best too, Sensei!
Ahaha! Tickling the lifeguard is not allowed!
Heehee. Hold your horses. I'll help you out!
As expected, you're amazing, Sensei!
Great work, Sensei!

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive!
RABBIT 3, arrived at the site! Heeheehee... If it's at sea, I can drop as many bombs as I want, right?
I wonder if there's a grenade lying around somewhere...
Phew... I'm beat...
The smell of destruction...
Heeheehee... I wonder what this button is connected to...
This cafe's firewall is so solid, for no reason...
RABBIT Type 224 Pistol, acquired. Do I have to make this waterproof, when I'm not even gonna go in the water? What a pain...
Mmm, I see. If I connect this and this, there'll be a huge explosion...
Heeheehee... There are so many things I can blow up with this.
Don't worry. I understood that perfectly!
*pant* *pant* It's burning, burning...
Call me whenever there's an obstacle in your way. I'll wipe it off the map. Heeheehee...
One day, when you get cornered to a point where you can't bear it anymore, come find me. I'll stay with you to the end.
When I look at Sensei, I lose track of where the boundaries are. ...It's troublesome.
Thank you, Sensei. Thanks to you, I learned that a person's feelings can be just as explosive as bombs.

Battle.Transcription: Heehee... Since it's been a while, shall I shoot to my heart's content?
Good... Good... This is the best...!
Don't let your guard down just because it's a water balloon, okay?
This is Rabbit 3. You're clear to attack!
So, what do I need to blow up now?
*pant* *pant* If only real missiles were this big.
Hm, hmm. It's been a while since I've gotten any exercise.
Putting the operator front and center? That's just mean.
Huh? Is it over already? I still have bunch of bombs left, though!
Heeheehee... If this many bombs can't solve the problem, I just need MORE bombs, right?

Lobby.Transcription: You're here, Sensei. So, which beach should we bomb today?

Ah, Sensei. On standby for orders.
I've planted lots of bombs, so I can set them off at a moment's notice.

You never gave those kinds of orders...?
Who cares? Good is good. Heeheehee...
This swimsuit is a bit too small, and it's so tight it actually hurts.
But that's what I like about it... Hah. Haaa...
Swimming? Of course I know how.
I might be an operator, but I'm an SRT member first.
Sometimes, the deep sea evokes more fear in me than wonder.

If I were to fall into that bottomless abyss...
...how overwhelming would the feeling of doom be...? Hah. Haaa...
Ugh, I'm hungry... You got any sweets, Sensei?
Maybe I had too much kusaya... The fishy taste just won't go away...

Happy birthday, Sensei.
What do you think about lighting up a bomb instead of a candle for my birthday?
It'd be a rather stimulating memory. Heeheehee.
Is there anything I want for my birthday?
Hm... Maybe some clothes alterations.
When I try to buy clothes based on my chest size, the sleeves are always too long and the waist too short.
Happy New Year, Sensei. I'll count on your generous support this year as well. Heehee...

Sensei, if it suits you, visit Kousagi Park this Christmas too.
We're gonna host a barbecue party.

Not only are we gonna have a huge turkey, but I'm also gonna serve some special kusaya.
Ah, of course, you better keep it a secret from the other members.
Ah, it's already Halloween. I thought I've been seeing ghost costumes around lately.
...Hm? Am I not afraid of ghosts?
Ehhh. No way in hell. Those things are already dead, no?

Event.Transcription:
This is Yatoura Village, renowned as the birthplace of shrimp...
This is my first time visiting in person.
What exactly is going on in this village?

You mean about the Deep Ones...?
If the rumors are true, what magnitude of explosion could they withstand?

That kusaya... Is it the fermentation process that makes it smell so much?
I want to try making it... Heehee

Heehee. Now...
I wonder if I'll be able to taste that delicious basil shrimp sandwich again?

Is it because of the fog...?
It's summer, but there's a bit of a chill...
Hm, 100% percent. I can smell a sense of doom from somewhere...

Even though it's for an SRT operation...
It feels nice and refreshing to be out by the sea in the summer.

You think this tube looks suspicious?
Well, it's not your everyday float used for water play. Heehee...

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive.
Oh my... Things have snowballed! This... I'm going to have to help.
(Cover...check. Exit...check.)
Should I check the ammo first?
Eh... I don't feel comfortable... I might miss Sensei at times like these...
This hairstyle is convenient for me...but I hope it doesn't look strange.
I...don't feel like taking a nap today.
...You have to tell me if you need my help, okay? You're my top priority.
Oh is this for me? Thanks!
Yep, I'll accept that. ...I guess it's time to punish some bad guys.
Oh boy, another gift. So, where's the next fight?
Heh, this kind of makes me shy, but...thanks, Sensei. You can count on this old-timer to fight for you.
Really... You're making an old-timer feel all shy.
If, by any chance, you're in danger, Sensei... No, I won't let anything like that happen.
Heh, I wonder when our next patrol together will be. I'm already looking forward to it.
You still believe me even though I look like this, Sensei. Hehe, that's a little embarrassing! But it does make me happy.

Battle.Transcription: I'll leave the suppressive fire to you.
I guess there are still some stragglers.
Time for this old-timer to step in.
Is that all? You're disappointing this old-timer.
That's a little troublesome, but...I always give it everything I have.
Heh, waiting around is harder than I thought.
You can leave the vanguard to me.
I guess that was to be expected.
All done! Time for a quick break.

Lobby.Transcription:
Ooh, Sensei! Good work!
How was the trip here? Did anyone follow you?

Good luck with your work day, Sensei.
This old-timer will be watching.

Hmm... Does Sensei like this kind of outfit?
Hmm... I'm not sure...
I always carry candy around with me. Sugar levels matter! Sensei, do you need one too?

Ugh... Argh.
Excuse me, Sensei. Could you massage my shoulders?
Wearing this is making me feel stiff.
Standing with your back to the wall is fundamental in indoor warfare!
Right there, just like that. It's quite useful, so keep it in mind!
Sensei, are you working overnight?

Here, have some warm coffee.
It'll get you ready for nighttime combat.

Happy birthday, Sensei!
As for your gift... Hmm.
I could let you hold my gun.
Oh, it's my birthday? I don't really care, but...
The fact that you remember...kind of makes me happy.

Happy New Year, Sensei.
I hope that this year, you and I can take it easy!

A Christmas gift...
If you're offering, I'd like a gun maintenance set.
I was thinking I should get a new one.

Heh. Would this outfit look normal on days like this?
Sensei, how about we go out together?

Normal.Transcription: ...You have to tell me if you need my help, okay? You're my top priority.

Battle.Transcription: Make sure to back me up.
You can leave it to the old-timer.
The firepower feels somewhat lacking, doesn't it?
Time for this old-timer to do her job!

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive.
I’m Sunaookami Shiroko of Abydos. Yes. Nice to meet you again, Sensei.
It's...not so bad here...
It's peaceful here.
Yeah... I might as well take a rest now that I'm here.
What's this...? Am I allowed to open it...?
(Does Sensei like this kind of furniture...?)
You would go to those lengths for me? Oh, I'm not complaining. I'm just...surprised.
Is this for me? I'll treasure it always.
Maybe I've gotten bigger... My height, I mean.
This is... I'll accept this. I'll do my best to be of assistance.
Thank you, Sensei. I hope... we can keep working together.
Can I...borrow your shoulder, Sensei?
I'm just glad I can help you, Sensei.
Hm... I don't know how this is going to sound, but I... I feel calm when I'm with you, Sensei.
There's still a lot I don't know...so I hope you can teach me a lot, Sensei.

Battle.Transcription: I should have brought a bicycle...
It's time to take this out.
For me...? All right, you can count on me.
Do you need to tell me something...?
Yep, I could see that coming.
Sensei's with us. We were never going to lose.

Lobby.Transcription: You look busy. Need a hand?
Yeah, I was waiting, Sensei. I won't let you leave until it's done.

Sensei, I finished some of the documents.
Hmm? How did I do it when you didn't tell me how?
...I have some experience with them.

About the snacks in the lounge...
I'm sorry, I ate a few.

I can have more?
...Thanks.

Sensei, are you still working?
I'll stay with you.

Why are you staring at me...?
A staring contest? Game on.
It's full of things I miss.

Happy birthday.
Why don't we go cycling together?
What? I already asked you that?

It's my birthday? Thanks.
...Sensei, I wish you'd congratulate the "me" here too.

Happy New Year, Sensei.
It's the beginning of another year. What are your new year's resolutions?

It's Christmas... Did you get me anything?
Just kidding. Merry Christmas, Sensei.

Trick or treat.
...I said it first. I'll take your treats.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive.
I'm Hakari Atsuko from the Arius Squad. Heehee. Did that sound too curt?
Do you think I could take a nice picture?
(I hope Sao-Sao is doing all right.)
I think I can smell flowers.
I think I can relax here.
This... I've never seen it before.
Oh, this... Thank you, Sensei. I love it. I'll use it for you.
Are you giving it to me...? I'll take good care of it.
It's rather enjoyable to get to know someone.
All this for me... You must expect I'll put it to good use.
Thank you, Sensei. You always show me new kinds of scenery.
I'll be next to you, Sensei. That's my wish.
You're always so generous, Sensei. It motivates me all the more.
Heehee. Thank you. I'll take a photo to commemorate the occasion.
Oh, at times like this...I need to properly thank you. I'm glad to be in your hands.

Battle.Transcription: Come now, let me take a photo.
That will make a fantastic photo.
All right, I'm taking the picture now.

Lobby.Transcription: Hi, Sensei. Is there anything I can do for you?
Welcome, Sensei. I'll be counting on you today, as usual.
I took a "selfie" with Misaki. Our expressions were both quite strange. Heehee. I'd like to take another one.
Uh... This might sound strange...but Sensei, could I take a picture of you?
You even work on days like these, Sensei.
Saori must also be... Uh, never mind.
Sensei, what do you think of my swimsuit? I hope it doesn't seem strange.
I got a yakisoba exchange ticket at a festival prize booth. Do you think Hiyori will like it?
Happy birthday, Sensei. Today, I give you presents. See? I remembered.
How about...me as your gift? I'll listen to everything you say today, Sensei.

Thank you, Sensei. I don't need gifts...
Rather, I want to walk with you.
Happy New Year, Sensei.
A new year... I look forward to what might happen.

Merry Christmas, Sensei. One should take photos of special days.
Now, look this way!
Trick...or treat...? I'm sorry, I don't know much about Halloween yet.
I don't know, so I'd like you to teach me, Sensei.

Event.Transcription: A festival by the beach... I've never experienced anything like this.
Are you having fun, Sensei?

I hope nothing...interrupts the festival...
You don't experience this kind of excitement every day.

The festival is almost over...
They say where there's a beginning, there's an end...
But it is a bit sad.

The festival, it's over...
Still, it's okay. The sea is still beautiful.

I can touch the sand, and follow the waves...
The sea is a joyful place.

I think...the outdoor stage would be fun.
Let's go watch it together, Sensei.

I'm happy that everyone's here.
Of course, you're included in "everyone."

Thank you for bringing me to the festival.
I hope you have fun too.

Hi, Sensei.
Here. It's a list of chores.
...It's a long list. Let's finish them one by one.
Did you call me?
Heehee. Don't look at me, look next to you.
Well done, Sensei.
You're so diligent. It's making me enthusiastic too.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive.
This is where I'll be working this time. I've never had a part-time job at the beach before, but you can count on me.
Can I practice here?
That decoration...I think it would suit Atsuko.
It's noisy around here. I don't think Misaki would care for it much.
A cafe, huh? Hopefully they have some magazines that Hiyori would like.
I distinctly remember putting the ledger right here...
The future is always unclear, but I do know one thing. I'll always cherish...this proof of your trust, Sensei.
...My work will go more smoothly thanks to you.
Are you sure you want to give me something like this...?
Once my next paycheck comes in, I promise to... Huh? Y-You don't need anything?
You've given me so much I can't even count it all, and the best I can do in return is say thank you.
You always seem to trust me, Sensei. Thank you.
Um, if... If it's all right with you, I'd like to play some music for you... A-Actually, never mind.
I'm always cheering for you, Sensei. ...Just remember that.
Working for pay is simply. But responding to the faith you put in me...that's much more difficult.

Battle.Transcription: I'd like to go and practice now...
We should take our work seriously, as always.
What I can do, what I want to do is...!
What do you need me to do?
The concert should still be on schedule.

Lobby.Transcription: Oh, Sensei. I was waiting for you. What do I need to do today?
Hmm, mm, mmm!
S-Sensei?! D-did you hear me just now...?
Part-time job or not, I can't slack off.
I always do my best at whatever I'm given.
I should buy a present for Misaki with my next paycheck.
I'm only wearing this outfit because I need it for my part-time job...
But if you like it, Sensei, I can wear it again sometime.

The beach, the festival...
I'd like to go with Azusa one day.
There are so many things I don't know about. Like the beach, or normal part-time work.
But I can't always excuse myself under the pretext of it being "unfamiliar." I'll give it my best shot.

Sensei, it's your birthday.
I prepared the best song for a happy day. If you take a seat, I'll perform it now.

My birthday...
Ahh... I forgot. I was so immersed in the work.
I'm not used to thanking people, but I should.
Thank you, Sensei.

Happy New Year, Sensei.
I hope you have a joyful year.

It's Christmas. I sampled a few carols.
Would you like to listen to them?

Hmm, trick OR treat...
I'm not sure...but I think I'm supposed to choose one. Right?

Event.Transcription:
Next up...
Oh, Sensei. Is there anything I can do to help?

W-Welcome! How many in your party?
...Oh, it's you, Sensei. I'm sorry. The greeting just automatically pops out.

My part-time job isn't over yet.
Let's stay awake until the end.
The festival is almost finished. Did you enjoy it, Sensei?

I safely finished this job too.
It's all thanks to you, Sensei. I owe you one.

The sea...is endlessly large. It's an amazing amount of water.
It's admirable.
If only I'd had more time, I could have completed everything for the performance...

The sea breeze is nice and cool.
It's perfect for cooling myself.
I'll do my best to make it a joyful festival.
I hope that you enjoy it too, Sensei.

Oh, Sensei. I'm sorry, but can you lend me a hand?
I could use some help.
This is the work I need to do today. Would you help me with it, Sensei?

I earn a living through part-time jobs.
The agenda must be properly managed.
S-Sensei? Do you need something?
You saved me. You're a fast worker.

Have you finished organizing it already...?
Please take this...as a token of appreciation.

Normal.Transcription: B-Blue Archive...!
Hee, heehee. I'm finally here...! Summer, the beach... This is so amazing!
What do they...do here?
Heehee... It's nice and cool...although I'll be hot again as soon as I go out...
Saori must be...
A magazine sweepstakes postcard. Can I fill it out here?
The swimsuit seems...tighter than I'd like. I hope nothing's wrong with me...
Hee... Heehee. What a precious gift... I-I won't give it back, even if you ask for it later...!
I-Is this for me...? This isn't some mistake, is it?
So you have a job for me... Heehee, I knew it...
Heeheehee, thank you... Not that I don't enjoy this, but I think I still prefer to have some shaved ice...
I-I kind of feel awkward since I'm enjoying myself more than usual... Maybe it's because it's the summer...? Or is it because of you...?
A-Are you saying you trust me...? Really...?
F-Flattery won't...won't get you anywhere, you know... A-Are you after my swimsuit?! ...Y-You're not?
Um, Sensei, do you enjoy yakisoba...? Do you want to have some together? Heehee, I'll have to ask you to pay for it though...
Life has gotten a little more bearable after meeting you, Sensei...but it is still suffering...

Battle.Transcription: Heehee, all of this for me...
I don't know if I'll be of any help, but...
Hee, heehee, we won... Is there a prize or anything?
We should get back to the festival...!
Wh-When it's hot, I need to...
Please be nice and take this hit!
A-Are you sure it's okay? While I'm wearing this?
Heh, heehee... Guess it's time for me to go...
I-I can't believe I'm fighting all the way over here...
We won... Not that the fight is over...
That ended faster than anticipated... I-I guess it wasn't that hard...

Lobby.Transcription: Oh, S-Sensei! Are you not going to play in the water today...?
Heehee... I'm on duty today... Excuse me...!
Hee... Heehee. If it's all right, can I have an ice cream...?

What?! You already got one for me...?
Thank you! I knew it, Sensei...!

The magazines at Schale are two months old!
I knew it. Life is hard...
Hee... Heehee. I know something that'll make you despair...

The lounge refrigerator is out of ice cubes.
I knew life was a pain... Even more so in summer.

Heehee... Wh-What? This? Um, it's a picture I took at the beach...
Would you like to see it, Sensei?
Heehee. It's full of cold desserts. Can I bring everyone from the Squad next time?

Happy birthday...!
Weird to celebrate the day your pain began, but I guess it's okay to enjoy it if you want to...

My birthday? I'm usually not all that interested...
But thanks to what you said, it's starting to feel kind of special.

Happy New Year... Another year of pain, but we have to live through it...
Heehee. I hope we get along well this year too.
I-It's a Christmas gift...! It's nothing, really. I bought it at the convenience store.
I-I'd appreciate it if...you accept it. Heehee.
I-I have no candy... Y-You can play tricks on me instead...

What? Sensei, you're giving it to me?
Heeheehee. Thank you very much.

Event.Transcription: Heehee. It's full of cheerful-looking people...

The sea... The festival...
This might be the peak of my life...

They're all new experiences for me...
Are beach festivals always like this...?

I-If I don't enjoy it until the end,
I might not be able to sleep...!

It's over... It's finished...
I'll never have a day like this again, will I?

What? You'll bring me to the ocean again?
Heehee. Thank you.
How about we go to a resort next time...?
Eek! D-Do you need me to do something?
You called me for no reason? How come...?

A-A-Atsuko and Misaki look good in their swimsuits...
What? Me too? Thank you...

I picked up some seaweed that washed up on the beach...
We can't eat this, can we...?

I'm happy with the sea and the festival...
But I'll be so sad when I go back to my everyday life...

Heehee. They're selling all sorts of things.
I won't refuse if you get me one, though. Heeheehee.
So many pretty things...

The shop is closed.
I didn't get to buy anything, but it was fun looking around.

I-I don't know which ones are good...
So I think you should choose...
E-Eek!!
Th-They even sell things like that...!
You can buy such expensive things like it's nothing... Adults are amazing...

Could it be a present for me...?
If so, thank you. Heehee...
Oh, that one. I had my eye on that. Heehee.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive!
As the security chairman of Red Winter Federal Academy, I'll show you the meaning of valor!
...What is this? How...cute.
S-Something cold just brushed between my legs...
I need to display more elegance.
*yawn* I'm sore from staying so still.
(These clothes are so thin. Students at other schools are really okay with this?)
Ah, Gray Balalaika. To maintain a stable mount even while charging, there's nothing like an SMG with a strap. But it does rub against the skin in this outfit, so it hurts a bit...
This is rather refreshing. Not bad.
(This book... Have I read it before?)
Oho, now this is interesting.
No matter how hot it is, you can't slack on training.
I'm know that my field of view is narrower than others... So please watch over me, Sensei.
I don't usually care for such revealing clothes...but if you like it, I'm okay with it, Sensei.
I wish I could repay you with more than just a medal, Sensei...
I...no, all of Red Winter will always believe in you, Sensei.

Battle.Transcription: All the hard work paid off.
What...what in the world is this?!
Such a nice, quiet forest... A-A bee?!
W-Wait! Isn't the slit in this skirt too much?!
(I'm not too confident on unfamiliar routes...)
Heehee. Did you see that? This is the power of Red Winter!
There is no failure in Red Winter's future!

Lobby.Transcription: I've been waiting for you, Sensei. Tell me, in which direction should the next charge be?
Hmm...
Huh? Sensei!? When did you...
I-I wasn't falling asleep!

Some Shanhaijing students told me that if you train in a discipline called "martial arts," you can travel long distances with a single step...
Is that true?
If you learned that technique...just think of the power it would add to a charge!

I've heard there's a decent restaurant in the Black Tortoise Promenade...
...Sensei, will you go with me?
I'd go alone, but I'm afraid that...I'd get lost.
I've heard Shanhaijing bears are herbivores.

So they must have gentle personalities, and nice, soft fur...
I'd like to touch one, just once...
(The deep slit in this skirt...is part of the design, right...?)
(...The seam wasn't sabotaged, was it?!)
So...students just walk around here in these freezing outfits? That seems a bit strange.
At Red Winter, it's normal to wear many layers of clothes.
...It's not like students would traipse about in these thin clothes on the Glacial Sea. Haha!
Is today...your birthday, Sensei?
Since we're not at Red Winter, I don't have supplies or new medals to give you...but...
Hm, instead, I'll follow your orders today. It can be anything! Command away, Sensei!
Spending a birthday away from home feels...a bit lonely.
Maybe it'd be better if you took Medvezi's place, Sensei.
Happy New Year, Sensei. I look forward to seeing your revolutionary acts this year!

I mistook a Peking Opera Club member in a red costume for Santa Claus...
I may be...just a bit too excited.
I was looking forward to getting a Christmas gift...
Some kid from Plum Blossom Garden got the better of me earlier.

I didn't have any candy, so I got pranked...
There's nothing at all to like about Halloween!

Event.Transcription:
The prestige of Red Winter and Shanhaijing hang in the balance of this exchange meeting...
It must be a success, no matter what!
You want to know what I'm doing here?
As you can plainly see, I'm in the middle of escorting the Great Leader, for her safety.
H-Huh? Great Leader Cherino?! Where did she go?

What does Shanhaijing think they're doing? Treating us like this...
Don't think I'll let them get away with it!

Allowing a coup d'etat in front of outsiders...
Those Shanhaijing guys have really embarrassed themselves.
If we were talking about Red Winter Federal Academy...
...Ahem! A coup d'etat is really a minor issue.

*sigh* I'm exhausted...
 I never thought I'd start to miss the snowfields of Red Winter.

The streets of Shanhaijing are too complicated...
They aren't suited for a charge.

Intimidated by a single club...
The members of the Genryumon must be softer than they look.

For the sake of the authority of the student council...
We can't let things slide, no matter how hard our opponents try to persuade...

Hm? What am I holding?
...Just some dumplings I got for free from the Black Tortoise Promenade.
The president's bodyguard gave me sunglasses...
Her outfit, her presence... She was no ordinary person.

I heard that it's a rule that you can't wear a slip under a qipao.
Is that right?

I don't want to insult the customs of other academies, but...
It just doesn't seem like the right outfit for a charge...
What are you doing here? I'm just organizing what we need for the exchange meeting...
Would you mind donating some supplies?
I think this exchange meeting is going to be larger than expected.
The exchange meeting is over, but supply donations are always welcome.
We're all in the same boat, so we might as well help other academies.
(This Peking opera mask...is kind of scary if you stare at it long enough...)
Oh, that's a good item.
We have enough to hold a successful exchange meeting.
Um... Sensei. I'm not making any accusations, but...where did you get all these supplies...?
Excellent! Sensei's name will continue to be praised in both schools!

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive.
Welcome to Red Winter―I mean, Shanhaijing. I will do my very best to help, so I don't bring shame to the authority of the mustache.
Whew... It's cooler here. I finally feel like I can breathe.
(Black tea? And no jam? What an unusual tea ceremony.)
I'll have to take notes on this design for Cherino's merch!
Maybe it's because of the light clothes, but it feels easier to move.
Now, let's share news of the great Cherino!
They say a word can be more powerful than a bullet... But when it comes to persuading someone, guns are faster.
I'll work hard for Red Winter Academy and for President Cherino.
Thank you for your good advice.
If we keep growing like this...maybe the Red Winter Academy can win you over, Sensei. Heehee.
The Genryumon's skill in commanding hearts is impressive. ...Heehee, I should watch carefully.
I feels like I'm being watched... Should I cut the slit even higher?
Little lies begin and build from within. Yes, I've liked you all along, Sensei.
It's unusually hot today... Is the temperature high?
Sensei...you can draw people in without saying a single word.

Battle.Transcription: The beautiful fragrance of flowers and the warm breeze... The vibes are good.
A new Chinese restaurant opened up!
Great Leader Cherino swears by the pudding-flavored dumplings. You should try them!
Experience the flavor of the great revolution!
Red Winter gives equal service to everyone.
How about I pick the lunch spot today?
I'll give you the Red Winter experience.
How is it, Sensei? Do you feel cool?

Lobby.Transcription: Welcome. Can I take your order?
...I was trying to act like a Black Tortoise Promenade waitress. How did I do? Heehee.
I've been waiting, Sensei. Would you like a cup of iced tea?
Argh... It'll take me a while to get used to this heat.
There are a lot of kids around the district! Maybe it's because Shanhaijing prioritizes education.
Do you like children? I suppose they are the future of the academy.
I had a chance to think about the communication skills demonstrated in the Peking Opera Club's performances...
Heehee, I'll have to use a Peking opera during my next routine office speech.

All of the food from the Black Tortoise Promenade was delicious, but it was a little greasy...
I'm worried it may be bad for Cherino's health.
Once, I gave the president of the Genryumon a wonderful mustache, but she politely declined it.
I'm sure it would've looked good...

Happy birthday, Sensei.
I bought you special meat dumplings from the Black Tortoise Promenade. How are they?
Um... These aren't dumplings on my head, though.
Oh, today is my birthday. I was so engrossed in work that I forgot.

Don't worry about gifts.
...But if you really want to give me something...
Would you spend naptime with me? Heehee.
Happy New Year, Sensei. What was your first dream of the year?
My first dream...was a nightmare that Cherino grew taller than me...
...Christmas parties in Shanhaijing aren't bad.
It's a shame they don't have mistletoe, though.
I borrowed a few masks from the Peking Opera Club for Halloween.

Now that I think about it, a lot of the masks had mustaches on them...
Maybe Shanhaijing students like mustaches, too.

Event.Transcription:
An exchange meeting of this scale is a first, even for the Red Winter Office.
I'm excited, too.

Sensei, have you seen Cherino in a qipao?
Heh heh, isn't she adorable?

Oh... I look good, too?
...Thank you.
(The Dark Monarch of Shanhaijing... She's much more powerful than I thought.)
(I can't just think that she's cute, heh heh.)
I thought I was used to coup d'etats now...

Coming face to face with one at a different academy...
It feels strange.

It's been a wonderful exchange meeting.
We'll have to host them at Red Winter next time! Heehee.

The parks in Shanhaijing are so big and clean.
Perfect for street speeches!

If we extol the greatness of President Cherino here...
...it could become a diplomatic incident, huh?

Things that change, or things that don't...
It's hard to choose.
But it is a problem that Red Winter Academy changes every single day.
President Rumi gave me tea leaves for sleep.
I'm going to use them to make milk tea for Cherino tonight.
Some club called the Eastern Alchemy Society is working on medicine that makes you younger?
This...needs to be recorded.
To celebrate the exchange meeting, we're holding an exchange ticket event!
If you have Madam's doll, you can exchange it for a prize here!

The exchange event is still in progress.
Don't forget to exchange your items before it ends.

I designed this doll.
All my experience making President Cherino dolls came in handy.

They were made to use for exchange tickets, but...
So many students just wanted to keep them. We've had trouble getting them back.
Do you think there was an issue with the prizes?
Congratulations! You're a winner!
You're a winner! You have good luck, Sensei.
This is...first place! Of course you'd win, Sensei.

Oh my, so many...
I'll bring them right away. Just a moment, please.
Welcome, Sensei. I was organizing the schedule for the exchange meeting.
There's a lot to take care of, since students from both schools will be here.
Yes. How can I help you?
No. Please focus on work for now.
Amazing work. If this was Red Winter, I would've given you a medal...
Thank you for your cooperation.

Normal.Transcription: It's Blue Archive.
I'm Kayama Reijo, the manager and head security of the main store of Shanhaijing Academy's Black Tortoise Promenade. I look forward to working with you again, Sensei.
I wonder how matters here are being managed...
This is teaching me about the ways that the Black Tortoise is different.
Maybe we should do some market research.
(If we're going to expand the Black Tortoise Promenade here...)
I wonder if there's any place to stretch...
They say most problems can be solved with guns and gunpowder... But for you, who always has my back, I'll make sure I achieve a harmony of guns and fists...someday!
Because you were here, Sensei, I could apply myself completely, without losing focus.
Managerial tasks have something in common with training. Both require the strength you get from believing in yourself.
I made the progress I made today because you were watching me, Sensei.
Unbending, upright, and calm. Balance is key.
I-I...I'm not very good at saying cute things like this, so... Th-Thank you for understanding, Sensei.
When you're by my side, Sensei, I'm excited. Don't ask...anything else...
In times like this, I wonder what I can do for you, Sensei. In times like this...of course! We should train in kung fu!
If you ever need protection, let me know. I'd give everything I have to protect you, Sensei! Th-There's no need to give everything? Well, maybe just half, then?

Battle.Transcription: I can feel the overflowing power!
Believe in yourself as we move forward.
It's the results of my training.
Whew, that was a great workout!
Hup! Hiyah! One point, for sure!
Pull it out from the root!
I'll give it my all! Backbreaking effort!
I'll show you the pinnacle of kung fu.
Don't let your guard down until the end.
Don't give way. Keep working hard.

Lobby.Transcription: Please let me know if you have any requests. But, um...please don't give me the difficult tasks.
I've been waiting for you, Sensei. No, don't worry. It hasn't been that long...I think.
I'm used to managing elite customers and high-value transactions. I can handle escort and security, too.
...What area am I most confident in? Definitely kung fu!
I feel like being active for a while. So I'll be going to kung fu training now...
...You mean a walk? A walk isn't enough...
No, okay! I'll go! As long as it's with you, Sensei!

Honestly, I'm not a very good shot.
People have even told me I might be better off fighting with my fists...
But I'm training diligently!
I think I can shoot as well as others now...
It's okay to ditch sometimes?
No, Sensei! Time is short! We're always losing time!
...We need rest to use our time productively...?
Actually, that does make sense...
Time for the two of us... Time with you, Sensei... It feels odd.
Um, Sensei... Can I sit...next to you...?
Happy birthday, Sensei!

This morning, I had a strange dream.
It was about guarding you in the moment you were born, Sensei...
...You weren't in Kivotos then. It's interesting.
Huh? What?! My birthday? Y-You...remembered?
I...was hoping you would, but...
