...Thank you, Sensei. I'm so lucky...
Happy New Year, Sensei. I brought New Year's food from the Black Tortoise Promenade.
I helped make it! Heehee... Can you guess what it is?
I'm well-informed about Christmas. I studied the subject not long ago.

...Well, then. I'm going to go defeat Santa Claus, the economic criminal...
...for passing out free gifts and disrupting the cost of living!

I'm aware of what day it is today.
As a member of the Promenade, I need to have a wide range of knowledge.
Halloween... It's the peak season for pumpkins, right?

Event.Transcription: Welcome, Sensei. The Moonlight Festival will start soon.

Thank you for coming.
Enjoy Shanhaijing's Moonlight Festival.

We didn't expect this situation, but...
For the Genryumon, Black Tortoise Promenade, and Shanhaijing...
...your presence is very encouraging, Sensei.

The Moonlight Festival was a success.
...Let's just ignore the disturbance for now.

How was the festival?
Shanhaijing and the Black Tortoise Promenade are always waiting for you to visit, Sensei.

The Moonlight Festival is the perfect time to show off the skills of the Black Tortoise Promenade.
You should rest, Sensei.
...I'll respond to pranks physically.
I'm kidding, Sensei. Pranks are fine.
It would only be a problem if it was too frequent, so please control yourself.

What's going on, Sensei?
...What? You just wanted to chat?
...If you keep joking around like that, eventually no one's going to believe you.
But I'll always believe you, Sensei.
I-I'm not really ticklish.
R-Really. There's no point in trying. So stop...!
Ahahaha!
...Please stop.

Protecting the store is important.
So...what are you looking for today?

If you ask us, the Black Tortoise Promenade will go anywhere.
...To the ends of Kivotos, someday!

Did you forget anything?
I don't want you to regret anything, so please look around carefully.

The Black Tortoise Promenade's secret item? A hidden menu...?
Um... There's no such thing...
Not even if you give me that look...

If anything's missing, please feel free to let me know.
...But there's nothing we can do about sold out items.
Yes, that's an item I recommend.
Will you be using it at home, or giving it to someone?

Thank you so much!
People say that all the time, but saying it to you, Sensei...it sounds new.

There's something the president used to say.
If something's given to you for free, you've become the product.
But if you're the product, Sensei...
N-Never mind. It's nothing.

Normal.Transcription: It's Blue Archive.
I'm Ryuuge Kisaki, president of Shanhaijing Academy's Genryumon. Fufu. Is it in my power to assist you?
Hm... Is there anywhere to put a censer?
(Outside of Shanhaijing, it's very...diverse.)
This looks like a good place to have a cup of tea...
(What...could that be?)
I feel relaxed here.
You've had it rough, Sensei. Fufu, perhaps that's not something I should say...but, genuinely, thank you. I swear that I'll treasure it above all else.
Is this...growth? Fufu. It feels all right.
At least I... No, never mind.
Potential is a wonderful thing. It paves the path to our future. Fufu... It's all thanks to you.
I can still succeed...? Hm... If you say so, it must be true.
Life is like a flowing river. It seeks someone to receive it. It doesn't mean anything too deep...but that doesn't mean it doesn't have meaning either.
How long has the bright moon hung there? I raise this glass and ask the skies. Fufu... You may have always been there, Sensei.
If your hands are empty, I shall grab it. If your heart is empty, I shall fill that spot. So you... You're fine the way you are right now.
They say relationships are like the breeze that ruffles your sleeves. That sounds a bit lonely, but Sensei, I won't forget you. No matter what happens. Never.

Battle.Transcription: Is ending it here the right thing to do?
I wanted to see what happens for a bit longer...
I'll leave the end to you.
Let's prove that your choice was correct.
What are you looking for? Come here, Sensei.

Lobby.Transcription: There you are, Sensei. Fufu. How audacious of you, to make even the president of Shanhaijing wait.

I've been waiting this whole time, Sensei.
This is a very important matter, so let me say it once more, for emphasis.
I've been waiting all this time, Sensei.

People can't be led with brute force. You'll lose their hearts.
But I'm sure you already know that.
You called on me, Sensei? Hm? You just wanted to talk?
Fufu. So you jest? It's all right. I'm like that now and then, too.

I haven't left Shanhaijing in a while.
And furthermore, this moment here in Schale is so special.
Especially because you're here.
Have you ever wished a moment would last forever, Sensei?
I have. I'm wishing that right now.
I lit a censer. Doesn't it smell interesting?
Shall we enjoy a tea ceremony together?
If you're tired, we might try falling asleep together. What do you think?

Of course I remembered. I could never forget.
The day when you, not just anyone, first entered the world.
Now, hurry up and get ready. I'll show you all the best that Shanhaijing has to offer.
...I see. You remembered.
Thank you, Sensei. Many people have offered me well-wishes, but...
Your birthday wish makes me happiest.

Fufu. A happy New Year, indeed.
Please take this envelope. Oh, and these dumplings, fish, and fireworks, too...
Hm? So you think you should be giving this to me, instead, Sensei?
That's true!

Is it Christmas? So it is. Then I wish you a day of peace.
I brought apples. Would you like some?

Is it Halloween? I don't know much about the holiday, but...
I believe it's traditional to eat pumpkin.
Here, a dish made with pumpkin and jujubes. I thought it would be nice to share it with you.

Event.Transcription:
Welcome to Shanhaijing, Sensei.
I hope you enjoy the Moonlight Festival to the fullest.

Let me know if you don't know where to go.
I'll have someone help you right away.

I didn't know it would turn out like this...
I'm causing trouble for you, Sensei.
You'll...stay by my side, won't you?

Everything will come full circle and return to you...
Now, let us go reclaim our Shanhaijing.

Great work, Sensei.
As president of the Genryumon, and also as a student...
You have my genuine respect and gratitude.

Many stories cross paths during the Moonlight Festival.
Fufu. If you're interested, why don't you investigate?
The Black Tortoise Promenade is using the Moonlight Festival as an opportunity to mingle with the outside world.
Although I made no particular statement as president...
The Genryumon and Black Tortoise Promenade. Which side does the underlying problem lie on...?
I'm sorry, Sensei. Even though I'm president, there are things I don't know.

As long as I'm president, I will guarantee the safety of Shanhaijing.
No matter who the opponent is.
That goes for you too, Sensei.
You're here. Right now...
I see. Well, it's time to refresh yourself now. Fufu.

We've prepared some entertainment for you.
Please enjoy.
...But please be careful not to overeat.
There's still time remaining.
Let's stay together until the very end.

What is it, Sensei?
Huh? You want me to taste it first?
Do you know what that means? Fufu.
What if that doesn't bother me?
Do you want a bite, Sensei?
I've already tried it. You don't have to worry. Heehee.

The snacks are one of the Moonlight Festival's specialties.
Should we look for them together?

Learning something new is a good thing.
Don't you agree?

Do you like sweets, Sensei?
To me, they're...just so-so.

Oh... That's interesting.
Can I try it, too?

You did it, Sensei. 
But you won't rest on your laurels. Right?

Work, you say? ...You're wondering why I'm here?
It's because this is the president's duty, too.

Each day is a new day.
That means you have to better yourself every single day.
If you ever need help, I'll always lend you a hand.

What is it, Sensei? You want to tickle me?
Fufu. That's a bit rude.
But I'll forgive even that.

Are you playing a prank?
Okay. I'll allow it. Just between you and me, Sensei.
...but please don't when other people are around.
Yes. You made this happen. Don't refuse, just take it.

You're very loyal, Sensei.
If I can, I'd like to keep you by my side forever...
No, no. Forget it.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive!
I don't have much experience as an idol...but I'll do my best. I look forward to working with you, Sensei!
It's a cozy atmosphere.
Is someone looking at me...?
What should I do next...?
Is there anything I can assist with?
Meet-and-greets...? Polaroids...?

I feel capable of saying things that would normally be difficult for me to vocalize right now. Please hear me out, but forget it later. Moving forward, please continue standing by my side. It's a promise.
Does this...mean that Sensei is becoming my sponsor? I'll do my best to meet up to your expectations!
Thank you for your consideration. I'll repay you with best performance!
Surprisingly, it feels like my nerves are getting eased... I'm sure it's all thanks to Sensei.
I feel confident thanks to Sensei. I feel like I can do anything right now.
Does Sensei have a favorable impression of me? ...If that's the case, I'd be happy.
If idols are meant to sing for someone, then I want to be an idol for Sensei.
Sensei... Please keep your eyes on me, okay...?
To even think this may be sinful, but...please look at me, Sensei.

Battle.Transcription: Let's move on to the next part!
I'll see you at the next stage.
Fun times go by in the blink of an eye!
I want to be a source of strength to everyone!

Lobby.Transcription: I've been waiting for you, Sensei. I've completed all my preparations.
Then please listen. This is the first song.
If you'd like, Sensei...I'll sing this song for you...whether it's on stage or not.
If my song can make you happy... There's nothing more I can ask for.
Hm? A handshake? Anytime!
A-Aha, ahaha...! S-Sensei! I-It tickles...!
Geez... Then I'll tickle you too...! Hiyah!
Happy birthday, Sensei. This song is dedicated to you.

A day just for me...
...I'll never grow accustomed to that.
However, I am happy. Thank you, Sensei.

Happy New Year, Sensei.
I hope that this year is a joyful one...
...one where I can gift my songs to even more people.

A holy night... It's a day for sending hymns to many people.
Yes, this is a good outfit to sing in.

Th-This is not a costume...
But...if it's to your liking...I will keep it on.

Event.Transcription:
Hello, Sensei.
If you don't mind... Please watch me...on stage!

Are you ready, Sensei?
The concert will begin soon!
Let the concert continue!
Let's do our best for the second half of the concert!

Phew! That was refreshing!
How did you feel, Sensei?
Oh my, Sensei. What's happening?

W-Wait!
R-Right now, I'm, uh...sweaty...

Autograph...?
I-I never thought of something like that...
I'll put on a performance that I won't regret!
What are you looking for?
Please pick one to your liking! My recommendation is...
Please make sure that you didn't forget anything!
S-Sensei...?!

O-Over there... Not me...
Ahaha!
So that's what you chose. I think it's very cool!
Yes, I was looking at that one too.
Would you like to go with that? Okay, here you go.
This one. Okay, here you go.

Normal.Transcription: Blue-Archive.
Heehee, are you surprised? Right now, I've surely changed from my past self.
D-Did they realize my identity?
Since it's come to this, I'll sing a song...!
For some reason, I can't soothe this excitement.
Heehee... That felt nice.
Is that person...looking at me, by any chance?
This, for me...? No, regardless of how I look, I am still myself. You're right. I'll cherish it. Thank you, Sensei.
I need to stay on guard, but when I'm with you... It feels like I loosen up too much.
Thank you, Sensei. How will I ever repay this debt?
I feel my strength overflowing. Well... Phrasing it that way might cause some misunderstandings.
I need to commit to improving every day...but receiving a helping hand here and there is nice as well.
Um... If you'd be open to it, how about...a duet?
How should I speak to avoid causing misunderstandings with the others?
It's difficult to explain this emotion... I know things can't stay like this, but...
I'll pray for Sensei. ...Or should I say I'll sing for you instead?

Battle.Transcription: I'll put you at peace soon.
That was a great time. Did you enjoy the performance?
Was I...able to get a bit closer to everyone with this?
Uh, um... So like this! Twinkle!
You can look forward to it. ...P-Performance. I meant my performance...
We have many guests. ...I mean at the concert.
That was a fun concert. I'd like to perform again.

Lobby.Transcription: Welcome, Sensei. H-How is it? Does it suit me?
I've been waiting, Sensei. I hope today is a fruitful day.

Many things happen in life...
...but I never expected to be wearing a costume like this.
It feels like you've seen me in this costume quite often as of late.

Um... If you're okay with it, Sensei...
...could we...continue meeting like this?
Is this what one would call...a songstress?
Um... W-Would you...like an autograph?

Happy birthday, Sensei.
I rushed here in this costume, so we that may celebrate.
Yes. Please allow me to dedicate a song to you, Sensei.

My birthday... You remembered.
Heehee, for some reason, I've been feeling this way ever since you talked to me.
I'm always prepared to sing.
Happy New Year, Sensei. I will sing for you this year as well.

Sensei, would you like to sing a hymn together?
Fufu. My costume is perfectly suited for this.

Although Halloween is not just a day of costumes...
Heehee. But if this is your desire, then nothing else matters.
Would you like a trick?

Event.Transcription:
Ahh. Ahh. Aahh.
Ah... S-Sensei?!

Thank you for coming, Sensei.
S-Sakurako is very happy!
We're already halfway there. Mmm...

People say that fun times pass in the blink of an eye...
But it truly feels like this ended too quickly.

Heehee, do you have any regrets?
What a coincidence. ...I feel the same.

Hm? What's wrong?
Ah... A handshake?

Compared to when I don the uniform of the Sisters, I feel this costume has helped me grow closer to everyone.
Heehee, this costume is nice.

Um... Do you have business with me?
If you call me over and over again... I'm not sure how I should react.

I've been practicing my ultimate dance move.
W-Would you like to see it?
I have organized your tasks.
You came to the right place, Sensei.

Now that I think about it, Sensei... It's just the two of us right now.
Huh? N-No... It's just the current situation...
There's no deeper meaning to...it...
These clothes look good on me...? Heehee, thank you.
Yes, confirmed.
Great.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive!
Aomori Mine from the Remedial Knights...no, Antique Seraphim. I look forward to working with you.
This place...
I heartily approve.
I must practice my dancing.
Fufu. There are many members in the audience.
I must practice vigorously to live up to their expectations!
Our relationship...is similar to that of an idol and her manager. I stand on the main stage, while you support me. Such a situation would have been excellent. What a shame.
The more preparations, the better. Delivery confirmed.
Receiving your support... Thank you. Such opportunities are rare, so this is a rather interesting feeling.
I'll strive to deliver even better performances.
This is... Heehee. Please look forward to the future.
Um... I feel a distance between us. If that's not true... Would you come a bit closer to me?
It's different from my standard outfit, but I feel at ease for some reason. How could this be?
If there's something I can do, please let me know.
My heart is pounding... I'm sure it's because the actual show is starting soon.

Battle.Transcription: I promise you a perfect performance.
Heehee, did you call for me?
I'll make this an unforgettable memory for you.
Heehee, please look forward to it.
How was it? I want to hear your thoughts.
Phew... I successfully finished the song.

Lobby.Transcription:
Welcome, Sensei.
I wish to consult with you about something. Do you happen to have a moment?
Excellent timing. We've just finished rehearsal.
This place, in a costume like this... It feels odd.
You seem tired... Would a song relieve that fatigue?
I am always learning one lesson or another from you.
However, in the realm of song and dance, I am the one qualified to teach you.

If you have any request, please feel free to let me know.
This is also part of fan service.

Happy birthday, Sensei.
May I sing you a song to celebrate?

...You remembered.
Um... As a birthday gift...
Would you participate in an excursion, with me?

Happy New Year, Sensei.
I hope to see more days on the stage than at a medical site, this year.
A holy day.. A day to sing carols, is that right?

Th-The intention of this costume isn't that...
...but, if you were to categorize it as a costume, that could be correct.

Event.Transcription:
Hello, Sensei.
You came here to see me— I mean, the stage, right?

I've been waiting, Sensei.
This seat is just for you. Please make yourself at home.
The show is still going on. Please focus!
Please listen until the very end.
Heehee, that was a great show.
Sensei... Is there a problem?
Is this also...a part of fan service?
If you enjoyed it, that's enough.

Ah, ah, ah.
..I was doing vocal warm-ups, so I'd be prepared to sing at any moment.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive!
Extra, extra! The Pandemonium Society's secretary, Motomiya Chiaki, is at Schale!
What an interesting place!
This might make for a good headline!
Ah! I want to be friends with that person too!
If we place the "Weekly Pandemonium Society" stand here...
Ah, Ibuki might like this!
I'm so happy! It's like when I get a lead for an exclusive news story, or maybe even better than that!
Ah, thank you! Sensei!
Yes! I'll keep the fire of my secretary soul alight and do my best!
I feel like I've gotten stronger! Right now, I could even make the Weekly Pandemonium Society's promotional activities a success!
Yay! I'm happy! I feel like I could fly right now! Sensei! I'm going to take a photo, so look over here! Now, say cheese!
Ahaha... This is a bit embarrassing!
This is... I'm happy. What? Quieter than usual? Me, you mean? N-Not at all!
Ugh! Seriously! I don't know what kind of face I'm supposed to make in these situations!
Um, I really don't know why, but I want to interview you more! Would that be okay...?

Battle.Transcription: This'll be the next special report!
I smell a lead... Ahaha! I got caught!
Let's see, let's see... Whoa! Watch out!
Now, where...? Ahaha! Big trouble! Run!
Currently in middle of an interview!
Maybe I'll find a new lead!
I got a lot of good photos!

Lobby.Transcription:
Ah! You're back!
I just happened to need an interview with you!
Hello, Sensei! Let's have another great day!

Yes! Motomiya Chiaki, on standby!
Are there any leads... I mean, anything I can help with?

Did you read the new edition of "Weekly Pandemonium Society" yet?
The special addendum "Cute Ibuki Bromide" is a total hit!

It's a picture of Makoto that'll be in the next issue of "Weekly Pandemonium Society"!
What? It's too small to see?
Sensei at work! Now, look over here!
Your face is so stiff. Relax, relax!

As a secretary and student rep, I can do anything!
Let me know if there's anything you need, Sensei!

Happy birthday!
I planned a special "The Day Sensei was Born" issue!
Now then, please answer the interview questions!

Oh, it's my birthday?
I've been so busy editing that I totally forgot! Ahaha! Thanks for letting me know!

Happy New Year, Sensei!
I'll give you the opportunity to read the first issue of "Weekly Pandemonium Society" before anyone else!

Merry Christmas!
Please stand next to the tree! I'll take a picture of you!

I've been waiting for this day!
There are a lot of interesting people on the street! I'm going to go make lots of friends!

Event.Transcription: Whoa! Lots of fun things!

Sensei! Over here! Sit next to me!
I saved you a seat, Sensei!

The party is in full swing!
Are you enjoying it too, Sensei?

This rambunctious party is almost over!
Let's enjoy it to the fullest, so we have no regrets!

A lot happened, but in the end...
It was a toootally fun party!
Yes? You called?!
Let's look for a picture to use in next issue!
Sensei, say "aah"!

Ta-da! It's the Pandemonium Society's special chocolate!
How is it? It's sweet and delicious, right?

Fun music, scrumptious food, it's all great, but...
Being with you makes everything feel different!

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive!
Now, did I keep you waiting, Sensei? I'm Kyougoku Satsuki, the Pandemonium Society's Intelligence Committee Director. Heehee, I look forward to working with you.
Let's gather intelligence on Schale.
Mmm, like this? Not bad.
Force them to infiltrate here, then...
I wonder how other academies carry out interrogations...
Is there anyone around...I can practice hypnotizing?
Oh my, you're well-prepared. Heehee, that's helpful, Sensei.
Fufu... This feels nice. Aren't things going well?
I feel I've gotten a bit stronger.
Heehee. Keep it up, Sensei. Okay?
Phew... The goal is as good as completed. You have my thanks, Sensei.
The process of building trust.
Do you trust me, Sensei?
Fufu, I feel the distance between us getting smaller. By...quite a bit?
I require you to continue to stay by my side, Sensei. ...Right to refuse? Do you really think you have that? Heehee.

Battle.Transcription: Now, do your best for me.
How was it? Do you think you've gotten stronger?
Pandemonium Society, it's an all-out attack!
It's time for my hypnosis to shine!
Heehee, you don't have to grab me like that, you know?

Lobby.Transcription: Hello, Sensei. I'm the student rep today. Heehee.

You're a potential partner for the Pandemonium Society.
Perhaps I should take this opportunity to observe you closely. Heehee.

Oh? Who do you think I am?
I can complete work like Schale's tasks in no time at all.

I'm Kyougoku Satsuki, the Pandemonium Society's Intelligence Committee Director.
Although you probably knew that already. Heehee.

Be careful not to stub your toe on the edge of the desk.
I don't like when it hurts.
I wonder where you've hidden Schale's top secrets...

...It'd be unexpected, but perhaps in the break room?
Heehee. Let's peruse their snack selection.
Sensei, are you, by chance, interested in the NK Ultra Project?
If you want to join now, I'll offer you some incredible terms.

Look at this coin closely... Now...
You want to clock out...
You feel the urge to play hooky...
...You always want to? Hmm.

Today is your birthday, correct?
I'm already aware.
As a potential partner for the Pandemonium Society, you're quite valuable.
Well, even if that weren't the case, I still would have known it.
Heehee. Happy birthday, Sensei.

Heh. You remembered my birthday as well?
Schale's intelligence network is quite competent.
As expected of our competitor.
Anyways, thank you for the birthday wish, Sensei.
Happy New Year, Sensei.

I hope we can establish a partnership...
...and make progress on the NK Ultra Project this year.
Do you like what you see, Sensei?
The Christmas aesthetic, I mean.
...You were confused? About what?
Ibuki was looking forward to Halloween.
Did you prepare any treats? Heehee, I'm looking forward to it too.

Event.Transcription: Welcome, Sensei. Take your time looking around.

The Pandemonium Society worked very hard on this event...
...so I'm sure you'll find it to your liking.
Oh my. I suppose things aren't working out.
Well, Makoto can most likely solve it somehow, yes?

I wasn't expecting your assistance here.
Heehee, I'll leave it to you then, Sensei.
And that's all for the party.
Just as I said, it worked out somehow, didn't it?

Hm? You keep pestering me...
Is there something you want?
Sensei, what is it you would like?
Heehee, Sensei... Try to hypnotize me.

Of course, it won't work on...
Huh? It's okay?
Heehee, don't say that... Here.
Sensei, if you stand idly by, you might get involved in Makoto's plot.
Come this way.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive
Calling me so late in the night... O-Of course, regardless of what I'm wearing, I'm always ready to go. Just know that I'll collect my dues later.
I think I'm a little sleepy.
Is there anywhere I can rest...?
Somewhere neither too warm nor too cool...
(Maybe lying next to Sensei, or something like that...)
What kind of tea helps promote a good night's sleep?
Thank you, Sensei. With this weapon, maybe I can reasonably get rid of anything that disturbs my sleep?
Pajamas are great in the right time and place. Don't you agree, Sensei?
It's a really functional type of clothing. And in bed... I don't mean anything weird about that!
I think I'll be able to sleep well tonight. I really like this pillow.
I think my dice luck is about to improve!
Since...I've decided to be honest. Thank you, Sensei. And...and that's it for now!
I know how hard you work every day. So for you to think of me...even in this situation... I'm really glad to have met you, Sensei.
M-M-Maybe, just in case, um, if you can't sleep well at night...! I could whisper to you...the constant of the natural logarithm, you know...?
S-So, what kind of dreams do you usually have, Sensei? Like for example, dreams about me...? Every once in a while, I dream about...

Battle.Transcription: Thank you. I wouldn't have woken up without you!
Right now...it's time to take cover!
When this is over, let's go to sleep.
Well, that was within the prediction range.
I feel my energy returning. Thank you!
Let's move to the next coordinates!
Careful, careful... Are you kidding me?! Ugh...
Carefully... Wait a minute! Not again...
Eek?! B-But, it's as I calculated!
Thank you, Sensei. I'm the perfect answer here!
I'll prove to you that your choice wasn't a mistake.
Eek! Please forget the mistake I just made...
Then, let's find the right path.
I don't have any stamina issues! ...At least not yet.
We won. It was a given, though.

Lobby.Transcription: ...Ah. You're here, Sensei.
Was I waiting for long? N-No, not really.
Hello, Sensei.
I look really comfy today?

Well, you called me so suddenly, I had no choice...!
...I did want to pick out a prettier outfit.
By the way, what kind of pajamas do you wear to sleep, Sensei?
Ah, no! I'm not thinking of anything else!
I was just curious...
A proper schedule, nutritional intake, sleep. They're all important.
I can be by your side and take care of you, you know?
I-If that's okay with you, Sensei...
Lack of sleep disrupts logic and causes you to make frequent errors.
No person is a perfect computer after all.
Are you resting well when you take breaks?
Looking at your face and skin, it seems like you may not be getting enough rest...
Sometimes, I think it would be nice to greet the morning next to someone I want to wake up with.
I-I don't mean anything by that!
Happy birthday, Sensei.
As a gift...I'll lend you my pillow for a day!
I'm just kidding. Please don't take that seriously!

You remembered my birthday. Thank you, Sensei.
For a gift... I'd be happy with anything from you.
What? ...I can have whatever I want of yours, so I should choose?
Then, perhaps...
Are you sure about this, Sensei...?
It's the new year, Sensei. I can't believe I'm spending the first day of the year with you...
Back in the day, I really wouldn't have imagined this happening.

Until now, I've only ever thought of Christmas as another busy day.
...You're asking how this year is so far?
Heehee... Can you take a guess?
It's Halloween... Someone told me I could just go out wearing this outfit...
Should I be happy about that...?

Event.Transcription: Welcome, Sensei.
I didn't think you would come.
Hello, Sensei.

We were going to have a pajama party to celebrate the end of the year, but...
...there's been a slight problem.

KO! YU! KI!!!
I'm not letting her off easy this time! For real!
So please don't try to stop me!

Somehow, everything was resolved...
In a way, it's also thanks to you, Sensei.
Are you talking about Koyuki?
...I'm going to let it go. Just this once.
Ah, you're here, Sensei. Would you like to rest a little before you go? Only if you want to...

What? You find this side of me refreshing?
Th-Thank you. 
Hearing that from you, Sensei...
It makes me really happy.
You had the sudden realization that I'm a high school girl?
What was I to you before?!
Board games are realistic in that they are fun, but managing the pieces seems a bit tricky.
This rings even more true when you consider certain Millennium students who are terrible at organizing and tidying up.
Um, Sensei? Would you please stop poking my waist...?
...I'm going to genuinely get mad if you try to point out that I've gained weight.

Do you need something?
With the end of the year approaching, I've been organizing supplies. Feel free to take anything you need.

I'm collecting supplies for the pajama party.
If there's anything you need, just let me know.

Hello, Sensei.
Make sure you didn't miss anything! Please check carefully!
Preparing for this party just feels like an extension of my accounting work...

Come to think of it, at the convenience store in Schale...
...there's a cute kid who manages the store.
She's always there. I wonder if she gets to take proper breaks.
Is that what you'd like to go with?
It seems like a reasonable choice.

I'll hang onto the receipt...
I'll put it down in Schale's ledger later.
Heehee. I'll be able to analyze your shopping habits this way, Sensei.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive.
I am Ushio Noa, the secretary who's come to record your day, Sensei. I'm looking forward to tonight. Heehee.
(This cafe seems like a mysterious world born from solitude and silence.)
(Shall we listen to the quiet of the night for a moment...?)
*yawn*... I'm a little tired.
Should we take a small break here?
(I think I heard Koyuki's laughter just now...)
This conversion kit can change into any form based on the user's intention. ...Just like me, heehee.
Exploring the unknown world is always scary, but it's also exciting.
I look forward to your lessons today as well, Sensei.
Fufu, I should record this as well.
I understand clearly.
...I don't think I can be satisfied with just records anymore.
I wish I could pause this moment, like a record.
I want to record everything about you, Sensei.
Sensei, please stay right there, so I don't have to pause my records.

Battle.Transcription: Do we really intend to use that method?
Please provide cover for a moment.
Light exercise before bedtime promotes good sleep.
Let's wrap things up quickly and go to bed.
Our next objective is that way.
That was a nice atmosphere change.
Today's record ends here. Thank you for your hard work.
I'm quite sure I asked for silence.
It's difficult to enjoy reflection in this atmosphere.
Fufu. I'll join this time too.
Then shall we focus on reading again?
The sudden call makes me think this is urgent.
A night stroll? I'm not opposed.
Oh my...? Fufu, you're quite bold.
Troublemakers confirmed. I will leave the command to you.
Your appearance always matches your records. Heehee, thank you for all your hard work.
Thank you for your hard work. Once we return, I'll make you a cup of tea to promote good sleep.

Lobby.Transcription:
Welcome, Sensei.
How about a warm glass of milk?

...Ah. You're here, Sensei.
I was distracted by the pleasant scenery and nice weather out the window. I didn't even realize you were here.
Sensei, why don't you change into something more comfortable?
If you work in more comfortable attire, it could increase your productivity.

I write in my diary every day.
It's an important record that allows me to reflect on the day.

No, I can't show my diary, not even to you, Sensei.
It's a girl's secret.
It seems like Koyuki's been avoiding me...
Have I unintentionally been putting too much pressure on her...?

The thread of time is said to unravel slowly...
...so why do the holidays pass by so quickly?
Happy birthday, Sensei.

Today is the day you were born. 
That thought alone makes my pen feel lighter.
Could you please allow me to record everything?

...My birthday. You remembered!
You wishing me happy birthday is enough, but...
...would it be okay to ask you to read me a book tonight?

Happy New Year!
This year, please make sure to take rests in between all your hard work.
Reading while enjoying the splendid night view of Christmas night can be very enjoyable.

If you're interested, would you like to read with me?
If it's a difficult book, I'll read it aloud for you.
Come to think of it, during Halloween, there seemed to be students wearing short and frilly clothes that looked like pajamas.
Fufu, do you also like short and frilly pajamas, Sensei?

Event.Transcription:
Hello, Sensei. It's so late at night to be running into you.
I haven't seen you at Millennium in too long.

Good evening, Sensei. Oh, this outfit?
I was preparing for a pajama party with the other members of Seminar.

Are you hiding something, Sensei?
(staaare)
Heehee, things are going more enjoyably than I expected.

Great job, Sensei.
If you aren't too tired yet, would you mind spending a little more time with us?
...Winter nights can be very long.

Wandering around the campus in our pajamas in the late hours of the night...
...makes my heart pound, like I'm doing something bad.

I know most of the rules for the board games, but... 
...I don't have much actual experience playing them.

Despite what she says, Yuuka seems quite excited.
I haven't seen Yuuka this enthusiastic in a long while.
(It would have been nice if President Rio had also attended the party...)
Ah, Sensei. I was just organizing the board games we're going to play at the party.

Could you help me organize the board games?
...It's a bigger mess than I expected.

The party is over, but...
...please let me know if there's a board game you're interested in.

It's a bit late, but...
...if you'd like, I can stay and play a little more.
There's quite a variety of board games.
Seriously... I told everyone to tidy up after themselves.
Ah, so it was over there.
Could this design be...?
Oh my, what an interesting looking board game.
I wonder how you play this.
Yes, let's keep on organizing.

Oh, Sensei. If you don't mind...
...could you lend a hand with the party preparations?
We were delegating which roles we would each take on at the pajama party.
Yes, please tell me.
It's more comfortable tying my hair up, but the back of my neck feels a little cool...
...That was three times. You were watching, right?
Heehee, that's a good idea.
Just what I'd expect you to say. I'll make note of it.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive.
It's been a while. I've been waiting for you, Sensei.
This is certainly a well-organized place.
This interior is...cute.
Compared to my room...well, I suppose this is the norm.
Do you always bring people here?
It's an interesting place. I'll have to visit more often.
Me, Sensei...? My apologies, I'm...at a loss for what to do next. I can't predict anything at the moment. Fufu, this is interesting.
Growth. It feels different from recovery. I suppose one might call it, "change with a direction."
Getting stronger...? It's a strange feeling.
Would you be interested in seeing my honest side, assuming I have one?
Thank you. Here's to the future.
I feel closer to you, Sensei. ...Am I the only one who feels like that?
Sensei, how many times a day do you think about me?
If you're being this kind to me...I might start expecting things from you, you know?
How can I repay your kindness...? Well, would you like to tell me about yourself, Sensei?

Battle.Transcription: I'm not sure if this would be of help, but...
I think there's still more left.
Huh, was it unexpected? No, this too was a predicted conclusion.
It turned out all right somehow.
...Huh? You came all the way here.
Spending time together like this... It's quite nice.
Shall we talk about our tastes or some such?
That was unexpected. I'll do my best.
I see, so such an outcome is also possible.

Lobby.Transcription:
You're here, Sensei.
I was just taking a look around.

So this is Sensei's personal space...
I should get used to it.

Since I'm almost always in my room...
Just being here is a whole new experience.
Of course, if you keep reaching out to me, the experience will go from "new" to "familiar."
If that's any trouble, you could come to...
...my room instead. Just saying.

You can take that however you like.
Just...feel free to imagine the possibilities.

Happy birthday, Sensei.
I don't know if my being here counts as a gift, but...

Oh, my birthday... You remembered.
Just as one of your precious students...yes??
...Fufu, I'm kidding. Thank you.

Happy New Year, Sensei.
This year, I'll try to act more boldly.

Christmas...
Now that I think about it, I should've popped out of a box.

Today is Halloween.
...Can I play a trick on you, Sensei?

Event.Transcription:
Welcome, Sensei.
You look busy.

Oh, Sensei.
You got here just in time.

Our progress is...
N-Never mind.

It's almost over.
...I'll tell you later.

So many things have happened.
Thank you for your help.

Did you call me?
Did something happen?
I'm not going anywhere.

It's fun doing something like this every once in a while.
Maybe it's because I'm outside of Trinity?

That tickles...
But I don't hate it.

I prepared some things.
Please take a look around.

Is there anything you need?
Let me know anytime.

Just to be safe...
...try searching one more time. Sensei.

...Me?
Heehee, I'm not for sale.

That's funny.
Is it my turn to poke you now?
That's good.
Not a bad choice.
Ah, so that's what you needed.
Yes. Here you go.
Please check it over carefully.

I thought I'd see you here, Sensei.
Heehee, call it a hunch.
...Please don't make me rethink my opinion of you.
...Heehee, you're the same as always, Sensei.
Good work.
Great.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive!
Master! I mean...Sensei! I'm here! I hope I didn't keep you waiting.
This place is very spacious! Would you like me to guide you?
I finally get to wear my school uniform! And it feels...nice! So now what should I do?
I'm hungry... Time to eat those snacks!
They're all so cute! I want to take photos together!
Sensei, you there? I can feel your eyes on me somehow. Come on out, wherever you are...
We'll have so much fun! Thanks, Sensei!
It feels like I've gotten stronger!
Thank you for your consideration, Sensei!
Ahaha! It really feels nice getting stronger!
I'll protect Sensei! Always!
You called, Sensei? I'm over here!
It's always fun being next to you!
Ask me for anything! For you, I'll make it happen!
I'm so happy! From being together with you, Sensei! I'll stay by your side!

Battle.Transcription: Whoa, what was that just now?
As expected! I knew it'd be like this!
Ahaha, that was fun. What about you?
I'll do my best to guide you!
Leave the next mission to me too!

Lobby.Transcription: Sensei! I'm here to help you! Ask me for anything!
What should I do today? What do you want to do, Sensei?

What do you think of the school uniform? I want to hear Mast—
I mean Sensei's opinion of it!

It's nice to go on a mission outside...
...but I also enjoy being with you like this, Sensei!

Sensei! Want to go for a puppy walk? I can be the puppy this time...
Huh? You don't want to? Aw, how come? Come onnn, Sensei!

What kind of work do you typically do, Sensei?
Is it something I can help with? I do know a thing or two about cleaning!

Found a manga! Is this yours, Sensei?
What? It's not? Odd. It smells like it's yours.

Pop quiz! What day is it today? The answer is...
It's the birthday of my favorite person, Sensei! A round of applause for you!
Ahaha, happy birthday, Sensei!

Ah, you remembered my birthday?
As expected of Sensei! I really, really like you!

Sensei! Happy New Year!
We can look forward to lots of fun together this year too right?

It's Christmas, Sensei! Did you get any gifts from Santa Claus?
What? Do adults not get gifts?
Then maybe I can give you one! Fufu!

Today is an especially fun day!
The streets are so lively! And there are lots of interesting outfits to see!
So, Sensei, come hang out with me!

Event.Transcription: Ah! Sensei! Over here!

Master... No, I mean...
Sensei! I've been waiting for this!
Yahoo! Are you having fun, Sensei?
Let's have fun till the end, Mas— I mean Sensei!

Wow, it's already over. Time really does fly.
But I had sooo much fun!
Sensei, is there anyplace you want to go? I'll guide you.
Hm? What? Is there anything you'd like to ask me?

Ahaha! That tickles!
Did you want to play, Sensei?
Heehee, then I'll tickle you too, Sensei! Come here!

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive.
Kakudate Karin, from Millennium Science School, preparations complete. ...I-Is this outfit okay?
I wish there were a mirror somewhere.
I'm free, more or less. How about you, Sensei...?
There's lots of cute furniture... I like it.
I don't sense any enemies. I suppose I can let my guard down a bit.
I should clean this place up... No, not while I'm in my school uniform.
No matter the time or place, whether I'm in a maid uniform or a school uniform, I'm always prepared when it comes to protecting Sensei.
Sensei, I won't forget...what I owe you.
This isn't exactly battle gear, but there are things I can do while I'm wearing it.
You went this far for me...? Thank you. I'll protect you with all the strength I have.
So you expect the best of me. Got it. I'll do my best to live up to that.
Sensei, what do you think of my...school uniform?
I'll be on close bodyguard duty for you today, Sensei. This outfit might be a better fit for that.
Wearing a school uniform to meet you... It's different from usual, and I like it.
Um, I AM in middle of a mission...but I still have time to spare for you, Sensei. Ask me anything.

Battle.Transcription: So, it's... Um... Hold on, watch out!
I don't really get it, but... Ah! This way!
There's nothing to worry about. I'll take care of it.
Providing cover. Leave the sniping to me.
Work...? If it's okay...with this outfit.
Th-The skirt's...shorter than my usual outfit...

Lobby.Transcription: Ah, Sensei, I was waiting.
...Why? Does the situation call for bodyguards?
Welcome, Sensei. Good work.
As you can see, I'm in my school uniform today. Why, you ask?
...Would you like to guess?
Maybe it's just because I'm dressed differently, but I feel unusually alert today.
I don't usually wear my school uniform... Does everything look right?
H-Hey, don't just keep on staring like that!
Ready and waiting. Any orders you have, just give them as usual.
Hello, Sensei! It's going to be a good day today.
...That's how I'd greet you as a regular student. W-Was it weird?

Happy birthday, Sensei. Let me know if there's anything you want.
I want to get you a present you'd like, Sensei.
I have a special birthday thank you for you. I'm happy...to be able to spend the whole day with you, Sensei.
Happy New Year, Sensei. I hope the new year's full of...more days like this.
N-Never mind.

I am dressed a little plainly for a special day...
What? It looks good on me...? Th-Thank you.

It's Halloween. Maybe it's because I don't usually wear a school uniform...
...but it feels like I'm actually in a costume.

Event.Transcription:
Ah, hello, Sensei.
...It feels awkward to greet you differently from usual.

Maybe I should go with cuter greetings...
I-I was just talking to myself!
It's quite a hectic event...
Just a bit more, and it'll be over. Let's do our best, Sensei.

To think it's already over...
It feels...a bit disappointing.
H-Huh? Wh-What's wrong? Is there anything you need me to do?

Th-This is just Millennium's designated, simple school uniform...
Is there anything weird about it?

Um... Sensei?
Since we're here...
...would you like to...
...N-Never mind. It's nothing. Sorry.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive!
Mikamo Neru, from Millennium Science School. I just got here... Huh? This outfit? What, do you think it's weird?
(What's that? Cool!)
Well, all right. Maybe I'll take it easy for a bit.
It feels odd, since I'm not wearing something over it.
I wonder when Sensei will get here...
Oh! I like this furniture. Should I get one in the club room too?
I suppose it's not much different from the usual, but it feels special somehow. ...Well, I guess it doesn't matter! Since it's between you and me, Sensei!
Not bad! Thank you!
Eh? Ohh. Well, um... Thanks.
This makes it look like we really are student and teacher. ...Oh wait, we are, right?
Thank you! Sensei! ...Do you like this sort of thing?
Regardless of what I'm wearing, I'm me. So treat me like you normally would.
Ugh... It feels warm and ticklish... N-No, I'm not saying I hate it...
I-It feels a bit embarrassing... Damn it! What is this?!
Sensei... Would you like to go outside for a walk? Since I'm in this outfit...

Battle.Transcription: Anyone else want to pick a fight?
They must not know who they're dealing with.
*sigh* What a pain in the... Just stay right there.
You should know I hold a grudge.
That's all you've got? My turn!
*sigh* Feels like something's missing. My bomber jacket, I mean.
Guides have a very hectic job.
Why is there so much work to do?
Let me know if there's more. I'll get it done right away.

Lobby.Transcription:
Sensei! You're here!
I mean, not that I was waiting for you in particular.

What's with the long face?
Cheer up! I'll stay by your side!

For some reason, I've been antsy...
I guess it's 'cause I'm not used to this.
*sigh* I miss my jacket.
Haah? You think I seem calmer in my school uniform?
I'm just not feeling that energetic today!

What...?! The school uniform suits me...?!
Flattery will get you nowhere, Sensei!

Is there anything I can do for you?
Well...it feels like I ought to sit at a desk, since I'm wearing a school uniform.

Hmm? Where do I feel most comfortable in this outfit...?
Here, for now.

Happy birthday, Sensei!
Want to celebrate together?

Haha! You remembered!
Thanks!

Happy New Year, Sensei.
What? This outfit?

Well, since you said it suits me...
I thought I would wear it from time to time this year.

A Christmas gift...
Right, Sensei, wanna try my bomber jacket?
I'm fine, since I'm in my school uniform right now!
A school uniform... It might be regular wear for other people, but it's like a Halloween costume for me.

Event.Transcription: Yo! Sensei! Here, over here!
Sensei! What took you so long?
Now, now! Stay focused!

Hold on just a little longer...
I'll play with you when I'm done!
Ha! It was fun, right?
Huh? You called? If you did, you ought to say something.
Huuuh? You just poked me for the sake of poking me? What does that even...?
*sigh* So childish.
I'll remember this. I'll be the one to poke next time, so brace yourself.

Normal.Transcription: Blue, Archive
Tsukatsuki Rio, from Millennium Science School's Seminar. I'll provide you with the most rational approach to every issue.
To optimize the layout here...
...Are you sure that thing needs to be right there?
If you need caffeine, you could always take supplements.
"The greatest good for the greatest number..." I wonder if that applies here too...
...Let's avoid any crowded places.
I'm not a great shot...but it's irrational to not have a gun in Kivotos. I'll try to protect myself, at least. And you too, Sensei.
I've gotten stronger. You're asking if that's all I have to say? It is. So what?
Investing in those with potential is always a rational choice, Sensei.
You're expecting a lot from me, aren't you? Well, leave it to me. I won't let you down.
And, um...thank you, Sensei. I'm supposed to say that in times like this, right?
When I'm with you, my temperature and my pulse both go up. I wonder why...
Sensei... You're the only variable in my life. And your words always manage to sway me.
Honestly, I don't like talking about the future, since it's always so uncertain. But when I'm with you...the future's possibilities always come to mind.
Sensei? I just wanted to call you. I was, um, doing something I saw somewhere...and it's...much more embarrassing than I thought.

Battle.Transcription: I'll leave this place to you, AMAS.
I'm looking at all of it.
This is what you needed, right?
I will show you the power of a rational mind.
Reason and emotion must work in harmony.

Lobby.Transcription:
Welcome, Sensei.
I just got here myself.
Fufu. I calculated the most efficient, logical path.

Just in time, Sensei.
This is today's schedule. Please take note of it.

I thought that being rational...
...meant maximum efficiency.
But now, I don't think that's always the case.

Have you ever gazed at the stars, Sensei?
The stars' light comes from the past, farther back than you can imagine.

So when we stare at the night sky...
...we're experiencing past and present at the same time.

Although we can't...
...see the future in them.

The future is like a cloud of uncertainty.
Whether to be anxious about that...
...or to celebrate its potential...

I haven't been able to answer that yet.
But...

If you're in that future...
I think I can at least refine my hypothesis.

If any of the Millennium students end up coming to Schale...
...please share their schedule with me.
Do you promise?

Out for a walk?
No. That's an irrational act.
More than that, it's dangerous.
So let's just stay here together forever.
...Why am I suddenly feeling embarrassed? Did I say something weird...?
Happy birthday, Sensei. Today's the day you arrived in the world, all full of potential.

Birthday wishes... I don't usually get very many of those.
So this... This is how it feels.
Thank you, Sensei. I mean it.

The whole concept of a "new year" is irrational in itself.
Seasons cycle, that's all.
But, well...since it's a social norm...
Happy New Year, Sensei.
I...really don't understand Christmas. Just what are holidays...?
What? A present? For me?

Um, thank you, Sensei.
...I don't understand the logic at all. But I'll accept your kindness.

A day for wearing costumes and demanding candy...
I don't get the meaning of it.
But if it's you, Sensei...

Trick or treat.
How is it? Fufu.

Event.Transcription: You've arrived just in time.
Right. I expected you to come around this time.
Things are going well, but not to a point where we can let our guard down.

We're almost there.
I can tell you about it soon.

All's well that ends well.
...And I mean that.
Hm? What's the matter? Poking me like that...
It's hard to understand unless you put it into words.
Um, so... Um...
Is there something you need or...anything?
I organized your to-do list.
Welcome, Sensei. Here's your to-do list for the day.

If you keep on poking me without saying anything...
...I won't be able to understand.

By any chance, did you want me to...
...do the same?
Got it. I'll check it off.
I'll update the "completed" list.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive...
Ugh, camping... I have to go outside again on my day off...?
I don't want to go outside today...
Ah, I just got a great idea!
Should I try installing the one-time bed I borrowed from Chihiro around here?
Huh? What is this wi-fi with a weird name...?
(Can I install BOOM on this too? ...Let's give it a shot!)
I modded this machine gun to make it look cool, but it's too heavy to bring hiking... Maybe I'll have to shave off some weight.
It feels like I've gotten better at camping. ...Is that a good thing?
It's still a long, hard road, but at least I'm on it now!
Mmm, with this, I can keep going!
Ooh, I'm overflowing with inspiration!
Thank you as always, Sensei. I mean it!
Climbing a mountain is rough...but it's okay if it's with you, Sensei.
Sensei, would you like to go out for a walk? It's not like I've had a change of heart or anything...but the weather does look nice!
(Huh? How odd... It just felt like Sensei was shining brilliantly...)

Battle.Transcription: Take a good look at my art!
The signal... I got it!... U-Uhh... Whoa?!
Got to catch it, got to catch it... Caught it! Wh-Whoa!
Ugh, I made a mistake...! Maybe I should just be glad I didn't get hurt.
As if camping wasn't enough, now there's a battle...!
Mm! With this, I'm not afraid of hiking!

Lobby.Transcription:
Ah, Sensei. You're here?
You're not planning on going back outside right now, are you...?

Isn't it really cold today, Sensei?
I predicted this, which is why I overloaded a bunch of electronic devices in the office!

I go up on tall buildings a lot when I'm graffiting...
...but climbing a mountain feels a little different.
It definitely feels like my energy levels drop without Wi-Fi access...
The mountain's scenery would feel more colorful if the fall foliage stayed throughout spring, summer, and winter...
But I guess fall foliage is more valuable because it doesn't stay long, right?

These braids?
Yeah, I did them myself.
My usual dango hair takes a long time to do, so I'm too lazy to do it on my days off...
How does Chihiro wake up and get to club room so early everyday?
Could it be...that she goes to bed before midnight?!

You can use a lot of things besides paint to graffiti.
Like how I drew the cave mural last time!

Since it's hard to get paint off...
...I should look for natural, recyclable materials more often.

Yay, Sensei! Happy birthday!
I drew a giant portrait of you on the outer walls of the Schale building for your birthday gift...

Ahaha, I was kidding. You don't need to be so shocked.
But if there IS any gift you want, let me know!

Whoa... It's already my birthday again.
Heehee, I don't need any presents.
Because I'm always getting lots of help from you, Sensei.

Happy New Year, Sensei.
Catch me on Coast of Light when you have time this afternoon!
Where is that...? Ah, I forgot to mention that it's from a game.

Merry Christmas, Sensei!
Since it's cold outside, let's stay in and make lots of Christmas wreaths today.
Let's make enough to fully cover the Schale building!

Yahoo! It's Halloween, Sensei.
It's the day I can freely set my imagination and artistic soul ablaze.
What do you say? Would you like to set your soul ablaze with me?

Event.Transcription:
I'm bored...
I really wish I'd brought at least SOME kind of gaming device.
I want to feel electromagnetic waves...
Maybe I'll draw something, using nature as a canvas.
(Ah, that mural... I forgot to erase it.)
(Well, no big deal, right?)

Mm. Not as bad of an experience as I expected.
The Mizutaki I had for dinner, that was really the best...
I think I might want to come again sometime, as long as I have my phone.
O-Of course, that doesn't mean I LIKE camping now!
Ugh... There are so many fun channels at the end of the year, and I can't watch them all...
Chihiro is so mean for that!
Ah, that cloud... It looks like a server computer.
It's been a while since I've touched a keyboard, and my hands are just itching to do something.
Sensei, do you have any handheld toys, by any chance? A rubber band? Anything?
So you're probably enjoying it out here, Sensei.
Well, I'll try to cheer up a bit, then.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive
Hello, Sensei. This is Himuro Sena from Gehenna Academy's Medical Emergency Club. I happen to be on my day off. Would you like to join me?
This seems to be a safe place.
Although it's my day off, I shouldn't let my guard down completely.
This looks like a nice place to spend time with you, Sensei...
That furniture's placement... It's bothering me.
We need to be especially careful of bodies... I mean, MEDICAL EMERGENCIES, in a place like this.
Even when I'm off duty, equipment maintenance is still important. Bodies... I mean emergency patients, don't wait for us.
They say rest is good for growth. I think this would be a good case study.
Thank you, Sensei. I don't always have the words to express it, but you're precious to me.
Even more bodies...Time for an emergency response.
I also believe I've grown as a person. And that's thanks to you too, Sensei.
Lately, I've grown curious about what you do on your days off. I want to know, so I adjust my days off accordingly.
I wish you would look at only me right now. And yes, that is selfish of me.
You know, I don't get to see you as often as I'd like, Sensei. Why don't we meet up?
I've already fulfilled my goal by being here with you, Sensei. Why don't we take this chance to make future plans?

Battle.Transcription: Let's say it's an emergency situation.
I wonder what bodies...PATIENTS might be there.
Case concluded. Let's head back, Sensei.
Nice view... Huh? Leave it to me...
There's a body...I mean an injured person.
I'm off duty today, but I'm fine being here with you, Sensei.
Did you call, Sensei? What's going on?
Gun, check. Medical supplies, check. I'm ready.
By the way, what do you do on your days off, Sensei?
I'm always ready, even on my days off.
How about we enjoy the rest of our time together?

Lobby.Transcription:
Welcome, Sensei.
I happen to be on my day off, so I decided to come for a visit.
Sensei's at work, I'm on a day off...
What if you took a day off too? Just one.
My hobbies are organizing medicine and being on standby.
Of course, I know those aren't ordinary hobbies.
But I enjoy doing them.

Being on standby at Schale is a fun experience.
Especially when you're here, Sensei.
I'm not making you uncomfortable being here, am I, Sensei?
Oh, you're actually happy?

Thank you.
I'll just let myself enjoy this moment, then.
You want to know if I like the ocean?

I'm not really sure, honestly.
I'm not too familiar with the ocean.
But it would be a new experience to see a drowned...
...Excuse me. A new kind of emergency patient.
It's hard to describe, but time I spend with you, Sensei...
...it's always a fresh experience to me.
In other words, every moment with you is special.
Because you're a special person to me, Sensei.

It's your birthday, Sensei.
Please be careful with excessive consumption of cake and other sugary foods.
If needed, I'll take charge of your emergency response.
I would like to report that today is my birthday.
What? You already knew, and you bought a cake?
Thank you, Sensei. I'll give you the first bite, then.
It's New Year's. I hope you have another safe and healthy year.

Christmas is indeed a good day.
If we exclude all the factors like fire, slipping on ice, and catching colds, that is.
But don't worry too much. I'm here.

It's Halloween. Please be careful with your sugar intake.
I'm saying this because I'm genuinely concerned for you, Sensei.

Event.Transcription:
Welcome to Gehenna, Sensei.
I hope you have a safe stay here.
I mean it.

You're here, Sensei.
I'm off duty today,
but I'm never going to let my guard down.

This is quite an interesting corpse...
Excuse me.

Ridiculous, but very interesting...
Excuse me for that too.
...An URGENT SITUATION, it seems like.
Rationally speaking, I should be hoping all of this blows over quickly.
But I wish I could take in more of it first.
That was a joke. Really.

Emergency over.
Good work, Sensei.
Even when I'm on a day off, the Medical Emergency Club always has the same duty.
This is my academy, a place where many things happen.
...Overall, it's quite an enjoyable place for me.

Do these clothes look good on me?
Hmm? You're not used to hearing me say that?

I just read it in a magazine someone recommended to me.
But if I made you feel something, I'm glad.

If you plan on visiting Gehenna on your next day off,
I would appreciate it if you'd get a hold of me first.
That would be the safest way.

Hello, Sensei. This is Himuro Sena.
When it comes to unpredictability,
this place is something like an emergency.

Welcome, Sensei.
I hope that fortune and good health will always be with you.

Was there anything else?
I'll support you until the end.

Do you like coincidences, Sensei?
I tend to like them.

They say it's better to be prepared for bad luck than to hope for good luck.
Prevention is also important in emergency medicine.
Leave it to me.

Congratulations, Sensei.
That looks interesting.
I see, so that's the prize.
Could I see it? I'm curious.

Incredible, Sensei.
Thank you for all your hard work.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive!
Welcome, Sensei! Please call me when you've picked out something from the menu! I'll do my best to prepare whatever you choose!
Whoa! What a cool cafe! There are always new things to learn as a waitress...
The interior is incredible...
(This recipe, it must be...!)
Hmm, so it goes like this, and then like that... This is a good reference.
A waitress resting at a cafe, how ironic...
If you think about it, a waitress does need a gun. I mean, it's only natural in Kivotos. Besides that, you sometimes get unreasonable customers, or the ingredients start acting up...
Thank you, Sensei! Um...is it better? At least a little?
I'll do my best! Meticulously, carefully!
Thank you for always looking out for me. I...I have so much to thank you for, Sensei!
I think what's most important is customer satisfaction. Basically, making people happy.
If I ever become a good cook, I want to make something for Sensei first!
I want to do my best to practice my skills. If you stay with me, Sensei...maybe I can do even better?
I'm glad you're here, Sensei. I... I just really like being around you!
I tr-tried quite a few different dishes...but I think the parfait actually turned out okay! I hope you enjoy it!

Battle.Transcription: Everybody's making me feel so energetic!
Oww! That could've been a disaster...
Customer at table 1, please hold on just a moment!
What would you like to order?
I did it! Huh? Where are you going?!
It's all thanks to Sensei! H-Hold on! Wait!
And now, with this... Ehehe... H-Huh?
And lastly... I did it! Wha?!
Kyah?! Were you waiting long? It's a parfait!
Thank you for visiting us. We'll look forward to seeing you again.

Lobby.Transcription: Whoa! Sensei, Sensei!
Did I wait long? Not at all! And I enjoyed the wait, even!
Welcome to Cafe Schale.
H-How was that, Sensei? Did it sound okay?
Lately, I've, um... I've been learning to cook a little!

Is it all my hard work and experimentation paying off?
Or is it thanks to Sensei?
I still fail more than I succeed, though...

...but if I can get someone to taste something delicious...
...if they enjoy my dish...
Just thinking about that makes my heart skip a beat.
My signature dish, for now, is parfait!
...Technically, it's my only dish, but still.
Since it's a dessert, the important thing is to stack the ingredients nicely...
A lot of people ask me if working part time is hard...
It's fine compared to School Lunch Club!

I always try to give it my best effort, without giving up.
That way...I won't have any regrets.
But if things don't work out...
...if that happens, please hold my hand. Sensei.

Oh, my goodness! It's your birthday, Sensei!
I tried making your birthday parfait!

...I did my best with it.
Please try it, if you don't mind!
What do I want for my birthday? Well, since you ask...
Would you stay with me? Even if it's just for today...?
Happy New Year, Sensei!
How about a New Year's cafe tour with Waitress Juri?
For Christmas, you've got to have chicken or turkey!

...I'm sorry, Sensei.
The chicken ran away...
It's a day for pumpkins, costumes, and candy!

Um... Sensei?
Just for today...
You can pull tricks, you know...

Event.Transcription:
Welcome to Gehenna Academy, Sensei!
I hope you have a fun, SAFE stay!
Yay! Sensei is here!
Wh-What do you think? My clothes, do they...suit me?

Waah... Waaaah...
Pan-Pan is... It's my fault... I have to do something...!

But still, Gehenna Academy is my school too!
I'm not going to sit still and do nothing!

I was worried how it was going to turn out...
Thank you, Sensei. With you around, it feels like everything's going to be fine!
I ended up working part-time at a cafe, so I tried wearing a fitting outfit.
If you don't mind, how about...a short break?
Part-time cafe work is a fresh and fun experience, too.

But still, when it comes to practicing cooking,
the School Lunch Club's work feels more important.
Ahahaha! Seriously, Sensei! That tickles!

...Phew, thank you.
That helped me loosen up a bit.
I've been waiting, Sensei! Come on, this way!
Is there anything you're looking for, customer? Would you like to see the menu?

Heehee, Sensei.
Look around to your heart's content, for as long as you like!

People often compliment my swiftness.
It seems like my experience with the School Lunch Club helped!
Yes, Sensei? Did you call me?
Even if you called me without a reason, or even if you wanted something...
I'm happy regardless!
Ah, so that's what you want! Please give me a moment.
Good choice! I'll get it to you momentarily.
We have plenty of supplies. Don't you worry!
If there's anything missing, please let me know anytime!
Ingredient preparation is important in a cafe too, of course! That's a common element with the School Lunch Club.
I like doing what I'm tasked to do. For some reason, it makes me feel proud.

Taking orders, bringing dishes...
Perhaps those are "missions" for me right now, you know what I mean?
Did you call for me, Sensei? Is there anything I can help with?
That's incredible, Sensei! Here, have this!
Being rewarded for all your hard work...it's really amazing!

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive!
It's New Year's, Sensei! Would you like to go on a dining adventure?
What new foods are we going to discover this year?
Dining! Adventure! A world of fun?
What kind of food would go well with this?
I should start by bringing out my very own custom special sauce!
Does anyone here like sardine mint takoyaki?
You never know what kind of danger awaits on a dining adventure. So I'll protect you with this, Sensei!
Huh?! This much? You sure? Heehee, thank you for the food!
Anything from you is delicious, Sensei!
You sure I can get all this?! I'll take you somewhere great to eat next time!
That was an interesting flavor! Um, I WAS supposed to eat that, right?
What was your New Year's wish, Sensei? I wished to spend more time with you!
I feel so calm when I'm with you. Even more than when I make Izumi's special sauce!
Sensei, can I take your hand? Heehee! Considering the occasion, how about if we link arms too?
For some reason, seeing you makes me happy, Sensei. More than good food, even more than new flavors...

Battle.Transcription: Mm. Mmm... Let's see... I'll give you this one!
Are you hungry? Have this one!

Lobby.Transcription: Yay! It's Sensei! Welcome, welcome!
It was a rough trip, wasn't it, Sensei? You deserve a big hug!
What? You appreciate the thought, but it's okay?
That's fine too!
Hey Sensei, after you finish work, let's go out for something delicious!
What? You don't...know when you'll be done with work?
Aww, but I'm lonely now...
You know, I think meeting you has changed me a lot.
What do I mean, specifically? Well...
Anyways, yeah!
Let me know if your throat hurts.
Because...I brought salty licorice!
It's oddly tasty! And also good for your throat!
What's one of your special moments, Sensei?
For me, all my special moments were about searching for something tasty, finding unique flavors, that kind of thing.
But now, I think being with you is the most special moment of all.

For me, gourmet food feels like a process of finding something new.
Which is why I always want to try new things.
What about you...Sensei?

I remembered! It's your birthday, right, Sensei?
I wrote it down so I wouldn't forget!

Okay, okay! Here, I bought a cake!
Don't worry! I haven't sprinkled Izumi's special powder on it yet!

You remembered my birthday. I'm so happy!
I brought a cake too, so let's share it together!
Hm? You think you should be the one to buy the cake?
What are you talking about, Sensei? The important thing is eating a cake on my birthday. The details are just...whatever!
I wore a kimono for New Year's! What do you think, does it look good?
Though wearing a kimono does make eating food more challenging... That's a problem......

Turkey! Chicken! Special pie and eggnog!
And with Izumi's special sauce on top of that, we're all set for Christmas!
Don't worry, Sensei. I'll get you your portion!
Halloween! Candy! Special pumpkin pie!
And for even more interesting flavor, Izumi's special icing!
Ah, I put too much on...

Event.Transcription:
Okay, Sensei! It's the new year!
Let's get started on the dining adventure!

Is there anything in particular you're hungry for?
You've got a lot of options!

And you know, even if I'm just sitting back and watching you eat...
...it makes me happy!

Every moment with you feels like a fresh experience.
Just like when I discover a new flavor.

I heard somewhere that it's good to go on adventures together.
So when I go on a dining adventure, it's going to be with you, Sensei!

I'm also part of the Gourmet Research Society!
The search for new flavors never ends!
That's my path to gastronomy!

Normal.Transcription: Blue, Archive!
Millennium's cleanup hitter, Nomasa Rei. ...Sensei, my goal right now is to hit a 0.10 batting average.
...Sumire didn't follow me all the way here, did she?
Practice and training are important, but so is adequate rest...
They say a moderate amount of caffeine can increase the effectiveness of your training...
(Maybe I'll skip training...just for today...)
That whipping cream looks delicious... No. I have to control myself.
Thank you, Sensei. Doing all this for me... I'm going to repay you by achieving a 30% batting average... I guess I should start with aiming for 10% for now...
The fruits of my training! Thank you for watching over me, Sensei.
Did I become a better batter? Was I able to...become a better player?
I want to take whatever I do seriously. Whether it be baseball...or anything else.
They say baseball is a sport where those who try the hardest aren't noticed. Like practicing your best to catch a fly ball. I like that part about baseball.
I think determining what can and can't be done is important. But...I want to give Sensei all the home run balls I hit. Heehee.
Data and statistics are important, even in baseball. But a lot of things in life can't be explained with just numbers. Um, for example, like Sensei...to me...
Home runs are my favorite part about baseball. Although I rarely... Actually, I've never...hit one before... But do you want to know something, Sensei? You're like a homerun to me. Heehee.
Watching baseball when I was younger used to give me the confidence to try. And now...I think that's what you do for me too.

Battle.Transcription: If it's now, I really think I can get a 0.40 batting average!
In a way, this is its own form of training.
I'm going to reform the baseball club one day...
Hiyah! How was my swing, Sensei?!
Nothing better than a home run.
Heave...ho. And that's one out, I suppose?
They say it's not over till it's over!
There's a saying that says luck comes from preparation. Good work, Sensei.
I'm sure this goes for everyone, but I hate losing!

Lobby.Transcription: You're here, Sensei. I was organizing the to-do list for today.
What? This is nothing... I'm used to this from managing the baseball club schedule, you know?
Hello, Sensei! Greetings from Nomasa Rei!
Heehee, how was it? I tried out what I learned from the baseball club's greeting training.
Is there anything else you'd like me to do? I'm actually really good with paperwork and organizing statistics!
...Though I'm probably not as good as the Seminar members...
If I had to choose, I'd say I'm more of an outdoor person, you know?
...Although I more so mean training grounds and baseball fields...
Schale student rep work is nice. It's like having an official excuse to take a break.
...But I'm starting to get a bit antsy to do something.
If you finish work early...do you want to go somewhere with me?
They started selling exclusive sports cards in this one stadium I go to!
Do you like the batting center, Sensei?
I'm sure you'll like it! All the fun you have from hitting balls will make your stress dissipate!
I didn't forget! Today's your birthday, right?
Heehee, I'm really good at memorizing numbers. Especially for analyzing yearly baseball statistics.
So, congratulations!
But there's not much I can do for you... I'm sorry.
It's another good day, Sensei!
Yes? My birthday...? Th-Thank you. I didn't think you'd remember...
A p-p-present?! No! You remembering alone is more than...!
Thank you. Heehee...

It's the new year, Sensei!
This year, for sure, I'll hit a home run...!
But before that I should reach a 0.30 batting average...
No, let's start with 0.10... *sigh*
There's a saying that goes like this: when it's winter, and there's no baseball, I stare out the window and wait for spring.
But right now...what do you say to chicken? Turkey sounds good too!
It's Halloween, Sensei.
Some people say that the Millennium Baseball Club is such a nightmare on its own that we don't need any special Halloween costumes.
I'm going to do everything I can to make sure no one can say that this year!

Event.Transcription:
Do you like baseball, Sensei?
Because I love it!

Today's game is important!
But every game is important!

The game isn't going well...
We can still make a comeback!

They say real baseball starts from the 9th inning, with 2 outs!
You have to be prepared to grab the opportunity when it arises!

I still can't believe it.
I hit a home run... That hit, that trajectory...
Baseball is really amazing!
What's wrong, Sensei? Do you have any questions about the rules of baseball?
I was looking through the game records.

It's easy nowadays because they're all organized on the internet.
But in the past, people had to dig for resources piece by piece.

D-Don't poke my sides...
Sensei! Not my armpit either...!
Since we're at a game, and there are lots of people...

...should we order something to eat?
Baseball stadium foods are delicacies!
Although the prices are...a bit. Let's not think about it. Yeah.
They're holding a raffle at the stadium!
I don't know how I got roped into helping them out, though...

Welcome!
Would you like to try your luck?
How is it, Sensei? Did I sound professional?
Hello, Sensei. If you have any leftover raffle tickets, please use them all before you leave!

I'm just helping out for today, but they said they'll pay me for the part-time work!
I'm thinking of changing my mitt first.
In baseball, skills are important, but so is luck.
...Maybe I just need more luck to be able to hit a home run?
First place! It's the first place prize, Sensei! Woah, how amazing!
This is the second place prize! It's a shame that you didn't get first place, but this is still incredible!

A lucky prize.
In a way, this prize is the essence of a raffle, right?

An honorable mention...
Well, whatever. This is still good, right?

A participation award...
Don't worry about it, Sensei! They say participation is what really matters! Yeah!
...Okay, nothing happened! ...Isn't that right, Sensei?

What really matters in these kinds of situations is to be consistent with your work output!
Just like training!

Repetitive work IS pretty boring...
...but there's a lot you can learn from it too!

They say great players eat the same things, sleep at the same time...
...and meet the same, strict standards for training everyday...
I'm...not sure if I have the energy for all that...

You're making me realize how incredible you are again.
Clocking in every day...getting swarmed by work...

What? Don't I also go to school every day?
But I heard work is way harder than school, no?

It's like...the fruits of training!
Congratulations, Sensei!

You did it, Sensei!
I'm going to work hard too. Please watch me!
And that's it for today's schedule!
Sooo, do you have some spare time after this?

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive
Hello, Trainer. If you're feeling thirsty, please let me know.
Let's find a quiet place to work out...
A cafe is a place to serve drinks. In that case...
How about adding a protein drink as a special menu item...?
Does anyone need refreshments?
I should have no problem squeezing in a few sets here.
Thank you for your consideration, Trainer. As the Athletics Training Club's coach, I'll continue to work hard. Then, let's go! One more set!
I think this keg also helps with training. I wish it were heavier, but it helps me do a full-body workout.
Smile, positive attitude, friendliness... They're important in both part-time and personal training.
I can't help others if I myself am not qualified.
May tomorrow's weight be heavier. And may tomorrow's me be stronger.
Smiles are always free. A smile for Trainer...is freer than free. How can something be more free? That just means...it'll always be sincere.
Thanks for always training with me. Now let's slow down the pace and relax today.
Trainer... No, Sensei. Thanks to you, I learn something every day. Will you keep running side-by-side with me?
Whether it be for working out or this part-time job, I'm more efficient when you're around, Trainer. Why is that? You don't know? I...think I do, though...

Battle.Transcription: Here you go. Hm? I caught it!
One second please. Is this?! There!
I want to energize the people!

Lobby.Transcription:
Welcome, Trainer.
The beverage offerings have changed. Would you like to try one with me?
Hello, "Sensei." As student rep, my duty today is to manage your energy levels and physical condition.
Anytime you need hydration or protein, let me know.

I...like the type of people who don't give up.
Someone who forges their own path. Who tries over and over again.
...Right. And all the similarities with you might be more than coincidence.
Setting goals is very important. Putting in the proper effort to reach that goal is also important.

It's okay, Trainer.
Getting started is half the battle.
Strangely enough, when I'm working part-time in this outfit, people...ask me to cheer them on.
Well, providing energy to people is important, after all.

If you're feeling tired, please let me know.
I'm confident in my sports massage skills.
And now I can also supply you with hydrating beverages.

Happy birthday, Trainer.
I was thinking of getting you a pack of protein drinks as a gift. What do you think?
Getting congratulated by "Sensei"... It feels sort of strange.
Then what do you say to a lively, special training to celebrate...?
...Hmm, for the gift, I'm thinking every variety of protein drink...

It's the new year. I hope this next year brings you good health.
If you need exercise or something to drink... You know what to do, right? Fufu.
It's Christmas. A dangerous day for gaining weight.

Don't worry, Trainer.
Fat is also stored fuel.
It's the source of energy for even more intense training!
Wh-Where are you running off to all of a sudden?!

Trainer. Would you like some pumpkin-flavored protein candy?
I specially ordered this, of course.

While I didn't put much consideration into taste this time either...
...I can guarantee its nutritional value.

Event.Transcription:
While I don't know all the rules to baseball...
...the energy in the air makes my heart beat faster.

What an incredible scene, Trainer.
Make sure you stay hydrated.

Something very unsportsmanlike seems to be going on.
We have to do something, Trainer!

Striving for victory is important.
However, taken too far, that can cause its own problems.
I learned something new.

It seems like everything ended well.
Shall we celebrate with a workout?
I wore this to blend in...but it isn't bad from a functional perspective either.
Trainer? Did you call me?

What's wrong, Trainer? Do you want to check my calves?
If so, feel them as much as you'd like. Fufu.

How much does this beverage equipment weigh?
About 25 kilograms?
It's perfect for extended low-weight, high-rep training.

You're here, Trainer.
Are there any items to your liking?

I manage our training supplies...
...so adapting to this role was quick and easy.
Please double-check to make sure you didn't forget anything.

Figuring out the quantity and providing it quickly...
I believe that can assist with agility training.

Even when I'm working, I'm consciously maintaining good posture.
I'm the president of the Athletics Training Club, after all.
Yes. I'm here.
Is there anything else you need, Trainer?
Understood. Give me a moment.
Would you like a complimentary drink?

Normal.Transcription: B-Blue Archive.
Saori from Arius Squad... I wore this for a mission... No, really.
