Hm, I can learn more about undercover operations here.
One day, for those kids too...dresses...
Will I have an opportunity to wear a dress outside of work one day?
Do I stand out? I can feel people looking at me.
Problem Solver 68... They're truly incredible.
This will enable me to complete more missions. Please tell me if there is anything I can assist you with.
Thanks for the support. I'm always in your debt.
I truly...want to repay your trust in me.
It was thanks to you...that I could press forward.
I want to express my gratitude... I apologize. I'm not very proficient at these things.
Why is...my heart beating so fast? Sensei... Do you know why?
Everything's changed since we met. Not just my look but also my heart.
Thank you. I promise I won't let you down, Sensei.
Someday... I'd like to wear this dress...just for you.

Battle.Transcription: It can't be helped if you saw.
It's for work. No hard feelings.
Thank you. It's all because of you, Sensei.

Lobby.Transcription:
Waiting for you in this outfit feels a bit embarrassing, Sensei.
Anyways, welcome.

You're here. Today, I'm bolder than usual.
Leave anything to me.
I've heard that dresses are meant to be worn for special occasions.
I was unaware of this when I put this on to meet with you.
There was no deeper meaning. I simply...wanted to be presentable for you, Sensei.
...The next time the opportunity arises to wear this dress, would it be okay to come see you again?
...That in itself is a special occasion to me.
I practiced my steps for today. Would you dance with me?

There's no meaning to my birthday...or at least I felt that way until very recently.
But thanks to you, I don't feel that way anymore.

Sensei. Did you make your new year's wish? Me too.
My wish is...a secret.

They say the Christmas season is meant for quality time with someone special.
Just...saying. I don't mean anything special by it.
This outfit isn't exactly a Halloween costume. Should I change?

Event.Transcription:
We'll be undertaking a special mission.
Let's begin.
As long as you're here, I don't anticipate any problems.
The mission is proceeding well. I'll trust in your orders.

We're in the wrap-up phase.
Please keep good time management in mind.
I hope I can continue wearing this dress, despite the mission being over.
Hm? What are my orders?
You...called me for no reason? Why?

I look pretty...?
Sensei...you have strange jokes.
Ah. Please don't say such things so casually.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive
Highlander Railroad Academy. Tachibana Hikari...here...
Ooh. Good place to play...
Sensei... Where are you?
Today...slacking-off mode activated! I decided...!
No snacks? What about juice?
Anything fun?
Is this for Hikari? Thank you. I'll get lots stronger...and protect Sensei.
Hikari. Evolved.
Whoa. Hikari, still growing.
What to do? If Hikari gets too strong?
Anything...is possible...!
Sensei. You called? Let's play.
Sensei. Anything you want from Hikari?
Sensei. Keep playing with Hikari. Okay?
Thanks for always playing with me. I like you looots, Sensei.

Battle.Transcription: I worked hard. I did well. Praise me.
Yuppies. Clickity, click, click, click. Here.
One sec. Shu shu shu shu shu. Complete.

Lobby.Transcription: Sensei. Welcome.
Hikari was waiting for you.
Ah... Lounge snacks. I nommed them all.
Hm? It's okay?
Sensei. Hikari super bored. Need excitement.
Hm? Paperwork...?
Boo. Suuuper boring.
Sensei. You want snacks?
So spicy...!
Hikari can't nom on this. You can have it.
Sensei. Hikari...deal with this document, okay?
It's fine. Student rep, after all.
...*zzz* Ah. Dooozed off.
Sensei... Your lap... I wanna get in it...
Taking action before permission. That is, Tachibana Hikari.
Look. Sensei. Puppy hand shadow.
...Huh? Is that...eagle? Can you do more things?
Schale train crew, over. Ta-da!
Today is your birthday. Happy birthday. Now we eat yummy cake together...!
Quiz. What day is today?

Answer. Hikari and Nozomi's birthday.
Give me present... Anything is good.
This year's resolution decided. Cut down on snacks...!
...Hm... I'll start next year.
Sensei. Have you cried this year? Hikari hasn't...kept it aaaall in.
So I'm a good child. So I get present?
Trick or...train.
Yes. My phrase. Gimme candy.

Event.Transcription: Welcooome, Sensei.
Hikari is ready.
Sensei. Emergency.
Help Hikari. Heeelp.
Operation preparations. No issue.
How is it, Sensei? Should we go...faaaster?
It's almost over. Hikari wanted to play more.
Had fun? Let's play again, Sensei.
Hm? Why? You wanna play with Hikari?
Tiiickles. Tickle.
Boo. Hikari will get reveeenge.
Head pats, please. Compliment Hikari.
Nope. Didn't do anything. But still. Gimme.
Want snacks? Hold on...
Ah... Hikari ate them all. Sooorry.
Is there anything you need? Pick, piiick.
Welcome. What do you want to buy?
Railroad tracks go everywhere. Like the shop.
Hikari? Recommend? Umm...
No. You have to choose.
Hikari wants to play. But holding back. So you have to, too, Seeensei.
Oh. That's good.
You have...good taste! Hu hu.
Good choice. Smart Sensei.
Are you buying something for Hikari too?

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive!
Whether it be train operation or track installation, leave it to me! Pahyahya!
Ah, this is that one place? Heh...
Should I slack off here for today?
There's sooo much fun stuff here. I should've come to visit earlier.
Where's Sensei? I had something to say... Ehhh, I forgot.
Phew! I'm RELAXED! At this rate, maybe I'll just conk out? But that'd be a waste of time, right? Haha!
Whoa, is this for me? Great! I'll wipe out all obstacles in the way with this! Pahyaha!
Ooh, what's this?
Pahyahya! I'm fuuull of energy!
Something feels tingly! I need to ruuun!
Right now, I could drive three times faster than usual! Pahyahya!
Why are you looking after me? Thank you! Pahyahya!
I like getting stuff...but are you expecting me to repay you?
I guess I should pay you back... What do you need?
Sensei, don't you like me too much? Pahyahya!! I'm kidding.

Battle.Transcription: Pahyahya! That'd make me feel better!
Let's just win and go back! Pahyahya!
This is it! This is it!
Easy peasy! How was it? Did you watch?
Don't ask me what happens next!
Mission? Great! Leave it to me!
O.K.! It's gonna work out! One way or another!
Ooh, what's this? Do it again! Pahyahyahya!
Let's get it done and over with!
A great victory! This is it! Haha!

Lobby.Transcription:
Huh, you're here now?
I was waiting! Pahyahya!
Sensei, you're late!
Making a student rep wait...
Well, I just got here too, though!!
So, what we doin'? You can assign me anything!
Ah. No paperwork, though.
...In that case, there's nothing to do?
Sensei, you're busier than I thought.

I'll feed you snacks then.
Say, "Ahhh!"
Pahyahya!
You've got a clumsy side, Sensei.
To be specific...
There's no way I'd tell you! Pahyahya!
Hold on! Aren't you poking me too much?
You don't have anything else to do?
Since you provoked me, you're ready for the consequences, right?
Ugh... But I don't wanna do anything boooring.
Today's your birthday, right? I already knew!
Happy birthday! But I didn't get you a present.
Huh, me? What do you mean?
Hm? Why, why?
Birthday present? Really?
Pahyahya, thanks! Hikari and I will treasure it!
It's already the new year. What fun stuff's gonna happen this year?
Sensei, what's your new year's resolution?
For some reason, everything feels tingly at this time of year.
Like...things are soft? Or something? Pahyahyahya!
Spending it with Sensei would be so much fun! Let's be together!
Ah! I forgot to bring candies!
Then I have no choice but to get tricked... What should I do?

Event.Transcription: Pahyahya! You ready?
Then, DEPAAARTING!
It was super last minute, so thanks for coming!
The situation is what you'd call "urgent." So I'll leave it to you, Sensei!
This is fine, right?
Well, as long as the brakes don't break!
Ahhh! It's all gonna be over soon! I just know it!
Hyaaah! It's finally over!
It worked out, right? Pahyahya!
Huh? What's wrong?
Nothing? Geez. I can poke you too, you know!
*sigh* How did it turn out this way?
Eh, it'll work out, riiight?
Anything fun going on?
Something to help with my nerves!
But I don't have any nerves! Pahyahyahya!
Keep riding with Highlander Railroad, 'kay? I'm looking forward to it, Sensei
Look around as much as you'd like.
Just tell me if you can't find something you want!
I mean, not that I'd know where it is! Pahyahya!
Work's finally done, but you can swing by if you want anything else?
Yeah! What about me?
...You want me to pick for you?
No way! You gotta pick it yourself, or else it doesn't mean anything!
Oh, that one! Nice!
Good choice! Pahyahya!
I want that too.
You've got good taste, don't you?

Normal.Transcription: B-Blue Archive... W-Was that right...?
H-Highlander Railroad Academy... U-Utsumi Aoba...
E-Everyone seems happy... I wonder why...
It's spacious and nice... I wish our night duty room was like this...
I-Is it okay for someone as unworthy as me to be here...?
(I feel like I reek of oil... It's bothering me...)
Calm down, and take a deep breath... *inhale* *exhale*
I-If there are people bothering me...I can sh-shoot them with this, right...?
R-Really? To me...?
I-It's troublesome that you keep...doing this...
Wh-Why...are you...doing all this for me...?
Th-Thank you...Truly...
Ah. Even if you this, you w-won't get anything, you know...?
I'm thankful...and h-happy, but... Umm... N-Nevermind...
You're at it again... You don't have to do this... I don't want to be disappointed later...
I-If you keep being nice to me...I'll start expecting it...

Battle.Transcription: I-I can do it... No, I can't do it...!
M-Machines and people are the same... I just have to hit them...!
P-Please clear the way!!! I-I'm alive...
S-So we're doing it... I knew, but...
I-I wonder if I can do it...

Lobby.Transcription: W-Welcome...Sensei...
I-I was looking around to see if there was anything I could do...
The Schale Office...smells nice...
Ah, huh... I-I was speaking too loudly, wasn't I?
Please call me if there's anything you need at all...

I-Is there anything I can repair...?
That's the only thing I'm confident about...

Um... The snacks in the lounge...
...can I eat them? I saw r-rice crackers...

W-We don't have those at Highlander...
Heehee... Thank you for the snack.
I...don't know much about important p-paperwork...
...but at the very least, I can do basic calculations...

I...
...brought some cup ramen from the night duty room...
W-Would you like to have some with me, Sensei...?
Um... I heard that today's your birthday...

I wanted to get you something, so...
...a m-monkey spanner! For you...
I wish you a truly happy birthday...!

What?! M-Me?
It is...my birthday, but...!

U-Uhh...
Honestly... I'd be lying if I said I hadn't been looking forward to it...
...Thank you... I'm truly...happy.

Here's to another good year...
Maybe I can look forward to this one...
A Christmas...gift...
N-No... That doesn't suit me...

I don't want to feel disappointed...
...so let's not think about it...
Wh-When it comes to costumes, I think...
...they're more fitting for other people...

Event.Transcription: Sensei... Thank you for coming...
I-It feels reassuring to have an adult around...
H-Highlander isn't always like this...! It's just that this time, it's...
W-Well, actually, it is like this most of the time...
B-But it's not always a total disaster. Maybe... I'm not sure.
Ugh... I-It feels like this situation is becoming very annoying...
I'm not sure if I can trust the officers... Umm...
Phew... B-But it seems like things are wrapping up okay...
I-It's over...somehow...
Thank you for your h-hard work, Sensei...
Wh-What is it...
Eh... D-Did I do something wrong...?
I-I have a bad feeling...
Everything will be okay, right...?
Wh-Why are all our officers like that...?
They don't understand the pain of us technicians...
...Wh-Why are you doing this...?
It tickles... That's my weak spot...
I-It feels like there's still lots left over...
S-Sensei... I'm glad you're here.

I guess I feel reassured...or perhaps relieved...
Heehee.
E-Even if you poke me like that... I-It won't trigger a help menu or anything like that...
I-I need to do something... Ughhh...
W-Whoa...
I-It wasn't an easy task...

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive
Asahina Pina from Allied Hyakkiyako Academy's Festival Operations Department! I'll guide you!
Wow... It looks like an office from a gangster movie. How cool!
(This TV... I can watch movies on it!)
This atmosphere...I have experienced it before!
There are many cool people... Pina can't lose!
The sight of people relaxing makes me sleepy too!
I think I've leveled up by one— No! By 500 levels!
Burning up very hot!
I'll do my best to protect Sensei!
I'm overflowing with power!
I'm full of energy!
What do you think of my guide uniform?
Isn't this like a gangster outfit? I hope you like it, Sensei!
I was able to become a proper guide...all thanks to you!
I hope you learn all the positive things about— Ah! Not me, but about Hyakkiyako!

Lobby.Transcription: Everyone's here, Sensei!
Sensei! I'll be your personal guide for today!
Leading people around while wearing a black outfit...
Is this not quite gangster?!

Hyakkiyako is like my "stomping grounds"!
Leave the guiding to me!

This is how we greet people!
Be prepared!
With Sensei, I'm invincible!

Today is your birthday, yes, Sensei?
Party preparations are proceeding swimmingly!

Today is my birthday!
Happy birthday to meee!

Happy New Year!
Happy New Year, Boss!
...No, I mean Sensei!
Hohoho! Merry Christmas, Sensei!
Trick or treat! It's Halloween!

Event.Transcription: Welcome tooo...Hyakkiyako!
Welcome to Hyakkiyako!
Sensei! Are you enjoying yourself?
I've grown accustomed to do this! I shall do my utmost to the very end!
Sensei! Please come find Hyakkiyako and Pina next time as well!
Ta-da! Leave the guiding to me!
Let's take much care to not get lost!
It's very lively with you here!
I'm glad that everyone's having fun!

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive.
Allied Hyakkiyako Academy, Hyakkaryouran Resolution Council. Goryou Nagusa. I'll use my strength to protect everyone.
What would Ayame have done here?
Is it okay for me to be here?
(This is...the smell of chicken skewers?)
It's a bit hot for me...but certainly others must enjoy it.
I'm getting dizzy... Perhaps I should take a break.

You're well aware of this, but it is only with the Authority of the Presidency that one can be worthy of holding this gun. That's right. It bears too much meaning for someone such as me, Goryou Nagusa. However, if you truly wish to place your trust in me once again... I shall fight with all my might.
This is really my power? ...Thank you, Sensei.
I've grown? Well... I'm simply doing my best.
It's thanks to you that I've unlocked this potential within me, Sensei.
I still have much to learn, but I know my shortcomings now. Thank you, Sensei.
Snow melts under warm sunlight...but if I meet the end by your side, then I have no complaints.
My only strength is my beauty, so why do you treat me with such kindness, Sensei?
Despite everything, I'm truly grateful. Although it may not appear so, since I'm considered an expressionless beauty.
Sensei's hand... It's nice...and warm.

Battle.Transcription: I'll show you the power of the Hyakkaryouran.
...One small victory is no excuse for overconfidence.
If this is the path I must take to protect everyone...!
Then I'll lie, and I'll play the role of Goryou Nagusa!
I'm afraid, but I'm even more afraid of losing everyone!
We've arrived at the operation area.
I may not appear reliable, but please believe in me.
The operation was successful thanks to everyone's efforts. Thank you.
This much is only natural. There's room for improvement.

Lobby.Transcription: Welcome, Sensei.
Where shall we begin our work today?

Ah, Sensei...
I'm relieved. You've returned.

...My apologies. I've found myself unable to correct this habit.
When people wander from my side...
...I fear they'll disappear.

So I ask of you...
...to not leave me alone for long.
I enjoy the change of pace while working at Schale.

The Hyakkaryouran has its own administrative work...
...but I find Schale is more professional in its processes.

Um, Sensei...
Why is it that you always prepare chicken skewers for my visits?

Naturally, I find them delicious, however...
Schale's office is hardly suitable for grilling chicken.
Is my face marred in some way? Why do you gaze upon me so intently?

You find my snow-white skin "eye catching"?
Mmm. How surprising.

The process of properly freezing hard ice...
It is a timely and meticulous one.
Although entirely different temperatures, it is reminiscent of the steel heating process.
Perhaps isolation begets rigor in all things of this world.

As the name would suggest, the Hyakkaryouran Resolution Council...
...specializes in resolving conflicts.

Naturally...
...problems would ideally be resolved without resorting to violence.

Rather odd, yes?
Simply having someone by my side evokes gratitude in me.
Perhaps that's why today feels special for me as well.
Happy birthday, Sensei.
Ah, my birthday... You remembered. Thank you.
I've never thought much of my birthday.
But perhaps I'll regard it more warmly from now on.

Happy New Year, Sensei.
For this next year, I may continue leaning on you, yes?
I like winter.
When the landscape turns white, it feels like I'm able to blend in with the background.

So this festival takes place in the height of winter.
I like it quite a bit.
Ah, apologies. I was contemplating "Halloween."

I'm always pretending to be the person I wish I were...
...therefore, I'm always in costume.

Fufu.
This day may be made just for me.

Normal.Transcription: Nyah? Blue Archive!
Now, now! Everyone, gather round and listen! The Yin-Yang Club President, Amachi Niya, is here, nyahaha!
Nyahah, the ideal place to slack off— I mean, spend time at!
Oho, so this is the kind of thing you enjoy, Sensei... This has been educational!
This is incredible! What a sight! Nyahaha!
Huh? Kaho is too suspicious. I already lied to her that I'm working hard! Nyahaha!
Kaho will like this, and Chise that...

...I'm very grateful, but I'm just a bit apprehensive of what more you could possibly expect from me. Even so, if it's you, I suppose I have to live up to those expectations. Nyahaha, checkmate it is.
Wooow... Everything's working out so well that it's actually scaring me... I'm truly impressed!
Oho, so that's one way to do it... I learned something from you!
Oh my, you're such a bad actor, Sensei! Why are you giving me all this?
It's hard work keeping things balanced. You must remain in constant motion to maintain it.
How troublesome... The president of the Yin-Yang Club can't lean this way or that... How very troublesome.
Pull if pushed, and push if pulled... What should I do? Ah, no... I was just talking to myself. Nyahaha...
Nyahah?! Y-You surprised me. Yes... I was just taken off guard, you know?
Uh, um, Sensei? Um... No, nothing, nyahaha!

Battle.Transcription: Fufufu. Me? Meddling? Of couuurse not!
Now then, shall we balance things?
It's not a festival without a show!
Aha... Do you really need me?
It's rare for me to actually get involved, you know?

Lobby.Transcription: Ho. I'm usually the one keeping others waiting.

This role reversal is a rather fresh experience!
Nyahaha! Welcome!

You're here, Sensei!
Now then...
Time for a cup of tea! ♪
...Aha. I suppose it's a taaad early.
Ahhh! I don't waaant to work!
Why am I being forced to do things for Schale that I would never do for the Yin-Yang Club?!
...I should be doing this for the Yin-Yang Club as well?
I suppose so!
Nyaha! As expected...
Sensei, you're this type of person too, yes?

Eh, stop playing dumb!
Let's slack off together!
Yeap, yeap. I'm working hard.
I-I mean it!
Mmm... It looks beautiful out today.
We should go for a walk to enjoy this luxury!
...Fufu, I've had an ingenious idea.
Hm? What is it?
It would be no fun if you knew beforehand, nyahaha!

Ah. Sensei.
Happy birthday.
What a wonderful day. I can finally repay you for all the help you've given me.

Hm? Please don't regard me so suspiciously...
It was a heartfelt birthday wish.
Ah, how sad... Boo hoo.
Oho.
Looking at your face...
...you're already aware of what today is.
Well then, there's no need for further discussion.
Fufu, did you prepare my birthday gift?

I wish you a happy New Year, Sensei.
I look forward to working with you this year as well.
...What? I can conduct myself formally when the situation calls for it...
A very, merry Christmas to you today!
I'll get gifts for my cute underclassmen on my way back. Nyahahaha!
...What? A gift for me?
...Uh, th-thank you.
Nyahaha, there are all sorts of interesting traditions outside of Hyakkiyako.

What? You'll pull a trick if you don't get any treats?
...Have our roles reversed somehow?
I don't have any treats...
H-Hold on, Sensei?!

Normal.Transcription: Blue... Archive!
Welcome to my stage, Sensei. Ha, just follow my rhythm.
I like the acoustics here.
There are many people... Would they like a performance?
Where should I put the drum...?
Where are the sweets?
I wonder if Sensei will show up soon...
It's as if I'm holding my custom drumsticks. Perfect. You're so thoughtful, Sensei.
Heehee, thank you for cheering me on, Sensei.
Cheers, and applause...!
Onward and upward!
How was my performance? You were a huge help.
Ha, do you want me to teach you how to drum?
For today's lecture... Shall we talk about the sweet "taste" of music?
It's so nice to be peaceful together.
I would have loved it if Sensei jammed with me. ...Just us two.

Battle.Transcription: It's time to show them our rhythm!
This one goes out to Semla!
Now, Sensei, feel free to clap.
I feel like I'm on a stage!
It was a great joint show.

Lobby.Transcription: Welcome to the stage!
Heehee... That was a joke. Unless you'd like to hear me play?
So, my fans have arrived.
The entry fee? Oh, uh... Maybe a banana chocolate tart?
You're here, Sensei! Would you like some candy?
I like hard candy. I can savor it while I practice.
Can I keep Sensei awake if I drum right next to them?
Though music is aural, I feel like I can taste it.
This place needs more ROCK! Can you help me decorate, Sensei?

Happy birthday, Sensei.
Would you like some sweets?

Today is my big debut!
You cleared your schedule, right, Sensei?

Happy New Year, Sensei.
I plan on hitting the drum instead of the bell this year. What do you think?

I should put some candies on the chimney.
Santa would appreciate it, right?

To share sweets like this...
...what an amazing day, Sensei.

Event.Transcription: Heehee. Welcome, Sensei.

Make yourself at home.
The performance will begin shortly.

We need more snacks...
NO, we need more practice...!
Okay, just one more part until the finale...!
...Ah, it was incredible. Good work, Sensei.
Hm? What's the matter, Sensei?

If you're going to poke me, poke my shoulders...
They're so sore from the drumming...
No matter how much you poke me, you're not getting any macarons, Sensei.

Sit down, Sensei.
I'll show you what the drum can do!

Normal.Transcription: Blue! Archive!
Hyakkaryouran Resolution Council, Kadenokouji Yukari... I am making my flashy summer debut! Please look forward to what I can achieve at the beach!
No matter the time or place, I shall take on everything with perfect form!
Ah! This must be what Sensei spoke about previously!
Is this...what they call the "etiquette of the sea"?
This outfit does invite the cold in... Achoo!
Hm, hmm. Super-invincible ship Yukari, sail out! ♪
This gift is our pledge, Sensei. I shall keep it with me always, and you will be on my mind whenever I gaze upon it. How truly mischievous of you.
I'll meet all your expectations! No matter what!
I still have much to learn, but I, Yukari, shall see to it that your trust is rewarded!

There truly is no end to the journey of knowledge. Life is but an adventure to learn more and more. And you always introduce me to new worlds I did not know existed, Sensei. Thank you, from the bottom of my heart.
I wish to grow stronger...and be of help to you, Sensei! More and more!
Every moment we are together is a gift in and of itself. And yet, you continue to give me more, Sensei.
My heart is filled to the brim with warmth. What do I do with this overwhelming feeling?
Flowers will inevitably wither, yet they never regret blooming. Since you wish it, I, too, will bloom splendidly, Sensei. Please watch by my side.
You have my deepest gratitude. I will never forget this moment.

Battle.Transcription: I'll live up to everyone's expectations!
Allow me to show you what an elite is made of!
Did you see my incredible performance?!
Fufu! It's a new page in the legend of the undefeated Yukari!
So this is a summer festival...! 'T-Tis a bit intense!
This outfit allows for easy movement!
I'll make the name "Yukari of the Hyakkaryouran" known to the whole world!
Let us continue the legend of the undefeated Yukari!
Fufu! Since the Hyakkaryouran is here, it's a given!
A perfect victory! Good work, everyone!

Lobby.Transcription: Sensei!! The beach! It's the beach!!
After your walk, would you like to watch with me?
The islands shattered Into a thousand pieces Thus comes summer sea
...Ah, Sensei! I was waiting for you!
As expected of you, Sensei! You retain your composure even before the great ocean...
...while I am too excited to remain still!
A valorous representation of adulthood! I must adopt this attitude as well!
Time slips through my fingers so very quickly while at the beach.
Oh! Could this be the famed "summertime"?!
Heehee. ♪
Hm? I seem to be having fun, even while working?
Because I am with you, Sensei!
Focus, focus...
Aaah! I am so filled with merriment that focus is beyond me!
Sensei, what should I do...?!
E-Eek?!
I wasn't drowsing at all!
An elite such as myself would never tire from mere play on the beach!
Haaappy birthday! I'll be the first one to congratulate you this year, Sensei!
Aah! Could it be that I wasn't the first?

Even happier!
For that can only mean that many people care deeply for you, Sensei!
Ah, Sensei. You remembered my birthday.
I have received birthday wishes from many people, and I feel very blessed.
And you were the one I wanted to hear those words from, above anyone else.
I truly am a greedy person, am I not?

It's a Happy New Year!
Here is my New Year's greeting!
I would love to spend the New Year with you, Sensei.

However, people partake in debauchery during the festivities! It is a busy time at the Hyakkaryouran!
I unfortunately cannot be by your side today...

Regardless, let us have strength this year as well!
I will continue counting on you, Sensei!
Sensei! It's a Merry Christmas!
Experiencing the winter sea with you... What a wonderful ambience...

Naturally, it would not be ideal to enter these icy waters.
However, all I require for happiness...is to be with you, just like this.
Hmm! I learned of a new cultural tradition today!
Today is the day people dress up as monsters and receive candy in return!
Ack! Upon further reflection, this swimsuit is not a monster costume, is it?!

Event.Transcription: Look, Sensei! The beach! It's the beach!
Heehee! The expanse of blue water is endless! ♪
It's the beach!
I did not anticipate that the day I would be in competition against my seniors would arrive in this way...

H-However, as a promising elite and the Hyakkaryouran's rising hope...
...I shall not readily back down!
It's the climax we have anticipated!
What am I to do, Sensei? My hands are shaking with nerves!
So quickly did the atmosphere amongst my seniors shift...
But it's only made them shine ever brighter!

...Kikyou and Renge have known each other for a long time.
They're childhood friends.

Undoubtedly, the two of them...
...share many stories in which I play no part.
That thought elicits a feeling of loneliness in me...
Sensei? Why are you staring at me like that?
Rather than sitting idly by, let us venture out for some fun!
Fufu. I'm serious, Sensei.
If you prefer to simply sit and watch, then I will join you.
It would appear everyone is well accustomed to the sea.
Perhaps I am the only sea novice?! Is that it?!

Whoa! Over here! Over there! Everything is new!
Sensei, what should we see first?!
My heart is aflutter! It's so sparkly that I need only look to find new amusements!

Ahhh. Fun times truly pass in the mere blink of an eye!
Be sure to leave all our regrets here before we return!
I know of this! Yes, yes, it's called "window shopping," correct?
Heehee, worry not. I will always be by your side!
Wow! I would like to see it more closely as well!
Heh, so this is the kind of thing you like, Sensei?
Honored guest, you have good taste! ♪
Hmm! What to choose... ♪

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive! Haha!
It's not summer youth activities if you're not at the sea! Are we ready to enjoy our hearts out?
Ooh, so this is the place you prepared...
Heh, so there are things like this too.
That Kikyou... I wonder what she's hiding this time.
Our regulatory office... I wonder if we could move it here...
The beach is always a fun place!
Ooh, so this is experiencing youth with my mentor! Thank you! I'll treasure it for life!
Th-Thank you, Mentor. I'm getting stronger thanks to you. Heehee.
I feel even more youthful now! Let's do some youth activities together, Mentor!
Oh! I feel even stronger now. It's thanks to the training we've done, Mentor!
I feel like I've matured through the waves of life... This is also part of youth, right?
Ugh, how should I express this gratitude? I feel bad, always being on the receiving end.
Wh-When I'm with you, Mentor, my heart feels tight for some reason. I think this feeling is— Gah! I have no idea!
This is a representation of your feelings... Then, one day, I too...!
Y-You want to do youth activities...? I'd like that too, w-with just us two!

Battle.Transcription: Time for some youth activities, everyone!
Fufu, this is the power of youth!
Leave it to me next time as well!
Are you ready to enjoy summer?
I'll show you the power of youth!
Okay! Whatever it may be, you can count on me!
I'll show you the path to victory!
Huh? It's over? I've still got more in me!

Lobby.Transcription:
Oh, Mentor! Welcome! I was waiting for you!
Let's go to the beach together!

Mmm! The beach and my youth call for me!
Once you're done working, we move out!
My uniform? I took it off because it was way too hot.
A-A swimsuit is completely different from underwear!
Mentor, have you ever tried wearing a swimsuit under your uniform?

That way, you don't have to change when you're outside! It's super convenient!
...Huh? Underwear for when I go back?

I picked this swimsuit with the other Hyakkaryouran members.
I wasn't expecting it to be so easy to move around in!
What kind of swimsuit do you like, Sensei?
Ah... I mean what kind would you like to wear, not look at!

I hope everyone else has a good summer too!
Including you, Mentor. Heh.

Today's your birthday, mentor!
The perfect day for some youth activities!

Now, now, don't just stand there.
Let's go make some unforgettable memories!
...Whoa?! You remembered my birthday.

I mean... Ahaha... I'm really happy.
Thank you...for spending the day with me.

Happy New Year, Mentor!
Huh? ...Am I not cold?

I'm training, so...
Achoo!
Merry Christmas, Mentor!

Having to bundle up for the cold is the worst!
Now! Let's go take a cold shower!

Trick or treat! Halloween: swimsuit version!
...How was it? I caught you by surprise, right?

Um... If you just stare wordlessly at me like that, it's a bit...
This took a lot of courage, you know...

Event.Transcription: Blue sea! Blue sky! White clouds! The best sounds!
Fufu, victory is ours! You'll cheer for me, right, Sensei?
There's not much time left! Let's give it our all!
We can't let our guard down until the very, very end!
The festival's over...but our youth will live on!
Limited-edition summer youth activities! Mentor, I'm excited!

Mentor, do you want to swim with me?
Okay! Let's see who's faster!
Never let your guard down. Stay sharp.
I'll be looking forward to your commentary, Mentor!
Mentor! It's a beach treasure hunt! I wonder what's hiding in there!
Treasure hunts are absolutely a youth activity! Let's hunt together!
Ah, that was fun. Let's do another one, next time.
I made another precious memory. Thank you, Mentor.
I see a lot of great treasure...
Hm? What's my most precious treasure?

Th-That's...
That's a secret! Secret! An absolute secret!
The youth I once dreamed of came to life again...
Thank you so much. Mentor...
Oh! Isn't this treasure?!
Mentor! I found a clue!
Treasure secured! Now, let's see what it is...!
As expected of Mentor! Your skills are amazing!
Let's go search for the next treasure!

Normal.Transcription: Blue...Archive.
I'm the Hyakkaryouran's operations officer. I have no issues with swimming. I've thoroughly studied the literature for today.
Hmm, so this is where your inclinations lie.
Relax...deep breaths... Float upon the water... It's rather difficult...
Where does the sunlight hit best?
This swimsuit... It's a bit tight.
How is Renge so adept at swimming?
Hm... So this is how you express your trust. If that is so, you should...rely on me more. Just as I trust you. ...You're capable of this, yes?
Teaching and learning are hand in hand. Growth cannot occur without a consistent effort to learn. That is the relationship I wish to have with you.
You truly broaden my perspectives... You are impressive, as usual.
...I have much growth to undergo. Just wait, Sensei, and I will achieve true perfection.
I shall continue to improve. Not only for myself, but also for you and everyone else.
Going this far for me... Just what are your intentions? Hm... Understood. Then I shall allow you to teach me how to swim.
You approach me without a modicum of hesitation... No, I suppose I am not complaining.
Well, something like this...may not be completely insufferable.
They say the most special bonds may be right under our noses. That's simply what I've heard.

Battle.Transcription: ...F-For how long do you intend to hold me for?

Lobby.Transcription:
Welcome, Sensei.
You promised to instruct me in swimming today. You didn't forget, did you?

The weather is pleasant.
We depart for the beach. Make your preparations.

You're well aware that I find submerging myself in the water distasteful.
Therefore, I also find the beach distasteful. However...
...if it is together with everyone... It's acceptable.
Feel honored. That "everyone" includes you as well.

I chose this swimsuit with everyone from the Hyakkaryouran.
They praised me the moment I put it on.

...You are in agreement?
Thank you.
We should go swimsuit shopping together in the future.
Not for me. I shall choose one for you.
Naturally, it will be one to my liking. I will not hear any objections.
What is the easiest stroke to learn, Sensei?
Doggy paddle...? Fufu, are you TRYING to get scolded by me?
You now know my weakness: I cannot swim.
Therefore, you must also reveal your weakness to me.

Allies should share their vulnerabilities with each other.
After all, we share a common fate...yes?
This day is a special one. It's your birthday.
...I never could have predicted I would celebrate someone's birthday dressed like so.
Sensei... What kind of memories do you wish to make?

Sensei. Today is my birthday.
Therefore, expect to clear your schedule for the remainder of the day.
I've planned every minute detail of our "Spend Time Together Operation."

...Hm? You've already cleared it?
I suppose you pass.

I've attempted to wear a special outfit for New Year's...
...in order to ensure it is an unforgettable one.
Fufu. My clever tactics are rather befitting of an operations officer, yes?
By wearing this outfit, I am messaging my unwillingness to venture outdoors this Christmas.

I wish to remain here today.
You'll stay by my side, yes?
I donned a special Halloween outfit just for you, Sensei.

Why swimwear...?
For the opportunity to behold your shock and surprise, of course.
Fufu. Prank successful.

Event.Transcription:
The Hyakkiyako Water Festival...
How did I get here?
Since I am participating, I will play without regrets.
And so, the festival is coming to a close. I've experienced many new things.

There is a twinge of bittersweetness at the end.
I used to despise the sea.
I have no regrets about this match. Thank you for watching, Sensei.
Are you in need of my tactics?

No matter my efforts, my body simply sinks.
Perhaps I am exerting too much force...
H-Hm? Since when have you been here, Sensei?
Worry not. Something like swimming is child's play to me.
That tickles.
...That didn't mean you should go away either.
This is the mission list I personally organized. You're grateful, yes?

Now then, begin the operation.
...What are you doing? You need to close the distance, so we can look together, yes?

When we're in private, I'll converse with you as much as you'd like.
So please focus on the mission for now.
Do you require the wisdom of an operations officer? Feel free to ask.
I'd expect nothing less. Any ally of mine must be at least this competent.
Seeing your work energizes me as well. Perhaps it's a natural consequence of being teammates?

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive!
Were you waiting for me, Sensei? Fufu. No. I suppose I was the one who was waiting.
It's cozier than I expected.
I see... So this is what it's like here?
Oh, isn't that...?
Fufu, maybe I'll go talk to her.
I feel like people are staring at me... Is it because of my outfit?
I did believe you'd at least try to stop me, but I see how you intend to play it. Fine, Sensei. If this is what you want... We'll stay together until the very end.
I'm feeling more and more like a runaway horse.
While I can, I'll have all the fun I can.
Aren't you curious...to see how far I can go?
Things have cooled down.
Would you like to go on a drive? I'll be the one driving, of course.
I'm glad you thought of me with the best of intentions. Otherwise, I would've been quite sad.
Would you like me to buy you anything? No? Fufu, that's very much like you, Sensei.
Your reaction has piqued my interest. Given the opportunity, I'd like to model a variety of outfits for you.

Battle.Transcription: Everyone seems to be looking forward to it.
The main character appears at crucial times.
This is the only time you'll hear this.
Would you me to cool things down?
Going out like this isn't half bad.
Do you have a lot of work?
As for who it was... Please keep it a secret.
It's been a while since I went wild.

Lobby.Transcription:
I've been waiting for you, Sensei.
...Yes. In this outfit.

Welcome, Sensei.
I'm looking forward to another "fun" day.

What are you...
...staring at so intently?
Ah, my sunglasses? Fufu...

No, I can't remove them.
It's part of my outfit right now.
Do you like them?
I can show you where I purchased them.
Do you intend to stay indoors on such a beautiful day?
Slippers? Ah, they're cute, yes?
Would you like a better view?

A day like this... 
...calls for the perfect outfit.
...What do those have to do with each other?
That's... Fufufu.

It's my birthday...
...so I'm a tad confused why I had to be the one to come over.
When you finish your work... 
...shall we go to my room?

Happy New Year, Sensei.
...
Did my mundane greeting...
...surprise you, Sensei?

I suppose this outfit isn't quite suited...
...for Christmas.
Next time... 
...I'll prepare something more appropriate.
It's a busy day. I like it.

Event.Transcription:
It's another cool day today.
...Is what one might say.
Allow me to guide you today.

That's youth for you.
Isn't that so?
I won't let up on the pedal until the very end.

It's refreshing...
...and bittersweet, all at the same time.

Say it aloud. Say it.
What are you so embarrassed for?

Are you tickling me?
Fufu. Anytime.

A different side of you...
I'd like to see that too.

I dressed light...
...because it's summer.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive.
Trinity General School, Justice Task Force— That was too formal for a beach. It's Hanekawa Hasumi. I look forward to our continued collaboration.
For some reason, this outfit...seems to attract too much attention.
This is the summer I WILL lose weight... Um, there are so many temptations here, though...
Adequate rest improves work efficiency. I understand the concept, but the execution is always...
I wonder why ordinary foods look so much more appealing on the beach...
Perhaps I should bring the other members next time...

I first joined the Justice Task Force with a single mission in mind. Somewhere along the way, I gained so many more precious things I wanted to protect. So I vow to this gun that, as long as I am here, no harm will come your way, Sensei. I won't forgive anyone who tries.
With new places come new lessons. Thank you for your guidance.
Rest is training as well. Intensity must be moderated as well... I'll keep that in mind.
Hm, that's all for today's class? Since we're at the beach today? Well, in that case...would you mind joining me?
Every moment I spend with you is an unforgettable one. One day, I'll be full of them.
By any chance...could you stay by my side for a moment? Yes, that's enough.
I treasure everything I receive from you, Sensei. Gifts, your words, and even your feelings.
If you keep doing this... I might misunderstand. Please don't give me hope like that.
If I could be a little greedy... No, never mind. Just this is enough.

Battle.Transcription: Made contact with enemy forces. Engaging.
As a matter of a heart, this much is... Eeek!!
Was it this way? Huh? ...Taking my shot!
I can hit that with my eyes closed.
Thoroughness, in every situation. There's no exception.
Excellent. I never intended to enjoy a leisurely vacation.
Entering mission zone. Awaiting your orders.
As the vice president of Justice Task Force, I have to save face.
Mission complete. Of course, it was a flawless victory.

Lobby.Transcription:
Oh, Sensei. You've arrived.
Let's begin today's work.

And once work is done...
...would you like to take a walk together?
I thought you would come, so I waited for you.
Hm? Because you're very diligent, of course.

...I am as well?
...You're right. Fufu. We may be rather alike.

Did you call?
...Hm? Relax?
...That's a difficult request.
Would you like a cup of tea on your break?
It's not something I boast about, but I do have a knack for brewing tea.
A cute swimsuit like this...
...doesn't quite suit someone like me.

What? It's cute on me...? 
You're flattering me...
The beach is a dangerous place.
It's easy to burn calories here, making you hungrier as well...
The beach, swimsuits, and summer...
Regardless, we can't let our guard down. No matter where we are, the Justice Task Force's duties come first.
Happy birthday, Sensei.
I've received so much from you, but I've never properly repaid you.
Is there anything I can do for you?
My birthday...?
Ah. Now that you say it...

...Fufu, I forgot my own birthday...
...and yet, you continue to look after me.
Thank you, truly.
Happy New Year, Sensei.
When I first met you, I never expected our relationship to come so far.
A pleasant surprise. Fufu.
Merry Christmas, Sensei.
Given the opportunity, would you like to visit the beach during winter together?
...In a warmer outfit, of course.
Um... Do I look properly excited for the festivities?
...Y-You too, Sensei?! I don't have any treats...

Event.Transcription: I didn't expect to come to the beach like this.
Hm? I look excited?
Fufu, perhaps so.
The mission hasn't changed, but the change in location brings a fresh feeling to it.
So I'm looking forward to the next couple of days.

Ah, Sensei. Have you seen Ichika and Mika by any chance?
I haven't seen hide nor tail of them.
Could...something have happened to them?

Even if you tell me to not worry and just enjoy...
Well, I'll trust your words, Sensei.

I can't believe all that happened right under my nose.
I am bit ashamed. I was so caught up in enjoying myself that I neglected my duties.
You're glad I had fun?
Only you would say that to me, Sensei.
Perhaps not exactly according to plan, but things still ended well.

You played an instrumental role in that, Sensei.
As a representative of the Justice Task Force, I would like to thank you once again.

Our Ichika has grown a little as well.
On a personal level, I'd also like to thank you for that.
Due to our own internal affairs, we're in your debt.

Even if you tell me to not worry about it...
Well, I suppose that's what I'd expect you to say.

But I wanted to express how I felt, at the very least.
Thank you. Truly.
This event meant a lot to the Justice Task Force as a whole.
Because one day, she'll have to serve in this role on her own.
As you already know, public affairs are not Tsurugi's specialty.

Because of that, I ended up...
...becoming the main point of communication with the Tea Party.
...Thinking about it, I've been serving those three for quite some time now.
To be honest, I'd given up on ever being able to visit the beach.
I really should thank Mika for this.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive!
Ta-da! Guess who? It's Ichika! I never expected to be at the beach with you, but life sure is full of surprises. I'm looking forward to our continued collaboration!
Ah, nice... Finally, a breather...
Am I overdressed...?
Hmm... Maybe I should do something...
Wow... Everyone's really shining...
There are all kinds of people here.
Oh! Um... I'll do my best to meet your expectations, but don't complain if I fall short, okay? You're the one who's made me more serious, after all.
Oh, so like this...? Wow, it sure is different when you're teaching me, Sensei!
Ah, you're giving me something again? Um... I'll try even harder, I guess. Haha!
I didn't want to become such a hands-on student.
Haha... You can prioritize the other students, you know. It makes no difference to me.
Um... Ummm... *sigh* Seriously. Thank you.
How am I supposed to repay you for this? I guess you're going to tell me there's no need, huh?
Um, I really appreciate how you view me...but I'm really not all that I seem.
Seriously, Sensei... I can't tell if you're really good or horrendously bad at reading the room...

Battle.Transcription: Ah, you shouldn't do that here— Haah.
Um, you'll get hurt. ...Seriously, you'll get hurt.
Oh my, how did you get in here...? Haha.
Ahaha! Don't blame me for what happens next! *sigh*
As expected, even here... Ah. It's nothing.

Lobby.Transcription: Ah, Sensei! I've been waiting for you!
Let's get this done, so we can go to the beach!
Welcome, Sensei!
I organized some paperwork while I was waiting!
Hm? Oh, it was nothing!
Oh, my...
Even at the beach, my job doesn't change, huh?
Ah, you feel the same way, Sensei?
That's just life, sometimes!
Ah, these sunglasses?
I wanted to try out some beach fashion... It's not my usual style, huh?
Ah, I look...pretty?
Really? Heehee, your compliment make me glad I wore it!
Mmm... What needs to get done next?
Whatever I want to do?
...Now that one's a tall order.
Whoa, that's a lot of work...
You're consistently diligent, Sensei.
Ah, if you ever need a hand, just call me, okay?
Sensei! Do you want me to brew you a cup of black tea?
I learned from one of my seniors!
Happy birthday, Sensei!
Fufufu. I wanted to be the first one to say it to you!

Anyways, do you happen to have any plans for today...?
Ah, work... Figures.

That just means we have to get this done fast!
If we work together, it'll be done in no time!
Oh! Um... Today IS my birthday...
...but did you come all this way just for that?
...Heh, I'm a little embarrassed.
Happy New Year, Sensei!
Haha, last year was really eventful, wasn't it?
Oh. Talking about last year during New Year's is a bit...
How about this: I'm looking forward to another year together, Sensei!
Ah, Sensei! I've been looking for you!
Fufu, are you surprised? I worked really hard to get all my work done early.
Why? Um...

Anyways, that means I'm totally free! 
Merry Christmas to me!
And that means you have to hang out with me today! Heehee!
Hm? What's the candy for?
Ah, this isn't a costume though.

But... Nom.
I ate it already, so you can't have it back! Heehee.

Event.Transcription: Ah. I'm already getting a bad feeling.

But since you're here...
...I'm sure things will work out, one way or another.
The beach... I didn't expect I'd come to the beach like this.
That's just how life is sometimes!

Mika...
She's not what I expected.
Ah! I mean that in a good way.
How do I feel about the beach?
Hmm... How should I put this?
If I think about the past few days, I don't think I've had the best impression. Haha!

It's already time to go back.
That bittersweet feeling...

...I don't have it at all.
I'm finally going home! Work's over! That's what I'm feeling! Haha!
The sound of waves crashing and seagulls crying, and the smell of salt...
This really is the beach.
Oh my, everyone's very excited.
I wish I could feel the same way.
Ah, Sensei. There's not much going on right now.
Even at the beach, I'd be happiest if things were uneventful.
Um, Sensei? You know staying with me won't be that fun, right?
Although I don't hate...being together.
Ah, Sensei! Did you come to help?
Oh my, I was a little worried that I wouldn't be able to get it done alone. Thank you!

Haha, what a mess.
Ah, Sensei. Hey there.

Sorry to pounce on you, but could you lend me a hand?
You'd literally be saving my life!
Haha... There's so much to do...
Maybe we just have to tackle things one by one, and it'll go faster than we think!
...I know that feeling reaaally well.
Once too much work piles up, you kinda just want to ignore it.
That's one problem solved! Good work!
Ooh, you're quite skilled, aren't you?
Ah... I wasn't being sarcastic! I was genuinely impressed.

Normal.Transcription: Blue...Archive.
You've arrived, Sensei. I do hope you have a peaceful vacation.
(I wonder if there's a chair I can rest on...)
Would it be okay for me to indulge in a bit of laziness today...?
How pleasant... Although it doesn't measure up to the sea breeze.
I will use it as reference for the Tea Party's interior design.
I shall enjoy a cup of coffee while I wait for Sensei.
It's a small and light gun, but the responsibility it represents is a heavy weight. I'm more than aware of this. So please watch over me, Sensei.
To take it this far...! Thank you, Sensei.
Strength is a prerequisite for composure... Thank you, Sensei.
This feeling... Like I've just finished a well-brewed cup of tea.
How is it? Did I become strong enough?
The sun is warm, Sensei.
The sunbed next to me happen to be empty... What do you say, Sensei?
Your presence makes the aroma of tea even more delectable.
To be at the beach with you... This will be an unforgettable experience.

Battle.Transcription: It's been quite some time since I've took a break...
I'll be counting on you for the rest.
Let's finish quickly, and return to the sunbed.

Lobby.Transcription:
Thank you for waiting, Sensei.
I checked today's workload, and... 
...I believe we can proceed leisurely.
Well, because I'll be helping you, of course.

Paperwork? Let us enjoy a cup of tea first.
That is not the priority right now.
After a vacation, even the most routine of tasks feel more menial.
But hard work is what makes the break afterwards even sweeter.
Just as how bitter tea highlights the sweetness of your snacks.
Naturally, even I have days where I wish to eat snacks by the mouthful.
Now, shall we return to our work?
Fufu, happy birthday, Sensei.

I made a reservation at a resort.
Why don't you spend a day of uninterrupted relaxation?

This outfit, you mean?
I was hoping to create a connection between summer and my swimsuit for my birthday.
Therefore, you'll always be reminded of me when summer comes.
And to do that, something stimulating would be better at achieving it, right...?

Even with your heavy workloads, I hope you're able to relax a little this year, Sensei.
Happy New Year.
Shall we say this outfit...
...is a prayer for that happiness?
...
Achoo.

If you have no plans... 
...would you like to sit in front of the fire and enjoy some snacks?
Throwing a rowdy party isn't the only way to enjoy a festival.

It may be Halloween, but I'm still a bit hesitant to promenade in this outfit.
I have quite a few deadlines today, anyways.

What? Trick or treat...?
Fufu, a treat, in that case. This is a snack made with black tea leaves. Please try it.
Your expression makes the effort of preparing this worthwhile, Sensei.

Event.Transcription: Sensei, you're here. Please, come sit.

There's a certain art to slacking off.
Fufu... I'll teach you.

I can't stop thinking about my work back at home.
Are things running smoothly without me?

There seem to be commotions left and right. 
It must be in my head, right?

It's time to head back.
Until next time...
What is happening, Sensei?

It's hot...
We'll require some cold drinks.
Um, besides the iced tea.
Sensei, are you also interested in this book?

Sensei, the sun's hot, no?
Come under my parasol.

Take your time.
We've prepared plenty of items.

This is my first time serving customers.
So... Please be patient with me, Sensei.

Have you shopped to your heart's content?
Now, let's return together, Sensei.

Hospitality is also a type of diplomacy...?
I see. Thinking of it that way puts my mind at ease.

Stocks, calculations, first in, first out...
These familiar words feel strangely unfamiliar today.
You have a sharp eye, Sensei.
Please wait a moment. I'll wrap it for you.

Huh? Pick out something for myself?!
Fufu, I appreciate the sentiment, but it's fine.
Fufu, am I doing a little better now?

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive! Ahaha! ☆
Once more, I, Misono Mika, have arrived! Looking forward to working with you again, Sensei! ☆
Ahaha, so weird!
Hm, so everyone takes turns visiting Schale like this.
(They must all have their own worries, right? Just like me...)
I wonder when Sensei will get here...
Can I use this?
This is...for me? You're kidding! Seriously? *sigh* You're so unfair, Sensei. You always do this kind of stuff like it's nothing. It's just not fair... I really wanted to repay you for everything...
Fufu, thank you, Sensei! I'll keep doing my best! ☆
Um, you don't have to worry about me too much, okay...? Well...I don't hate it when you do, though.
Am I...the only one you care about this much? There's no way, right?
If you do all this... It might make me happy.
If you need anything, let me know anytime! I'll get it for you, one way or another!
Thank you...for always taking care of someone like me.
Just being around you makes my heart feel warm... I'd be happy if you felt the same way.
Yes... Thank you. I'm really...really happy.

Battle.Transcription: You think you can stop me?
Good work! It's time to play now! ♪
Sensei, this way! Fufu, how pretty... ☆
Here, over here. Here. It's a special seat.
Don't let go of my hand, okay? I wanted to show you this, Sensei.
Wow, it's a shooting star, Sensei!
Ah... There, over there! How pretty!
Don't ask me what happens next!

Lobby.Transcription:
Ah! Sensei!
I'm ready!
What should I help out with first?

Welcome back, daaah-ling!
Would you like a bath? Dinner first?
Or...
Ahaha, just kidding! ☆
Just leave it to me! ♪
I can't guarantee I'll do a good job, though! ☆
You really are amazing, Sensei...
You work so hard...on super-boring stuff...
Hm? Why am I wearing a swimsuit?
Uhm... Now that you're asking, it's embarrassing...
Nothing's going on today...

Eh? I'm actually not bored at all, though.
It must be because I'm with you, Sensei! ♪
Peace above all, they say...
Sure! I guess that makes sense!
Senseiii! It's your birthday, right?
I wanted to tell you this in person. I'm really happy...that we met.

Happy birthday!
I hope you have the best day!

Wow... Ahaha...
I was told that I'm on Student Rep duty today.

At first, I was like, no way!
I'll always remember today!

Happy New Year! Sensei!
This year, I'll work hard just as you do, Sensei!

Sensei... Do you know what day it is?
Are you really okay with me being the Student Rep today?

...Huh?
Um, really...?

...Fufu. Got it!
Let's do our best today too, Sensei! ♪

It's Halloween, Sensei!
If you don't give me treats... I'll pull a trick! Got it?

Hold up! You don't have to be THAT nervous! ...Do you?
I have no tricks or ulterior motives!

Event.Transcription: Yahoo! Are you having fun, Sensei?
Hmm. What would Sensei do...?
Things aren't going quite how I expected...
I'm sure it'll work out, one way or another!

I shouldn't let my guard down.
There's no telling what'll happen next.
Phew! Things wrapped up, somehow!

I wonder how it would've played out if you weren't here, Sensei.
I don't even want to think about it...
I'm glad you were with me.

I'm sure you already know this...
...but I can be a bit clumsy.

Hm? Did something happen?
Something that may require my help?

Ahaha, th-that tickles, Sensei!
You sure about that? I might retaliate, you know!

Sensei...? I'm starting to wish...that you'd stop.
Ah, I don't hate it! Not at all!
But...I might misunderstand.
Whoa, so much to do...
You're working...at the beach...?

What a bother...
I could be convinced...with a reward!

Fufu, Sensei...
What do you think about playing hooky?
Wow! I'd expect nothing less from you, Sensei!
Okay, great! We're picking up the pace!

Normal.Transcription: Nyuhuhu, Blue Archive!
I'm Shirao Eri, of Wildhunt Art Academy's Occult Society. The world is full of magic. Yes, even this meeting!
I wonder if there'll be poltergeist phenomenon somewhere...
Ooh, I feel inspiration for my magic spells residing here!
I can sense strong mana coming from here.
Nyuhuhu... An outing is so exciting!
If this was my atelier...I could create a masterpiece!
Nyuhuhu, this is my exclusive magic wand! I'll repay you with even more perfect magic!
Ooh... I can sense the expansion of mana!
You've drawn out my potential, Master!
I want to get better at having conversations like this too...!
I'll work hard and practice! On both my magic powers...and my drawing skills!
Is this...your feelings towards me?
M-My heart started beating fast...?! M-Master... Did you cast charm magic?!
Master... This feeling... It wasn't part of the fortune!
You words hold an interesting magic power to them, Master... I'll borrow your magical powers to complete my piece!

Battle.Transcription: Thank you for the support magic!
Now, what kind of magic would you like to see?
For today... It says this way!
Anywhere as long as there's magic!
That's it, Master! Your commands were perfect!
Nyuhuhu, this is the magic of victory!
I'll show you the power of magic!
Holy wave... Come upon this place!!
Clearly, you can't start without my magic!
Now, let us create a miracle together!
Look over here! I've succeeded in flight magic!
With my magic and Master's commands, no one can stop us!
Nyuhu... I knew this would be the result of my fortune telling!
Please look forward to my next magic act! Nyuhuhu.

Lobby.Transcription:
I was waiting for you, Master.
Let's study magic together today as well!

Oh, Master!
I just happened to pull the "Wheel of Fortune" card!
It's a magical day, Master!
We discovered a new phenomenon, hidden in our academy yesterday.
Nyuhuhu, you want to know more? I knew you were one of us, Master!
Ah, Master! I was drawing a magic circle on the office floor.
Don't you worry! It's not explosion magic. Nyuhuhu.
Master. Did you know?

If you chant an enhancement spell while shooting...
Your gun will have more firepower!
One day, I'm going to create an incredible piece like the "Portrait of Genesis."
Master! Please look forward to my artistic endeavors!
Happy birthday, Master!

I'll place your portrait over here, Master!
You're happy, right?

Today's no ordinary day. It's my birthday...
...AND it's Halloween!
For these two to intersect... It must be fate, right? Nyuhuhu!
It's New Year's...
May this year also be filled with magical events!
Christmas is a day you spend with someone special...
Master, I'm so happy to see that you're that captivated by my magic!
The whole street is filled with magic power today!
Now, what kind of prank should I pull today... Nyuhuhu.

Event.Transcription: The one guided by the Arcana. This way.

Now then, let us uncover the secret that lies beneath Wildhunt...
You and I, together.
Umm, I can't let the Prefectural Council find out about my plan...
Just a little more! Let us welcome the finale with no regrets!

Next time too...
I want to create an incredible piece of art with you, Master!
Nyuhuhu, are you interested in magic?
Master, would you like me to read your fortune?

For free, of course.
Just let me know!
P-Please don't touch my hat.
This is the symbol of a magician, so it should never come off!
Ah, I made a magic engraving over there...!
If you keep touching it... It might explode. Nyuhuhu.
Now then, let us get our hands on the magic tools!
Ooh, these items... I can feel their magic power just by looking at them...!

I can't get magic tools from here anymore...
...but that's okay!

Whether it's memories with you or magic tools...
...I'll have more and more of them in the future!
Was there anything to your liking?
I'm looking forward to seeing your style, Master!
Oh my, this item is full of magic powers!
I'd expect nothing less! You have good taste!
Let's test it out right now!
Ah, I thought that was a good one too!

Normal.Transcription: Blue... Archive... Heehee.
Itagaki Kanoe from Wildhunt Art Academy... I knew...we'd meet today. Red thread connects us, after all... Heehee.
I've never been somewhere like this... Not even in my previous life.
I'll also bring...occult merch.
There's "something"...over there.
Is there...somewhere small and dark?
Should I try a summoning ritual here?
As expected of Sensei... You know well. Eheehee.
I hope...I get taller.
The souls are dancing... Heehee.
The possibilities alchemy offers...are multiplying.
Let's try...a new experiment.
Aah, Sensei! Kanoe's really happy! ...What do you think? Heehee.
Heehee... Sensei... It's just like "last time."
I-I only have you, Sensei... This isn't the act. It's the truth. Th-Thank you.
Heehee... Eheeheeheeheehee...!

Battle.Transcription: Those who believe in the occult will be victorious.
it's good for your health, I promise...
I knew it... You do need me...
You chose me...in your previous life too.
I'll protect you. Just like I did...in my previous life.
My hands are cold...but my face is hot.
The same result as "that time"... Heehee.
Heehee, this victory...was also destined by fate.

Lobby.Transcription:
Sensei, I've been waiting for you.
For longer than you know. Since my previous life.
Welcome, Sensei...
I...tend to have low body temperature...
I need someone to help me warm up... Heehee...

Thanks to this hair tie...
I can see "them."

Heehee...
Just kidding...

This potion I made...
Would you like to try it?
I put in...a "few things" for you, Sensei.
Fate...is real...
Our meeting...is proof of that.
I...can mimic any voice.
Let me know if there's a voice you want to hear. I'll make it happen...
Happy birthday, Sensei...
Your birthday...is on the same date as your previous life. Heehee.

Today is the All Souls' Day...
And my birthday.

All the sleeping souls...
Let's pray for them together.

Hello, Sensei.
Happy New Year.
Didn't I sound like an adult? Heehee...
Spending Christmas with you makes Kanoe happy, Sensei! ♡
I'll stay right by your side all day! ♡

Halloween...
The day when Occult Society shines the brightest from the darkness.
Now, let's make jack-o'-lanterns... Heehee.

Event.Transcription: Welcome to the Occult Society...Sensei.
...The secrets of the academy are waiting for you.
There are many secrets slumbering underneath...you know?
Warning. Warning. The event will soon be over.
...Apparently.

Good work, Sensei.
This memory... I'll take it with me into my next life. Heehee.
Sensei's hand...is warm.
Hm? There's a crow over there? I don't know that one...

You... like me?
Say it properly. Heehee...
Feel free to pet me... Just like in your previous life.
I organized the academy's secrets...for you.
Now... Let us uncover the academy's secrets together.

To think you'd uncover this secret...
I knew you could do it, Sensei!
Good work... Everyone will be happy. Heehee.
Here, in Wildhunt... There are still many secrets that have yet to be found.

You really...like me, right...?
That makes me so happy... Eheehee!

Normal.Transcription: Blue, Archive
It's so hot and humid. What do we do now?
I'm bored...
(What...is that?)
So this is how people spend their free time...
Like I said, not interested. Seriously.
(I wonder...what Sensei's doing now.)
I wonder if I'd even use it here... "It's up to me how I use it"? *sigh* You always have a way with words. Fine... Thank you.
It's not like I'm having fun or anything. Take responsibility for bringing me here, Sensei, and entertain me.
You're the one who made me like this, Sensei. ...So you better be ready to handle all of it.
Something like this might not be half bad... I was joking, forget it.
What are you staring at me for...? I SAID I'm not having fun.

Don't look at me.
No, I'm not embarrassed...!
Fine... Seriously. This isn't the WORST... There, I said it.
If tomorrow...is going to be better... Please continue to prove that to me.
You're the one who made me like this... What are you going to do about it? ..."Anything you can"? D-Do you even know what you're saying?

Battle.Transcription: I-I brought it just in case!
Is it done...? No! It's safe...
The ocean... It's not that fun.
Fine... I just have to have fun, right?

Lobby.Transcription: You're late again? *sigh* I guess I just got here too.
...I wasn't waiting for you. But, um... Good job.
Am I interested in the beach? No. Not at all.
...There's a lot of water. It's not drinkable, though.
My memories at the beach...? Doesn't matter.
"It was fun, so let's go together again"...?
You say things like that without batting an eye...
...Well, when are we going?
...They're all meaningless, in my opinion. The beach, this swimsuit.
...They're not meaningless to you?
Like I said, stop saying stuff like that!
...I can drink as much clean water as I want here.
No, it's nothing...
I wonder if they enjoyed the beach. ...What about me?
Not at all. It was boring.
Um. Don't think too much of this, but...is there anything you want?
I-It's just a question!
Life and death, it's all in vain. So there's no reason to celebrate.
Even if you celebrate...
Thank you.
It's the new year. In the past, I would've said I was one step closer to death again.
...What would I say now?
Why...are you asking me something like that?
I still can't buy into this kind of thing...but it does seem like everyone's having fun.
A negotiation for tricks and treats... What is the point?
Is this candy...? I didn't pull a trick or anything.
Oh...? Is today not that kind of day?

Event.Transcription: Ah, you're here. ...I'm enjoying things at my own pace.
So this is the ocean...
Sigh... I want to go somewhere quiet.
Please do something, Sensei.
What's with this crowd...? I guess they seem harmless.
It's over... Yeah, wasn't too bad. I'll give you that.
What's wrong, Sensei?
Well, regardless of what you say, I don't plan on being entertained.
(...Maybe it'll be a new experience.)
Wh-What the...? Why are you poking me? I'm not a stuffed animal!
...You're bored? Why don't you go watch something at the outdoor stage?
Me? I'm not interested... Unless you want to go...
Then I'll go with you.

Normal.Transcription: Blue...archive?
I-I'm Sakurai Miyo from Wildhunt Art Academy. N-Not sure why I'm here...but I look forward to working with you.
(I wonder if there's somewhere I can sit down and write...)
Too many people would be able to hear me if I use my typewriter...
Everyone seems to be free... Unlike at Wildhunt.
(I wonder...what story lies behind Sensei's coffee preference.)
Entrance here, an escape route over there... Why am I analyzing all this?
If anything can be a book...I'll consider this my book. One that carries our story... Our book.
Wh-Where did you get something like this...?
This is legal, right...?
Sometimes, you need the resilience and strength to bring about a clean ending. Thank you, Sensei.
Thank you, Sensei. Thanks to you...I think I'll be able to treasure myself more.
Y-You don't have to do all this for me...
Um... Sensei, can I use your name in a novel that I'm writing?
Um, so... I missed you, Sensei.
It feels like I'm in a cheery novel when I'm with you. ...One of those novels you hope never ends.

Battle.Transcription: I guess it can't be helped at this point...
H-How much do we have left...?
I think we can say it ended well...
This wasn't what I wanted to write...
I hate this kind of creative work...
This will be the last time...
I got it done before the deadline...
Do I really have to do this...?
Just you and me? ...Okay, I like it.
Can I please just go back to writing...?
Why do we need to engage in such meaningless fighting...
Um... It went according to the plan, but...

Lobby.Transcription: Ah, you're here. I was reading and didn't see you coming.
What am I writing lately? Well, uh, I'll show you when I finish...!

Um, is there anything I can help you with?
As long as it's not a crime, I'll do anything...
I can just sit back and write? Th-That's what a writer should do...?

Can I look at you while I write, Sensei?
Why? D-Do I need a reason to want to look at you?

When I write a novel, everything that happens around me feels like foreshadowing.
...What would me coming here be foreshadowing?
Since you didn't come to Wildhunt today...I came here.
You came here for my story... Thank you, Sensei.

What present do I want? Hm...
Shall we take it slow and talk about it for two hours or so?
It's the first page of the new year. Shall we read the preface together?
Merry Christmas, Sensei. If there's anything you need, I'll get it for you today...

It's candy. Say ahh.
...I'll play a trick on you if you refuse, okay?

Event.Transcription: Welcome, Sensei. I just finished writing the plot.
Seeing you makes me feel at ease.

When I first enrolled in Wildhunt...
...I never imagined I'd be doing something like this.

Things have gotten complicated.
...But I still can't give up.
The story must be finished.

Fortunately, everything ended well.
...But still, I don't think I'll be accepting a commission like this again. Ugh...
Hm? Is my typewriter too loud...?
I wonder how I got involved in all this...

If you keep staring at me like that...
It's nice, fufu.
You should come visit our dormitory when you're done with work.
Welcome, Sensei. Please come this way.
Give me your hand, Sensei. Let's pull a card together.
Endings are important. Let's go watch the finale of this place without any regret.
Hm? Is there something wrong with the card?
Is there a card you're looking for?
This is...! I've also only seen this card in books...!
You have good luck, Sensei! Let's keep this pace going...!
Ordinariness is an aesthetic of its own.
Don't get discouraged, Sensei. Misfortune can hint at future fortune.

Normal.Transcription: This is! Blue Archive!
Another great choice from our— No, I mean Sensei! ...Pardon my late introduction. I'm Wakasa Fuyu, a second-year at Wildhunt Art Academy. Make sure to remember me!
Huh, isn't this a really good spot for a business meeting?
If I were to install a screen, where would be best...?
(Aren't these beans decent? Should I try importing these too?)
But...I wonder if Sensei's going to come.
(I-Is that the Prefectural Council? What should I do? Run away?!)
I'll absolutely repay you for this...! Because that's business! So... Until then, please stay by my side.
Ooh, where did you get something like this...? Thank you, Sensei!
So much investment...! I won't let you down!
Doing this much for me...? ...Is there something you need me to procure, by chance?
Thank you, Sensei. I'll make sure to repay you for your generous investment...!
Media and art... Would you like to listen to my story?
How odd. I start talking a lot with you, Sensei.
Um, do you like watching movies? Oh, no, I was just asking for artistic purposes...!
I wonder why it is that I want to have them by my side, when I can already see them whenever I want...

Battle.Transcription: I'll make sure to repay you for this...!
Fu, fufu, a-an attack like this...!
Now then, shall we go in and win?
Please leave us a good review.
Fufu, would you like to see the merchandise?
Shh, keep what you just saw a secret, okay?
How was it? Did I look cool?
Destination is the enemy territory! Delivery complete!
You will not regret that choice.
Is the thing we need to deliver...victory itself?
Fufu, is this the new market?
I wonder what kind of produce I need to win...
Fufu, things went as I expected.
The product, named "Victory," has been successfully delivered.

Lobby.Transcription: I've been waiting for you, Sensei!
Come take a seat, Sensei. Let's talk business.
Hmm, so this is what office work is like...
Oh? Have you finally decided to become the Free Trade Cartel's advisor?

What a nice office.
We can't...use it as the Free Trade Cartel's base, can we?

How comfortable...
Maybe I can relax here...
*yawn*

Um, if you keep poking me like that...
...I'll stick right next to you, okay?

Happy birthday, Sensei!
Um, I recorded a birthday video for you.
W-Would you like to watch it...?

Birthday present... Something I want...
I don't think there is anything, but...
...could I ask for your time today instead?

Happy New Year, Sensei.
This? It's a recording of a bell ringing on New Year's.
What do you think? Can something like this also be "art"?
...Shall we take our time and talk about things?

I happened to rent a Santa outfit...
I-Is your curiosity piqued?

Please give me just a moment, Sensei. 
I managed to get my hands on a delicious pumpkin!

Event.Transcription: Hello! I'm Wakasa Fuyu, the Sales Manager of the Free Trade Cartel!
If there's anything you need, please feel free to contact me.

Fu, fufu, fu...
I-I can easily handle something like this, you know?

(How did things end up this way? What did I do wrong?)
(This is doomed, right? Right? Really is, right?!)
Fu... Fufu... I should avoid commissions like this one for a while...
Yes, you're right. I am the face of our club.

Going to meetings, taking commissions, handling customers...
Yes, that is my role.

Of course, without support from Miyo or Ritsu...
...I would've been just an ordinary art student.
...Art really isn't easy at all.
We're still open and have plenty of stock. Please take your time.
Is there anything you're looking for?
The shop will stay open for a while longer. Please take your time.

You have something specific you're looking for?
...We should talk about it over there.
Pfft! E-Even if you poke me like that, you're not getting a discount!
You have sophisticated eyes.
I also had my eyes on that product.
Refunds and exchanges would be difficult, you know?
That's a great choice. Do you need it wrapped, by any chance?

Normal.Transcription: Blue! Archive!
My name is Usuba Ritsu! Nice to meet you!
Where would be the best place to showcase a statue?
The air feels stuffy. Maybe I should drill a hole in the wall over there?
Is there a way to express the aroma of coffee through sculpture?
I wonder if there's anything worthwhile goods...
I'm sure people back in Wildhunt would love it if I imported this cake, right?
Whoa...! I really wanted this! Thank you, Sensei!!!
Really, REALLY? You're giving this to me?
I think I could move an even bigger rock now!
Heh... Thank you, Sensei! I'll work even harder!
Sensei, look at this! I've gotten so strong!
Hey, hey, can I try sculpting your face, Sensei?
Heh, so this is what your skin feels like... I think I figured out how to carve it!
Did you know, Sensei? I've only had one model in my head these days.
It's strange... Why does my heart feel heavy, like it's being crushed by stone, whenever I see you?

Battle.Transcription: I happened to get some good products!
I'm sure I put it here!
Here, eat this and get going!
I can't let you tire out! Here!
What? What is it? What'cha playing with?

Lobby.Transcription: Yahoo! Sensei, what were you up to?
The weather's so nice! Let's go outside, Sensei!
I like our club! It brings other people joy!

When you look at a rock or a clump of clay...
...don't you feel the urge to bring out the shape it carries inside?

I can't figure out your dimensions visually. 
So would you mind if I hugged you, Sensei?
Being at Schale feels just as comfortable as leaning on marble!
Sensei! You should stop working for a bit and play with me!

Sensei, thank you for being born!
I'm really, really happy to have you in my life!

You know, Sensei, it's my birthday today.
So you should play with me all day long!

Happy New Year, Sensei! Let's go watch them ring the bell together soon!
...Huh, it's over already?
We're getting a lot of snow! Do you want me to teach you how to sculpt with snow, Sensei?

Let's go outside, Sensei! 
We need to secure candies and chocolate!

Event.Transcription: Welcome, Sensei! This way!!

Feels like there's something complicated going on...
But, well, I guess I'll face it!

It's my first time accepting a commission like this...
Well, I guess Miyo will come up with an amazing plan, right?
I guess we might've accepted an odd, but interesting, commission...?

It's over!
Hm? Why does everyone look so tired?
What, Sensei? Is there stone dust or something on my face?

Ahaha!
If you keep poking me, I'll poke you too, okay?
I-I think it's okay for everyone to relax a little...

Don't worry! The Free Trade Cartel...
...always finds a way!
We have loooooots of fun things prepared for you, Sensei!
Nothing's impossible! It might be hard, though!
As expected, Sensei! You're amazing!
Did you get your rewards? Don't forget to take them with you!
Hm? Is there anything you want to know?
It was hard, but fun? Heehee, I feel the same way, Sensei.

Normal.Transcription: Blue! Archive!!!
I'm here, I'm here again! Uzawa Reisa, this time as a magical girl!
Th-There's so many people again today...
A-Act as natural as possible...
(Ah, I know that too!)
Everyone seems to be having fun!
(Aaah... My spot...)
Sensei, you're always so nice to me... When we're together like this...I feel like the strongest!
Can I really have something so...? Thank you!
I'll make sure to grow with this strength you've given me, Sensei!
I, Uzawa Reisa, will aim even higher!
If it's for you, I'm okay with 2 stages— No, 17 stages of transformation!!
The power of connection is strong! Yes, it's quite literally the strongest!
I look up to a hero's strength... But...I also look up to your kindness.
You know how you compliment me a lot? That makes me so...happy!
I'll protect both you and peace!

Battle.Transcription: With love! And courage! And friendship power!
From feed ramp to chamber: six-groove, right-hand twist rifling magic!
Give me the strength to never falter!
Magical Vigilante Crew of Justice, mobilize!
Uzawa Reisa! Also known as...Thermite Pink!
Dodged in the blink of an eye!
Thank you for the recovery magic!
Here's my ultimate magic! This'll hurt!
And a cool farewell! Whoosh! Sha-sha-sha!!

Lobby.Transcription: Fufu, you're late, Sensei. No, please don't feel bad!
Because justice arrives faster than anyone else!
Please put Uzawa Reisa from the Vigilante Crew out of your mind...
Today, I am...Uzawa Reisa from the Supreme Magical Vigilante Crew!
I've come to answer your call...!
Thermite Pink has arrived!
What if the Vigilante Crew had a uniform?
And it was something cool like this one!
Bolt forward! Thermite Pink!

I wish I had something to nibble on... Right!
Do you want, like, bread or anything, Sensei?
Sensei, happy birthday!
If I had actual magical powers, I would cast blessing magic on you! Heehee!

Thank you for celebrating my birthday! Heehee.
Sensei, Happy New Year! May this year also be full of justice!
Magical Christmas!

Trick or magic! Happy Halloween!
My witch costume? No! I'm a magical girl!
