Event.Transcription:
Sensei! Here, over here!
Fufu, I suppose you couldn't keep up with how fast I was?

The Vigilante Crew's super-magical warrior!
Thermite Pink is here!
Whoa! There are so many guests!
Fufufu... I don't think anyone's noticed yet...

That an ordinary person like me was actually the Vigilante Crew's super ace...
...and a magical girl!

The transformation is over...
...but magic isn't! Eheehee!
Yes! Thermite Pink here! Also known as Uzawa Reisa!

Fufu, I'll show you my transformation pose...
I've been practicing! For starters...
Kyaaah?!
I-I feel like I just made eye contact with someone I know...
This? It's Thermite Pink's magic wand!

The official wand is a bit pricy...
So I tried decorating it with stuff I have at home!
Thermite Pink! Transformation!
Now! Let's go protect peace!
Swoosh! Bam-bam!! Sparkle!
Welcome to the magic store!
We don't have half-off stickers, okay?! This isn't a supermarket!
This outfit is not for sale! I have no extras!

Exchange... In other words, making a contract!

This feels like a magic item for some reason!
So it's magical shopping!

You insert a medal, like this! And clink! Clank! There you go!
They still had these machines here!

Let's put in all the remaining medals and spin!
I wonder what we'll get! I'm excited!
This place is incredible! I wish this was my home...!

Aah!! Isn't that an ultra-rare one?!
I only pulled that once in my life before. It's a super-rare card!

Gold! That's nice! It's shiny!
Ah, ah...

It seems peaceful here... That's great.

I've located the exit.
Um... This is really cute, but does it fit me?

Thank you for protecting my sense of justice. I'm always in your debt.
The strength to protect others. I've always wanted this.
Thank you for watching over me.
Thank you for staying with me, Sensei.
You relying on me, and coming to visit, really makes me happy.
Happiness wasn't far away.
If I have your permission...I want to continue to protect you, Sensei.

I hope I don't stand out...
Staying on the side of justice...is the reward for me.
Strength to protect others... I still have it.
H-How do I turn this off?!
The next patrol mission... I see.
Ah... Yes! Looking forward to working with you!
This high point should give us an advantage.
The mission begins... Th-There's too many people...!

I've thoroughly prepared. Thank you for calling me.
Thank you for visiting even when you're so busy.
I'm always ready for Vigilante Crew missions.

N-No. I wasn't fishing for compliments!

Fortunately, pretty well.

That wall in the office... The partition wall.
It would be good for stopping bullets.
Happy birthday. Would you like to go on a walk together?

B-But that's...!

U-Ugh...
Magical, lyrical...Thermite White!
...Was that good enough?

It's my birthday?
Oh. Already?
I forgot about it because I was so busy. Thank you.
What do I want? Hm...
Nothing really. I already have everything I need.
It's the new year. I look forward to working with you again.
My new year's wish?
I hope that, next year, we'll get to exchange well wishes like this again.
It's that time of the year when the streets get crowded. I can understand why they're excited.
Being able to protect that peace makes me happy.
Many people gave me treats on my way here...
But they also warned me not to pull any tricks.
Sensei, do I pull a lot of tricks?

Event.Transcription: I-I get nervous when you stare at me so closely...

This is all for the infiltration.
Although, I do think this is a pretty outfit...
It feels like the crowd is getting bigger and bigger...

Everyone is happy with it.
Regardless of how, I'm glad I could be of help.

I was able to become more confident.
Thank you, Sensei.

The infiltration is over, but the patrol continues.
I wish I could see you more often.
Please don't pull! That's not a decoration!
With six-groove, right-hand twist rifling magic, um...and...
I'm not familiar with the lines, so it's hard to memorize them.
Kyaaah! E-Eek!! A-Aah...! That tickles...!

I like the atmosphere at the amusement park.
It's really...peaceful.
W-Welcome. Sensei...
Is there anything you need...?
That was a memorable patrol. Thank you.
I hope you can find what you need.
This reminds me of what happened at the convenience store.
Yes, this way.
Here it is.
Thank you for always cooperating with us.
I'm glad it could be of help to Sensei.
It's an old machine. I'm not sure if it still works, though...
I suppose it runs when you put in a medal.
I'm glad Reisa is enjoying herself.
I hope you get that one card... I think it's called "rare"?
It's almost closing time. Please check if you have any medals left.
I've been feeling someone's gaze for a while...
Let's do this quickly, before we attract more attention.
It's rainbow. Is this...a good thing?
It's...pink.
It's gold.
It's sky blue. How refreshing.
Black... This feels a bit ominous.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive!
I'm Komakaze Rabu, captain of the Splash Helmet Gang. H-Hold on, Sensei!! Personal space! Don't run at me like that!
Is there no...hat hanger?
That face looks really familiar...
(Should I...talk to them?)
This place isn't half bad. The roof doesn't even leak.
The kids would've really liked to come visit...
Yeah! This is it! This is it! Thank you, Sensei!
This, for me? Um... Thank you!
Y-You're really giving this to me? No take backs!
What're you going to do, after making me this strong? There's no knowing what's going to happen later, you know!
Fufu, it feels nice to get stronger! ♪
Um, you do know that I'm a troublemaker, right?
Don't stand so close to me! It bugs me.
It's been a while since someone treated me like a student... Seriously...
Seriously! There are people watching! You can pat my head later!

Battle.Transcription: My helmet is not for decoration!
Then get in line! I'm busy!
You fought like a Helmet Gangster!
Funny how you thought you could underestimate the Helmet Gangsters!
I'll put a clean end to this!
Don't get hurt, but make them hurt!
Don't go easy on them! Charge!
Hmm, so I can make a mess?
It feels weird being on the same side as you all. Aha, haha...
P-Put me down!! People can see!
These small fry sure are getting cocky!

Lobby.Transcription: Oh, Sensei. Yahoo.
What should we do today? Play baseball?
Hey, Sensei.
Got any cool stories?
Sensei, you ever think about wearing a helmet?

Helmets are cool and practical, you know?
It protects your skull, AND it looks cool. Isn't that the best?
(Looks like most people here at Schale don't wear helmets...)
(I feel so anxious all of a sudden!)
Sensei, why do you have so much work?
You always come running, anytime, anywhere, so I thought you didn't do much.
Hmm, mmm, mhmm...
Mhm! Helmets are the best!
Huh, isn't today your birthday, Sensei?
Happy birthday! You should eat lots of yummy food!
You know, it feels like the gang is hiding something from me.
They said they have something serious to tell me. What could they be up to?
It's the new year. Let's stay healthy and make lots of money!
Merry Christmas, Sensei!

Well, Santa didn't visit this bad kid...
...but I think it's still okay for me to have fun!

*huff* *huff*
It was rough...
People kept going, "Trick or treat...?"

I didn't have any treats to give!
So they all pulled tricks on me! Ugh!

Event.Transcription: Sensei, do you know what this is?
...It looks like a vending machine...
Looks like it only takes exclusive medals.
I guess that means we can only use it here... So let's give it a shot.
Huh, it's closing time. Let's use all our medals and leave.

They're not going to pop out of the frame or anything, right...?
Whoa, it's shiny... Is this what they call super rare?
That one's hard to find. Is it rare?

Ugh, I have no clue...as to what's good and what's not.
Huh? Black? That's my favorite color!
*huff* *huff* ...Just what is their deal?!
Magical girls? They're not actually magic, right?!
Wh-What are you doing?! Go do your job already!
(Sensei, you're too good of a person.)
I'm telling you this because I don't think you know.

But it's really loud for me whenever someone pats my helmet.
...
Only a little bit, then. ...Seriously.
Yeah, that's more like it!
Great! This is it!
That's it for today! Easy peasy!
This is light work!

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive. Fufu.
Kakehashi Subaru here. If you have any issues, I'll help you to the best of my abilities. Well, in the Arius way.
A "cafe"... An expensive place.
(This reminds me of...Water Time for some reason.)
I wonder...what that is.
(It was hard for me to visit somewhere like this before.)
Working at a cafe... I wonder if they're hiring.
It still doesn't feel real to me... It feels like everything's going to disappear like a dream when I wake up in the morning... Thank you, Sensei. I'll cherish it.
What a strange feeling... I suppose this is what they call "growth," in the outside world.
So this must be what it feels like to grow. I suppose I could move forward too, like the others.
I've been thinking that I want to try to change. ...Could you keep this a secret from the others?

I don't fully trust you yet! But...I think I do about 95% of the time.

You say it makes you happy when students rely on you...but that just makes me feel guilty and insufficient... I-I don't mean anything special by that! It's just... It's the Arius way to repay our debts!

Battle.Transcription: Thank you. I'll continue to do my best.
Were you satisfied? That's a relief.
Suppression complete. I hope this solves the problem.
What score did I get for that, Sensei?
What kind of place is this?
I see. So this is how it feels.

Lobby.Transcription: Welcome, Sensei. I'm Kakehashi Subaru, Student Rep for today.
I've been waiting for you. Do you have any orders for me?
What? "For starters, just relax...?"
"Snack as much as I want"?
I-I can't! Even if I am the Student Rep!
Then, just a little bit...
I'm only saying this to Sensei,
but I also don't like the expression Arius "Satellite School".
Calling it "satellite school" makes it feel like it's under the main school... It gives off an impression of being isolated.
...I'm sorry, I was thinking of everyone back in Arius.
I need to do my best for them.
...What? "Do your best for yourself too"?
Th-Thank...you...
Eh? Studying...? I-I'm studying properly.
*sigh* But why do I have to do something that looks so useless...
"You might not understand it now, but you'll find it useful one day" ...you say.
*sigh* Seriously... Yeah, yeah. I got it!
Uhm... Whenever I meet Sensei, I get this strange feeling.
Until now, I haven't met an adult...who would do so much for me.
Happy birthday, Sensei.
Th-There's not much I can do for you, and saying happy birthday is the only thing I can offer...
What? You want to listen to me playing harmonica? Th-That's...
Ugh, okay. I'm only doing this for Sensei, okay?
My birthday... Thank you for celebrating my birthday, Sensei.
In Arius, we treasure our birthdays.

Celebrating each other's birthdays...
If we lose that too, then it feels like we're really going to lose something special.
But still... We'd get scolded, so we couldn't throw grand celebrations.
It's the day that marks the end of a year, and the start of a new one.

We'd hope a day like this would never come back then.
How strange... Now, I don't think it's a bad thing.
Happy New Year, Sensei.
It's Christmas. I know the concept, at least.
...We'd joke around and say let's be
Santa who gifts a bullet rain to Trinity and Gehenna.
I don't really know what Halloween is...
But if you exclude... festival, tricks, and treats from it...
It feels somewhat like Arius in the past. ...The time when we had nothing but fear.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive.
Be polite, but be persistent. I'm Miyoshi Takane from Red Winter Federal Academy's Publishing Department. Nice to meet you.
This place possesses a charming atmosphere.
Is the Wi-Fi good here? I must upload my critique...
Sharing stories over tea. How quaint. Truly.
(How should I review this place...?)
Is photography permitted...?
Do you know the saying, "the pen is mightier than the gun"? Yes, it's true. Fufu... Let's have an in-depth..."discussion" with those who ignorantly replied to my reviews.
Humans have always marched forward for a greater tomorrow. That's the reason why we must reflect on ourselves and never halt our efforts.
As long as there is a chance, we must not stop. Now, give me your hand, Sensei. Let us venture forward together.
One must know oneself. Critics are no exception. That's the only way we can grow, just as we're doing now.
The concept of "soulmates" is a tad outdated. But for now, I'd like to lean into the concept. I think faith in it drives us forward.
I have come to realize... I'm accustomed to critiquing...other people. But it'd be a fresh experience to hear a critique of myself. So...Sensei? I'm willing...if it's you, Sensei....

Throughout life, we find it difficult to find something that completely suits our tastes. Nevertheless... It seems there is an exception. And, as of what that is... I'll keep it a secret. Yes. For now.

There are few things that excite me as much as finding a good story. Personally. And to me, a good person is...just like a good story. You don't understand what I'm saying? Fufu... That's reassuring. For now.
Sometimes, I consider a version of myself who never met you. That would be such a gray...trite story. What do I mean? Fufu. It's a meaningless thought. Perhaps.

Battle.Transcription: Keep your eyes forward and walk with confidence. Posture reveals a lot about a person.
A good beginning makes a good ending. Just like in a story.
The end is the new beginning.
When a paragraph ends, a sentence continues.
It was an ending befitting of...at least 4 out of 5 stars.
Praise and glory to everyone for their hard work.
Are you okay? Always remain classy!
Critique is an act of focusing on the essence of writing.
Yes. I'll help however I can.
Kyah?! Seriously... You'll make up for this later, okay?
This is a story worth critiquing.
A happy ending. While cliché, it's a satisfying conclusion.

Lobby.Transcription: How have you been, Sensei? Today is an exquisite day.
Because I was able to meet you like this.
I'm quite delighted to make your acquaintance, Sensei.
Oh my, was I a touch too formal?
M-Mmm. In that case...
Hello, Sensei!
We frequently have snowball fights in Red Winter.
If there's one forbidden rule, it's hiding a rock in the snowball!
Something like that would hurt a lot, you know...?
What? You want to hear "that laugh"...? Wh-Why?! But I...
U-Ugh... Okay. If you insist...
O-Ohohohoho!
...I'm not doing that again...!
Do you like ice hockey? I love it!
Six players working as a team, the skates, the sticks...
Body checks, shoulder tackles, wild brawls...!
And even results that make no sense and the ensuing revolt from the crowd!
Ah... Forget about the last part...
Critique is the act of capturing a moment and using your own words to share your impressions.
I suppose it's similar to photography in that sense.
Fufu, So... Um.
Will you allow me to take a photo of you, Sensei?
Some people think I'm a lady born from nobility...
There must be limits to their delusions.
I am Miyoshi Takane, no more, no less!
What...? Oh. "Princess of the Frozen Kingdom" then, got it.
Sensei!!

What? Today? Did something special happen today?
It's just another day out of the 365 that pass by.

Fufu. I'm just kidding, Sensei.
Happy birthday.
Now then, shall I start my critique...
...of you and your birthday?

Oh, what are my plans today?
...Nothing in particular. It's just another day, right?
Unless...it isn't?
Ugh...

S-Seriously! Did you think that was funny?
I really thought you forgot my birthday!
I'm going to make sure that you pay for that, okay?

Happy New Year, Sensei.
I look forward to another great year together.
Just like how first line of the story is important, the way you spend the first day of the year...
...stages how the rest of the year will go.
That said... Would you like some clementines?
It's a Red Winter tradition to enjoy clementines near the heater.

Christmas...
The story of Santa Claus is passed down in many places.
In Red Winter, Santa Claus has a partner called the "Snow Maiden."
Yes, quite a different partner from a reindeer...
Which is why, for today, I'll be your Snow Maiden.
If you think about the origins of Halloween...
In a way, Halloween...
...inspires creators with new ideas.

Apart from that, though...
...I'll pull a trick even if you give me treats, you know?
Hiyah!

Event.Transcription: This is my first time visiting Trinity...
I-I should do my best to not cause any trouble.
The place called Trinity, and the stories born there...
Heh. I like them both.

Everything is going well...
...which is a bit concerning.

If this were part of a story...
...a conflict would eagerly interrupt these scenes.
I had a feeling this would happen...
Yeah... I need to stay composed...
What a relief... Truly, I'm very glad.
Thank you so much, Sensei.
And...I'm sorry, Sensei.
I was relieved that everyone was nice to us.
...But still, ultimately, I'm just an ordinary student...
Did you call me, Sensei?
What? "That laugh"?
I'm not doing it! Not here, at the very least!
...Although it might be a different story if it were just the two of us...

Please stop teasing me like that.
Otherwise...!

I will record each and every one of your actions...
...and critique them, okay?
"Sensei was once more pulling pranks on Miyoshi Takane today..."
"I decided to announce this to all of Kivotos."
Fufu. Right? I'm glad you understand.
Expanding your horizons means broadening how you view the world.
In a different sense, it means expanding your own world.

And...as I thought about this...
...I became curious about something.

What kind of world...
...do you possess?
Even though I'm at Trinity, I must not forget my duty.
...Otherwise, I could end up like our president...
...who deliberately forgets proper decorum.
I tried making a checklist, Sensei.
It wasn't much.
It's similar to coming up with the structure of a critique.
A story is a compilation of small chapters.

Although the writing process...
...may not necessarily follow that exact order.

But in the sense that they're both ultimately organized, formed...
...and expressed...
Both tasks must be tackled diligently.
Repetitive things tend to be easily ignored.
Since they're boring in the first place, you know...?

But if you neglect your small tasks...
...they are bound to catch up with you eventually.
That felt like a gentle lecture?
Y-Yeah... I know I nag a lot.
After all, critics are essentially finicky, nagging complainers.
5 out of 5! That's incredible!

It's proper to reward someone who so diligently...
...completes their homework.
Here you go. I prepared this for you.

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive. Heh, heh, heh.
Publish, print, distribute. That's the Publishing Department's motto. Hello, Sensei. I'm Aramaki Yakumo.
Let's see... How best to optimize our revenue streams...
It's warm and cozy here...
What if I set up a sales booth there...? Heh, heh, heh.
Nowadays, textual content is more of a business platform.
I wonder how much this place makes daily...?
They say it depends on how you use the tool, right? With this, I can "guarantee" that my contracts are upheld. Heh, heh, heh.
A better today than yesterday, a better tomorrow than today... That will lead us to better business... No, no, a better future.
To keep the Publishing Department running, I need to become a stronger president. I wonder if there's a good contract somewhere...or a method to secure funding...
Oh, I feel like my brain's working fast now. Now, Sensei. If you need a competent contract agent, call me anytime! Heh, heh, heh.
Thank you, Sensei! I've prepared a special contract here so that I don't forget what you've done for me. Hm? What's with the fine print? Y-You don't have to worry about that!
So this is what it means to "bond" with Sensei. Hm? My impression? Uh... You're asking me something that's hard to quantify...
This...is hard to put it into words. It's quite difficult. To stumble over my words as the Publishing Department president...is inherently problematic... But uh, I'm not used to this feeling...
*sigh* I figure that I might as well just say it clearly and get it over with. S-So, Sensei! Ah, uhh... I'm sorry. I need a little more time, please.
Great... There are moments you can't evade even through contracts... I was really happy to have you with me. You completed my trailing sentences. So please continue...to correct my lines for me.

Battle.Transcription: You just have to sign it.
Thank you for your purchase. Heh, heh, heh.
Come in, come in! Heh, heh, heh.
Sales are going well. Heh, heh, heh.
Shall we look for a new distribution channel?
I have a feeling this is going to be a huge hit...!
Oh my, did you call me? For a contract? Business expansion? Which one is it?

Lobby.Transcription:
Wow, you're here, Sensei!
I was waiting so anxiously.
Now then, shall we start a discussion about...
...our new business venture between the Publishing Department and Schale? Heh, heh, heh.
I was waiting!
As I was standing here...
...I came up with a list of books that Schale might need.
..If you want, I'll bring them right away. Heh, heh, heh.
My hobby is writing business proposals, yeah.
That's odd? Well, you could look at it that way...

But I like imagining the possibilities.
Writing down your ideas is surprisingly fun, you know?
...That's not a collection of business proposals, but a scratchpad?
What do you mean?! This isn't some scratchpad!
It's different because... Well, um...
Negotiating the budget with the Office is always tough...
But...ultimately, all that matters is getting paid, right?
We overcome any deficits with the Publishing Department's business capability!
...And charge the Office again to earn twice as much. Heh, heh, heh.
I rode multiple types of transportation to get to Schale.
And I'm quite envious of your railroad system...
Well, that's not the only thing that I'm envious of...
The publishing industry is in a biiit of a squeeze nowadays.
Especially with text being overrun by video platforms.
Which is why I came to the following conclusion.
The Publishing Department should also absorb various video platforms!

Ah. I'm serious about this.
I want to become a transfer student at Schale.
It's warm, the facilities are maintained, and there are plenty of business opportunities. You're here as well.
I can't, since Schale is not a school?
Right... Reality is frequently bitingly cold...
Would you look at that, our star of the day is here.
Happy birthday, Sensei. Here's a small gift from me.
Here, it's a library card. I look forward to seeing you use it. Heh, heh, heh.

Today is May 18th, you know?
Isn't there something you're forgetting? Don't you have something you should say to me?
As expected of you! I knew you'd remember my birthday!
It's the new year. Mmm...
Most businesses plan an event for every new year.
It's a bit of a dilemma...

It doesn't make a big impact because everyone does it...
...but you'll fall behind if you don't bother...
They say Christmas season is the peak business season!
So many owners plan for the season, complacent and uninspired...
...thinking anything will sell this time of year.
Today is Halloween.
Oh, right. I've had this question ever since I met you.
Getting a treat from you, or getting the freedom to trick you...
I wonder which one's better.

Event.Transcription: With no risk, there's no return.
Now then, shall we get to business...?
I'll show you now.
The skills of a Publishing Department that survived a harsh Red Winter!

Well...
It's probably closer to "survival instinct," though.

It's here... The momentum is here!
I can't call myself the Publishing Department President if I miss this!
...How did it come to this...?
I mean... I have the gist of what caused this...
But I can't give up just yet...
Wow... I was really concerned at one point!
What? You're glad things went well, but I should reflect on myself?
Um... Can we push that back to a later time...?
Creators are...

...good at creating things...
...but they're surprisingly uninterested...
...in the methods to spread their works...
The reason why books...why text is important...
...is because they are products with the "potential" to bring...
...maximum output with minimal input!

It's incredible to be able to create something.
The same goes for having the talent to make it happen.
Having such talent, it's great.
I truly...believe that.
I'm thankful to the Trinity students.

Huh, why are you looking at me like that?
I'm serious.
What do you think the basics of business are, Sensei? Naturally there's exchange... Trade...
And money, of course!

Welcome!
To the heart of business, where money and goods flow freely!
Heh, heh, heh. Please look around!

There might be hidden treasure waiting deep inside the shelves.
Keep your eyes peeled until the end, Sensei.
Ah, of course, you can also keep your eyes peeled for me, you know?
The price isn't going down even if you talk to me, okay?
Offering a discount would require tremendous business considerations...
...and even closed-door political negotiations.
I never thought I'd see a day when I'd be doing business with you, Sensei.
Yeah, seriously, life's full of surprises.

Nice, nice!
Is there anything else you need?
I'm only telling you this here...
It's so thrilling to see the results with my own eyes!
Culture is money. That's the reality.
In that regard, what you just purchased...
...could be considered cultural in a sense, you know?
I guarantee the quality, okay?

Normal.Transcription: Blue, Archive.
N-No matter what I'm wearing, I'm still a full-fledged member of the Ninjutsu Research Club! Ono Tsukuyo!
Ughhh. Does this outfit stand out too much...?
Don't spill coffee on your outfit... Carefully... Carefully...
I want to hide inside the furniture right now.
I can't even walk without being cautious in this outfit.
(There's so many...different fashion styles.)
I'll do my best. For our ninja way...!
I feel like I'm the center of attention... I must be imagining it, right?
I've grown... Do I really...have some talent...?
Do I...really deserve something like this...?
My show begins now. Please keep your eyes on the new appearance of Tsukuyo, the ninja...!
This dress looks good on me? Really? Eheehee...
As long as Sensei's supporting me, I can take any path...
Rather than being alone on the stage...I'd rather be next to you, Sensei...
If it's between something I like and something I'm good at... I'd like to remain with the thing I like.

Battle.Transcription: Let's go to the runway of victory...!
It's giving me strength...! Thank you...!
Everyone worked so hard through the finale...!
L-Let's all go get ramen together...!
In this situation, a ninja would...!
E-Even if my dress rips off...!
You really want to scout me...?!
...I'll go try. If that's the path I must take...!
Model... No, Ninja Tsukuyo, on my way!

Lobby.Transcription:
H-Hello, Sensei.
T-Today, I'll be your personal model, Sensei.

I've been waiting for you, Sensei.
...Do I stand out too much?
Rather than a model, I want to become a ninja first.
Would you like to take a closer look at this outfit?
It's more complicated than it looks... It's interesting!
Wh-Why is there a magazine with my pictorial here at Schale...?!

A m-meal?
I-I'm okay with anything as long as it's not salad...

I feel much more comfortable in this office chair... 
...than I ever did at the fashion show venue's sofa.
H-Happy birthday, Sensei.
I-I'll show you my ninja walking that I practiced just for you, Sensei...!
M-My birthday?

It's been so busy lately that I forgot about it... 
...Th-thank you, Sensei!

Happy New Year!
My New Year's wish...
...is for people I like to only have reasons to smile. Eheehee...
W-Would you like to walk around the Christmas streets together?
I am confident in my walking now...!

Even though it's Halloween...
...doesn't this outfit stand out too much?
...What? There's people wearing a lot worse in the streets?

Event.Transcription: S-Sensei...?! Th-This outfit is weird, right...?

Y-You're here, Sensei...
Th-This outfit is um...
Wh-What is this...? What is happening right now...?
It's strange up on the stage.

I'm sure I'm getting more attention than ever...
But it's surprisingly lonely...
Everyone...! I'm back...!
Am I really a person befitting of this outfit...?
I-I stand out too much, right, Sensei?
Ugh, a ninja shouldn't be like this...

I-I-I-I'm pretty...?!
Huuu...

I-If I think of...
...this outfit as a form of disguise... That might work...
I-I organized the missions we need to complete...

These missions aren't easy...
But you can do it, Sensei!
I-Is there something wrong with the things I prepared?
What? Th-There weren't any missions like this...

I-I knew it...!
I knew you could do it, Sensei!
Incredible! I knew it! You have the talent to be a ninja too, Sensei!
G-Good work...! That was an incredible finale!

Normal.Transcription: Blue, ahem, Archive?
Hello, Honorable Sensei! This mission's an infiltration! Please take care of me!
Fufu... What should I do if someone recognizes me...?
Is this dress...too much to be wearing here?
(A dress... Coffee... I'm getting an idea! For new content!)
Next time for sure...! I'll hold a fan meeting with my subscribers here...!
(Perfect, for now! ...Where's the most secluded spot here?)
This... This for me...! But if it's Honorable Sensei's decision! Yes! Thank you!
This is...! I feel like this dress was made just for me!
My power grows with this out...! But my ninja mindset never wavers!
How precious...! So you DO want to take the path of the ninja with me!
Fufu, what do you think, Honorable Sensei? I've gotten cuter... No, stronger, you know?
Th-This is a bit embarrassing. Uwaaah...
What do you think of my new hairstyle? I tried really hard...
Cute, you say...? H-Heehee, Heeheehee...
I wouldn't l-look out of place as your bodyguard in this outfit, would I, Honorable Sensei...?

Battle.Transcription: A Girl's Ninja Scroll Michiruchi, staaart?!
Ah, ah. This is undercover Zero-One... Did I do this right?
Is this the place? Our new operations area...!
This dress is just for the mission...! Anyways, what do you think, Honorable Sensei?

Lobby.Transcription:
You're here, Honorable Sensei!
Tsukuyo lent me her curling iron. Do you know how to use one?
I've been waiting, Sensei.
...No, even in a dress, speaking like that doesn't suit me.
Why is it that as clothes get prettier, they get more uncomfortable...?
It's uncomfortable, but there's lots of different places to hide my ninja gear!
Mindset makes a ninja, not the outfit!
So even if I'm wearing a dress, I'm still a ninja!
I want ramen...but I probably shouldn't while I'm wearing this...
This is the Michiru-style dress code, you know? Nyahaha!

I wore this especially for your birthday, Honorable Sensei!
...Hm? Does that mean I'm the gift?

N-No! Well, I mean, I wouldn't mind. I'd actually like it.
Wait, no! NYOOO!
My birthday live stream is scheduled for today.
The special guest, and my gift...is none other than Honorable Sensei!
Here, come sit next to me and look at the camera!

Happy New Year, Honorable Sensei!
You've got to start the new year with period dramas!
That said... Would you like to binge some with me?

Did you know, Honorable Sensei?
That "Santa" is just a ninja, disguised in different clothes...!

These caltrops?
Of course, it's a trap for those after our candies!
...Just kidding. They're just caltrop-shaped candies.

Event.Transcription:
What's better for an infiltration, onigiri or hyorogan...?
Hm? You're here, Honorable Sensei!

Nice outfit, Honorable Sensei.
Seeing you in something like this is new...
Aaaah...! Why the heck is there a fight happening in a FASHION SHOW venue?!

...Mmm, I miss her. Tsukuyo.
I wonder if she's doing well... Is she eating ramen properly?

Yes...! With this, the Ninjutsu Research Club is back!
Over here! Honorable Sensei, this way! Hurry!

I'm bored...
Hm? Situations always seem to happen every time I say that?

Ugh... I feel like this dress is a bit tight...
Why do people wear stuff like this?!

What makes a ninja, ninja...?
The outfit...doesn't seem to be it.

I'll show you...! That my ninja way...
...won't be stopped by something like clothes!
Oh, you're here, Honorable Sensei! Take your time and look around.
About this item...
We have everything except what we don't have! Nyahaha!
Fufu, let's close for the day and go get the new ninja meal, Honorable Sensei!

Choose carefully, buy boldly...!
This is a merch-purchasing technique...!
One day, I'll have "Michiruchi, A Girl's Ninja Scroll" merch displayed here...!
Good. Good choice.
Yeah, that's the correct choice for a ninja!

For here, or to go—
Ah, wrong place.
Oooh...! Yes! That's our store's signature product!
Actually, everything here is!

Fufu, welcome, Honorable Sensei.
I, too, happen to be choosing ramen.
Hm. A nice smell...
...doesn't seem to be the only thing they've got! Let's go!
Thank you for the food... I'm completely stuffed...
Noodle and broth... That's like ninja and ninjutsu...
What's your favorite ramen, Honorable Sensei?

I feel it...!
The kind of taste that can inspire new ninjutsu!
Auuugh...?! Th-This flavor is...!
Ugh, not bad, huh...?
It's not bad. But that's all! It's just "not bad"...!
Ugh, i-is this even ramen...?

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive.
A logical solution within the realm of electrons... Allow me to demonstrate.
This place is a type of conceptual space as well... I'll need to do more analysis.
I wish I had these kinds of organizational skills.
...Looking at this, it would seem you and I share similar tastes.
If I ever make the Avant Guard: Maid Type, perhaps I'll station it here.
Let's...keep things as clean as we can.
My determination to protect everyone... That gives me the strength to pull the trigger.
Equipment upgrade successful. Your help was instrumental, Sensei.
We're in a mutually complementary relationship. Is it okay if I interpret it that way?
If you're investing such resources in me... Right. I see.
Thanks to you... I've learned the feeling of "gratitude." ...That's all I had to say.
My body suddenly feels hot... Maybe from the suit's thermal insulation...
This is...the moment where uncertainty finally takes shape.
This deja vu I'm feeling from this conversation... Perhaps it's because of...the simulation from conceptual space.
Do you like this suit, Sensei? ...No, there was no double meaning there...at all.

Battle.Transcription: There's no issue with on-site combat.
I'll continue with battle situation analysis.
There are too many variables on site...
Beginning scan. I can see it clearly.
A hypothetical future to a rational reality.
Is there a need for electronic warfare?
I'll show you the power of this suit.
Your commands and my analysis. It's a rational combination.
I've completed analysis on the target of observation. All that's left is the real battle.
That proved the rationality of conceptual space.

Lobby.Transcription:
I've been waiting, Sensei.
I'll provide support in whatever task necessary. Quite rational, yes?
Let's begin working. Whatever you need, just name it.
There's a story that says...that time does not flow around us.
Rather, the past, present, and future all exist as one, within the same moment.

Based on that theory...
Even now, we're still experiencing the day of that incident.
I'm honestly curious. What's on your PC?
I'm sure I could easily hack into it with this suit.
...Rest assured. I prefer not to employ...such methods.
I wonder what lies beyond the observable realm.
I wish to find that answer...
...Together with you.
I wish we had made a suit for you as well, Sensei.
Then you and I could've enjoyed conceptual space, together.

...We can just escape reality?
Not like this.
Gravity exists everywhere.
Even between you and I.
We're unconsciously...falling towards each other.

Happy birthday, Sensei.
Your gift is this Avant Guard: Task Support.

...Hm? You'd rather receive my direct support?
Th-That's...troublesome...

Today...was my birthday.
I was so carried away with my work that I forgot.
I tend to get tunnel vision when I'm too focused on something.
You've helped me make a good memory, Sensei. Thank you.

Happy New Year, Sensei.
What is the appropriate attire for the New Year?
...I hope this is okay.
It's more than okay...? That's...good to hear.
The say today is a day to celebrate someone's birth.

I don't quite understand it...
However, I'm grateful...that I'm able to experience this moment.
Ghosts? I don't believe in such things.

Ghosts can't interact with gravity nor electromagnetic forces...
...so it's impossible for us to perceive them with our own eyes.
...Hm? You don't understand? How so?

Normal.Transcription: Blue, Archive.
Perfect maid, perfect recon. Asuma Toki. Please consider us "in the same boat," and rely on me.
Rest is important. That is why the 3-day work week is a necessity.
I am looking for a place to sit or lie down.
A sufficient amount of caffeine and sugar may serve as fuel for a mission.
This cafe's recipe...is decent.
Proper rest ensures the next mission's success.
Changing your weapon requires a surprising amount of grit. Almost like changing your breakfast from toast to pancakes. But I guess this is different, since it's from Sensei.
Asuma Toki, leveled up. My feelings toward Sensei have leveled up too. So Sensei's feelings toward me have also leveled up.
With this, I'm stronger. ...Upon further reflection, I am not quite there yet. So please stay with me a little longer.
People can't grow up just by getting stronger. You see, they have to rely on each other. ...I'm ready at any time, Sensei.
Grown-up Toki is Perfect Toki. ...Actually. I will correct my statement. Only when you're by my side, Sensei.
I see. With this, my existence within Sensei has grown. ...It's the other way around? Impossible.
Don't worry, Sensei. As long as I, the lucky recon maid-agent, am with you, no obstacles will stand in our way.
If there is such thing as relationship level, this would be the time when it goes up. It feels like it just increased by ten thousand points.
Sensei, aren't you cold? I'm a bit— Actually, I am VERY cold. So come closer, please.

Battle.Transcription: My dual wielding pistols aren't just for show.
Failure is not an option. Ya-ho.
All I did was my duty. V—
Asuma Toki's perfect recon. On my way.
Everything will begin from this very hand.
My gun handling is also perfect.
It's about how you use your guns and tools.
I can move out within 5 minutes.
Mission accomplished. Hurry up and compliment me, please.

Lobby.Transcription:
Hmm...
Mmm...
Ah?!
You're here, Sensei.
...No. I was not dozing off out of boredom.
Hoping Sensei might come closer to wake me up...
I absolutely do not harbor any such ulterior motives.
Sensei, I was waiting for you.
Let us begin today's work.
Organization, complete. Task list, ready. Coffee, ready. Snacks, ready.
Preparations are complete.
Yes, please hurry and compliment me.
I have been thinking a lot about hobbies.
I've come to the conclusion that I should do whatever entertains me.
That said, Sensei.
Would you like to read this manga with me? Or play video games?
There is also a streamer's channel that I enjoy watching.
I have revamped my armament and outfit to pursue reduced weight and increased speed.
However... I do miss the heaviness and firepower output at times.
It's a shame that a person cannot exist within a state of quantum superposition.
Truly, a shame.

While I was watching a streamer's live stream the other day...
I left a comment about infinite magazine and dual pistols.
Some from Genryumon of Shanhaijing Academy "liked" it.
I wonder why...
Sometimes, I ponder topics like the world ending.
Not for any particular reason.
I like to think what I would do if such a day did come.

What would you do, Sensei?
I... have already decided on my course of action.
...But I'm not going to tell you.
Because sometimes keeping a secret or two can be good.
There are many important things to consider when it comes to recon.

Above all, you must know your enemy and know yourself...
...in order to guarantee the success of the operation.
Meaning, we must deepen our relationship.
...You don't understand?
I do, so there are no issues.
I'm aware.
Today marks Sensei's first reconnaissance into the world.
Please show me if you have any reconnaissance records.
As today's main heroine...
I will request a very reasonable gift for this day.
It is...
...love and attention.
Happy New Year.
A new year of my life begins right here.
Now then, Sensei.
Let's go plan the rest of our lives together.
A teacher can't show favoritism...and give a Christmas gift to a student.
So instead, I got you a gift.
Yes. I am the gift.
...This is not a joke. Really.
I heard candy and snacks make good combat rations.
In other words, perfect for Halloween.
...Does Halloween really count?
Well...
Yes. Because I say so.

Event.Transcription: Welcome to Asuma Toki's shop, Sensei.
...That was a lie. It's everyone's shop.
We couldn't prepare a lot of stock...
But we still hope it will be of help to our teacher.
Welcome to Asuma Toki's shop, Sensei.
...That was a lie. It's everyone's shop.
We couldn't prepare a lot of stock...
But we still hope it will be of help to our teacher.
Asuma Toki. Calling in remotely.
I would be there with you in person if the situation wasn't so dire.
Even during an emergency, Toki's shop is still open.

Yes. Sensei. I'm here.
I won't run away or hide.
Wait, no... Could it be that, if I suddenly disappear, you'll earnestly search for me?!

What do you think, Sensei?
It comes with heat retention, stability, and even calming capabilities.
This combat suit is excellent, just like me.

Sensei, discover all of my suit's new features with me.
There is no need to hold back. You can hold me as long as you desire.

Yes. Sensei. I'm here.
I won't run away or hide.
Wait, no... Could it be that, if I suddenly disappear, you'll earnestly search for me?!

What do you think, Sensei?
It comes with heat retention, stability, and even calming capabilities.
This combat suit is excellent, just like me.

Sensei, discover all of my suit's new features with me.
There is no need to hold back. You can hold me as long as you desire.
Please hold on.
I'll recall the product's location with the memory of a perfect maid.
Although we had no option but to handle this online, it is still business as usual.
The best agent can operate anywhere, after all.

Thank you for your purchase.
Say the word, and I can make the purchase as well.
That's what you want. Understood.
Do you want to spend quality time together, until the item is back in stock?
That's the kind of thing you like. Noted.
Yes. Here you go. Please come again.
Please come see me again.

Yes. Here you go. Please come again.
Please come see me again.
That's a good item.
Please grab that item from the back shelf.
If you made an accidental transaction, you can have a full refund.
...I am sorry. Apparently, you can't.
If you'd like, I can add a chance for a phone call with me as a complimentary gift.
Naturally, you want it, right?

Normal.Transcription: Blue Archive!
President, infiltrator, rear support. Akeboshi Himari, the beautiful, super-genius, and delicate omniscient hacker, making a flawless entrance. Thank you for waiting, Sensei.
(The thermostat must be set too low in here.)
This is a nice place to relax.
Caffeine, in moderation, can be helpful.
Having somewhere you can rest is important.
No thank you to any cold drinks.
Thank you, Sensei. Ideally, we won't need to draw our weapons at all... But it's important to be prepared.
"Anyone can grow at any time"... I'm sure Sensei would say something like that.
Growing by yourself is a difficult thing... It'd seem I'm who I am today thanks to you, Sensei.
I know, Sensei. I should never let my guard down, but I must be flexible as well.
Growth is something to celebrate... Yes, I know that well. However, it makes me think of how much you've done for me, Sensei. Please don't push yourself too hard.
What do you think of my new suit? Isn't it flattering on me? Of course it is!
They say people aren't meant to live alone. Lately, I've really come to understand what that means. ...Surely, you would never leave me all alone, would you, Sensei?
Ever since I met you, everything has been unpredictable, even for an omniscient like me. And... I'm sure it will continue to be so moving forward.
For a moment, could I be vulnerable with you...? Stay with me. Even if it just for now. Thank you, Sensei. I'm happy. Truly.

Battle.Transcription: Fufu. Did I make you wait?
When it comes to speed, I'll never lose.
Do you want one? Would you like me to make you one?
Do you need my help? Of course you do.

Lobby.Transcription: I knew you would arrive right now, Sensei.
How did I know?
Fufu, that's a secret. A true beauty is shrouded in secrets, after all.
Thank you for the hard work, Sensei.
...Hm? Why do you look so puzzled?
How did I get to Schale? Naturally I came on this...
..."wheelchair".
Aren't you curious what your lucky color is today?
Hm? Why am I suddenly asking this?
I thought I'd change your monitor background to that color, Sensei.
...You don't have to be so modest.
Although the AI field has made great strides...
...the general consensus is that AI can't completely replace people yet.
Because some things can only be done by people.
For example...
...something like this.
If there's anything that's burdening or bothering you...
...please feel free to tell me anytime.
Because right now, I can quite literally...
..."fly" to you.
Mmm... Hmm... Huh?
Yes. Sensei. I was sleeping a little.
More precisely, I was studying the relationship between REM and non-REM sleep.
...Are you hoping to join me, Sensei?
Because right now, I'm your exclusive life support...
...and beautiful, super-genius, and delicate omniscient hacker.
Fufu. You're so lucky, Sensei. Don't you agree?
...As am I.
Happy birthday, Sensei.
Did you really think I wouldn't know?
I see. How about, for your gift, we go on a tour together?
Hello, Sensei. Do you know what today is?
Correct, it is my birthday. Therefore, I'm here for my birthday gift.
So, for my present... I would like to invite you to ride on my backseat.
Hm? That's all?
Of course. That's exactly what I wanted.
Spending time with you is the best gift I could ask for, Sensei.
Happy New Year.
I'm sure many things will happen again this year.
But others still won't change at all.
Like how charming I am.
...I'll keep showing off my best charm for you, okay, Sensei?
"It's not rational to feel excited because it's Christmas."
...Some people say.
However, there's a certain truth that can only discovered in the irrational.
Well then, Sensei? Would you mind escorting me?
I'm okay wherever, or to whatever, it is.
Halloween has become too much of a production these days.
Regardless, if it's simply a reason to enjoy another day, perhaps that has its own meaning.
Well, there's that, and also that I'm in a mood for some tricks today...
I'll pass on the treats! ♪

Normal.Transcription: Blue, Archive!
Aris, on my way!
This! It looks very much like Kei!
I am a bit sleepy...
This is a no-PK zone!
(Scan complete. Hostile signatures... None.)
Where is the charger?
Sword of Light has always illuminated the path for me. Just like... Sensei!
Sensei has always protected me. Now, I will protect Sensei.
I want to learn more! I want to know more!
There are lots of adventurers who are stronger than me! I want to become stronger!
In every world, a hero fights against the demon lord. But is there no option to not fight?
Sensei, please continue to stay with me!
I knew it! I really like you, Sensei!
I wish to adventure through lots of worlds with you!
Right now, I feel happy to be here with you. Do you feel the same way, Sensei?

Battle.Transcription: Mission complete! Moving to the next level!
Situation clear... Sensei! How was I?
Landing approval confirmed... I have returned!
This is my max power...! Blinding Light!
I can see it...! So this is the world of Mach...!
My magic power level is at...100%!
Tear the darkness asunder, power of light!
Would you like to fly with me, Sensei?
Scan complete. I have taken control of this area!
Mission clear! No further hostile signatures detected.

Lobby.Transcription: Fufu, I knew you would arrive at this very moment!
My auto-detection system told me!
Sensei, I was waiting for you!

It is okay!
I would wait for you forever!
This suit's flight mechanics are very similar to a game I played before.
However, unlike in that game, it is first-person in real life!
I wish to see from a third-person perspective!
Sensei? What is wrong?

Ah! So you saw!
Yes! I DID come in from the window!
In this mode, I have both light and flying attributes!
...Eh? It is dangerous, and I should still use the door like normal?
This equipment is still unstable, so it requires regular maintenance!

However, there is no cause for concern!
Himari, Rio, and even Utaha...
They all said I could bring it to them anytime!
However... If I ask one person, the other two will be upset...

What should I do...?
Eek...!
Uwaaah... These wings are so big that they bump into everything.
How does one with wings usually move?
The person I know with biggest wingspan...
Ah! I will ask the head prefect later!

Kei said I will turn out like Momoi if I keep playing video games...
What does she mean by that?
I like Momoi, so I wish to be like Momoi!
...What is wrong, Sensei? Your reaction was identical to Kei's!
Happy birthday, Sensei!
Since it is your birthday, that means that you were born today!
It is a bit interesting to think of a time when Sensei did not exist.
Fufu. Sensei, do you remember?
Today is the day when Sensei and I—the day when everyone and I, met!
Although I do not remember when I was born...
...there is no doubt that today is my birthday!
Happy New Year, Sensei!
It is unfortunate...but I cannot join you in this next journey.

For I have a pact with my online friends to see the sunrise in-game together this year.
Therefore, I must stay up all night playing...

Eh...? We are going to go outside RIGHT NOW??
Waah! How could this happen to me...?

Bum bum bum!
I will be operating as Santa for the day!
I will be flying in the sky and giving people gifts in place of Santa, who is too busy today!
Ah, I forgot to give Sensei a role. Um...
...Ah! Sensei, you are Rudolph!
Wah! Sensei, help me!
There are people chasing me asking for photos!
But this is not a costume!

Event.Transcription: Sensei! A mission! It is a mission!
What do I need to do today?
Ah, I was supposed to organize...
I am greeting you remotely, Sensei! Aris, here!

This has become a situation...
But let us overcome it together!

Hu. Hu. Hu...
How is it, Sensei? This is my new armor!

Even without armor...
In fact, even if I lose the Sword of Light...
No matter what, I am still Aris.
As long as I am with everyone!
And as long as I am with Sensei!

Malkuth...
She must be the final boss!
By the way... There will not be a hidden boss, right...?

If we get return safely...
I desire to introduce Kei to everyone!

Bum bum bum!
Sensei has earned a reward!

You are very cool, Sensei!
We shall do it one by one!
Boo... I wish to celebrate by Sensei's side too!
Yes! I really like Sensei, because you never change!

Normal.Transcription: I need to do this, right...? Blue Archive.
It's Kei. I don't know why you're in such a rush, but... Fine. I'll keep looking after you, Sensei.
(I'm...also a "student." So I'm sure something like a Cafe would be...!)
I wonder...what that tastes like?
I see... So this is what it means to feel relaxed...
Getting my own body...has its drawbacks too...
Heehee... Just standing up feels nice...
It means...starlight from far away, to put it simply. Though, that may also signify time in the distant past. But they also say the past and future can coexist, depending on the coordinates.
...I've gotten stronger. Yes, I know. I'll admit, I couldn't have done it without you. That's why I'll keep fighting.
To resist, I must go forward. In the past, I was determined to do it on my own... But, in the end, people aren't meant to live alone.
Seriously, I've already said it before! I'm grateful, okay?! That's the first you've ever heard that? Well, you've heard it now, so we're good!
A-All right... I'm only going to say this once, so listen up! None of this would've been possible without you. Thank you...
Wh-What is it?! I'm not going to say anything! Ugh... Fine... I-It's not like I hate you. Are we good now?
Why do you look so gloomy? What? Because you think I hate you? Th-That's not what I meant... ...I just have to stay by your side until you feel better, right...?
What? Since I insist, you're not going to do anything to me...? Wh-When did I say that?! I just...! Ah!! You're teasing me again, aren't you?!?!
*inhale* *sigh*...I-I'm going out of my way to say this! So you better listen! ...Don't do anything too dangerous. I'd hate it...if you weren't around anymore.

Battle.Transcription: Can't be helped, since Sensei asked. I guess.
As expected. Did you see that, Sensei?
Hmph. You should thank me more, Sensei.
Because this is all your fault!!
Don't you dare make me do something weird.
Fine, I get it. I'll do it.
Kyaaah...?! I-Is this funny to you?!
Well, I guess that's what this amounted to.
That was simple. Anything else? It's only because I don't want it to bother me later!

Lobby.Transcription: What have you been getting up to? You're late!
...I've already prepped everything, so come sit.
Ah, you're here. Let's get started then.
...What's with that smug look on your face?!
Stop calling me cute!
D-Do I hate it? I-It's more of...!
...Don't JUST call me cute...
Why am I always mad?
That's rude. I'm not even that bad.
But well... Look at the world around us.
Things are such a mess, isn't it almost stranger to NOT be furious?
I'll say this while I have the chance.
You're eating properly, right? And you'd best be exercising well.
It's beneficial for adults to go to bed and wake up early too!
Work hard, but in moderation. And relax in moderation.
...Geez, you really are a handful.
Ugh, seriously! Stop treating me like I'm some obedient child!
...I'm not a child.
You laughed?! Sensei, you just laughed, right?! I saw you!
Just you wait! I'll make you rue the day you were born!
What. Don't call me for me if it's not important.
What? Making sure I'm safe and sound is your job?
Seriously, this adult just says anything!
But, you know... I suppose even being able to be like this is nice.
Hello, Sensei.
What? Don't I have anything to say?
I don't.
I really don't, so just leave it at that!
Happy...birthday. Sensei.
What?! My birthday? M-More importantly, it's Aris' birthday...!
What? ...They're on the same day anyways?! Well! That's true, but...!
...Thank you.
Happy New Year. New Year's Day... The first day of the year, I guess.
No. I should get used to this way of life now.
I'm a full fledged "student" now, after all.
It's not like I'm expecting a gift or anything.
I wouldn't refuse one, however. Naturally.
D-Do you really not have one for me?
...! Th-Thank you...
A day when ghosts return. What a superstitious festival...
Gimme candy!!

Event.Transcription: It's something like...a Total Assault in a state of emergency.
I'm managing the shop, even if it is remotely.
Please hurry, Sensei. I have an emergency on this side!
Malkuth... And those brats...
Seriously! No one listens to anyone around here!
When it's all over... Do you think that we'll be able to get back?
It should be there! Hurry!
Hurry and make your purchase, then get back to command!
What? You want my sales greeting to be nicer?
Geez! There's a time and place for everything!
We can't do this without Sensei...

Is there anything else you need?
Whatever you need, don't hesitate to ask.
It's important to stay consistent.

Are you listening, Sensei?
You need to be diligent!

Welcome, Sensei.
Let's organize what we need to do today.

What's going on?
What? You called me for no reason?
Don't call me if you have nothing to talk about!
...Once in a while is fine, though, I guess.
I-I'm not ticklish at all!
I'm not ticklish...!
AAAHHH! Take this! TICKLE ATTACK!!
...Here. Go ahead. Take it.
Wh-What now?! You want a compliment or something?!
...Good job, Sensei.
Yes. I knew you'd pull it off in no time.
Why are you patting my head all of a sudden?!
...I didn't tell you to stop, though...?

Don't forget to rest when you can, Sensei.
And to brush your teeth!
You're not hurt anywhere, right? Great. That's a relief.

Is there anything else you need?
Whatever you need, don't hesitate to ask.

Normal.Transcription: Blue, Archive.
In these situations... I should change, too. What do you think, Sensei. Do I look good?
Ugh... Need caffeine...
I want to come here again, just us two.
Maybe I'll sit there...
This backpack is oddly warm.
It's peaceful here...
This is my first time using this type of weapon... But I'll get used to it for the mission's sake... And for Sensei's.
Maybe I've grown a little.
Proper growth is essential. Even if it's for the sake of operational efficiency.
Thank you, Sensei. You helped me get a little stronger.
Did I change a little? In the end, people eventually change right in front of each other.
I've been having this thought. I might be a little self-indulgent. Which is why...wouldn't it be more efficient for Sensei to look after me all the time?
Come a little closer. See? It's perfect, now that we're right next to each other. Isn't it efficient to share body heat?
Looking back, there are lots of mysterious things in the world. But the most mysterious of them all...is you. Fufu. Sensei, you're really interesting.
If something happens, come find me. I'll protect you. No matter the cost.

Battle.Transcription: Thank you. Please continue providing support.
Did you see that, Sensei? I did it.
It's okay now, Sensei. There are no more threats.
This will be a little hot.
I am the designated shooter today.
Locking on Sensei's heart... I'm really not used to this.
What do you think, Sensei? Did I do well?

Lobby.Transcription: I watched you approach through the scope. I'm looking forward to working with you again today.
Do you want a warm cup of coffee? Mine is iced, so be careful not to mix them up.
Am I feeling hot? Hm, I wonder. I'm fine, for now...
But even if it's hot, as long as I can stay with Sensei...
I might be able to endure forever.
I hope you call me for Student Rep duty more often,
if only for the sake of my own efficiency.
Mm, my studying isn't progressing just by being at Schale...
I just want to stay next to Sensei.
Here, Sensei. All done.
Heehee. I finished pretty early, right?
You won't find an excellent student like me anywhere else... Right? What do you think, Sensei?
You know how people say I should speak with other people's feelings in mind?
I thought that sounded inefficient.
But now... I think I understand a little.
Because I'm curious to know...how Sensei feels and what Sensei thinks.
Sensei often tells me to
get along with others...
...But yeah, it's really a hassle.
As long as I have Sensei, that's more than enough for me.
I didn't forget. Today is Sensei's birthday.
I've safely secured the surrounding perimeter, so...
If you don't mind, why don't we go out together?
...Just us two.
My birthday... Thank you for celebrating it.
Hm? What do I want as my gift?
It's fine. I already have it.
A gift called Sensei.
It's already New Year's...
Before, it was just one out of 365 days out there.
But it might be a bit different now.
Heehee, Happy New Year, Sensei.
You know, I enjoy Christmas.
Because it's chilly.
Hm? There are Christmases that aren't chilly...? I don't think I like that.
Halloween... I used to simply think of it as a day when I can replenish calories.
But I plan on truly enjoying the festivities this time.
Of course, I'm going to play tricks and get treats too. I don't plan on holding back.

Event.Transcription: Ya-ho! Do you copy, Sensei?
Since we're in a state of emergency, we have to connect with comms.
Even if it's through the lines, it's nice to see you.

Fresh air secured...
But it's still hot. Maybe if I take off more clothes...?
Hm? I shouldn't do that? Is that so...
Well, if you say so, Sensei...
I'm more of a marksman than a sniper right now.
That's why I need to move with the team.
...I'm glad we've moved somewhere cooler.
Sensei, chatting with you really is fun.
Here, good work.

Normal.Transcription: Blue... Phew... Archive...!
Hanaoka Yuzu here... E-Even though I look like this right now, please take care of me...
(I think I now know...how precious peaceful everyday life is.)
The sofa isn't going to suddenly deploy or anything, right...?
It's warm, it smells good... It's nice, heehee.
A cabinet... Ugh, I don't want to go in one of those for a while...
I knew it. This outfit stands out too much... Augh...
Practice like it's real, treat it like it's a game...! I'll do my best...!
I'm starting...to get the hang of it...!
I-I have to get stronger...! B-Because I don't know when I'll get ejected. Augh...
I'm scared, but I'm not shaking. Could this be...courage...?
Even if I can't go forward, I won't back out either...!
Um... I'm not embarrassed in front of you, Sensei...
Sensei, um, would you...like to game together?
Um, could you...hold my hand one more time?
The outside world is still a bit scary, but, if Sensei is there... Then I'll...

Battle.Transcription: It's okay, I've done it once before...!
I'll put in the commands. My hands remember how...!
Me?! But I never agreed to roll out?!

Lobby.Transcription: Eek...! Th-This outfit is, um...
...W-Welcome, Sensei...
I-I was waiting for you, Sensei...!

Let's move out...
No, no. Shall we get started with Student Rep duty...?!

This outfit is more comfortable than it looks...
But it's more embarrassing than how comfortable it is...
Doesn't the texture of this suit seem strange? I feel like even a bullet would slide off.
I'm certain that everything is covered, but I feel naked... Augh...
This suit... For some reason, it seems like it can be linked with a computer...
Will this...help with Student Rep duties?

A-Are you feeling hot?
Um, this suit feels quite cool on the surface...
Happy birthday...!

Um, as your gift,
I prepared a game...package...
A-Are you okay with it...?

Th-Thank you, Sensei.
For not forgetting about me...
Many things happened, but the year passes by in the end.
...Happy New Year, Sensei.
I don't have a Santa outfit, but this is similar, so...
M-Merry Christmas, Sensei!
Th-There are people in the streets with outfits even more daring than mine...!
...Um, of course, it's not like I wanted to be daring...!

Event.Transcription: W-Welcome, Sensei...
It's supposed to be...something like a shop, but it's a bit small, isn't it...?
Ugh... It's a bit scary... Auuugh...
Sensei... You're not going to forget about me, right...?
I'm trying to do what I can...
But everyone's so much more impressive than I am...
Ah... yes...! That one, you mean...!
Talk like a clerk... Talk like a clerk...
Thank you as always!
H-Here you go...
